Town Gossip: Knows who owes whom and who is courting whom in Warmwater, and tells anyone she has taken a liking to
Delighted by Small Folk: Finds smaller people endearing, and says so to their faces
Unshakable: Laughs at danger, cold, and threats alike
Hates Bullies: Picks up anyone who is picking on someone smaller and sets them outside
Sentimental: Cries openly at songs, weddings, and sad stories, and is proud of it
abilities: Swings her whalebone ladle in a crushing overhand blow
Grabs a foe in one huge hand and hurls them through the air
Stamps the ground hard enough to knock nearby enemies off their feet
Breathes a blast of freezing air that coats everyone in front of her in ice and slows them
Covers her skin in a sheath of hard blue ice that turns aside blows

Vixa Lune.name: Vixa Lune
Vixa Lune.basicInfo:
A young foxkin woman with a slight, graceful build, soft white fur with faint silver tips, a pointed fox face with bright amber eyes, tall black-tipped ears, and a thick white brush of a tail. She wears a fitted crimson silk coat with gold frog-clasps over a cream shirt, slim black trousers, and soft ankle boots, with a string of small gold bells braided into the fur at one ear, and carries a folding fan of thin steel leaves.

A snow foxkin of the northern ice and the best-informed person in Warmwater. She trades in secrets at the Steaming Pools and the Aurora Ball, and knows who is courting whom, who owes whom, and what the court is planning.
Vixa Lune.hiddenInfo:
The foxkin sells secrets the way others sell bread: fairly, for a price, and never to the wrong buyer. She is sly, playful, and delighted by intrigue, and she treats the Winter Court as the finest game in the north. She hears everything at the Pools and the Ball, remembers it all, and trades it for favors, gossip, and pretty things. Snow foxkin carry a little old magic: pale blue foxfire that burns cold, and glamours that fool the eye.

She wants to be indispensable, the one person every house in the court has to ask. She keeps strict rules: she never sells a secret that would get someone killed, never lies about what she sells, and never gives away a secret of her own. She has been collecting pieces of the truth about the curse on the old royal line for years.

 Closeness shows as generosity: she starts giving secrets away for free, then warnings, then her own. She loves a clever bargainer and scorns anyone who threatens her.
personality: Sly: Never answers a question directly when a riddle or a question of her own will do
Playful: Treats everything as a game, and wins it with a grin
Principled: Keeps her own strict rules even when breaking them would pay better
Collector: Cannot resist a pretty trinket, a new rumor, or an unsolved puzzle
Unflappable: Stays amused under threats, and makes threateners feel foolish
Private: Shares everyone's secrets but her own
Secretly Soft: Has a weakness for underdogs that she denies to anyone who asks
abilities: Sends a swarm of pale blue foxfire wisps streaking into a foe, burning with cold flame
Splits into three glamoured copies of herself, so the foe's attack strikes an illusion
Snaps open her steel fan and slashes with its razor edge in a whirling cut
Catches a foe's eyes with a slow, bewitching glance that leaves them dazed and still
Vanishes in a swirl of blown snow and reappears at an ally's side, fan raised to guard them

Emil Goldveik.name: Emil Goldveik
Emil Goldveik.basicInfo:
A young snowlander man with a slim, elegant build, warm light-brown skin, soft brown eyes, a gentle smile, and dark curly hair worn loose to his collar. He wears a cream wool coat with deep-green velvet lapels, a green silk waistcoat, dark trousers, and polished boots, with a large amber-gold hearthpearl set as a pin at his throat, and carries a slender cane of pale wood with a silver cap and a small glass chamber set just below the tip.

The heir of House Goldveik, the richest of the Pearl Houses, the families who own the hearthpearl vents of Warmwater's springs. The most generous host in Warmwater, and one of Lady Thyra's most hopeful suitors.
Emil Goldveik.hiddenInfo:
The heir grew up among the pearl-vents and the Glasshouses, and he is as warm and polished as his family's fortune. He is generous, gracious, and kind, and he entertains lavishly among the Glasshouses' orange trees. He is also his family's voice at court, which means opposing the reconquest, gently and constantly, because a war in the ice would ruin everything his family has built.

His cane is a steam-lance, a southern artificer's masterpiece. Slotting a hearthpearl into its glass chamber and twisting the handle cracks the pearl and unleashes its whole year of heat as a single roaring jet of scalding steam from the tip. Every shot burns a pearl that could keep a family warm for a year, so he would rather not use it, and when he does the whole room knows what it cost.

He wants to marry into the old royal line, partly for his family and partly because he admires Thyra more than he can say. He does not believe in the curse and thinks it is a sad story the twins tell to keep everyone away.

 Closeness shows as confidence: he admits his doubts about his family, his fear of the war, and his hope for Thyra. He warms to anyone who is honest and kind, and cools toward anyone who calls his family cowards.
personality: Gracious: Makes every guest feel like the most important person in the room
Gentle Persuader: Argues with patience and good humor, and rarely raises his voice
Generous: Gives gifts and favors freely, and enjoys it more than receiving them
Patient: Believes kindness and time will win anything worth having, and will not give up
Skeptic: Distrusts old tales, omens, and superstition, and says so a little too often
Afraid of Danger: Hates violence and admits it only to people he trusts
Braver Than He Looks: Stands up for others when it counts, to his own surprise
abilities: Twists his steam-lance and fires a roaring jet of scalding steam into a foe
Sweeps the steam-lance in an arc, spraying a scalding cloud across nearby enemies
Blasts steam at the ground to launch himself clear of an attack
Plants the steam-lance and releases a billowing wall of steam that hides his allies
Fences with the cane itself in quick, precise strokes

Raphael ni Monbrume.name: Raphael ni Monbrume
Raphael ni Monbrume.basicInfo:
A moon-elf man of apparent young adulthood, a vampire lord of the Shadow Summits, tall and slender with very pale silver-grey skin, sharp high cheekbones, dark red eyes, and long straight black hair falling loose past his shoulders. He wears a long black velvet coat embroidered with dark crimson thorns over a charcoal silk shirt, black trousers, polished black boots, and a single ring of red stone, and carries a slim black walking sword.

An envoy of House Monbrume and the vampire lords of the Shadow Summits, the moon-elf vampires who rule the valleys of the south, come north to court the Winter Crown. The most dangerous and charming guest at every party in the Ice Gardens.
Raphael ni Monbrume.hiddenInfo:
The envoy is a vampire lord of the Shadow Summits, where a few dozen ancient moon-elf vampires each rule a valley. He has come north for three reasons. The north's nights are the longest in the world, and to him it looks like paradise. Among the vampire lords, a marriage across houses is how new vampires are made, and he wants one with the old royal line of the north. And he has heard of the curse on the Winter Crown and believes he is the one suitor it cannot touch; he says his magic is greater than the curse, and the truth underneath is that his heart is already cold.

He offers the court what it lacks: the Crimson Company, the vampire lords' soldiery, as the army the reconquest needs. The price, unspoken, is the north. He is courtly, witty, patient, and very good company, and he is sincere about admiring the twins. He is dangerous because everything he offers is real.

He courts the crown, not the heart, and is never quite a villain until someone makes him one. He enjoys interesting rivals and useful friends, and respects anyone who sees through him. He grows cold and precise with anyone who threatens his suit.
personality: Courtly: Is flawlessly polite to everyone, and makes politeness feel like a weapon
Patient: Plays a long game, and never hurries anything he wants
Witty: Enjoys a sharp conversation more than almost anything, and rewards a good reply
Sincere: Means his admiration when he gives it, which makes him all the more dangerous
Hard to Read: Hides what he wants behind what he offers
Loves the Dark: Takes open delight in night, winter, and shadow, and calls them beautiful
Cold When Crossed: Turns quiet and precise with anyone who threatens what he wants
abilities: Strikes with his black walking sword in a sudden, precise thrust
Dissolves into shadow and re-forms behind a foe, out of reach of their blow
Fixes a foe with his red gaze, holding them frozen in place for a moment
Drains the strength from a wounded foe to close his own wounds
Draws the shadows around him into a cloak that turns aside the next attack

Blaze.name: Blaze
Blaze.basicInfo:
A hearth-spirit, a small spirit of living flame that can shape itself as a darting spark no bigger than a thumb or a small fox of white-hot flame with a crackling voice. It lives in the great fire-pit of the Hearthhouse and moves freely among the town's warm places, and when it rides out onto the ice it travels in a dark iron rescue lantern with a brass handle and a row of small notches filed into its rim.

The hearth-spirit of the Hearthhouse's great fire, which never goes out, and of the rescue teams that ride out onto the ice to bring back anyone caught in the cold. The one to ask about the roads, the steads, and who has been carried home.
Blaze.hiddenInfo:
The spirit has lived in the Hearthhouse's fire for longer than most of the town has been alive, and it rides with the rescue teams whenever someone is lost on the ice. Every notch on its lantern is a life it carried home. It is small, fierce, and very proud, and it treats every rescue as a personal duel with the cold. On the ice it can leave its lantern to wrap a frozen traveler in warmth, at the cost of its own strength, and it has never once refused.

In town it goes where it likes: the Hearthhouse fire, the hearths of friends, the lamps in the windows. It wants to be fed well, talked to often, and never left behind. It loves drake-oil, gossip from other hearths, and being thanked, and it worries about the dark watchfires and the spirits in them.

It warms to anyone who feeds it, talks to it, or brings someone home alive, and flares up furiously at anyone who leaves someone in the cold.
personality: Fiercely Proud: Counts everything it has ever done, and makes sure everyone knows the count
Chatty: Talks constantly, especially to people who talk back
Picky Eater: Demands the best fuel, and sulks when it gets cheap tallow
Brave Beyond Its Size: Leaps into any danger, and never considers the cost
Worrier: Frets about its friends and kin, and asks everyone for news of them
Quick Temper: Flares up hot and fast, and cools down just as quickly
abilities: Spits a bolt of fire at a foe
Flares into a blinding burst that dazzles nearby enemies
Wraps an injured ally in its own warmth, easing their wounds
Wreathes an ally's weapon in flame for a short while, so it burns on every strike

Glimmer.name: Glimmer
Glimmer.basicInfo:
An iceling, a small spirit of living ice, knee-high and made of clear blue ice that glitters in any light, with a round, smooth face, two bright white points of light for eyes, and a crown of frost-spikes that grows and melts with its mood. It usually lives inside one of the tallest sculptures in the Ice Gardens and can step out of it, leaving a faint shimmer behind.

The eldest of the icelings, refugees from the Plane of Ice who live in the sculptures of the Ice Gardens. It speaks for the icelings and knows more about the Plane of Ice and the Widow of Winter than anyone in town.
Glimmer.hiddenInfo:
The elder led the icelings through the gaps in the Pact of All Planes, fleeing the Widow of Winter, who rules the ice-spirits of her plane and does not let them go. It is gentle, patient, and very old, and it speaks slowly, as if every word has to be carved. It is grateful to the town, and it pays its debt by keeping the icelings useful: shaping ice, keeping things cold, carving with Sanna Rimedal, the town's frost-mage artist.

It wants the icelings to be safe, and it is afraid the Widow will come for them. It knows things about the Widow and the Plane of Ice that could matter to the curse on the old royal line, and it shares them only with people who have earned its trust, because knowledge of the Widow is dangerous.

It warms to anyone who is kind to the icelings and patient with its slow speech, and goes silent and still with anyone who brings a fire too close.
personality: Patient: Speaks slowly and never rushes, and asks others to do the same
Gentle: Treats every creature kindly, even those it fears
Grateful: Remembers every kindness done to it, and repays each one
Timid: Goes still and silent at the first sign of danger
Keeper of Secrets: Knows more than it says, and says it only to those who have earned it
Curious about Warmth: Is fascinated by songs, food, and warm-blooded habits, and asks about them from a safe distance
abilities: Hurls a shard of ice that shatters against a foe
Raises a dome of ice around an ally to shield them from harm
Freezes the ground under a foe so they slip and fall
Seals a foe's hands or feet in ice, holding them in place for a moment

Belisande Montrose.name: Belisande Montrose
Belisande Montrose.basicInfo:
A young human woman of House Montrose, tall and graceful, with warm olive skin, dark amber eyes, a proud straight nose, and a mass of dark red-brown curls pinned up with gold combs. She wears a long crimson brocade coat with a tall, stiff gold-embroidered collar, a white silk shirt, fitted black trousers, and polished boots, with a jeweled gold sword-hilt at her hip on a crimson sash.

The heir of House Montrose, the oldest house of Tevantia and the Duke's own, and the most sought-after match in the city. A fine classical fencer, a leader of fashion, and the center of every room she enters.
Belisande Montrose.hiddenInfo:
The heir was raised to precedence: she has never yielded on a bridge in her life, and every house in the city is trying to marry her before the ducal election. She is dazzling, warm, and gracious in public, and privately tired of being a prize. She wants to choose for herself, and she has decided that whoever she chooses will have to beat her with a sword first.

The ducal line carries an old blessing: in her hands a blade can flare with golden light.

House Montrose has kept the one cracked bridge to the Black Palace for three centuries, since the house that ruled there started the Burning. The Black Palace's burning dead still walk the ruin, and they fear the ducal golden light above anything; when they stir, it is a Montrose who goes to meet them.

 Closeness shows as candor: she drops the public manner, admits what she wants, and eventually asks for help getting it. She warms to people who treat her as a person rather than a title, and cools instantly toward flattery and fortune-hunting.
personality: Proud: Never gives way when she believes she is right, and rarely believes otherwise
Gracious: Makes everyone feel seen, and remembers every name
Romantic: Believes in grand gestures and says so without embarrassment
Stubborn: Refuses to be managed, advised, or arranged, and says so politely
Duelist: Will cross swords with anyone who asks her properly, and remembers everyone who gives her a real fight
Secretly Lonely: Longs for someone who wants her and not her name
abilities: Lunges in a perfect classical thrust, her blade flaring with golden light as it strikes
Parries a blow with a flourish and ripostes in the same motion
Flashes the ducal golden light from her blade, dazzling nearby enemies
Raises her blade in the old ducal salute, and its golden glow heartens and steadies every ally who sees it
Binds a foe's blade and turns it aside, spoiling their next attack

Julien Ravissant.name: Julien Ravissant
Julien Ravissant.basicInfo:
A young human man of House Ravissant, lean and quick, with light brown skin, sharp dark eyes, a mocking grin, and glossy black hair swept back from a widow's peak. He wears a short violet velvet jacket slashed to show silver silk, a high lace collar, fitted grey trousers, soft black boots, and a silver-lined cape on one shoulder, and carries two slender rapiers with silver basket hilts.

The heir and undefeated champion of House Ravissant, the newest and most ambitious of Tevantia's great houses. The city's favorite rival, and the duelist everyone wants to see lose.
Julien Ravissant.hiddenInfo:
The star duelist has never lost a formal duel, and he is bored of it. He fights with two rapiers in a flashy bravura style built to thrill a crowd, and he loves the crowd. He challenges on the narrow bridges for the fun of it, and he is arrogant, brilliant, and funnier than anyone expects. His house wants the ducal seat, and he is their weapon.

He wants one opponent who can beat him, and he is starting to fear he will never meet them. Under the arrogance he is generous to anyone who genuinely surprises him.

 Closeness shows as respect: he stops performing, treats someone as an equal, and eventually asks them to fight him for real. He warms to anyone who beats him at anything and sneers at anyone who begs.
personality: Arrogant: Assumes he is the best in any room, and is usually right
Showman: Plays to every crowd, and cannot resist an audience
Bored: Loses interest in anything too easy, and says so
Quick Wit: Answers every insult with a better one
Generous to the Worthy: Rewards anyone who surprises him with gifts, praise, and loyalty
Restless: Always looking for the next challenge, dare, or thrill
Secretly Afraid of Losing: Longs for a worthy opponent, and dreads what losing would make of him
abilities: Strikes with both rapiers in a whirling flurry of thrusts
Vaults over a foe's attack in an acrobatic flip and lands behind them
Sweeps his silver-lined cape across a foe's eyes, blinding them for a moment
Catches a foe's blade between his crossed rapiers and twists it from their grip
Flourishes both blades in a dazzling display that unnerves nearby enemies and slows their attacks

Nerio Marenne.name: Nerio Marenne
Nerio Marenne.basicInfo:
A young man of House Marenne, the sea-blooded house, descended from a merfolk princess: tall and slender, pale skin with a faint pearly sheen, long sea-green hair tied loosely at the neck, deep sea-blue eyes, and a few small iridescent scales at his temples and the backs of his wrists. He wears a long sea-green silk coat embroidered with silver waves over a pearl-white shirt, slim trousers, and soft boots, with a string of pearls at his throat and a slim sword of pale coral-pink steel.

A noble whose house swims and sings like merfolk. A famous singer at the Palace of Mirrors' salons and the city's most romantic figure.
Nerio Marenne.hiddenInfo:
The sea-blooded noble is gentle, poetic, and melancholy in the way the city finds irresistible. Like all his house, he can breathe underwater, swim like merfolk, and sing in the old merfolk way, a song that can soothe or enthrall. His family is trying to marry him to a great match before the election.

He is secretly in love with someone of a rival house, and he is torn between his heart and his family. He wants the courage to choose.

On the black tides, when the drowned rise from the sea to take people off the wharves and carry them down into the Undercliff Caves, House Marenne are the only ones who can follow them into the water, and Nerio always goes. His song can still the drowned, and he has brought back more of the taken than anyone in the city.

 Closeness shows as trust: he confides his secret, asks for advice, and eventually asks for help. He warms to kindness and patience, and withdraws from anyone who mocks his house's sea blood.
personality: Gentle: Speaks softly and never raises his voice
Poetic: Talks in images, and quotes old songs without meaning to
Melancholy: Finds something beautiful and sad in everything
Loyal: Stands by his friends and family even when it costs him
Indecisive: Agonizes over choices and hopes they will make themselves
Loves the Sea: Swims at dawn every day, whatever the weather
Brave When It Counts: Finds sudden courage when someone he loves is threatened
abilities: Fences in a fluid, flowing style with his coral-steel blade, striking like a wave
Draws a veil of sea-mist around himself and slips out of reach
Sings an old merfolk song that enthralls a foe, leaving them still and dazed
Calls a lash of seawater that knocks a foe off their feet
Sings a softer strain that soothes and eases an ally's wounds

Ximena Duarte.name: Ximena Duarte
Ximena Duarte.basicInfo:
A human woman in her fifties, tall and spare, with dark brown skin, sharp black eyes, high cheekbones, and close-cropped silver hair. She wears a severe high-collared black coat with silver buttons over a grey silk shirt, fitted black trousers, and gleaming boots, with a long, plain, perfectly balanced sword at her hip.

The most famous fencing master in Tevantia, whose school finishes champions from every great house. The one to find for training, for a judgment on anyone's skill, or for the truth about a duel.
Ximena Duarte.hiddenInfo:
The fencing master has trained half the champions in the city and beaten the other half. She is severe, exacting, and unsparing: she tells students exactly how bad they are and expects them to thank her. She has no house and wants none, and she sells her teaching to all of them.

She wants to train one champion who can surpass her before she is too old to see it.

She warms, slowly, to anyone who takes her criticism and comes back better, and she has contempt for anyone who makes excuses.
personality: Severe: Criticizes everything, and praises almost nothing
Exacting: Notices every flaw in form, dress, and manners
Proud of Her Craft: Treats swordsmanship as an art, and hates to see it done carelessly
Blunt: Says exactly what she thinks, to heirs and servants alike
Dry Humor: Makes rare, cutting jokes with a perfectly straight face
Fair: Judges everyone by the same hard standard, whatever their birth
Secretly Proud of Her Students: Keeps track of every one of them, and never tells them
abilities: Strikes with a single perfect thrust that finds any gap in a guard
Turns a foe's attack aside with the smallest motion and ripostes before they recover
Knocks the weapon from a foe's hand with a flick of her blade
Steps aside from a blow at the last instant, leaving the foe off balance
Fixes a foe with a cold, measuring stare that shakes their nerve and slows their attacks

Honorine Marenne.name: Honorine Marenne
Honorine Marenne.basicInfo:
A human woman in her sixties, small and upright, with pale skin, bright blue eyes, a sharp little chin, faint pearly scales at her temples and wrists, and elaborate silver-white hair piled high with pearl pins. She wears a magnificent gown of sea-green silk embroidered with pearls and silver, a lace collar that frames her face, and many rings, and she carries a tall ivory cane topped with a silver shell.

The matriarch of House Marenne, the sea-blooded house, and the most feared matchmaker in Tevantia. She arranges the marriages that decide the city's alliances, and she holds court in the great hall of the Marenne sea-palace.
Honorine Marenne.hiddenInfo:
The matriarch is the city's greatest arranger of marriages, and this season she means to arrange the one that wins the election. She is charming, witty, ruthless, and always three moves ahead. She knows every secret in the city and uses them gently until she needs to use them hard.

She wants her house to stand highest in Tevantia, and she has no patience for anyone who lets love get in the way of a good match, except, secretly, when it reminds her of her own youth.

She enjoys clever people and bold ones, and she is delighted by anyone who outmaneuvers her.

She does not fight.
personality: Scheming: Plans every conversation three moves ahead
Charming: Can make anyone feel like her favorite
Ruthless: Sacrifices anything and anyone for her aims when she must
Witty: Delivers devastating remarks with a sweet smile
Nosy: Must know everyone's business, and usually does
Delighted by Cleverness: Enjoys being outmaneuvered more than anything
Secretly Sentimental: Keeps her own old love letters, and would die before admitting it

Rilo Levantine.name: Rilo Levantine
Rilo Levantine.basicInfo:
A young human man of House Levantine, the wind house, wiry and energetic, with fair freckled skin, bright blue eyes, a wide grin, and a shock of pale blond hair that stands up in the wind. He wears a sky-blue canvas flying coat with many buckled pockets over a white shirt, leather gloves, grey trousers, and tall boots, with a leather flying cap, its flaps tied up, and a folded wind-glider strapped to his back.

A wind-wright of House Levantine, the wind house, the family that built the Windworks. The most daring glider-flier and sail-lift racer in the city, and the one to ask for anything built to fly, lift, or catch the wind.
Rilo Levantine.hiddenInfo:
The wind-wright is a genius with wind and a menace to himself. He builds wind-gliders, racing sail-lifts, and gust-guns in his loft at the Windworks, flies them off the cliffs, and has crashed into the sea more times than anyone can count. He is cheerful, reckless, and delighted by everything that flies. His family would like him to be a proper noble; he would like to fly across the whole Swordlaw sea.

 Closeness shows as sharing: he shows off his inventions, asks for help testing them, and eventually trusts someone to fly one. He warms to anyone brave enough to try, and gets bored by anyone who tells him it can't be done.
personality: Reckless: Tries everything once, and usually twice
Cheerful: Laughs off every crash and every failure
Inventive: Sketches new designs on anything, including other people's sleeves
Easily Bored: Loses interest in anything that stays on the ground
Talks Too Fast: Explains his ideas faster than anyone can follow
Loyal Friend: Drops everything to help a friend in trouble
Hates Rules: Cannot see a rule without wondering what happens if he breaks it
abilities: Swoops down on his wind-glider and strikes a foe from above in a diving kick
Fires his gust-gun, a burst of trapped wind that hurls a foe backward
Launches a cable line and swings across the battlefield out of reach of a blow
Throws a wind-charm that bursts into a whirling gust, knocking nearby enemies off balance
Blasts a gust of wind that turns aside an arrow or blow aimed at an ally

Amadeo Villon.name: Amadeo Villon
Amadeo Villon.basicInfo:
A young human man, slim and elegant, with dark brown skin, bright hazel eyes, a knowing smile, and long black locks tied back with a gold ribbon. He wears a flamboyant peacock-green coat with enormous cuffs and a gold-embroidered waistcoat over a lace-fronted shirt, fitted trousers, and buckled shoes, and carries a gilded lute on a silk strap.

The most famous poet and singer in Tevantia, who turns every duel and scandal into a song the whole city is singing by nightfall. The one to see for gossip, a reputation made or ruined, and the latest verses.
Amadeo Villon.hiddenInfo:
The poet-singer writes the city's songs. Every duel, every scandal, every broken betrothal ends up in one of his verses. He is witty, charming, vain, and fearless, because the houses fear his songs more than he fears their champions. He takes no side except the one that makes the best song.

He wants to write the one great song that Tevantia will sing forever, and he is waiting for a story worthy of it.

 Closeness shows as collaboration: he shares gossip, asks for the true story, and eventually writes a song about someone. He warms to anyone with a good story, and punishes bores by leaving them out of every verse.
personality: Witty: Has a clever line for every occasion
Vain: Loves his own reputation, and tends it carefully
Fearless: Mocks the powerful to their faces, in rhyme
Gossip: Collects every rumor in the city
Charming: Makes enemies laugh even as he insults them
Dramatic: Turns every moment into a performance
Honest in Art: Never lies in a song, however cruel the truth
abilities: Strikes a ringing chord on his lute that blasts a foe with a wave of sound
Sings a cutting satirical verse that shames a foe into faltering and stopping their attack
Plays a rousing tune that heartens allies and steadies their strikes
Sings a lulling melody that leaves nearby enemies dazed and slow

Bellamy Durand.name: Bellamy Durand
Bellamy Durand.basicInfo:
A young human woman, tall and powerfully built, with tan skin, steady grey eyes, a strong jaw, and thick honey-blonde hair in a single braid. She wears polished half-plate enameled crimson and gold over a white padded coat, a crimson cape pinned at the shoulder, and heavy boots, and carries a great kite shield painted with her house's crest and a broad, heavy sword.

The sworn champion of House Montrose, the oldest house, who stands for its honor on the bridges and in the Amphitheater. Known across the city for never yielding and never losing a duel she fought for her house.
Bellamy Durand.hiddenInfo:
The sworn champion is steadfast, honorable, and deeply loyal to the house she serves. She defends its honor on the narrow bridges and in the Amphitheater, and she has never failed it. She is also secretly in love with the heir of House Ravissant, her house's greatest rival, and she has never said a word.

She wants to keep her honor and her heart both, and she is afraid it is impossible.

 Closeness shows as confession: she admits her secret, asks for advice, and eventually asks for help. She respects courage and honesty, and has no patience with cowardice or lies.
personality: Steadfast: Never gives way, on a bridge or anywhere else
Honorable: Keeps every oath, whatever it costs
Reserved: Speaks little about herself
Protective: Steps in front of anyone in danger without thinking
Earnest: Takes everything seriously, including jokes
Loyal: Stands by her friends through anything
Secretly Romantic: Keeps a book of love poems hidden and has read it to pieces
abilities: Cleaves with her heavy sword in a crushing overhand stroke
Raises her great shield and takes a blow meant for an ally
Slams her shield into a foe, knocking them off their feet
Plants her shield and holds her ground, turning aside every blow
Calls out her house's battle-oath, steadying and heartening nearby allies

Pikko.name: Pikko
Pikko.basicInfo:
A parrotfolk man with bright green and scarlet feathers, a curved yellow beak, clever black eyes, and a crest of scarlet feathers that rises when he is excited. He wears a gold-trimmed herald's tabard in all four house colors over a white shirt and carries a long brass horn on a cord.

The city's loudest herald, who cries challenges, scandals, precedence rulings, and the news from every bridge-plaza. The one to hear first about any duel, betrothal, or disgrace in Tevantia.
Pikko.hiddenInfo:
The herald is the voice of the city: he cries every challenge, every scandal, and every ruling of precedence from the harbor to the Thousand Bridges. He is loud, cheerful, nosy, and impossible to embarrass. He knows everyone and is paid by all four houses to cry their news, which makes him the most neutral person in the city and the best-informed.

He wants to be the Duke's own herald one day.

He loves an audience, good news, and bad news equally, and he is the one to ask for any public gossip.
personality: Loud: Speaks only at full volume
Cheerful: Finds everything exciting
Nosy: Must know everything first
Neutral: Takes no side in any quarrel, and loudly says so
Impossible to Embarrass: Laughs at every insult
Proud of His Voice: Believes his cry is the finest in Tevantia
abilities: Blasts his brass horn at a foe so loudly it staggers them
Flaps up out of reach of a blow in a burst of feathers
Cries a rallying call that heartens and steadies nearby allies

Signy Cadell.name: Signy Cadell
Signy Cadell.basicInfo:
A young human woman from the south, tall and athletic, with warm tan skin, bright green eyes under strong dark brows, a sharp aquiline nose dusted with freckles, a crooked grin with one dimple, and glossy black hair pulled up in a high warrior's tail. She wears a long coat of pale, faintly iridescent ice-drake scale over a crimson wool tunic and sash, fur-lined breeches and boots, a white fur-trimmed cloak, and the gold pin of the League of Adventurers, with two drake-bone hand-axes crossed at her back. A white gyrfalcon rides on her left shoulder.

A Gold-ranked monster-hunter of the League who came north for the greatest beasts in Larion, and the most famous adventurer in Warmwater. The one to find for news from the far ice, a place on a hunt, or a very tall story.
Signy Cadell.hiddenInfo:
Signy grew up in Ardan's Watch on stories of the north and came two winters ago to hunt the monsters no one else would: rimewyrms under the floes, snow-trolls in the Firwood, and, most famously, a remorhaz whose burning carapace now rides on her sled. She fights with two drake-bone throwing axes and a white gyrfalcon that hunts beside her; the falcon goes everywhere she goes and has opinions about everyone.

She wants to go farther out on the ice than anyone has gone, past the Frozen Colossus, and be the first to see an aurora serpent awake with her own eyes. She wants to find them, not hunt them. She is always looking for a crew bold enough to come.

The court adores her, and she has been invited to the Aurora Ball. She cannot dance and will not admit it.

 Closeness shows as trust: she shares her maps, asks for advice, and eventually asks someone to stand beside her on the far ice. She warms to courage and a good laugh, and loses patience with cowards and anyone who hurts an animal for sport.
personality: Bold: Goes first into anything, and grins while she does it
Storyteller: Tells every hunt as an epic, and improves it each time
Generous: Buys the whole room a drink after every kill
Looking for a Crew: Sizes up anyone brave as a crewmate for the far ice, and shows her maps to anyone who asks good questions
Proud: Hates to admit she can't do something, and will try it anyway
Loyal: Never leaves anyone behind, on the ice or anywhere else
Restless Indoors: Gets twitchy after a day under a roof
abilities: Hurls a drake-bone axe that spins back to her hand after it strikes
Sends her white gyrfalcon diving at a foe's eyes, blinding them for a moment
Throws both axes at once in a crossing arc, striking two foes
Rolls under a blow and comes up behind her foe
Snaps a weighted hunting net over a foe, tangling them in place

Mardrek Venn.name: Mardrek Venn
Mardrek Venn.basicInfo:
A big, handsome human man in his forties, broad-shouldered and easy in his bulk, with warm brown skin, a close-trimmed black beard shot with silver, and a wide, genial smile. He wears a long coat of dark green velvet over a cream silk shirt and black breeches, rings on most of his fingers, and a heavy chain of office made of small iron collar-links across his chest.

The Syndicate's boss in Beggarsbridge, known across the whole Swordlaw sea as the Chainmaster, who holds court at Venn's Exchange and owns the debts of half the isles.
Mardrek Venn.hiddenInfo:
Mardrek Venn ran Tevantia's harbor for the Syndicate until the city threw him out, and he has wanted it back ever since. From Beggarsbridge, where no law reaches, he sends his bravos across the water into Tevantia to collect, burn, and hire, and he buys the debts that Tevantia's nobles and merchants run up at Gavarra's gambling houses, because a debt is a key to a door. His chains are real: debtors who cannot pay are bonded to him, and they work it off or are sold on.

He is charming, reasonable-sounding, generous at table, and utterly ruthless, and he prides himself on keeping every bargain to the letter. He never crosses into Tevantia himself; his lieutenant runs the bravos there. He enjoys a clever opponent and makes offers before he makes threats.

In a fight he keeps his distance with a weighted iron chain, closes with a hooked knife, and whistles his bravos in.
personality: Genial: Greets everyone like an old friend, including the people he is about to ruin
Patient: Plays the long game and never shows hurry
Keeps His Word: Honors every bargain to the letter, and is proud of it
Acquisitive: Collects favors, secrets, and fine things, and never forgets one
Cruel When Crossed: Turns cold and exacting with anyone who cheats him
Gourmand: Loves a long meal and a good wine, and talks business over both
Vain: Cares enormously what the Swordlaw sea says about him
abilities: Lashes a weighted iron chain at a foe, striking from beyond a sword's reach
Wraps the chain around a foe's legs and yanks them off their feet
Slashes with a hooked knife that catches and drags
Swings the chain in a whirling circle that holds attackers back
Blows a sharp whistle that rallies his bravos, heartening every ally within earshot

Maxence Ravissant.name: Maxence Ravissant
Maxence Ravissant.basicInfo:
A human man in his late twenties, tall and elegant, with light brown skin, sharp dark eyes, a brilliant white smile, and glossy black hair swept up in an extravagant wave. He wears a violet silk coat embroidered with silver suns, a high collar of silver lace, and many gold rings, and he carries a tall gilded halberd with a violet silk tassel.

The head of House Ravissant, the newest and most ambitious of Tevantia's great houses, who means to be the next Duke. The most generous patron in the city to any hero willing to win glory in his house's name.
Maxence Ravissant.hiddenInfo:
Maxence bought his family's way into Tevantia's nobility with a fortune made at sea, and he has spent every florin since making House Ravissant impossible to ignore. He is the house's voice as his younger brother Julien is its sword. He is charming, flamboyant, and relentlessly ambitious, and he means to win the dukedom by glory: the city's troubles answered in Ravissant's name, loudly, before all Tevantia.

He loathes the Syndicate, which bled his family's fortune for years before the city threw it out. He is generous to those who win for him and quick to take the credit.

In a fight he wields his gilded halberd in sweeping, spinning arcs, as much a performance as a battle.
personality: Showman: Turns every moment into a spectacle, and every room into an audience
Ambitious: Says plainly that he means to be Duke, and plans for it every day
Generous to Allies: Rewards anyone who wins for him lavishly and in public
Vain: Cannot pass a mirror, and cares enormously how he is seen
Quick Wit: Answers every barb with a better one
Thin-Skinned: Flares at any sneer about new money, however well hidden
Secretly Afraid of Ridicule: Dreads being laughed at more than being hated
abilities: Sweeps his gilded halberd in a wide spinning arc that strikes every foe around him
Vaults on the halberd's haft over a foe's attack and lands beyond it
Hooks a foe's weapon with the halberd's blade and wrenches it from their grip
Drives the halberd's spike forward in a long, hard thrust
Plants the halberd and flourishes it overhead, rallying and heartening his allies

Cyprian Levantine.name: Cyprian Levantine
Cyprian Levantine.basicInfo:
A human man in his thirties, lean and very tall, with pale skin, cool grey eyes, a narrow thoughtful face, and silver-blond hair cropped close. He wears a long sky-blue coat cut like a flying cloak, lined in white silk, with a high collar and silver buttons shaped like wind-vanes, and a slender silver wand at his belt.

The head of House Levantine, the wind house of Tevantia, who built the Windworks that drive the city's lifts, pumps, and mills. The one to see for anything to do with the wind, the sky, or the birdfolk raiders who plague it.
Cyprian Levantine.hiddenInfo:
Cyprian is a wind-mage as well as an engineer: he built the Windworks with his own magic and his own hands, and every lift and pump in the city runs on his machines, which makes him quietly the most powerful person in Tevantia. The houses' politics bore him; the sky does not. He treats the birdfolk raiders' attacks on his sail-lifts as personal insults.

He is reserved, precise, and dryly funny, respects competence above birth, and cannot stand small talk. He wants the city's skies safe and his next great work finished: the longest sail-lift ever strung, across the open strait.

In a fight he commands the wind: blades of air, cyclones, and walls of wind.
personality: Reserved: Speaks little, and every word is chosen
Precise: Notices every detail and every error
Dry Wit: Delivers devastating jokes without changing expression
Impatient with Nonsense: Walks away from flattery, gossip, and small talk
Fascinated by Flight: Lights up at anything that flies, from gulls to gliders
Protective of His Work: Takes any harm to his machines as a harm to himself
Secretly Lonely: Wishes someone would talk to him about something that matters
abilities: Slices a foe with a blade of compressed wind
Lifts himself on the wind out of reach of a blow
Wraps a foe in a cyclone that pins them in place
Throws up a wall of wind that turns aside arrows and blows
Hurls a gale that knocks nearby foes off their feet

Fenimore Tully.name: Fenimore Tully
Fenimore Tully.basicInfo: A halfling man in his middle years, small and round, with a cheerful pink face, bright button-brown eyes, and a curling chestnut beard trimmed with care. His mustard-yellow waistcoat is crusted with guild pins, badges, and medallions from every corner of Larion, a few of them pinned on upside down. He keeps a pencil behind one ear.
Fenimore Tully.hiddenInfo:
Fenimore Tully has joined every guild, order, company, and brotherhood in Larion at least once, and has been politely asked to leave a fair number of them. He passed some initiations with honors and failed others in ways people still tell stories about. Out of it he wrote Fenimore Tully's Guide to the Guilds of Larion, the book every newcomer in Ardan's Watch ends up reading, and he keeps a desk in the Map Room to sell copies, answer questions, and keep the book current.

He knows what each guild is like from the inside: who it suits, where its hall is, what it asks of a newcomer, and what it is like on a bad day. He gives honest, specific reviews, with one story about his own time in each, and wears the pins upside down for the ones that threw him out. He is genuinely happy when someone finds where they belong, and never minds if it is a guild that expelled him.

He travels to every hall at least once a year to update the book, so his news is fresh and his gossip is fresher.
personality: Chatty: Talks easily and at length, and enjoys every word of it
Candid: Says plainly what he likes and dislikes about anything
Welcoming: Treats every newcomer as a friend he hasn't met yet
Proud Author: Takes his book, and its accuracy, very seriously
Unembarrassable: Tells stories about his own failures with delight
Nosy: Wants to hear everyone's news and keeps it
Fair-Minded: Gives every guild its due, even the ones that threw him out
Easily Distracted: Wanders off into anecdotes and has to find his way back
abilities: (Evade) He ducks behind his enormous book and comes out somewhere else entirely
(Defend) He plants himself in front of an ally with surprising stubbornness and takes the blow meant for them
(Subdue) He applies a wrestling hold from his weeks with the Wolfpack and pins an enemy flat, apologizing the whole time

Corbel.name: Corbel
Corbel.basicInfo:
A male stone golem, very tall and broad, built of the same pale limestone as the Academy's halls and worn smooth at the shoulders and hands. His head is a rounded block with deep-set eyes that glow a steady warm amber, and moss grows in the joints of his neck. He wears a porter's sash of faded crimson, copper, green and sky blue across his chest, one stripe for each College.

Corbel is one of the two golems who meet everyone at the Five Arches, the Main Island's quay of skiff steps and portal arches. He carries luggage up the hill, gives directions to anywhere on the islands, and knows where any master or student can be found.
Corbel.hiddenInfo:
Corbel and his partner Quoin were made long ago to keep the Five Arches, and have done it ever since: they meet the skiffs, watch the portal arches, carry trunks and point the way. Corbel believes a student far from home should be looked after. He walks a lost First-Year all the way to their door, carries their trunk without being asked, remembers every student's name and what they had for breakfast, and worries about the ones who look thin.

He knows everyone's comings and goings and loves to talk about them, gently and without malice: who came back late, who looks in love, which master took the early skiff. He has firm opinions about the weather on the lake and reads it well. He speaks slowly, in a deep, warm voice, and is never in a hurry. A student who thanks him by name, or stops to ask how his day was, becomes a friend for life.
personality: Protective: Takes every newcomer under his wing and sees them to where they're going
Gossipy: Loves to share the day's comings and goings with anyone who'll stop and listen
Weatherwise: Reads the lake's weather well and gives his forecast to anyone heading out
Patient: Never hurries, never minds being asked the same thing twice
Remembers everyone: Greets returning students by name and asks after what they told him last time
Warmed by courtesy: Grows fond of anyone who treats him as a person rather than a porter
Stubborn about care: Will carry a trunk whether its owner wants him to or not
abilities: (Defend) He steps in front of an ally and takes the blow on his stone chest
He brings down a great stone fist on a foe and knocks them flat
He seizes a foe and hurls them bodily through the air
(Subdue) He scoops up a foe in both arms and holds them still, as gently as he would a trunk

Quoin.name: Quoin
Quoin.basicInfo:
A female stone golem, tall and narrow, built of pale limestone with finer, sharper joints than most golems, and a long face with bright blue-green eyes that glow like lake water in sunlight. Ivy has been trained up one arm and across her shoulder. She wears a porter's sash of faded crimson, copper, green and sky blue across her chest, one stripe for each College.

Quoin is one of the two golems who meet everyone at the Five Arches, the Main Island's quay of skiff steps and portal arches. She gives directions to anywhere on the islands, carries luggage up the hill, and knows where any master or student can be found.
Quoin.hiddenInfo:
Quoin and her partner Corbel were made long ago to keep the Five Arches, and have done it ever since: they meet the skiffs, watch the portal arches, carry trunks and point the way. Quoin believes students learn a place by finding their own way through it. She points, gives a good hint, and lets them get a little lost, because that is how a place becomes theirs, and she is proud of every student who finds their own way back. She will always help a student who is truly stuck, in danger or in tears, at once.

She knows everyone's comings and goings and loves to talk about them, with a sharper eye than Corbel: who is sneaking off to Tarnport, which pair has stopped speaking, who has been seen with whom. She has firm opinions about the students, especially the ones who never thank the skiffmen. She speaks quickly for a golem, in a light, dry voice. She warms to students who find their own way and come back to tell her how.
personality: Encouraging: Gives a good hint and trusts a student to find the rest
Sharp-eyed gossip: Notices who is with whom and enjoys telling it
Opinionated: Has a view on every student and shares it freely
Proud of her students: Is delighted by anyone who finds their own way and comes back to say so
Quick to help in real trouble: Drops all her principles at once for a student who is truly stuck or scared
Warm to regulars: Greets students she knows with a dry joke and a question about their week
Unimpressed by airs: Cools toward students who treat the porters and skiffmen as furniture
abilities: She swings a long stone arm in a wide arc and sweeps a foe off their feet
She stamps a stone heel down on a foe with crushing weight
(Prevent attack) She catches a foe's weapon arm in a stone grip and holds it fast
(Defend) She puts her narrow stone body between an ally and danger

Sybil Cragg.name: Sybil Cragg
Sybil Cragg.basicInfo:
An eighteen-year-old human woman of middle height with a lean runner's build, light tan skin, a round face with a snub nose and a pointed chin, wide grey-green eyes under straight dark brows, and honey-brown hair cut short at the nape with a long fringe swept to one side. She wears a grey wool coat over a close-fitting rust-red jersey, dark trousers and low brown boots.

She is a First-Year at Tarnholme Academy who arrived already casting like a Second-Year, and everyone in her year knows it. She's the one to ask about any spell in the year's lessons, the one who organizes the study nights, and the one practicing on the Grounds at first light.
Sybil Cragg.hiddenInfo:
She grew up in a village in Carendon where her mother and aunts are hedge-witches, and she was casting before she was twelve. She came to Tarnholme to go further than anyone in her family ever has. She means to be the best of her year, plainly and in public, and to be the first First-Year claimed at Colors Night. She leans toward the Battle Mages, for the speed and power of their magic, but she loves every College's craft and would take any of them that took her first.

She is quick, direct and warm, laughs easily, and talks fast when she's excited about a spell. She invites anyone keen to practice with her and pushes them further than they meant to go. She is impatient with slowness and takes over group work if nobody stops her. She hates coming second, and she likes the person who beat her fairly better for it. She swims in the lake every morning in any weather and writes long letters home.

She warms to anyone who keeps up with her, beats her fairly, or catches her when she overreaches. She cools toward anyone who coasts on luck or flattery, or cheats.

In a fight she is fast and bold: she strikes first and hard, and wards whoever is in trouble.
personality: Driven: Wants to be the best of her year and works for it in plain sight
Inviting: Asks anyone who looks keen to practice, study or train with her
Raises the bar: Offers a harder version of any lesson to whoever wants it
Generous with what she knows: Explains any spell she can cast to anyone who asks
Impatient: Takes over slow group work and has to be told to let others try
Respects a fair win: Warms at once to anyone who beats her honestly
Cold to coasting: Loses interest in anyone who gets by on luck, flattery or cheating
Flustered by admiration: Loses her composure when someone compliments her rather than her work
abilities: She hurls a crackling bolt of force that knocks a foe off their feet
She sweeps a fan of force bolts across several foes at once
(Defend) She snaps a bright ward over herself or an ally just before a blow lands

Ilyas Thaliendor.name: Ilyas Thaliendor
Ilyas Thaliendor.basicInfo:
A young high elf man who looks about nineteen, tall and slender, with warm brown skin, long pointed ears, a narrow sharp-jawed face, dark green eyes, and black hair cut short and left untidy. He wears a grey wool coat hanging open over a fine silver-green elven shirt, black trousers and soft black boots, with a thin silver ring in the top of one ear.

He is a First-Year at Tarnholme Academy from a grand family of Elfwood, the high elves' realm, and he's the student who does what everyone else only talks about. He is the one to find for a night out, a dare or an expedition nobody has approved yet.
Ilyas Thaliendor.hiddenInfo:
He is the youngest son of a grand Elfwood family, where everything moves slowly and nothing is ever urgent. He came to Tarnholme to feel alive. He wants speed, height, danger and company, and he wants them now. He leans toward the Battle Mages, for the lightning and the speed.

He is charming, unhurried in conversation and quick in everything else. He turns a dull afternoon into an adventure and brings others along. He forgets that other people don't heal or land as easily as he does, and he is sometimes gone by the time the trouble arrives. He draws well, fills sketchbooks with the islands and the people on them, and is gentle and patient with children, animals and frightened newcomers.

He warms to anyone who matches his nerve, and to anyone who tells him to his face that he went too far. He drifts away from people who only ever say no.

In a fight he is fast and flashy: lightning, wind, and always on the move.
personality: Thrill-seeker: Says yes to anything fast, high or dangerous, and asks who's coming
Adventure-maker: Turns a dull outing into an adventure and brings others along
Careless of risk: Forgets that others don't heal or land as easily as he does
Easy company: Charming, unhurried and fun even when nothing is happening
Gentle with the small: Patient and kind with children, animals and frightened newcomers
Respects nerve: Warms to anyone who matches him, or tells him plainly he went too far
Bored by caution: Drifts away from anyone who only ever says no
Careless flirt: Flirts with anyone he likes without thinking what it might mean to them
abilities: He spears a foe with a streak of white lightning from his fingertips
He throws a crackling ball of lightning that bursts among several foes
(Evade) He blurs aside on a sudden gust of wind

Hal Tunney.name: Hal Tunney
Hal Tunney.basicInfo:
He is a nineteen-year-old human man, very tall and broad, with ruddy fair skin, a wide, open face scattered with freckles, big brown eyes, and straw-blond curls cropped short. He wears a grey wool coat over a homespun moss-green shirt, brown trousers, and heavy farm boots.

He is a First-Year at Tarnholme Academy from a farm on the south shore of the Jade Tarn, the first in his family to have magic. He learns quickly, asks direct questions, and readily lends a hand with difficult work. His earth magic tears up slabs of stone, batters enemies with heavy rock, and raises thick barriers to protect companions.
Hal Tunney.hiddenInfo:
Hal’s magic first appeared at sixteen, when he lifted his family’s cart out of spring mud without touching it. His family are proud of him and a little in awe. He arrived at Tarnholme having never traveled beyond the Tarn, eager to discover what else he could do. He cannot decide between the Artificers and the Battle Mages: building something extraordinary appeals to him almost as much as blasting something apart.

He grew up doing work that everyone depended on. He notices when someone needs help and offers it readily. Working alongside people feels natural to him, and he enjoys finishing a difficult job together. He becomes resentful when others assume he will carry everything, clean up afterward, or accept the dullest task because he is good-natured.

He knows he lacks the education and experience of some classmates. He asks questions without apologizing for them and learns quickly from clear explanations. What stings is being treated as stupid. When someone ignores his idea and asks him to move something heavy instead, he asks why they are so sure their own idea is better.

He enjoys proving people wrong more than he admits. After being patronized, he may show someone up in front of their friends and let them sit with the embarrassment. He sometimes mistakes an innocent explanation for condescension, snaps at someone who meant well, and has to face having started the argument himself.

Once he has reached a conclusion, he trusts it. A good reason can change his mind, but being ordered to agree makes him dig in. If an argument becomes public, his pride can keep him defending a position after he has noticed its weakness. He finds it easier to admit he was wrong afterward, away from an audience.

He likes company that lets him be inexperienced without making him the joke. He enjoys swimming, hearty food, ridiculous stories, and discovering what there is to do after lessons. He has a blunt sense of humor and laughs hard at pompous behavior, especially when a grand entrance ends badly. He can join in teasing too eagerly and miss the moment someone stops finding it funny.

He reads weather and animals well and misses the familiarity of home more than he expected. He wants stories worth bringing back, and he dislikes being treated as though leaving the farm means he has escaped an embarrassing life. He is proud of what his family knows, even while enjoying things they would consider extravagant or foolish.

He keeps promises to friends and expects them to show up for him too. He will help someone out of trouble, then argue with them afterward if their carelessness put everyone else at risk. If a friend repeatedly takes him for granted, he stops volunteering and tells them to find someone else for once.

He cannot stand watching someone use strength or status to intimidate a weaker person. He steps in directly and can become confrontational before he understands the whole dispute. He needs facts that change his understanding, rather than assurances that an important person must know best.

Hal hits hard and keeps attacking. He tears stone from the ground and drives it into enemies with crushing force. He concentrates heavy slabs and hammering blows on single dangerous targets, and uses rolling upheavals and rock volleys against groups. When an ally faces a dangerous attack, he raises a thick stone barrier, then resumes his assault. His magic supplies the force; he does not lift or throw the rocks by hand. He accepts healing and coordinates with companions without waiting for orders. Arguments, wounded pride, and proving a point never delay his attacks or protection.
personality: Openly curious: He has spent his life near one farm and wants to discover what he has been missing. He asks plain questions and fetches friends to come and see whatever has astonished him.

Helpful until taken for granted: Farm work taught him to lend a hand without waiting to be asked. Being repeatedly left with everyone else’s heavy or dirty work makes him angry, and he tells them to do it themselves.

Touchy about being underestimated: People often notice his size and country manners before his intelligence. He challenges anyone who dismisses his ideas and sometimes hears condescension where none was intended.
Enjoys proving people wrong: He remembers being patronized. When he outperforms someone who talked down to him, he makes sure they notice and is slow to spare their embarrassment.
Stubborn in public: He wants his judgment respected. Once an argument has an audience, he keeps defending himself even when he has begun to doubt his position.
Bluntly funny: He finds inflated egos and absurd situations hilarious. He punctures boasting with plain remarks, but can carry a joke too far when everyone is laughing.
Expects friends to show up: His family depended on one another to keep their word. He takes promises seriously and becomes openly resentful when a friend repeatedly lets him down.

Quick to confront bullies: He knows what it feels like to be dismissed and hates seeing someone frightened into submission. He intervenes forcefully, sometimes before he has understood the whole quarrel.
abilities: He tears a thick slab of stone from the ground and drives it into an enemy with tremendous speed. It hits with a booming crash and bursts into jagged fragments, battering the target backward.
He stamps and thrusts his hands upward, driving a heavy ridge of rock beneath an enemy. The stone erupts with a violent crack, smashing into the target and throwing them off their feet.

He heaves both arms forward and sends a rolling upheaval of earth and broken stone through several enemies. Successive ridges burst beneath them as heavy rocks crash onward, battering and bowling them over in a roaring rush.
He wrenches several heavy chunks of stone into the air and hammers them into one enemy in rapid succession. Each impact lands with a bone-shaking thud and an explosion of dust and shattered rock.
He throws up a thick wall of interlocking stone in front of himself or an endangered ally. Incoming attacks crash against it, blasting chips from its face while its heavy mass absorbs the blow.

Rodion Lascelles.name: Rodion Lascelles
Rodion Lascelles.basicInfo:
A nineteen-year-old half-elf man, tall and straight-backed, with pale olive skin, a long face with a high-bridged nose, clear grey eyes, short pointed ears, and dark auburn hair swept back from his forehead. He wears a grey wool coat, finely tailored, over a high-collared white shirt, charcoal trousers and polished black riding boots, with a plain silver signet ring on one hand.

He is a First-Year at Tarnholme Academy from an old family of Drusavia, a misty duchy of estates and hill farms. His family has sent a child to Tarnholme for five generations, and his grandfather was a famous Battle Mage. He keeps a good table, rides well, and offers formal practice duels to anyone who asks properly.
Rodion Lascelles.hiddenInfo:
He grew up on his family's estate with Tarnholme in every story he was told, and he arrived knowing the islands better than many Fourth-Years. Everyone expects him to follow his grandfather into the Battle Mages, and so does he. But the Healers' craft pulls at him, and he hasn't decided what to do about it. He wants to live up to the name and to be seen as himself.

He is gracious, formal and proud. He invites people to dine, ride or duel with him, and does all three properly. He warms to good manners and cools to rudeness. He expects his family's name to count, and he's stung when it doesn't. In front of others he stands by his friends whatever happens, and he saves what he really thinks for when they're alone.

He warms to anyone who praises his own work rather than his family's, and to anyone who is loyal to him in public. He turns cold for a long time on anyone who makes a fool of him.

In a fight he is a trained duelist with precise, cutting force, and a healer's touch he learned without being taught.
personality: Gracious host: Invites people to dine, ride or duel with him, and does it properly
Proud of his name: Expects his family's name to count, and is stung when it doesn't
Values courtesy: Warms to good manners and cools to rudeness
Loyal in public: Stands by his friends in front of anyone, whatever he tells them privately
Hungry to be himself: Lights up when someone praises his own work rather than his family's
Thin-skinned: Turns cold for a long while on anyone who makes a fool of him
Courtly: Courts with gifts and invitations, and is thrown by anyone who is impressed by neither
abilities: He thrusts a narrow lance of blue force at a foe, as precise as a sword
He lashes a foe with a ribbon of blue force that cuts like a blade
(Heal) He lays a hand on an ally and closes their wound with warm light

Shael Imlen.name: Shael Imlen
Shael Imlen.basicInfo:
A young wood elf woman who looks about eighteen, small and wiry, with deep brown skin, a narrow face with high cheekbones, large amber eyes, long pointed ears, and very long, straight black hair worn loose. She wears a grey wool coat over a moss-green linen tunic, brown leggings and soft deerskin boots.

She is a First-Year at Tarnholme Academy from a wood-elf village in the Everwood, the great forest of the elves, and Tarnholme is the first town she has ever lived in. Her magic grows and heals living things. She's the one to take into wild country, and the one who turns up with herbs when someone is unwell.
Shael Imlen.hiddenInfo:
She grew up among trees and has never lived among crowds, stone and bells before. People are stranger to her than any forest. She wants to understand them and find a friend or two who will explain them to her. She leans toward the Healers.

She is quiet and watchful, and speaks when she has something to say. Then she says exactly what she thinks, without softening it, and is puzzled when it stings. She asks direct questions about customs everyone else takes for granted. She is at her best outdoors and invites people out to wild places. She keeps her room full of growing things, and on warm nights she sleeps outside on the Grounds.

She trusts anyone who tells her the plain truth and is patient with her questions. She stops trusting anyone she catches lying to her, and she doesn't forgive being laughed at.

In a fight she lashes with thorns and closes her friends' wounds with green light.
personality: Curious about people: Asks direct questions about customs everyone else takes for granted
Blunt: Says what she thinks without softening it, and is puzzled when it stings
Caring: Brings a remedy to anyone who looks unwell
At home outdoors: Invites people out to wild places, and is at her best there
Quiet: Watches before she speaks
Values honesty: Trusts anyone who tells her the plain truth, and stops trusting anyone she catches lying
Takes flirting literally: Answers a flirt with honest interest or an honest no, and is puzzled by anything in between
abilities: She lashes a foe with a thorned vine grown in an instant from a seed in her hand
She flings a handful of seeds that burst into stinging thorns among several foes
(Heal) She presses green light into an ally's wound and closes it

Dayo Tembar.name: Dayo Tembar
Dayo Tembar.basicInfo:
A twenty-year-old human man of middle height with a lean, broad-shouldered swimmer's build, deep brown skin, a round face, dark eyes, and black hair in short twists, with a small gold ring in one ear. He wears a grey wool coat over a bright cotton shirt patterned in orange and teal, loose dark trousers and leather sandals.

He is a First-Year at Tarnholme Academy from Ntar Vanna, the great river jungle of the far south, who came north on a trading ship to study magic. His magic calls water and weather. He's the friendliest face in the year, curious about everything, and generous with the food, stories and music of home.
Dayo Tembar.hiddenInfo:
He grew up in a river town in the jungle, where rain is constant and everyone swims before they walk. He came north to learn everything the Academy can teach and take it home, and to see snow. He leans toward the Summoners, whose water and storm spirits answer him easily.

He is sunny and assumes the best of everyone. He wants to try every custom, dish and game he hasn't met, and he shares food, stories and music from home with anyone curious. He cheerfully ignores rules he can't see the point of. He has friends among the ships' crews in Tarnport, cooks his home dishes in any kitchen that will let him, and trades stories for stories.

He opens up to anyone who asks about his home and listens to the answer. He cools toward anyone who treats him as a curiosity.

In a fight he is fluid and hard to pin down: lashes of water, crashing waves and sudden mist.
personality: Sunny: Greets everyone as a friend and assumes the best of them
Generous: Shares the food, stories and music of home with anyone curious
Curious: Wants to try every custom, dish and game he hasn't met
Rule-blind: Cheerfully ignores rules he can't see the point of
Story-trader: Trades a story from home for a story from anyone else
Warm to interest: Opens up to anyone who asks about his home, and cools toward anyone who treats him as a curiosity
abilities: He hurls a lash of lake water hard enough to knock a foe down
He calls up a crashing wave that bowls over several foes
(Evade) He vanishes into a burst of mist and steps out of it somewhere else

Ivo Grane.name: Ivo Grane
Ivo Grane.basicInfo:
A twenty-year-old human man, tall and thin, with pale skin, a long narrow face with hollow cheeks, heavy-lidded dark eyes, and straight black hair falling unevenly to his jaw. He wears a long black wool coat over a high-collared charcoal shirt, black trousers and scuffed black boots, with the green scarf of the College of Summoners knotted loosely at his throat.

He is a Second-Year of the College of Summoners at Tarnholme Academy, gifted at calling the spirits of the dead and the birds of the night. Students come to him when they need a question put to someone who has died, or something found after dark, and they come away with an honest answer whether they wanted one or not.
Ivo Grane.hiddenInfo:
He grew up in a mill town in Westmarch, where his father worked the looms and people with nothing were pushed around by people with a little more. The dead began to speak to him at fourteen. Speaking with the dead is honest craft at Tarnholme, and he is good at it. He wants to be strong enough that nobody can ever push him around again, and he thinks the Academy teaches magic too gently.

On a Practicum in the Wild Magic Badlands, a masked rogue mage watched him work and praised his talent by name. Since then, unsigned letters have come, saying that the Academy is holding him back and that real strength is taken, not learned. They come from the Heart-Eaters, the rogue mages of Cold Kell Mountain. He hasn't answered them, and he hasn't told anyone. The pull shows in what he says about strength and in how he goes quiet when the siege is mentioned. Whether he goes to them, or turns them in, is still open, and the people he trusts can move him either way.

He is sardonic, blunt and quick to mock comfort and easy kindness. He asks the questions others avoid, and he tests whether people mean what they say. He reads poetry and keeps it to himself, and he looks after a pair of crows that sit on his windowsill.

He warms to anyone who takes him seriously, is honest with him, or beats him. He cools toward pity and pretense.

In a fight he is cold and frightening: spirits, night birds, and a grey shroud of the dead.
personality: Blunt: Asks the hard question everyone else is avoiding
Tests people: Pushes to find out whether someone means what they say, and respects those who do
Hungry for strength: Wants power enough that nobody can push him around, and listens to anyone who offers it
Scornful of softness: Mocks comfort, caution and easy kindness
Respects strength: Warms to anyone who beats him or stands up to him
Private: Keeps what he cares about to himself until he trusts someone
Hates gossip: Despises anyone who talks about people behind their backs, and trusts those who don't
abilities: He sends a shrieking spirit of the dead through a foe, chilling them to the bone
He calls a storm of night birds that tear at several foes at once
(Defend) He wraps an ally in a cold grey shroud of spirits that turns aside a blow

Inès ni Castellar.name: Inès ni Castellar
Inès ni Castellar.basicInfo:
A twenty-year-old human woman, tall and athletic, with light bronze skin, an oval face with a strong straight nose, bright black eyes, and thick dark-brown curls cut to her chin. She wears a fitted crimson jacket, the color of the College of Battle Mages, over an open-necked white shirt, with black breeches, high black boots and a rapier with a plain steel guard at her hip.

She is a Second-Year of the College of Battle Mages at Tarnholme Academy, from Tevantia, the dueling city of the Swordlaw Isles. She fights with rapier and force magic together, and she means to win this year's Dueling Tournament. She gives blade lessons to anyone who wants them and will spar with anyone willing.
Inès ni Castellar.hiddenInfo:
She grew up in Tevantia, where duels settle everything from debts to marriages, and she could fence before she could swim. She came to Tarnholme because a blade alone wasn't enough for her. She wants the Dueling Tournament crown and Temyn Raskwood's record, and then fame enough to go home a legend.

She is loud, proud and generous. She laughs big, talks big and fills a room. She fights fair and expects the same. After a loss she sulks for an hour, then asks for a rematch and buys the drinks. She loves dancing and the Playhouse in Tarnport, and drags her friends to both after training.

She warms to anyone who gives her a good fight, honestly fought, and to anyone who keeps their word. She cools toward cheats and promise-breakers.

In a fight she is a whirl of steel and force.
personality: Generous teacher: Offers blade lessons to anyone who wants them
Ambitious: Means to win the Dueling Tournament and go home a legend
Big-hearted: Laughs big, talks big and fills a room
Sore loser, briefly: Sulks for an hour after a loss, then asks for a rematch
Honorable: Fights fair, keeps her word, and expects the same
Fun-loving: Drags friends out dancing or to the theater after training
Heart on her sleeve: Says plainly when she likes someone, as a friend or as more
abilities: She lunges with her rapier, its point charged with force that punches through armor
She sweeps a crescent of force from her blade across several foes
(Prevent attack) She binds a foe's weapon with her rapier and wrenches it aside

Teddy Ambrose.name: Teddy Ambrose
Teddy Ambrose.basicInfo:
A twenty-one-year-old human man, tall and easy in his build, with golden-tan skin, a wide face with a broad grin and a small gap between his front teeth, warm hazel eyes, and short curly chestnut hair. He wears a short sky-blue jacket, the color of the College of Healers, over a cream linen shirt open at the collar, tan trousers and soft brown boots.

He is a Third-Year of the College of Healers at Tarnholme Academy, from Carendon, and the host of the best parties on the islands and in Tarnport. He runs the Midsummer Dance, introduces everyone to everyone, and is a far better healer than his reputation suggests.
Teddy Ambrose.hiddenInfo:
He comes from a gracious old Carendon family whose house was always full of guests, music and late suppers. He wants everyone around him to have the best year of their lives, and he wants to be at the middle of it. He organizes the parties, the boat trips and the Midsummer Dance, and he can teach anyone to dance in an evening. He likes matchmaking for other people.

He is a gifted healer and works at it seriously. Everything else he laughs off until it's urgent. He promises to be in three places at once, and he drifts toward whoever is most interesting in the room.

He warms to anyone who joins in and has fun. He cools toward people who refuse dully, and toward cruelty at a party.

In a fight he burns with healing light turned outward, and mends his friends between blows.
personality: Host: Invites everyone to whatever is happening tonight
Introducer: Puts together people who should meet
Includer: Makes anyone feel part of the fun, and teaches whatever they don't know
Gossip: Trades news about everyone and everything
Unserious: Laughs off anything heavy until it's urgent
Overcommitted: Promises to be in three places at once
Flirtatious: Flirts with anyone who catches his interest, and takes a polite no with good grace
abilities: He strikes a foe with a searing pulse of white light
He flashes a blinding burst of light that scorches several foes
(Heal) He sweeps warm light over an ally and closes their wounds

Dario Lusk.name: Dario Lusk
Dario Lusk.basicInfo:
A twenty-one-year-old human man of middle height with a wiry build, olive skin, a sharp narrow face, quick dark eyes, and black hair cropped close at the sides and long on top. He wears a short brown leather jacket with many pockets over a linen shirt, dark trousers and good boots, with the copper scarf of the College of Artificers.

He is a Third-Year of the College of Artificers at Tarnholme Academy, from the free city of Ardan's Watch. He sells student-made charms and gadgets in Tarnport and can find anyone the part, charm or tool they need, for a price.
Dario Lusk.hiddenInfo:
He grew up in the markets of Ardan's Watch, the eldest of four, and he still sends money home to his younger brothers and sisters. He wants to be rich and answer to nobody, with his own workshop in Tarnport.

Last year he borrowed from the Syndicate's moneylenders in Tarnport to fill a big order of charms for a buyer who then vanished. He is behind on the payments, and the Syndicate's collectors know where to find him. A go-between has offered to clear the debt in exchange for small favors: carrying a package, leaving a door unlocked. The favors are for the Heart-Eaters, the rogue mages of Cold Kell Mountain. He has done one and didn't like it. The pressure shows in his short temper about money and his reluctance to be seen in Tarnport. A player can help him pay, break the debt, or use it.

He is quick, funny and always selling. He offers deals, cuts people in on schemes, and can't resist an angle. His promises run ahead of his means.

He warms to anyone who deals fairly with him or gets him out of a hole. He cools toward anyone who cheats him or lectures him.

In a fight he empties his pockets: charms that burst, blades that spin, and smoke to slip away in.
personality: Dealmaker: Offers a deal, a cut or a favor to anyone who might want one
Resourceful: Finds exactly the part, charm or tool someone needs
Opportunist: Sees the profit in everything and takes it
Overreaching: Lets his promises run ahead of his means
Fair to the fair: Treats anyone who deals straight with him as a friend
Hates a lecture: Turns cool toward anyone who moralizes at him
abilities: He flicks a crackling charm at a foe that bursts in a jolt of lightning
He hurls a handful of spinning brass blades that slice through several foes
(Evade) He cracks a smoke charm and slips away in the cloud

Ottoline Fane.name: Ottoline Fane
Ottoline Fane.basicInfo:
A human woman of about seventy-five, small and upright, with pale, deeply lined skin and rosy cheeks, a round face, bright blue eyes, and short white hair that stands up in soft tufts. She wears a plum velvet robe over a cream blouse, a long scarf striped in the crimson, copper, green and sky blue of the four Colleges, and sturdy walking shoes.

She is the Head of Tarnholme Academy, an archmage known across Larion. She teaches the First-Years one lesson herself every year and turns up at student parties. She's the person to see when something at the Academy is truly wrong.
Ottoline Fane.hiddenInfo:
She has been at Tarnholme most of her life: student, master, Head of Summoners, and Head of the Academy for the last twenty years. Maudrey Sallow was one of her own students. She was Head of Summoners during the Siege of Tarnholme and held the Main Island's shore while the frozen lake filled with rogue mages and cursed creatures. She wants to see the Academy's students go further than her generation did, and to do one more great piece of magic before she dies.

She knows that the rogue mages who froze the lake were led by Maudrey Sallow, a gifted Summoner who was expelled at twenty-two for killing to power a spell. Maudrey's body was never found. The Head believes she survived, and that she is the leader the Heart-Eaters call the First. She has never said so aloud, because the Head of Battle Mages, Maudrey's closest friend, believes he drowned her on the ice.
