Emberglass Oil.description: A clay vial of lamp oil clouded with powdered emberglass, enough to kindle one weapon for a single attack. Apply it as part of the attack and the weapon deals fire damage; the vial is consumed whether the strike lands or misses.

Consecrated Oil.name: Consecrated Oil
Consecrated Oil.description: A small temple vial of oil blessed over a living flame, enough for one weapon. Apply it as part of an attack and the weapon deals radiant damage; the vial is consumed whether the strike lands or misses.

florins.name: florins
florins.description: The standard trade coin throughout Larion.

Herbalist's Kit.name: Herbalist's Kit
Herbalist's Kit.description: A canvas satchel of dried herbs, poultice cloth, small bottles, twine, shears, mortar, pestle, and field notes for hedge medicine and simple remedies.

Fine Steel Shortsword.name: Fine Steel Shortsword
Fine Steel Shortsword.description: A well-forged steel shortsword with a peened pommel and a blade that holds its edge through a long day. Balanced closely enough that the arm tires later than it should.

Steel Shortsword of Flame.name: Steel Shortsword of Flame
Steel Shortsword of Flame.description: A steel shortsword whose fuller has been laid with a fire-charm, so the edge runs hot and sears what it cuts. It bites hardest into plants, fungi, trolls, and cold-natured things.

Masterwork Emberglass Saber of Fire.name: Masterwork Emberglass Saber of Fire
Masterwork Emberglass Saber of Fire.description: A curved saber ground from coal-red Emberglass and set in a blackened hilt. The volcanic glass burns as it cuts, and tells against frost beings, trolls, and venomous creatures.

Moonstone Dagger of Radiant.name: Moonstone Dagger of Radiant
Moonstone Dagger of Radiant.description: A short pale blade knapped from temple moonstone, cool to the hand and faintly lit from within. Its radiant edge bites hardest into undead, fiends, and shadow-bound things.

Fine Stormsteel Mace of Shock.name: Fine Stormsteel Mace of Shock
Fine Stormsteel Mace of Shock.description: A flanged mace of drawn stormsteel that snaps and stings on impact. The shock it carries disrupts constructs and clockwork far better than plain iron.

Sun-Gold Mace of Radiant.name: Sun-Gold Mace of Radiant
Sun-Gold Mace of Radiant.description: A flanged mace of sun-gold over a hard iron core, warm even underground. Its radiant blows bite hardest into undead, fiends, and shadow-bound things.

Frostjade Battle Axe of Frost.name: Frostjade Battle Axe of Frost
Frostjade Battle Axe of Frost.description: A two-handed battle axe with a pale frostjade head that mists in warm air. Its edge leaves killing rime in the wound and is carried against fire elementals, magma-born things, and oozes.

Stormsteel Short Spear of Shock.name: Stormsteel Short Spear of Shock
Stormsteel Short Spear of Shock.description: A short spear with a stormsteel head and copper-bound haft, useful one-handed or from behind a shield. It discharges through the thrust and rattles constructs to their joints.

Caustic Bronze Dagger of Acid.name: Caustic Bronze Dagger of Acid
Caustic Bronze Dagger of Acid.description: A narrow dagger of caustic bronze, its surface furred with green-black corrosive tarnish. Its acid bite eats stonework, armor, shell, and hardened hide.

Caustic Bronze Mace of Acid.name: Caustic Bronze Mace of Acid
Caustic Bronze Mace of Acid.description: A flanged mace of caustic bronze whose green-black head smokes against stone and plate. Its acid blows pit armor, shell, hardened hide, and masonry.

Venomwood Dagger of Poison.name: Venomwood Dagger of Poison
Venomwood Dagger of Poison.description: A narrow dagger carved from dark venomwood, its grain sweating clear toxin along the edge. Even a shallow cut deals poison damage to living flesh.

Voidglass Knife of Shadow.name: Voidglass Knife of Shadow
Voidglass Knife of Shadow.description: A thin knife of black voidglass that seems to swallow the light around its edge. Its shadow bite tells against celestials and the blessed, and poorly against the already dark.

Superior Frostjade Warhammer of Frost.name: Superior Frostjade Warhammer of Frost
Superior Frostjade Warhammer of Frost.description: A one-handed hammer with a head of pale frostjade that leaves rime on whatever it strikes. It is carried against fire elementals, magma-born things, and oozes.

Witchwood Staff of Arcane.name: Witchwood Staff of Arcane
Witchwood Staff of Arcane.description: A tall staff of grey witchwood, unshod and worn smooth at the grip. Witchwood carries arcane force cleanly, which makes it a vessel first and a cudgel second.

Masterwork Voidglass Greatsword of Shado.name: Masterwork Voidglass Greatsword of Shadow
Masterwork Voidglass Greatsword of Shado.description: A two-handed blade of black voidglass with a hilt of cold iron, said to have been quenched in a starless well. It drinks light along its length and cuts what should not be cut.

Warded Sun-Gold Blade of Radiant.name: Warded Sun-Gold Blade of Radiant
Warded Sun-Gold Blade of Radiant.description: A longsword of hammered sun-gold that keeps the warmth of noon hours after dark. Undead and fiends flinch from it before it lands.

Fine Red-Jade Pendant.name: Fine Red-Jade Pendant
Fine Red-Jade Pendant.description: A drop of polished red jade on a plain cord, warm against the sternum. Red jade is the stone of blood and vitality, and this one steadies the wearer against hard use.

Superior Sun-Gold Torc.name: Superior Sun-Gold Torc
Superior Sun-Gold Torc.description: A open-ended neck ring of soft sun-gold, worn by envoys and temple speakers. People listen to the wearer a beat longer than they mean to.

Fine Thoughtstone Lens.name: Fine Thoughtstone Lens
Fine Thoughtstone Lens.description: A single ground thoughtstone lens on a folding brass arm. Looking through it lends an odd clarity about what a room is actually doing.

Fine Rimebone Charm.name: Fine Rimebone Charm
Fine Rimebone Charm.description: A carved knuckle of rimebone strung on sinew, cold to the touch in any weather. Its bearers say it teaches the body to endure what it would rather not.

Masterwork Aether-Crystal Circlet.name: Masterwork Aether-Crystal Circlet
Masterwork Aether-Crystal Circlet.description: A fine silver circlet cradling three cut aether crystals above the brow. It widens what the wearer can hold open at once, and steadies the channel while they do it.

Superior Warded Mail.name: Superior Warded Mail
Superior Warded Mail.description: A shirt of fine riveted mail whose every fourth ring is silver, scribed with a continuous warding line. The wards keep the metal from fouling a working, which plate never does.

Masterwork Runed Brigandine.name: Masterwork Runed Brigandine
Masterwork Runed Brigandine.description: A brigandine of small plates riveted between layered canvas, each plate cut with a channel rune. It turns a blade like armour and carries a working like a robe.

Leather Cap.name: Leather Cap
Leather Cap.description: A close leather cap with a padded crown and a short neck flap, worn under a hood or alone.

Fine Studded Gloves.name: Fine Studded Gloves
Fine Studded Gloves.description: Supple gloves faced with small iron studs across the knuckles, cut close enough to keep the fingers honest.

Fine Oiled Wool Mantle.name: Fine Oiled Wool Mantle
Fine Oiled Wool Mantle.description: A heavy mantle of twice-oiled wool that sheds rain and holds heat through a night watch.

Jeans.name: Jeans
Jeans.description: Blue denim jeans, worn soft with a hole in one knee.

T-Shirt.name: T-Shirt
T-Shirt.description: A soft graphic T-shirt with "VOYAGE" printed in small letters across the chest.

Sneakers.name: Sneakers
Sneakers.description: Worn fabric sneakers with scuffed rubber soles and no laces.

The Widow's Edge.name: The Widow's Edge
The Widow's Edge.description: A slim Warded sword of grey steel, recovered from an Ur-carved strongbox among the wrecks of Widow's Way. Its cuts land with impossible depth, but the hand around its grip keeps a weak, slow pulse. Named power — Widow's Due: drive the blade into your own shadow and make one shadow attack at impact 200 against a foe you can see as the edge erupts from the foe's shadow. When called, black thread knots around the wielder's wrist and their shadow remains visibly thinner.

Crown of the Drowned King.name: Crown of the Drowned King
Crown of the Drowned King.description: A verdigrised sun-gold circlet laid upon the Drowned King before the flooded earth swallowed his tomb. It opens the wearer's magical channel while filling their limbs with the drag of deep water. Named power — The Drowned Court: grave-cold water bursts across the scene and drowned guards rise beside every foe the wearer can see, each making one shadow attack at impact 200 before sinking away. Afterward, one drowned petitioner remains in the nearest reflection and names a grievance it expects the wearer to judge.

Wolfskin Girdle.name: Wolfskin Girdle
Wolfskin Girdle.description: A girdle of grey wolfhide sewn around an iron clasp, made by a Wrath-Speaker who trapped a wolf-spirit in its own skin. It gives the bearer the wolf's strength and wind while narrowing judgment to meat, motion, and pursuit. Named power — The Old Hunger: become a towering grey wolf until the end of the current turn and make one immediate slashing attack at impact 200. When called, the clasp bites shut and the hide strains toward the nearest wounded creature even after the bearer resumes their own shape.

Iron Ore.name: Iron Ore
Iron Ore.description: Rough lumps of iron-bearing rock from a mine or a slag heap. A smith smelts it into the iron behind ordinary blades, armor, tools, and arrowheads.

Rawhide.name: Rawhide
Rawhide.description: An animal hide, scraped but not yet tanned. A leatherworker cures it into the leather for jerkins, boots, caps, and gloves.

Wool Cloth.name: Wool Cloth
Wool Cloth.description: A folded length of plain woven wool. A tailor cuts it into tunics, cloaks, hoods, and robes, or the padding worn under armor.

Hardwood.name: Hardwood
Hardwood.description: A seasoned length of oak, ash, or yew with a straight grain. A carpenter or bowyer works it into bows, staves, shields, shafts, and trap frames.

Healing Herbs.name: Healing Herbs
Healing Herbs.description: A tied bundle of wound-herbs, fever-leaf, and knitbone, gathered fresh. An alchemist brews them into healing potions and stamina draughts, and a healer packs them into poultices.

Venom Gland.name: Venom Gland
Venom Gland.description: A venom gland cut whole from a snake, spider, or other poisonous beast, still full. An alchemist draws poison from it for coatings, extracts, and needle traps.

Game Meat.name: Game Meat
Game Meat.description: Fresh-butchered meat from a hunted animal. A cook turns it into trail food that keeps or a dish worth sitting down for; it spoils within a few days.

Silver Ore.name: Silver Ore
Silver Ore.description: Silver-bearing rock chipped from a seam. Smelted and worked, silver deals radiant damage and is the metal carried against undead, fiends, and lycanthropes.

Thunderglass.name: Thunderglass
Thunderglass.description: A shard of glassy mineral fused where lightning strikes again and again, humming with stored charge. Worked into a weapon, focus, or arrowhead, it deals shock damage.

Emberglass.name: Emberglass
Emberglass.description: A piece of raw volcanic glass that glows like banked coals when squeezed. Worked into a weapon, focus, or arrowhead, it deals fire damage.

Frostjade.name: Frostjade
Frostjade.description: A chunk of pale green stone cold enough to mist in warm air, cut from glacier veins. Worked into a weapon or arrowhead, it deals frost damage.

Voidglass.name: Voidglass
Voidglass.description: A shard of black glass that reflects stars even underground. Worked into a blade, focus, or arrowhead, it deals shadow damage.

Witchwood.name: Witchwood
Witchwood.description: A length of grey wood cut from a tree grown around old magic. Worked into a staff, wand, or bow, it carries arcane force cleanly.

Cold Iron.name: Cold Iron
Cold Iron.description: Forest iron from the veins beneath Sanctuary Vale, which must be worked cold and never touched by forge-fire. Worked cold, it deals arcane damage, and its touch is anathema to the fey.

Dream Coral.name: Dream Coral
Dream Coral.description: A branch of pale reef coral that stirs old memories in whoever holds it. Set into a charm, focus, or blade, it deals psychic damage.

Venomwood.name: Venomwood
Venomwood.description: A length of black-green wood that sweats toxin along its grain. Worked into arrows, darts, or blades, it deals poison damage.

Acid Gland.name: Acid Gland
Acid Gland.description: An acid gland cut intact from an acid-spitting beast, heavy with corrosive fluid. It yields vitriol for acid flasks and traps, and bronze quenched in it becomes caustic bronze.

Rimebone.name: Rimebone
Rimebone.description: A piece of bone from an ancient beast preserved in glacier ice, cold in any weather. It drinks heat from wounds and is worked into frost weapons and charms.

Drake Scale.name: Drake Scale
Drake Scale.description: A plate of thick overlapping scale shed by a drake in its molting or stripped from a kill. A leatherworker or armorer works it into armor that turns blades.

Spider Silk.name: Spider Silk
Spider Silk.description: A hank of giant-spider silk, lighter and stronger than rope of the same weight. A tailor or fletcher works it into light garments, bowstrings, and fine cord.

Troll Blood.name: Troll Blood
Troll Blood.description: A stoppered vial of troll blood that still tries to close any cut it touches. An alchemist brews it into greater healing draughts and burn salves.

Moonbloom Truffle.name: Moonbloom Truffle
Moonbloom Truffle.description: A pale, faintly luminous truffle dug from beneath old oaks in Whitecliff Downs. Halfling cooks prize it for pies, pastes, and cordials, and it holds a charm longer than any ordinary ingredient.

Elemental Core.name: Elemental Core
Elemental Core.description: The heart left behind when a bound elemental or construct is broken, still warm with the power that drove it. It is the rare catalyst an enchanter needs to carry a Masterwork piece through a Warded rite.

Hushwick.name: Hushwick
Hushwick.description: A stubby candle-lamp in a tin cage, made by a Tarnholme student who never got it right. Lit, its flame dims and leans toward any unseen listener, hidden creature, or scrying eye within earshot, so no one stays hidden from its bearer inside its light.

Dead-Letter Lantern.name: Dead-Letter Lantern
Dead-Letter Lantern.description: A narrow brass lantern with a violet glass, made by a Tarnholme artificer. Its light shows erased, overwritten, invisible, or magically concealed writing, marks, and sigils on anything it falls on.

Homegoing Lamp.name: Homegoing Lamp
Homegoing Lamp.description: A paper lamp on a thread, keyed by its bearer to one doorway or campsite. Released anywhere within a day's walk of that place, it floats toward it through fog, dark, forest, or maze, and the party can follow it home.

Noon-Glass Lamp of Radiance.name: Noon-Glass Lamp of Radiance
Noon-Glass Lamp of Radiance.description: A fist-sized lamp of noon-glass holding a captured midday. Smashed, it floods the scene with noon light and makes one radiant attack at impact 150 against each of up to three shadow creatures or undead that can see it. The lamp is used up.

Silver Shortsword of Radiant.name: Silver Shortsword of Radiant
Silver Shortsword of Radiant.description: A shortsword of Velmere silver forged over an iron core. Its radiant edge bites hardest into undead, fiends, lycanthropes, and shadow creatures.

Silver-Tipped Arrows of Radiance.name: Silver-Tipped Arrows of Radiance
Silver-Tipped Arrows of Radiance.description: Arrows tipped with blessed silver. Their radiant damage burns undead, fiends, lycanthropes, and shadow-bound creatures.

Gillcharm.name: Gillcharm
Gillcharm.description: A knot of dried gill-cord around a river pearl, sealed in wax. Broken and held in the mouth, it lets the bearer breathe underwater until the scene ends. The charm is used up.

Commanding Thought.name: Commanding Thought
Commanding Thought.description: Drive one immediate command into another mind. On success, the target performs the commanded action rather than the action it intended.

Open the Mind.name: Open the Mind
Open the Mind.description: Attempt a new psionic technique drawn from something you have witnessed, studied, or practiced. Gain +10 on the attempt. On full success, learn the demonstrated technique as a new ability.

Forceful Hand.name: Forceful Hand
Forceful Hand.description: Strike one target with a powerful telekinetic blow. The attack has impact 150 and deals impact damage; a successful blow can also knock the target back.

Touch of Feeling.name: Touch of Feeling
Touch of Feeling.description: Reach toward one mind and feel its strongest immediate emotion. Distinguish what the person actually feels from the expression they present, even when they conceal it well.

Second Sight.name: Second Sight
Second Sight.description: Open your awareness to nearby thinking presences. Sense their direction and whether they are calm, alert, or distressed, even when darkness or concealment hides them.

Thought Lash.name: Thought Lash
Thought Lash.description: Shape a crackling whip of thought and strike up to two minds you can see. Make one psychic attack against each at impact 125.

Find the Pressure Point.name: Find the Pressure Point
Find the Pressure Point.description: Focus on one person and discern an immediate concern, desire, or fear that could change their response to you. Use that insight as you speak, gaining +10 on the attempt to persuade or intimidate them.

Hurl the World.name: Hurl the World
Hurl the World.description: Tear a heavy loose object from its resting place and hurl it at one enemy. Make one attack at impact 200 using the object’s damage type.

Plant a Feeling.name: Plant a Feeling
Plant a Feeling.description: Press one strong emotion into another mind: fear, affection, anger, or confidence. The feeling is real to them, but how they act on it remains their own.

Follow the Thought.name: Follow the Thought
Follow the Thought.description: Hold one question in mind as you touch another person’s thoughts. Draw out the thought or image that rises in response, even if they refuse to answer aloud.

One Step Ahead.name: One Step Ahead
One Step Ahead.description: Read the movements forming in an opponent’s mind and strike before their defense is ready. Make one weapon attack at impact 200 using the weapon’s damage type.

Invisible Grasp.name: Invisible Grasp
Invisible Grasp.description: Seize one creature in telekinetic force, lift it, and slam it into the ground or a nearby surface. Make one impact attack at impact 200.

Shared Senses.name: Shared Senses
Shared Senses.description: Briefly join your perception to a willing creature. Take one look or listen through its senses, then return to your own. You do not direct its actions.

A Fortunate Disaster.name: A Fortunate Disaster
A Fortunate Disaster.description: Knock one real thing loose and let your luck turn it into a chain of accidents that strikes, rescues, opens, or overturns exactly what you need.

Old Blood Rises.name: Old Blood Rises
Old Blood Rises.description: Speak an ancestor's name and let their strength fill your body for one act of strength, endurance, or violence. Their shadow looms over yours as you act. If it attacks, the attack has impact 150.

Yearfold.name: Yearfold
Yearfold.description: Make one attack as silver afterimages of your past selves repeat the same motion and fold into a single stroke. The attack has impact 150 and deals arcane damage.

The Ward Advances.name: The Ward Advances
The Ward Advances.description: Raise a wall of silver light and drive it across the scene, sweeping foes aside in a storm of shining leaves while it stands between them and you or an ally. Make one attack against each of up to three foes at impact 150 that deals radiant damage, and defend yourself or one ally.

Shadow Wound.name: Shadow Wound
Shadow Wound.description: Stab your target's shadow instead of their body; the same wound opens on them a heartbeat later. The attack has impact 150 and deals shadow damage.

Dragon Breath.name: Dragon Breath
Dragon Breath.description: Breathe a torrent of your bloodline's element across up to three foes. Each hit has impact 125 and deals your bloodline's damage type.

Black Edict.name: Black Edict
Black Edict.description: Unleash a surge of black power across the scene and stop it dead along a line you choose. The attack has impact 150 and deals shadow damage.

Weightfall.name: Weightfall
Weightfall.description: Slam one blow straight down so the ground splits and the crack erupts under your target, throwing them up with the broken floor. The attack has impact 150 and deals impact damage.

Soul Flare.name: Soul Flare
Soul Flare.description: Open the seams around your soul-core and blast one foe with white-blue light pouring from every joint of your body. The attack has impact 150 and deals arcane damage.

The Far Fang.name: The Far Fang
The Far Fang.description: Spit one hard, narrow stream of venom that strikes like a dart. The attack has impact 150 and deals poison damage.

Turn the Exchange.name: Turn the Exchange
Turn the Exchange.description: Let one foe commit to an attack, then step inside it, catch the weapon or limb, and turn their own motion back on them. Their attack is spoiled, and your counter has impact 150 using your weapon's damage type.

Take the Field.name: Take the Field
Take the Field.description: Enter the thick of the fight and carry one continuous attack through up to three enemies. Each hit has impact 200 and uses your weapon's damage type. Drive every target away from the people or ground they threatened, then finish wherever you choose.

Change of Hands.name: Change of Hands
Change of Hands.description: Strike at an armed foe's grip, take their weapon, and carry the same motion into a blow against them. On a successful attack, they are disarmed, you end holding their weapon, and the attack has impact 150 using that weapon's damage type and item bonuses.

One Look Is Enough.name: One Look Is Enough
One Look Is Enough.description: Reproduce one nonmagical weapon technique another character performed in the current scene. Use any weapon you hold to repeat its movement and immediate physical result. Supernatural powers and item effects from the original technique do not carry over. An attack has impact 200 and uses your weapon's damage type.

Anything to Hand.name: Anything to Hand
Anything to Hand.description: Snatch one loose object you can lift and read its weight, balance, edge, and breaking point as a weapon. Make one attack with it in the same motion. The attack has impact 200 and uses the physical damage type that fits the object; the object may break.

Break What Protects.name: Break What Protects
Break What Protects.description: Name one weapon, shield, piece of armor, or physical obstruction currently protecting a foe. Break or cast it aside and continue the same motion into them. On a successful attack, the protection is visibly disabled and the target takes an impact-200 attack using your weapon's damage type.

The Whole Armory.name: The Whole Armory
The Whole Armory.description: Fight through the battle with every weapon you can reach, including your own, ones thrown at you, and ones you rip from enemies. Strike up to three targets with up to three different weapons in one continuous passage. Each hit has impact 250 and uses that weapon's damage type and item bonuses. End holding any one of them.

Crooked Flight.name: Crooked Flight
Crooked Flight.description: Launch an arrow along a trajectory no ordinary shot could follow, curving around cover or reaching a known target from an impossible angle. The attack has impact 150 and deals piercing damage. It cannot pass through solid matter.

World's Teeth.name: World's Teeth
World's Teeth.description: Choose one unstable feature already present in the scene and set it loose with a shot, strike, or sudden movement. It attacks one foe at impact 150 using the damage type that fits the hazard and leaves the terrain visibly changed.

Landstep.name: Landstep
Landstep.description: Break sight behind real cover and emerge from another piece of cover in the same scene with your attack already falling. The attack has impact 150 and uses your weapon's damage type. You cross the intervening ground unseen but cannot pass through solid barriers.

The Hunt Turns.name: The Hunt Turns
The Hunt Turns.description: Choose the physical thing one foe relies on most to threaten you and put one shot or strike exactly through it. On success, it is broken or disabled for the rest of the scene, and the foe takes an impact-300 hit using your weapon's damage type.

Nail Them There.name: Nail Them There
Nail Them There.description: Put one arrow through whatever will hold a foe to the ground or nearest solid surface. The attack has impact 200 and deals piercing damage. On success, they remain pinned until they break or cut free.

One Clean Moment.name: One Clean Moment
One Clean Moment.description: Hold the draw until one foe opens the smallest gap in their guard, then loose before it closes. The attack has impact 200 and deals piercing damage.

Bring Them Down.name: Bring Them Down
Bring Them Down.description: Put one arrow into the point that carries a foe's weight. The attack has impact 200 and deals piercing damage. On success, even a much larger foe is brought hard to the ground.

Three Roads.name: Three Roads
Three Roads.description: Set three arrows to the string and loose them in one draw. Choose up to three targets; each shaft takes its own line. Each hit has impact 200 and deals piercing damage.

Melt Away.name: Melt Away
Melt Away.description: Slip out of sight using real cover, a distraction, or a moment when no one is looking. On a successful Stealth check, you become Hidden.

Disappear Mid-Sentence.name: Disappear Mid-Sentence
Disappear Mid-Sentence.description: Vanish in front of watching eyes, in the half-second everyone expects your next word, and make one attack or action from hiding. An attack has impact 300. You stay Hidden afterward.

Wrong Shadow.name: Wrong Shadow
Wrong Shadow.description: Attack from hiding so that everyone looks at the wrong spot: another window, a higher roof, the far side of the smoke. You stay Hidden.

Takes One to Know One.name: Takes One to Know One
Takes One to Know One.description: Read the signs by which a settlement's underworld recognizes its own. On a successful Investigation check, find one named local professional with useful criminal connections and learn how to approach them. They have business and terms of their own.

Where the Money Sleeps.name: Where the Money Sleeps
Where the Money Sleeps.description: Study one settled area long enough to see where its wealth gathers and where its watch fails. On a successful Investigation check, identify one named business or residence worth robbing, the prize believed to lie inside, and one weakness in its security.

Nightknife.name: Nightknife
Nightknife.description: Draw your dagger through your own shadow. A black second edge rises from it and crosses the target with the steel. The attack has impact 150 and deals shadow damage.

Already Done.name: Already Done
Already Done.description: Reveal one preparation you could plausibly have made before this moment. A route is ready, an object is already where you need it, or one obstacle has been quietly spoiled. The preparation takes effect now and completes that part of the job.

A Fair Exchange.name: A Fair Exchange
A Fair Exchange.description: Swap one small object you can see for one you carry. On success, neither its owner nor anyone watching notices the switch.

Gone Before the Blood.name: Gone Before the Blood
Gone Before the Blood.description: Strike one foe and turn the attack itself into your escape from attention. The attack has impact 200 and uses your weapon's damage type. On success, you become Hidden after the blow lands.

The Second Shadow.name: The Second Shadow
The Second Shadow.description: Make two attacks against one or two targets before the first reveals your position. If you begin Hidden, both attacks receive Hidden's doubled damage before Hidden ends. Each attack uses its weapon's damage type.

Oathbound Smite.name: Oathbound Smite
Oathbound Smite.description: Speak a word of faith as you strike. Radiance runs along your weapon and breaks from the point of impact. The attack has impact 150 and deals radiant damage.

Vowshield.name: Vowshield
Vowshield.description: Name the person or sacred charge you defend and advance behind a towering shield of light. Strike one foe at impact 150 radiant and drive them away from your charge, ending between them and danger.

Let the Light Through.name: Let the Light Through
Let the Light Through.description: Open your body to your patron's presence for one action. Make one attack at impact 150 radiant or perform one supernatural physical feat your ordinary body could not. The presence withdraws when the action ends.

By My Hand, Rise.name: By My Hand, Rise
By My Hand, Rise.description: Place one hand on a living creature and call the strength of your vow through them. Restore 40% of the target's maximum health.

Judgment Falls.name: Judgment Falls
Judgment Falls.description: Name the wrong for which one foe must answer, then strike. The attack has impact 200 and deals radiant damage, or the damage type of your equipped Vow Focus.

The Vow Goes Before.name: The Vow Goes Before
The Vow Goes Before.description: Raise your equipped Vow Focus. Its divine aspect takes visible form ahead of you and drives through the opposition. Make one attack against each of up to three targets; each attack has impact 200 and uses the focus's damage type.

Let Fury Loose.name: Let Fury Loose
Let Fury Loose.description: Spend 5 stamina to enter controlled Fury for up to five turns. At levels 1–4 it grants +2 Strength; at levels 5–9, +3 Strength and +1 Constitution; at level 10 or higher, +4 Strength and +2 Constitution. When it ends, Fury Crash applies -2 Strength and -1 Constitution for up to four turns.

Second Wind.name: Second Wind
Second Wind.description: Break off, plant your feet, and drag your wind back. Restore about 40% of maximum stamina. Costs the turn, so it is taken instead of attacking or defending.

Draw Power.name: Draw Power
Draw Power.description: Stop, open yourself to the ambient current, and pull it in. Restore about 40% of maximum mana. Costs the turn, so it is taken instead of casting or acting.

Break the Line.name: Break the Line
Break the Line.description: Charge through one foe, formation, or physical barrier without stopping. A creature barring the way takes an impact-150 attack using your weapon's damage type, or impact if you are unarmed. On success, you end on the far side and leave a clear path behind you.

Worldbreaker.name: Worldbreaker
Worldbreaker.description: Strike one creature, structure, or patch of ground with everything your body can carry. The attack has impact 300 and uses your weapon's damage type, or impact if you are unarmed. On success, the point of impact and the terrain around it break open.

The Ground Gives First.name: The Ground Gives First
The Ground Gives First.description: Strike the ground beneath one foe hard enough to wrench the surface upward. The attack has impact 150 and deals impact damage. On success, the target is thrown down nearby and the ground remains broken.

Turn the Giant Over.name: Turn the Giant Over
Turn the Giant Over.description: Take hold of one foe, however much larger than you, lift it clear of the ground, and drive it down. The attack has impact 200 and deals impact damage, and the target ends prone.

One Against the Rest.name: One Against the Rest
One Against the Rest.description: Seize one foe and use their body as the weapon. Swing or hurl them through up to two other targets, then cast them down. Each target hit, including the one seized, takes an impact-150 attack dealing impact damage.

Back Through the Wall.name: Back Through the Wall
Back Through the Wall.description: Strike one foe hard enough to carry them through a nearby physical obstruction. The attack has impact 250 and uses your weapon's damage type, or impact if you are unarmed. If nothing stands behind them, drive them across the scene and leave them where you choose.

Form: Three Before Thunder.name: Form: Three Before Thunder
Form: Three Before Thunder.description: Reach one foe in a single breath. Palm, elbow, and heel strike from three angles before the first impact sounds; then you stand beyond the target as all three blows land together. The attack has impact 150 and deals impact damage.

Form: Dawnpalm.name: Form: Dawnpalm
Form: Dawnpalm.description: Draw one breath into your striking hand until dawn-light burns along every line of the palm. Strike one foe; the light passes through them and erupts from the far side in a white-gold sunburst. The attack has impact 150 and deals radiant damage.

Form: Stone-Breaking Hand.name: Form: Stone-Breaking Hand
Form: Stone-Breaking Hand.description: Command one hand to become harder than stone without losing speed or feeling. Strike with the bare hand; ordinary armor, stone, and metal can break before it does. The attack has impact 150 and deals impact damage.

Form: Sight Without Eyes.name: Form: Sight Without Eyes
Form: Sight Without Eyes.description: Close your eyes and still your breath. For one turn, your whole body senses movement through sound, vibration, displaced air, and touch. You can act and attack without sight, and darkness, smoke, blindness, or visual illusion cannot mislead you. This does not reveal a creature whose presence is otherwise unknown.

Form: Hundred-Pace Palm.name: Form: Hundred-Pace Palm
Form: Hundred-Pace Palm.description: Drive an open palm toward one target you can see. The air buckles along the strike and carries its full force across the intervening space, hitting as though your palm had landed directly against the target. You remain where you are and never touch them. The attack has impact 200 and deals impact damage.

Form: Flesh Remembers.name: Form: Flesh Remembers
Form: Flesh Remembers.description: Set one palm over a fresh wound in your own body and take a single measured breath. Blood returns, torn flesh closes, and broken bone draws back toward the shape it held before the injury. Restore 40% of your maximum health. This cannot replace missing tissue or remove poison, disease, or a curse.

Form: Flow Like Water.name: Form: Flow Like Water
Form: Flow Like Water.description: Command your muscles, joints, and bones to bend with supernatural flexibility. For one turn, your body can fold, twist, and flow through any space or restraint that could physically admit it. You remain solid flesh and cannot pass through an unbroken barrier.

Form: Stilling Hand.name: Form: Stilling Hand
Form: Stilling Hand.description: Touch one living creature and command one motion within its body to stop until the end of its next turn: its voice cannot form, its grasp opens, its legs will not carry it, or its breath cannot support spell or exertion. It remains conscious and free to act within that limit. The Form cannot stop a heart, kill, or cause lasting injury.

Form: The Body Obeys.name: Form: The Body Obeys
Form: The Body Obeys.description: For one turn, command your whole body to become whatever one physical deed needs: impossible strength, speed, hardness, flexibility, or lightness. Make one attack against up to three targets at impact 250, or attempt one physical feat beyond mortal limits. You stay flesh: you cannot fly, pass through solid matter, grow new body parts, or change another body.

Bloodstep.name: Bloodstep
Bloodstep.description: Open one practiced scar and spend 10% of your maximum health. Cast the blood across the scene in a bright arc, run along it, and descend into one attack at impact 150 piercing.

First Cut.name: First Cut
First Cut.description: Make one piercing attack at impact 150 against a living, blood-bearing foe. On success, leave the target Bleeding through the next exchange unless the wound is closed or spent.

Second Cut.name: Second Cut
Second Cut.description: Attack one living foe who was already Bleeding before this action. The wound rises into your blade as a shadow attack at impact 150. On a successful hit, restore 20% of your maximum health and end the target’s Bleeding without its follow-up pulse.

Hungerblade.name: Hungerblade
Hungerblade.description: Draw your weapon across a practiced scar and spend 10% of your maximum health. Blood extends its edge into a crimson blade that sweeps through up to three targets. Make one piercing attack against each at impact 125. Every living, blood-bearing target hit is left Bleeding through the next exchange.

Blood Has Weight.name: Blood Has Weight
Blood Has Weight.description: Seize the blood leaving one foe who was already Bleeding before this action and make it impossibly heavy. Make one piercing attack at impact 200. On success, the blood drags the target down and pins them for one turn. Their Bleeding remains to resolve normally.

The Red Double.name: The Red Double
The Red Double.description: Open a deep practiced wound and spend 20% of your maximum health. Your blood rises beside you as a full-sized double carrying a red copy of your weapon. You and the double each make one attack at impact 200, against the same target or different targets, using your weapon’s damage type or piercing damage if you are unarmed. The double collapses when both attacks end.

Pass the Pulse.name: Pass the Pulse
Pass the Pulse.description: Reach into the wound of one living foe who was already Bleeding and draw its failing strength into another living target. Make one shadow attack at impact 200. On success, restore 20% of the recipient’s maximum health and end the foe’s Bleeding without its follow-up pulse.

The Red Feast.name: The Red Feast
The Red Feast.description: Reach for up to three living foes who were already Bleeding before this action. Make one shadow attack against each at impact 200. If at least one attack succeeds, restore 20% of your maximum health total, not per target. Every successfully drained target’s Bleeding ends without its follow-up pulse.

Open Vein.name: Open Vein
Open Vein.description: Open a vein, yours or a living foe's, and pour the blood into one attack. Your own: spend 10% of your maximum health; the attack has impact 200 and deals piercing damage. A foe's: the attack has impact 200 and deals shadow damage, and a hit restores 10% of your maximum health and leaves the foe Bleeding through the next exchange.

The Blood Stands Up.name: The Blood Stands Up
The Blood Stands Up.description: Open every scar and spend 20% of your maximum health. Your blood rises around you as a towering red body for one turn. Make one piercing attack against each of up to three targets at impact 250, or perform one physical feat no mortal body could manage.

Form: The World Holds Its Breath.name: Form: The World Holds Its Breath
Form: The World Holds Its Breath.description: Take one perfect breath and move faster than sound for one attack or feat: strike a formation from every side, run up falling stone, or carry someone out of a collapse before the first stone lands. An attack has impact 300.

Walking Lie.name: Walking Lie
Walking Lie.description: Speak, sing, or gesture one brief illusion into the scene, complete with sound and motion. It lasts through one immediate action or reaction before breaking.

Cutting Verse.name: Cutting Verse
Cutting Verse.description: Deliver one line, note, or gesture with enough force to strike the mind directly. Make one attack at impact 150 that deals psychic damage.

Take Up the Chorus.name: Take Up the Chorus
Take Up the Chorus.description: Sing a rising refrain that puts breath back into tired lungs. Restore 25% of maximum stamina to yourself or one ally who hears you.

An Invitation Follows.name: An Invitation Follows
An Invitation Follows.description: Give a notable public performance and let word of it reach the people who matter locally. On a successful Performance check, a wealthy or influential person—or their representative—offers an invitation into company or a venue normally closed to strangers.

The Room Is Yours.name: The Room Is Yours
The Room Is Yours.description: Take command of a gathered audience for one brief song, speech, or story. On a successful Performance check, everyone who can hear gives it their full attention and understands what you mean. When it ends, each responds according to their own motives.

The Final Chord.name: The Final Chord
The Final Chord.description: Sing or play one final chord that carries through the whole scene and strikes at the minds of your foes. Make one attack against each of up to three foes at impact 250 that deals psychic damage.

This Is How It Happened.name: This Is How It Happened
This Is How It Happened.description: Tell your version of a recent event so well that people want to repeat it. On a successful Performance check, your version starts spreading through the local gossip.

Magebolt.name: Magebolt
Magebolt.description: Gather arcane force into a white-blue bolt and hurl it at one target. Make one arcane attack at impact 150. The bolt bursts on impact into shards of light.

The Unwritten Spell.name: The Unwritten Spell
The Unwritten Spell.description: Use one magical principle you have witnessed or studied to design and attempt a new spell. You gain +10 on its first casting. On full success, you learn the finished spell as a new ability.

Hand of Force.name: Hand of Force
Hand of Force.description: Summon a giant translucent hand that closes around one target. Make one arcane attack at impact 150. On success, the hand crushes the target and holds them in place for one turn.

Spell in Waiting.name: Spell in Waiting
Spell in Waiting.description: Write one spell you know onto Prepared Vellum and cast it into the page without releasing it, making a scroll that casts that spell once when used. Making the scroll uses Lore one difficulty tier above casting the spell directly, with a minimum of Hard, and consumes one Prepared Vellum.

Spellshift.name: Spellshift
Spellshift.description: While casting a spell, change one feature of it: its origin, path, shape, choice of targets, or how its force is divided. The spell keeps its source and purpose.

Forked Comet.name: Forked Comet
Forked Comet.description: Launch one white-blue comet that divides in flight. Make two arcane attacks at impact 150 against the same target or different targets. The two halves strike from opposite directions.

Falling Upward.name: Falling Upward
Falling Upward.description: Reverse gravity beneath up to three targets. Make one impact attack against each at impact 150. On success, they fall violently upward and remain suspended for one turn.

White Ruin.name: White Ruin
White Ruin.description: Cast a narrow white ray that unbinds matter where it strikes. Make one arcane attack at impact 250. On success, the struck surface crumbles into pale ash around the point of impact.

One Law Bends.name: One Law Bends
One Law Bends.description: Choose one physical or magical rule governing the immediate scene and force it to admit one exception. Flame halts in midair, gravity turns toward a wall, a sealed door stands open, a summoning reverses, or a curse follows its loophole backward. The world visibly contorts around the exception and obeys.

No One Taught You This.name: No One Taught You This
No One Taught You This.description: Reach inward for a magical power you have never used before and attempt it by instinct. You gain +10 on the attempt. On full success, you learn the power as a new ability.

Power Breaks Loose.name: Power Breaks Loose
Power Breaks Loose.description: Stop holding the magic inside you. It erupts from your whole body, bends around your allies, and strikes up to three foes. Make one arcane attack against each at impact 125.

The Power Takes Shape.name: The Power Takes Shape
The Power Takes Shape.description: Release everything inside without losing yourself. For one turn, your inborn magic rises around you as an immense living form. Make one arcane attack against each of up to three targets at impact 250, or perform one great supernatural feat. The form collapses back into you when the turn ends.

It Simply Happens.name: It Simply Happens
It Simply Happens.description: Cast one spell you know without word, gesture, focus, flare, or warning. Nothing reveals the casting before its effect appears, and the spell cannot be interrupted during the cast.

Twin Casting.name: Twin Casting
Twin Casting.description: Cast one spell you know and let it emerge from you twice. Apply its immediate effect to two valid targets. If it attacks, make one attack against each at impact 150 using the spell's damage type.

Too Much at Once.name: Too Much at Once
Too Much at Once.description: Overfill one attack spell with more magic than it was meant to hold. Make one attack at impact 200 using the spell's damage type.

Living Magic.name: Living Magic
Living Magic.description: Let magic replace your body for one turn. Pass through one solid obstacle and make one arcane attack against each of up to three targets at impact 200, or perform one supernatural feat possible for a body made of magic. You take flesh again when the turn ends.

Handspan Gate.name: Handspan Gate
Handspan Gate.description: Draw your patron's sign in the air as a hand-sized portal. Part of a lesser servant reaches through and does one quick thing you choose: strike or grab a target, handle a small object, or deliver a short message. An attack has impact 150 and deals the servant's natural damage type, or shadow damage if none is established.

Pact Lash.name: Pact Lash
Pact Lash.description: Snap your patron’s sign toward one target you can see. A full stroke of the patron’s power crosses the scene as chain, claw, flame, shadow, storm, or its established equivalent. The attack has impact 150 and deals shadow damage, or the patron’s established damage type if different.

Pactfold.name: Pactfold
Pactfold.description: Place your patron’s sign on one creature or object and a second sign at a place you can see. Pull the marks together to move the target instantly to the second sign. A willing target arrives safely; an unwilling target is torn through and hurled out, taking impact damage.

Patron's Mark.name: Patron's Mark
Patron's Mark.description: Burn your patron’s sign onto one creature you can see and name one voluntary act it must not take: cross a threshold, speak a name, draw a weapon, or attack a named person. The creature remains free to disobey, but the first time it does so before the scene ends, the mark strikes it at impact 200 and disappears. The attack deals shadow damage, or the patron’s established damage type if different.

Patron's Servant.name: Patron's Servant
Patron's Servant.description: Open your patron’s sign wide enough for one lesser servant to cross whole. It takes a form suited to the patron, follows your spoken directions, and remains for the rest of the scene. It returns beyond the world when the scene ends or it is defeated.

Patron's Reach.name: Patron's Reach
Patron's Reach.description: Call one immense part or instrument of your patron into the scene: a hand, chain, jaw, wing, blade, storm, or its established equivalent. It closes on one target with overwhelming force, then withdraws. The attack has impact 250 and deals shadow damage, or the patron’s established damage type if different.

No World Between.name: No World Between
No World Between.description: Open a full breach to your patron for one turn. The patron manifests in the scene, and you direct one great physical deed suited to its nature: attack up to three targets at impact 250, seize or carry something enormous, or break a major obstacle. Any attack deals shadow damage, or the patron’s established damage type if different. When the deed ends, the breach closes.

Blood Tithe.name: Blood Tithe
Blood Tithe.description: Touch fresh blood from yourself or a living creature to your patron’s sign. If you open your own flesh for it, spend 10% of your maximum health. The sign drinks the blood and releases one shadow attack against a target you can see. The attack has impact 150.

The Sign Descends.name: The Sign Descends
The Sign Descends.description: Raise your holy symbol and call down a known sign of your deity. Make one attack at impact 150. Its damage follows the sign's nature: sunfire deals radiant, storm deals shock, iron or roots deal impact, and grave-light deals shadow.

Rain of Mercy.name: Rain of Mercy
Rain of Mercy.description: Raise your holy symbol and call warm golden rain over one living target. Heal them for 35% of their maximum health.

Not One Step More.name: Not One Step More
Not One Step More.description: Plant your feet, raise your holy symbol, and name what must leave. Make one radiant attack at impact 150 against an undead, fiend, shade, or possessing spirit without harming its host. If the attack fully succeeds, the target is also turned, banished, or cast out of its host.

Come Out and Be Named.name: Come Out and Be Named
Come Out and Be Named.description: Raise your holy symbol toward one established curse or profaned place and command the power behind it to show itself. It takes a visible form that can be confronted, and you strike it once at impact 200 radiant. Revealing it does not end the corruption; the manifested power must still be overcome.

Mercy Without Measure.name: Mercy Without Measure
Mercy Without Measure.description: Raise your holy symbol over one living creature. Restore 60% of its maximum health and end one poison or disease presently afflicting it.

The Reliquary Opens.name: The Reliquary Opens
The Reliquary Opens.description: Raise an equipped reliquary and call forth one sacred power its description establishes. Make one attack at impact 200 using its established damage type, restore 40% of one living target's maximum health if it carries a healing power, or perform one immediate divine deed its sacred history supports.

The Sign Fills the Sky.name: The Sign Fills the Sky
The Sign Fills the Sky.description: Raise your holy symbol and let your deity's known sign expand until it fills the scene overhead. Make one attack against each of up to three targets; each attack has impact 200 and uses the sign's established damage type.

The Miracle Returns.name: The Miracle Returns
The Miracle Returns.description: Perform the rite of one miracle already established in your faith. For one turn, that miracle happens again at the scale its story established. If it attacks, make one attack against each of up to three targets at impact 250 using the miracle's damage type. If it heals, restore 60% of the maximum health of one living target.

Greenbreak.name: Greenbreak
Greenbreak.description: Call a root, thorn, or other hard growth from the ground beneath one foe. It bursts upward with enough force to strike them. The attack has impact 150 and deals piercing or impact damage according to the growth.

Run It to Ruin.name: Run It to Ruin
Run It to Ruin.description: Mark one foe as your prey and hit them with the whole wild in one attack: antler, root, fang, and falling earth, each bursting from you in turn. The attack has impact 250 and deals piercing, impact, or poison damage depending on the final blow.

Wear the Wild.name: Wear the Wild
Wear the Wild.description: For one turn, become the wild itself, all bark, thorn, antler, fang, and storm, and use that body for one attack or impossible feat: break a formation, hold up a falling bridge, or overturn a siege beast. An attack has impact 300 and deals the damage type of the form you wear.

Greatshape.name: Greatshape
Greatshape.description: Cast off your mortal outline and become an immense beast for one immediate deed. Make one attack at impact 150 using the shape's natural damage type, or perform one physical feat your ordinary body could not. You return to yourself when the deed ends.

Life Knits Life.name: Life Knits Life
Life Knits Life.description: Lay a hand on one living creature and call its body back toward wholeness. Restore 40% of its maximum health.

A Thousand Small Lives.name: A Thousand Small Lives
A Thousand Small Lives.description: Break your body into a swarm of small living creatures for one action. Flow through any opening the swarm can cross, or engulf one foe in an impact-200 attack using the physical damage type that fits the creatures. Reform where the swarm ends.

Briar Colossus.name: Briar Colossus
Briar Colossus.description: Become a towering giant of bark, root, and thorn for one turn. Strike up to three foes; each attack has impact 150 and deals piercing damage. When the turn ends, return to your own shape.

The Green Tide.name: The Green Tide
The Green Tide.description: Call a season's growth through the entire scene at once. Roots and thorny growth split the ground, climb walls, and fill open space. Attack up to three foes at impact 200 with piercing damage. The new terrain remains afterward.

Elder Shape.name: Elder Shape
Elder Shape.description: Become an immense elder beast for one turn. Use its body to attack up to three targets at impact 250 using its natural damage type, or perform one physical feat beyond mortal limits. When the turn ends, take your own shape again.

No Shape Forgotten.name: No Shape Forgotten
No Shape Forgotten.description: Attempt the shape of one living creature you have pursued, tended, faced in danger, or closely observed. If the transformation fully succeeds, it becomes a named Shape ability you can learn and use again.

Soulstrike.name: Soulstrike
Soulstrike.description: Step your spirit half a pace out of your body as you attack. Flesh and spirit strike together. The attack has impact 150 and uses your weapon's damage type, or psychic damage if you strike without one. Your spirit returns at once.

Second Soul.name: Second Soul
Second Soul.description: Invite one named spirit from your court to share your body for one immediate deed. Its form appears over yours as you make one attack at impact 150 using its damage type or perform one supernatural feat within its nature. It leaves your body when the deed ends.

Walk Without Flesh.name: Walk Without Flesh
Walk Without Flesh.description: Step out of your body as a visible spirit for one action. Move through the scene, passing through one solid obstacle if needed, and make one psychic attack at impact 200. Then return to your waiting body.

Flesh Follows Spirit.name: Flesh Follows Spirit
Flesh Follows Spirit.description: Lay a hand on one living creature and draw its spirit firmly through every wounded part. Flesh follows spirit back toward wholeness. Restore 40% of the target's maximum health.

A Place at My Side.name: A Place at My Side
A Place at My Side.description: Call one named spirit from your court into full visible form beside you for one turn. It makes one attack at impact 200 using its own damage type or performs one immediate supernatural deed within its nature, then withdraws.

One Body, Three Voices.name: One Body, Three Voices
One Body, Three Voices.description: Call up to three named spirits from your court through your body in immediate succession. Make one attack against each of up to three targets; each attack has impact 200 and uses that spirit's damage type. All three spirits leave as the action ends.

Spirit Court.name: Spirit Court
Spirit Court.description: Call every named spirit in your court into visible presence for one turn. Make one attack against each of up to three targets; each attack has impact 250 and uses a damage type one of the spirits can supply. Instead, the court may perform one great supernatural deed within their combined natures. They withdraw when the turn ends.

Disaster in Three.name: Disaster in Three
Disaster in Three.description: In three motions, cage a charge in charm-wire, arm it, and hurl it at one foe. Choose acid, fire, or shock as it leaves your hand. The attack has impact 150 and deals the chosen damage type.

Everything Has Parts.name: Everything Has Parts
Everything Has Parts.description: Touch one broken everyday item or a big heap of manufactured scrap, and every useful part leaps free into one bundle of Mechanical Components. A carried source item is used up.

Teeth Underfoot.name: Teeth Underfoot
Teeth Underfoot.description: Skid one carried trap across the ground under a foe, arming it as it slides, so it springs on them. Make one attack at impact 150 using the trap's damage type; the trap is used up.

The Room Was Ready.name: The Room Was Ready
The Room Was Ready.description: Spring a trap or device you prepared earlier in the scene as a foe reaches its trigger. Make one attack at impact 150 using its damage type; a mundane rig deals piercing or impact damage according to its construction.

One More Working.name: One More Working
One More Working.description: Grab the wreckage of a trap or single-use device that already went off this scene and force it to fire once more. It attacks at impact 150 with the same damage type; nothing usable is left.

Between Two Footfalls.name: Between Two Footfalls
Between Two Footfalls.description: Open a trap blueprint you carry and build its device between one enemy step and the next. If you carry every material the blueprint names, construct and spring it in this action: consume those materials, make one attack at impact 300 using the trap's damage type, and retain the blueprint and toolkit.

The Third Measure.name: The Third Measure
The Third Measure.description: Pour one carried potion, oil, venom, extract, or etchant into a three-necked glass heart and apply its effect once to each of up to three targets it could affect. If it harms them, make one attack against each at impact 150 using its damage type. The item is used up.

Second Function.name: Second Function
Second Function.description: Reconfigure your gadget weapon into one other physical tool for this action. Use the new function immediately; afterward the weapon snaps back into its fighting shape. An attack made this way keeps the weapon's damage type.

One Turn Too Many.name: One Turn Too Many
One Turn Too Many.description: Wind your gadget weapon one turn past its stop and release everything in one attack at impact 200 using the weapon's damage type. The mechanism kicks back into its ordinary setting afterward.

Clockwork Scuttler.name: Clockwork Scuttler
Clockwork Scuttler.description: Snap together a palm-sized clockwork creature and give it one immediate physical task. It unfolds the limbs and tools it needs, races to complete the task, then comes apart. If it attacks, the attack has impact 150 and deals piercing or impact damage according to its construction.

One Good Machine.name: One Good Machine
One Good Machine.description: Empty your kit and build one impossible machine for this turn. Choose piercing, impact, acid, fire, or shock. It attacks up to three targets; each attack has impact 250 and deals the chosen damage type. Instead of attacking, it may perform one great physical deed. When the turn ends, it tears itself apart.

Foreseen.name: Foreseen
Foreseen.description: Reveal that you saw this moment coming and prepared for it: a needed object is already in place, a hidden danger is marked, or an escape is open.

See It Coming.name: See It Coming
See It Coming.description: See every moving thing a heartbeat before it moves, and act first: strike, grab, cross, or step in before anyone else can.

Run Beside Me.name: Run Beside Me
Run Beside Me.description: Lock eyes with a beast, strike your chest, and run. It takes your goal as its own for one wild act: charging with you, hunting your target, carrying someone you are saving, or carrying you.

Loose the Shade-Hound.name: Loose the Shade-Hound
Loose the Shade-Hound.description: Call a ghostly hound of grey mist out of your shadow and send it at one foe. The attack has impact 150 and deals shadow damage.

The Gray Raven.name: The Gray Raven
The Gray Raven.description: Raise a dead carrion bird as your scout and see through its eyes. It cannot fight. Speak its name again at dawn or it falls apart.

The Gray Tether.name: The Gray Tether
The Gray Tether.description: At dawn, knot one raised servant's shadow around your wrist to keep it whole past dawn.

The Gray Muster.name: The Gray Muster
The Gray Muster.description: At dawn, bind up to three raised servants inside one grave-circle to keep them all whole past dawn.

The Gray Legion.name: The Gray Legion
The Gray Legion.description: At dawn, draw up to five raised servants into a black banner to keep the whole company whole past dawn.

Threshold Step.name: Threshold Step
Threshold Step.description: Cut a doorway in the air and step through it to any place you can see.

The Ways Between.name: The Ways Between
The Ways Between.description: Open a doorway to any place you know. It stays open just long enough for you and the companions beside you to step through.

Sunder the Binding.name: Sunder the Binding
Sunder the Binding.description: Find where a true curse hooks into its victim, drag it into the open, and break it. This can end a curse carried as a trait, a bargained item's hold, or the grey country's mark.

Ride the Storm.name: Ride the Storm
Ride the Storm.description: Call the wind beneath your feet and fly on it, turning, climbing, and diving as you like. Once the spell succeeds, the wind will not let you fall until you choose to land.

The Graywalk.name: The Graywalk
The Graywalk.description: Step through your own shadow and cross, body and all, into the Shadelands. To come back, find your shadow there and step through again.

True Resurrection.name: True Resurrection
True Resurrection.description: Perform a full rite over the dead, call their soul by name, and declare the price before witnesses. If the soul answers, it returns to its body alive. A soul can be brought back this way only once.

Turning Ward.name: Turning Ward
Turning Ward.description: Name fire, frost, shadow, or poison and trace a ward across your chest: defend yourself, and resist that harm until the ward breaks, the danger passes, or you move on. A new Turning Ward replaces the old one.

Greater Turning Ward.name: Greater Turning Ward
Greater Turning Ward.description: Name fire, frost, shadow, or poison and draw a ward around your whole company: defend yourself or one ally, and all of you resist that harm until the ward breaks, the danger passes, or you move on. This replaces any Turning Ward already on them.

No Road Needed.name: No Road Needed
No Road Needed.description: Ride where no road goes—up stairs, over walls, across rooftops or a broken bridge—in one unbroken run, carrying your passengers safely through.

Field Engine.name: Field Engine
Field Engine.description: Build a crude siege engine from your tools and whatever is at hand, and fire it at once. The attack has impact 200 and deals piercing or impact damage depending on how it is built. It falls apart afterward.

Breath Returned.name: Breath Returned
Breath Returned.description: Bring back someone whose breath or heartbeat has just stopped, pulling them back from the edge of death.

Golden Stitches.name: Golden Stitches
Golden Stitches.description: Sew one wound shut with a web of glowing golden thread, closing torn flesh and broken bone in one pull. Restore 25% of the target's maximum health.

Shockwave Strike.name: Shockwave Strike
Shockwave Strike.description: Land one compact blow whose force passes through the target's whole body and bursts out the far side in a ring of dust and debris. The attack has impact 200 and uses your weapon's damage type.

Living Sigil.name: Living Sigil
Living Sigil.description: Trace a burning sigil onto your weapon, tool, or missile, name a power — fire, frost, shock, acid, poison, radiant, shadow, arcane, or psychic — and strike in the same motion. Make one attack at impact 150 that deals that damage type.

Crown of Night.name: Crown of Night
Crown of Night.description: Raise a crown of total darkness over the scene and name one foe; every shadow turns on them at once. The attack has impact 200 and deals shadow or psychic damage, chosen when you cast it.

Night Talon.name: Night Talon
Night Talon.description: Send your shadow racing across the ground to rise under one foe as a huge black claw. The attack has impact 150 and deals shadow damage.

Skyfall.name: Skyfall
Skyfall.description: Spring straight up over the target and drop heel-first onto them with your full weight, landing on your feet. The attack has impact 200 and deals impact damage.

Warstroke.name: Warstroke
Warstroke.description: Turn into one huge two-handed swing that hits up to three enemies in reach with the full weight of the blow. Each hit has impact 150 and uses your weapon's damage type.

Thunderburst.name: Thunderburst
Thunderburst.description: Throw a ball of wind and lightning that bursts on one foe with a thunderclap, blasting loose objects and bystanders away. The attack has impact 150 and deals shock damage.

Thunderlance.name: Thunderlance
Thunderlance.description: Pull lightning from a storm cloud above your hand and throw it like a spear through one foe. It explodes in a thunderclap that staggers everything nearby. The attack has impact 200 and deals shock damage.

Earthfist.name: Earthfist
Earthfist.description: Wrench your hand upward and a stone fist bursts from the ground under one foe, knocking them flat or caging them in rock. The attack has impact 150 and deals impact damage. The stone remains.

Worldrend.name: Worldrend
Worldrend.description: Strike the earth and send a crack racing ahead of you that heaves into a ridge or drops into a chasm, throwing aside up to three foes. Each hit has impact 150 and deals impact damage.

Ruinmaker.name: Ruinmaker
Ruinmaker.description: Smash the ground or a nearby structure so it bursts into a storm of stone, timber, and debris that strikes up to three enemies in front of you. Each hit has impact 150 and deals impact damage.

Ghost Passage.name: Ghost Passage
Ghost Passage.description: Wait for the moment every eye in a watched, guarded, or brightly lit space is turned elsewhere, then cross it in one smooth, silent line. Gain +15 on the attempt to cross it unseen.

Veil Champion.name: Veil Champion
Veil Champion.description: Draw a full summoning circle and call a powerful being of the kind you choose to fight for the purpose you name.

Swift Circle.name: Swift Circle
Swift Circle.description: Trace a quick summoning circle, and one limb of a planar beast bursts through to strike, grab, or shove whatever you point at. If it attacks, the attack has impact 150.

A Blade's Breadth.name: A Blade's Breadth
A Blade's Breadth.description: Shoulder past the target's guard with your dagger hidden along your forearm, then turn your wrist and drive the point home. The attack has impact 200 and uses your weapon's damage type.

Rankbreaker.name: Rankbreaker
Rankbreaker.description: Drive shield-first into the enemy line and keep going, turning each collision into the next until you burst through up to three enemies. Each hit has impact 150 and deals impact damage.

Lone Phalanx.name: Lone Phalanx
Lone Phalanx.description: Advance one step behind a blur of thrusts that fills the space ahead like a whole rank of spearmen, striking up to three enemies. Each hit has impact 150 and uses your weapon's damage type.

Reconstruct the Scene.name: Reconstruct the Scene
Reconstruct the Scene.description: Put every object back where it stood and mark each footprint, wound, and line of sight until the whole event is laid out in order. One fact it proves becomes impossible to deny.

Retrace Their Steps.name: Retrace Their Steps
Retrace Their Steps.description: Retrace the route someone took through this place before you arrived. You find what they touched, where they went, and what they came for or left behind.

Throughshot.name: Throughshot
Throughshot.description: Draw your bow to its limit and shoot straight through cover, shield, and armor to hit the target behind them. The attack has impact 200 and uses your weapon's damage type.

Red Dominion.name: Red Dominion
Red Dominion.description: Close your bloody fist and seize one living creature's blood: yank its body aside, freeze a limb, tear open a wound, or drain its life. A damaging use has impact 200 and deals shadow damage.

The Red Price.name: The Red Price
The Red Price.description: Cut yourself and pour your own life into one weapon, spell, or punch. It erupts with black-red power on impact, but the cut hurts you too. The attack has impact 150 and deals shadow damage.

Sacred Word.name: Sacred Word
Sacred Word.description: Speak one holy word. It blazes across one foe and bursts into light. The attack has impact 150 and deals radiant damage.

Winter's Grasp.name: Winter's Grasp
Winter's Grasp.description: Point, and ice springs up to lock one foe's limbs and weapon in place, freeze a door in its frame, or seal the ground under a hard shell.

Sphere of Winter.name: Sphere of Winter
Sphere of Winter.description: Throw a bead of killing cold that bursts into a blizzard around up to three foes. Each hit has impact 150 and deals frost damage. The ice and frozen ground remain afterward.

True Self Hidden.name: True Self Hidden
True Self Hidden.description: Leave a perfect false you where your enemies expect you and strike from where they don't. Make one attack at impact 250 while they fight your double.

Mirrorstep.name: Mirrorstep
Mirrorstep.description: Send an illusory double running across the fight while you go the other way. Gain +10 to slip away, lose a pursuer, or become Hidden.

Far Fist.name: Far Fist
Far Fist.description: Punch at a target out of reach. The air buckles in a visible line and delivers the full blow across the gap. The attack has impact 200 and deals impact damage.

Catalyst.name: Catalyst
Catalyst.description: Crush two prepared reagents together and throw the reaction at one foe. Choose fire, acid, or poison. The attack has impact 150 and deals the chosen damage type.

Wyrmseed.name: Wyrmseed
Wyrmseed.description: Throw a seed of green fire that hatches in midair into a thorny wooden serpent, which coils around one foe and bites. The attack has impact 150 and deals poison damage.

Firebrand Charge.name: Firebrand Charge
Firebrand Charge.description: Wrap your body in flame and charge. Your weapon, shoulder, or hand hits first and the fire bursts after it, knocking back anyone nearby. The attack has impact 150 and deals fire damage.

Red Comet.name: Red Comet
Red Comet.description: Wreathe yourself in fire and hurl your body across the fight like a falling star, crashing into one foe or barrier and leaving a burning trail. The attack has impact 200 and deals fire damage.

Staff Wheel.name: Staff Wheel
Staff Wheel.description: Spin your staff into a blurred wheel and drive it through up to three enemies, hitting high and low with every turn, then stop on the far side. Each hit has impact 150 and uses your weapon's damage type.

Honored Host.name: Honored Host
Honored Host.description: Call the honored dead of your faith into a glowing rank behind you and send them charging through one foe. The attack has impact 150 and deals radiant damage.

The Fourth Strike.name: The Fourth Strike
The Fourth Strike.description: Strike three times from different angles to move their guard, break their footing, and turn their counter aside, then land a fourth blow in the opening. The fourth blow has impact 300.

Carve the Lane.name: Carve the Lane
Carve the Lane.description: Fight your way across a crowd of enemies, shoving and cutting as you go. Make one attack against each of up to three foes in your path at impact 275.

Turning Point.name: Turning Point
Turning Point.description: Pick the spot that will decide the fight and take it in one bold move, throwing back the foe who holds it. Stop that foe's attack and make one attack against them at impact 275.

Give Magic Weight.name: Give Magic Weight
Give Magic Weight.description: Clap your hands and harden your magic into one solid object of pure color, such as a bridge, a wall, a hand, or a blade. It catches, carries, blocks, or strikes once, then shatters into light. If it strikes, the attack has impact 300.

The Second Arc.name: The Second Arc
The Second Arc.description: Strike one foe with your magic and whip its trailing light into a second. Make one attack against each of two foes at impact 300 with your spell's damage type.

Naked Magic.name: Naked Magic
Naked Magic.description: Crush one magical attack in your hands until its element burns away, then drive the pure white-violet magic through one target. The attack has impact 300 and deals arcane damage.

Set the Terms.name: Set the Terms
Set the Terms.description: Use one weapon clash to force a condition on the fight: pin their weapon, cut off their retreat, push the fight across a line, or open a way through.

Answer in Kind.name: Answer in Kind
Answer in Kind.description: Turn a foe's attack into your counter: slip inside a thrust, turn with a heavy blow, or let a charge carry them onto your weapon. Against a foe who is attacking you, the counter has impact 200.

No Motion Wasted.name: No Motion Wasted
No Motion Wasted.description: Fight through the danger in front of you in one unbroken chain, every parry becoming a strike and every recoil a step, and finish on the far side with your weapon already still. Strike up to three foes; each hit has impact 250.

Hold the Spell.name: Hold the Spell
Hold the Spell.description: Hold a spell you are casting inside your body instead of releasing it, and let it go at the moment you choose.

Wear the Working.name: Wear the Working
Wear the Working.description: Pour one spell you know through your whole body until you become it, as living fire, storm, frost, shadow, or light, for one attack or feat. An attack has impact 250 and deals that magic's damage type.

Two Spells at Once.name: Two Spells at Once
Two Spells at Once.description: Cast two spells you know at the same time and release them as one blast that carries both. If it attacks, the attack has impact 300.

Answer for Them.name: Answer for Them
Answer for Them.description: Name the person, people, or sacred charge your oath requires you to answer for, then call on your equipped Vow Focus. Its divine aspect takes bodily form through you for this action. Make one attack at impact 250 using the focus's damage type, or perform one physical feat your ordinary body could not.

The Oath Answers.name: The Oath Answers
The Oath Answers.description: Speak a fulfilled vow in full and call on the equipped Vow Focus born from it. Become the living battle-form of the patron who answered for one turn. Make one attack against each of up to three targets; each attack has impact 250 and uses the focus's damage type, or radiant damage if none is established. Instead, perform one great physical deed in direct service of the oath. Return to yourself when the turn ends.

Bond Incarnate.name: Bond Incarnate
Bond Incarnate.description: Call your bonded beast-spirit by name. It appears in full, solid form, does one deed that fits its nature, then returns to the bond. If it attacks, the attack has impact 200.

Send the Shade.name: Send the Shade
Send the Shade.description: Send your bonded Shade through one foe. It passes through them like an open door onto the land of the dead, draining color and warmth. The attack has impact 200 and deals shadow damage.

Advancing Dawn.name: Advancing Dawn
Advancing Dawn.description: Name the danger and charge it with a white-gold sunrise at your back, putting all that light into one attack. The attack has impact 150 and deals radiant damage, leaving Galard's sign burning where it hits.

Shieldfall.name: Shieldfall
Shieldfall.description: Bring a shield of white-gold light down edge-first through one foe, then plant it upright between the threat and the people you protect. The attack has impact 150 and deals radiant damage.

The Place Answers.name: The Place Answers
The Place Answers.description: Put your hand on the ground and wake the oldest spirit of this place. It rises in a body made of the land and uses its full power for the purpose you name.

The Deed Walks.name: The Deed Walks
The Deed Walks.description: Name what you are doing right now, such as a hunt, a fight, or a rescue, and call its spirit into a visible body beside you to perform one mighty act for it.

Close the Trap.name: Close the Trap
Close the Trap.description: Read how the positions and terrain already surround one objective, then make the move that closes it: a capture, an encirclement, an escape, or a breakthrough.

Take the Ground.name: Take the Ground
Take the Ground.description: Call the move and make it first: drive a foe back, turn their flank, or seize the ground you chose before the enemy can react.

Death Can Wait.name: Death Can Wait
Death Can Wait.description: When someone is moments from dying, grab hold and work fast with pressure, bone-setting, and whatever tools are at hand to keep them alive through the immediate danger.

Blood, Bone, Breath.name: Blood, Bone, Breath
Blood, Bone, Breath.description: Work on one wounded person with your bare hands: stop the bleeding, set the break, and get them breathing. Restore 15% of their maximum health and end their Bleeding.

Inside Their Guard.name: Inside Their Guard
Inside Their Guard.description: Use what one person has already shown you about themselves to get past their guard: your words land, your hand goes unnoticed, or your blow finds their weak side.

Firethief.name: Firethief
Firethief.description: Pull the heat out of the air around one foe into a white flame in your palm, then hurl it back at them. The attack has impact 150 and deals fire damage.

Forked Thunder.name: Forked Thunder
Forked Thunder.description: Tear a spark apart between your hands and send lightning forking into up to three foes. Each hit has impact 125 and deals shock damage.

Tidefall.name: Tidefall
Tidefall.description: Lift a great wave over one foe and bring it crashing down, freezing solid as it hits. The attack has impact 150 and deals frost damage.

Earthrise.name: Earthrise
Earthrise.description: Push both hands down and raise the ground into a path across the scene or a high wall through it. The new shape stays.

Daybreak.name: Daybreak
Daybreak.description: Draw a burning line across the air that opens into a sunrise, blasting holy light through up to three foes in front of you. Each hit has impact 125 and deals radiant damage.

Black Star.name: Black Star
Black Star.description: Pull a small black star from between your palms and throw it at one foe, where it collapses in a silent burst. The attack has impact 150 and deals shadow damage.

Mirrorstorm.name: Mirrorstorm
Mirrorstorm.description: Shatter your reflection into a swarm of doubles that rush one foe from every side and burst on contact. The attack has impact 150 and deals psychic damage.

Gravewind.name: Gravewind
Gravewind.description: Rip a small tear into the Shadelands and blast a freezing wind full of grasping pale hands across up to three foes. Each hit has impact 125 and deals shadow damage.

Sudden Calling.name: Sudden Calling
