Sudden Calling.description: Rip open a summoning circle and pull through a lesser planar creature of your choice. It does one thing you command, then the circle takes it home.

Three Futures.name: Three Futures
Three Futures.description: Start an action and watch three versions of yourself try it three different ways at once, then choose the one that becomes real.

Briar Tide.name: Briar Tide
Briar Tide.description: Raise a rolling wall of black roots and venomous thorns that tears through up to three foes in front of you. Each hit has impact 125 and deals poison damage.

Soul Unbound.name: Soul Unbound
Soul Unbound.description: Your spirit steps out of your body as a towering glowing figure and strikes one foe straight through their armor. The attack has impact 150 and deals psychic damage.

Crimson Reaping.name: Crimson Reaping
Crimson Reaping.description: Strike a living foe and pull a stream of their life back into your body. The attack has impact 150 and deals shadow damage. On a successful hit, restore 20% of your maximum health.

Draw the Wound.name: Draw the Wound
Draw the Wound.description: Pull one affliction out of a living body as a writhing knot of color and pain, then tear it apart. End one poison or disease afflicting the target and restore 15% of its maximum health.

Grand Design.name: Grand Design
Grand Design.description: Touch one crafted object and name what it is for. A giant glowing copy appears and does that job once at impossible scale, then falls apart into sparks. If it attacks, the attack has impact 200 and uses the object's damage type.

Field Dressing.name: Field Dressing
Field Dressing.description: Drop beside one wounded person and pack, bind, and brace their injuries in one fast sequence. Restore 25% of their maximum health.

Show How It Happened.name: Show How It Happened
Show How It Happened.description: Pick up one object that was used here and act out exactly what was last done with it, from the first movement to where it ended up. Everyone watching sees how it happened.

Bait the Reaction.name: Bait the Reaction
Bait the Reaction.description: Give one person a cue you know they will react to, then act while they are reacting.

One Lesson.name: One Lesson
One Lesson.description: Show an animal one new trick with your hands, voice, and body, and it performs it at once as if trained for years.

Thundering Pass.name: Thundering Pass
Thundering Pass.description: Ride at full speed through the fight, you and your mount striking up to three enemies you pass, and come out the other side without slowing. Each hit has impact 125 and uses your weapon's damage type.

Carry the Battle.name: Carry the Battle
Carry the Battle.description: Attack one foe and drive them across the fight under an unbroken advance, ending with a blow that leaves them where you choose. As you move, you knock nearby enemies off balance and spoil their formation. The attack has impact 150 and uses your weapon's damage type.

Empty Hand.name: Empty Hand
Empty Hand.description: Take one hand-sized object you can see, even from another person's grasp or a locked container. On success, it is in your hand before anyone sees how you took it.

Hurl the Unliftable.name: Hurl the Unliftable
Hurl the Unliftable.description: Seize an object or creature too heavy for an ordinary person to lift and hurl it where you choose. One creature thrown or struck by it takes an impact-150 attack dealing impact damage, and the landing changes the terrain.

Worldchord.name: Worldchord
Worldchord.description: Hold one clear note until every hard object in the scene answers at its own pitch. Cut the note short and send the gathered chord through up to three targets. Each attack has impact 150 and deals psychic damage.

The Voice Between Blades.name: The Voice Between Blades
The Voice Between Blades.description: Sing one phrase into the fight and every weapon, spell, and battle cry stops on the same beat. No one who hears it can commit violence while you make one statement and someone answers; if no one answers, the pause ends after a few breaths. It cannot force agreement or lasting peace; afterward, each side chooses whether to fight again.

Become the Spell.name: Become the Spell
Become the Spell.description: Let your body come apart into a rushing stream of magic. Pass through one target, making one arcane attack at impact 150, then take flesh again wherever you choose in the scene.

Whole Sword.name: Whole Sword
Whole Sword.description: Strike with the pommel, the edge, and then the point in one smooth combination, each blow opening the way for the next. The attack has impact 150 and uses your weapon's damage type.

Lunge.name: Lunge
Lunge.description: Close the distance in one long step and drive the point home before your foe can answer. The attack has impact 150 and deals piercing damage.

Whirling Staff.name: Whirling Staff
Whirling Staff.description: Spin your staff around your body so both ends strike up to three enemies around you, then catch it upright without giving ground. Each hit has impact 125 and uses your weapon's damage type.

Threefold Flight.name: Threefold Flight
Threefold Flight.description: Loose three arrows down the same line so fast that each drives the last one deeper, hitting as one shot with the force of three. The attack has impact 150 and uses your weapon's damage type.

Unbroken Arc.name: Unbroken Arc
Unbroken Arc.description: Let one great cut carry you all the way around and bring the axe down again on the same foe or another in reach. The attack has impact 150 and uses your weapon's damage type.

Full Reach.name: Full Reach
Full Reach.description: Hit with the butt up close, the blade at middle distance, and a final thrust at full reach, all in one motion. The attack has impact 150 and uses your weapon's damage type.

Twice Struck.name: Twice Struck
Twice Struck.description: Land a full blow, then hit the exact same spot again before the target can move. The attack has impact 150 and uses your weapon's damage type.

Seven Cuts.name: Seven Cuts
Seven Cuts.description: Close in and slash seven times in a single breath, then step back out of reach. The attack has impact 150 and uses your weapon's damage type.

Long Throw.name: Long Throw
Long Throw.description: Put your whole body into one throw that crosses the entire fight and hits as hard as a blow at arm's length. The attack has impact 150 and uses your weapon's damage type.

Four Weapons.name: Four Weapons
Four Weapons.description: Hit with fist, elbow, knee, and heel in one unbroken combination. The attack has impact 150 and deals impact damage.

Full Weight.name: Full Weight
Full Weight.description: Swing the warhammer in one full circle and bring all that momentum down in a single crushing blow. The attack has impact 150 and uses your weapon's damage type.

Advancing Wall.name: Advancing Wall
Advancing Wall.description: Slam into the target behind your shield, turn the impact into a second full-body slam, and plant the shield upright. The attack has impact 150 and deals impact damage.

The Glance.name: The Glance
The Glance.description: Catch a living person's eyes and take over their intention for one moment: the hand stops, the question goes unasked, the guard decides he saw nobody. It works on one mind at a time, not on the dead, the mindless, or anyone who will not meet your eyes, and afterward they remember doing something they cannot explain.

Old Shapes.name: Old Shapes
Old Shapes.description: Turn into mist, a bat, or a wolf and travel that way until you choose to stop. Mist goes where air goes and cannot be struck; the bat is fast but sees little detail; the wolf can fight but cannot open doors. Everything you wear and carry stays behind.

Flying Headbutt.name: Flying Headbutt
Flying Headbutt.description: Launch yourself headfirst at an enemy. Your skull strikes with the force of a battering ram, dealing impact damage at impact 150 and knocking the target backward.

Everything Is a Nail.name: Everything Is a Nail
Everything Is a Nail.description: Bring your hammer down with enough force to smash an enemy through the furniture, door, or other breakable obstacle behind them. The attack has impact 150 and uses your hammer’s damage type.

Hammerfall.name: Hammerfall
Hammerfall.description: Leap into the air and land hammer-first on an enemy. The attack has impact 150 and uses your hammer’s damage type.

Make Some Room.name: Make Some Room
Make Some Room.description: Swing your hammer in one enormous circle, striking up to three enemies around you. Each attack has impact 125 and uses your hammer’s damage type.

Dwarf Toss.name: Dwarf Toss
Dwarf Toss.description: Seize an enemy and throw them into another. Both targets take impact damage at impact 150.

Through the Wall.name: Through the Wall
Through the Wall.description: Charge straight through a wall or barricade and hammer an enemy on the other side. The attack has impact 200 and uses your hammer’s damage type. The barrier must be something you can physically break.

Anvil and Hammer.name: Anvil and Hammer
Anvil and Hammer.description: Launch your hammer into an enemy, then follow it with a flying headbutt. Resolve the combination as one attack at impact 200, using your hammer’s damage type.

Bring Down the House.name: Bring Down the House
Bring Down the House.description: Smash your hammer into the ground, sending a violent shock through the surrounding floor or earth. Strike up to three enemies at impact 150, dealing impact damage and throwing them off their feet.

Dwarven Express.name: Dwarven Express
Dwarven Express.description: Hurl yourself forward in a tumbling charge of armor, boots, and hammer. Smash through up to three enemies in your path, making an impact-damage attack against each at impact 200.

Psychic Lance.name: Psychic Lance
Psychic Lance.description: Drive a concentrated thought into one mind you can see. Make one psychic attack at impact 150.

The Rider Answers.name: The Rider Answers
The Rider Answers.description: Call one willing named spirit from your court and open your body to it. On success, it enters and remains after this action, giving you the Ridden trait until it departs, is expelled, or the channel breaks. While it rides, spirit channeling governs the attacks and supernatural feats it supplies, and damage follows its nature.

Watchfire Blade.name: Watchfire Blade
Watchfire Blade.description: Wake the watchfire spark in your weapon so the strike bursts into roaring flame. The attack has impact 150 and deals fire damage.

Grand Classical Lunge.name: Grand Classical Lunge
Grand Classical Lunge.description: Lunge in the grand classical style of House Montrose, a long, perfect thrust delivered with ceremony. The attack has impact 150 and uses your weapon's damage type.

Flowing Water Riposte.name: Flowing Water Riposte
Flowing Water Riposte.description: Yield to the attack like water in the House Marenne style, then flow around it and strike back. The attack has impact 150 and uses your weapon's damage type.

Crowd-Thrilling Flourish.name: Crowd-Thrilling Flourish
Crowd-Thrilling Flourish.description: Strike in a dazzling House Ravissant flourish, a whirl of blade and cloak that thrills any crowd. The attack has impact 150 and uses your weapon's damage type.

High-Wind Leap.name: High-Wind Leap
High-Wind Leap.description: Leap high in the House Levantine style, as if carried by the wind off the bridges, and strike from above. The attack has impact 150 and uses your weapon's damage type.

Trial Piece.name: Trial Piece
Trial Piece.description: Use one craft principle you have found, such as how a material behaves, how a finished piece was put together, or a master's method seen at work, to make something no known method makes or to make a known thing a new way. Use alchemy, smithing, carpentry, leatherworking, tailoring, cooking, enchanting, engineering, trapcraft, or gadgetry. The attempt is one difficulty tier harder than ordinary making. You gain +10 on it. On full success, you learn the technique as a new ability.

What Grows Here.name: What Grows Here
What Grows Here.description: Forage with a trained eye, knowing where this country's rarer plants hide. Add this bonus to one foraging attempt.

Know Where to Look.name: Know Where to Look
Know Where to Look.description: Name one material that grows or can be taken from the land or a creature, and learn the nearest place in this region where it can be gathered and what guards it.

Strike the Seam.name: Strike the Seam
Strike the Seam.description: Read the rock and cut where the seam runs richest. Add this bonus to one mining attempt.

Prospector's Eye.name: Prospector's Eye
Prospector's Eye.description: Name one ore, stone, or crystal, and learn the nearest place in this region where it can be dug and who holds the ground.

Skin It Clean.name: Skin It Clean
Skin It Clean.description: Take a creature's hide, scale, and prized parts so they come away whole and unspoiled. Add this bonus to one attempt to harvest a creature.

Wear the Kill.name: Wear the Kill
Wear the Kill.description: In a proper workshop, make one piece of armor or clothing from creature material: hide, scale, silk, or bone. The piece is named for its material.

Melt It Down.name: Melt It Down
Melt It Down.description: At a forge, break down one metal weapon, armor piece, or tool you carry into its raw metal: Iron Ore for iron and steel, Silver Ore for silver, or the aspected material it was made from. The source item is used up.

The Master's Piece.name: The Master's Piece
The Master's Piece.description: At a proper forge, make one Masterwork weapon or piece of armor yourself from exceptional material you carry. The attempt is Extremely Hard.

Fell the Best.name: Fell the Best
Fell the Best.description: Walk a stand of timber and cut the tree worth working: Hardwood, or Witchwood or Venomwood where the place grows it. Add this bonus to one attempt to cut timber.

Bowyer's Hand.name: Bowyer's Hand
Bowyer's Hand.description: Make one bow, staff, spear shaft, shield, or sheaf of arrows away from a workbench, with a knife and the timber you carry.

Field Still.name: Field Still
Field Still.description: Brew one potion, oil, extract, or etchant from materials you carry without a laboratory, at no penalty for the makeshift kit.

Dressed the Part.name: Dressed the Part
Dressed the Part.description: From cloth at hand, make in a single scene one garment for a specific purpose: a disguise, a livery, gear against the weather, or dress fit for a court.

Fish the Water.name: Fish the Water
Fish the Water.description: Fish, net, or dive one stream, lake, or shore and bring back one catch named for its kind.

To the Den.name: To the Den
To the Den.description: Follow one creature's sign back to where it sleeps, nests, or keeps its kills. You find the place and what lies there: eggs, sheddings, bones, or a hoard.

Feast for a Hall.name: Feast for a Hall
Feast for a Hall.description: Cook or brew one meal, feast, or cask good enough to win over a named host, table, or buyer, the way their own people honor guests.

What It's Worth.name: What It's Worth
What It's Worth.description: Appraise one item, material, or trophy: name what it is, its grade, a fair price in florins, the kind of buyer in this region who pays most for it, and who made it.

How It Was Done.name: How It Was Done
How It Was Done.description: Recall the recipe for one item you hold or see: the materials it takes, the tools and workshop it needs, and who is known for making it well.

Low Sweep.name: Low Sweep
Low Sweep.description: Sweep a foe's legs out from under them with a low, drilled strike and bring your weapon down as they fall. Make one attack at impact 200.

Through the Guard.name: Through the Guard
Through the Guard.description: Knock a foe's weapon aside with your free hand, step through their guard, and drive your weapon into the opening. Make one attack at impact 250.

In the House's Name.name: In the House's Name
In the House's Name.description: Invoke your Adventuring House, its name and the favors it is owed, when you persuade, bargain, or ask for help, hospitality, or passage. Gain +10 on the attempt.

Call for Hands.name: Call for Hands
Call for Hands.description: Put out word in your House's name for local hands, such as guides, porters, or guards. Gain +10 on the attempt to hire them for one job.

On the House.name: On the House
On the House.description: Buy a round, set out food, or tell the story of your tavern's best night to win over a person or a room. Gain +10 on the attempt.

The Regulars Talk.name: The Regulars Talk
The Regulars Talk.description: Ask around wherever you are; someone here has drunk at your tavern. Gain +10 on the attempt to turn up a rumor or lead.

Find the Seam.name: Find the Seam
Find the Seam.description: Read where one foe's armor, hide, or shell is thinnest and drive your weapon into that seam. Make one attack at impact 200.

Silver Dust.name: Silver Dust
Silver Dust.description: Rub a pinch of silver dust from your Order pouch along your weapon and strike as the edge flares with cold white light. Make one attack at impact 250 that deals radiant damage.

Take the Blow.name: Take the Blow
Take the Blow.description: Throw yourself between an ally and an attack and take it on your shield or your body instead. Defend one ally.

The Wall Holds.name: The Wall Holds
The Wall Holds.description: Plant your shield squarely in a foe's path and jam their strike before it can land. Stop that foe's attack.

Ride Them Down.name: Ride Them Down
Ride Them Down.description: Charge a foe at full gallop, or at a dead run on foot, and hit them with all your weight behind the blow. Make one attack at impact 200.

Banner Charge.name: Banner Charge
Banner Charge.description: Shout the Vigilant war-cry, charge a foe, and run them through as you pass. Make one attack at impact 250.

Name the Spell.name: Name the Spell
Name the Spell.description: Study one spell or magical effect in front of you. Gain +10 on the attempt to say what it is, who could cast it, and what would counter it.

Clean Getaway.name: Clean Getaway
Clean Getaway.description: Duck into a crowd, a shadow, or a side door, lose whoever is following you, and become Hidden. Gain +10 on the attempt.

Ask the Guild.name: Ask the Guild
Ask the Guild.description: Leave the Guild's mark in the right place and wait for an answer. Gain +10 on the attempt to fence something you carry or learn where something is kept.

Spin and Strike.name: Spin and Strike
Spin and Strike.description: Feint high, spin, and strike from the other side in a move made for the crowd. Make one attack at impact 200.

Finishing Blow.name: Finishing Blow
Finishing Blow.description: Stagger a foe, let the crowd roar, then deliver the blow that ends it. Make one attack at impact 250.

Run Them Down.name: Run Them Down
Run Them Down.description: Run a quarry to ground the way the pack does: read its trail at a run, cut off its escape, and catch it. Gain +10 on the attempt.

Unmask the Dead.name: Unmask the Dead
Unmask the Dead.description: Speak the Inquisition's rite of seeing over one person or place. Gain +10 on the attempt to find undead, a shade, or a possessing spirit hiding there.

The Lord's Word.name: The Lord's Word
The Lord's Word.description: Speak one command in the voice of a Lord of the Blood, and one foe freezes where they stand, unable to move against you. Stop that foe's attack.

Bind and Thrust.name: Bind and Thrust
Bind and Thrust.description: Catch a foe's blade on yours, bind it, and slide down its length into a thrust. Make one attack at impact 250.

Guild Seal.name: Guild Seal
Guild Seal.description: Stamp a piece you made with the Guild of All Arts' golden hammer-and-chisel seal before you sell or show it. Gain +10 on one attempt to sell it at its full worth or to win over a buyer.

Masterpiece.name: Masterpiece
Masterpiece.description: Give one piece a master's full care at a proper forge or workshop, from choosing the stock to the last finish. Gain +15 on one attempt to make a Fine, Superior, or Masterwork piece; it does not loosen what Masterwork requires.

Blind Route.name: Blind Route
Blind Route.description: Find one blind route through the scene and take it before anyone looks your way. Gain +15 to become Hidden.

Under the Guard.name: Under the Guard
Under the Guard.description: Duck under a foe's guard and drive your weapon into the gap at the knee, hip, or armpit. Make one attack at impact 150.

Make It Mine.name: Make It Mine
Make It Mine.description: Try a fighting move you have seen a master or a foe use, in a real fight. You gain +10 on the attempt. On full success, you learn the move as a new Technique.

Worked It Out.name: Worked It Out
Worked It Out.description: Pull a trick, con, or bit of lockwork you have worked out yourself. You gain +10 on the attempt. On full success, you learn it as a new Trick.

Answer the Oath.name: Answer the Oath
Answer the Oath.description: Swear before your patron to do one specific deed in the face of danger, then do it. You gain +10 on the attempt. On full success, your patron's answer becomes a new Invocation.

A New Movement.name: A New Movement
A New Movement.description: Improvise a movement of the blood-dance you have never danced before, in the middle of a fight. You gain +10 on the attempt. On full success, you learn it as a new Dance.

Make a Song of It.name: Make a Song of It
Make a Song of It.description: Turn something you witnessed into a song or tale and perform it where it matters. You gain +10 on the attempt. On full success, you learn the performance as a new Song.

Ask in Need.name: Ask in Need
Ask in Need.description: Pray for a rite your faith has never shown you, in a moment of real need. You gain +10 on the attempt. If your god answers and the prayer fully succeeds, you learn it as a new Rite.

Let a Spirit In.name: Let a Spirit In
Let a Spirit In.description: Call on a spirit you have just met and let its power move through you. You gain +10 on the attempt. On full success, you learn to call on it again as a new Spirit ability.

Over the Top.name: Over the Top
Over the Top.description: Vault, climb, or leap over whatever stands in your way and come down onto a foe on the other side. Make one attack at impact 150.

Strike from Cover.name: Strike from Cover
Strike from Cover.description: Strike from cover, then slip back out of sight. Make one attack at impact 150, and try to stay Hidden.

Through Me First.name: Through Me First
Through Me First.description: Step into the blow meant for one ally, catch it on whatever you hold or on your own armor, and shove it back into the foe who threw it. Defend one ally and make one attack against that foe at impact 250.

The Last Exchange.name: The Last Exchange
The Last Exchange.description: Meet one foe's hardest attack weapon to weapon and turn its whole weight around into a single finishing blow. Stop that foe's attack and make one attack against them at impact 300.

Covering Shot.name: Covering Shot
Covering Shot.description: Watch over one ally and put an arrow through the hand, weapon, or eye of the foe threatening them, at any range you can see. Stop that foe's attack and make one attack against them at impact 250.

Crooked Rain.name: Crooked Rain
Crooked Rain.description: Loose three arrows high on crooked lines so each drops onto a different foe from the side they aren't guarding, around cover and over walls. Make one attack against each of up to three foes at impact 275.

Eyes Elsewhere.name: Eyes Elsewhere
Eyes Elsewhere.description: Flick a coin, a shout, or your empty hand to one side so one foe's eyes follow it, and put your weapon into them in the half-second they look away. Make one attack at impact 300.

Out Clean.name: Out Clean
Out Clean.description: Take the way out you noted on the way in (a window, a drain, a rooftop, a moving crowd) with what you came for in hand, even with every eye in the room on you. Gain +20 on the attempt to escape.

Cover of Light.name: Cover of Light
Cover of Light.description: Stand over one wounded ally, raise your patron's light over them like a shield, and press your own strength into them through your hand. Defend one ally and heal them for 50% of their maximum health.

The Vow Kept.name: The Vow Kept
The Vow Kept.description: Speak aloud the vow you are keeping and bring your weapon down on one foe as your patron's radiance breaks over them in a column of light. Make one attack at impact 300 that deals radiant damage.

Through All of Them.name: Through All of Them
Through All of Them.description: Charge the length of the fight without slowing, bowling up to three foes off their feet one after another, and stop wherever you choose. Make one attack against each of up to three foes at impact 250.

Drag Them Clear.name: Drag Them Clear
Drag Them Clear.description: Crash through to one ally in trouble, haul them clear by the collar with one hand, and smash the nearest attacker aside with the other. Defend one ally and make one attack against one foe at impact 300.

Form: All Still.name: Form: All Still
Form: All Still.description: Strike three points along one foe's body in a single touch (the side of the neck, the spine, the hollow under the ribs) and command the whole body to stop at once. Subdue one foe without lasting injury.

Form: Ten Before Thunder.name: Form: Ten Before Thunder
Form: Ten Before Thunder.description: Reach one foe in a single breath and strike ten times (wrists, elbows, knees, ribs, jaw) in the time one blow should take, then stand behind them as every strike lands together. Make one attack at impact 300.

The Red Wheel.name: The Red Wheel
The Red Wheel.description: Spend 10% of your maximum health and whirl your blade in a full circle, flinging the blood off it as a crimson wheel through up to three foes. Make one piercing attack against each at impact 250, and leave each living foe hit Bleeding.

Every Drop.name: Every Drop
Every Drop.description: Drive your blade into one living foe and drink the wound as it opens, the blood climbing the steel and sinking into your scars. Make one attack at impact 300 that deals shadow damage, and heal yourself for 25% of your maximum health.

The Last Word.name: The Last Word
The Last Word.description: Say aloud the one true thing about one foe that they least want heard, with enough force that the words land like a blow. Make one attack at impact 300 that deals psychic damage.

The Whole Lie.name: The Whole Lie
The Whole Lie.description: Sing, speak, or gesture a whole false scene into being (a bridge collapsing, riders cresting the hill, a queen at the door), complete with sound, smell, and heat. Gain +20 on the attempt to deceive, frighten, or misdirect anyone who sees it.

Shattered Comet.name: Shattered Comet
Shattered Comet.description: Launch one white-blue comet that bursts in flight into three, each fragment curving to hit a different foe from the side they aren't watching. Make one arcane attack against each of up to three foes at impact 250.

Unmade.name: Unmade
Unmade.description: Trace with one finger the pattern that holds one foe together, then cut it with a single line of white light; flesh, armor, or stone splits along the line. Make one arcane attack at impact 300.

All of It.name: All of It
All of It.description: Pour every bit of power you have been holding back into one attack spell until your skin glows and the air shakes around you. Make one attack at impact 300 using the spell's damage type.

Everything Breaks Loose.name: Everything Breaks Loose
Everything Breaks Loose.description: Let all your inborn magic out at once: it pours from your skin, closes around you and one ally like a burning shell, and lashes out at up to three foes. Defend yourself and one ally, and make one arcane attack against each of up to three foes at impact 275.

Dash Them Together.name: Dash Them Together
Dash Them Together.description: Seize up to three foes in telekinetic force, lift them off their feet, and slam them into each other, the ground, or the nearest wall. Make one attack against each of up to three foes at impact 250 that deals impact damage.

Drown the Mind.name: Drown the Mind
Drown the Mind.description: Pour everything your mind can hold into one foe's mind, every sound, memory, and fear at once, until their own thoughts go under. Make one attack at impact 300 that deals psychic damage.

Swallow the Blow.name: Swallow the Blow
Swallow the Blow.description: Snap your patron's sign open in the path of one foe's attack so the blow falls through into the patron's realm, then open a second sign behind the attacker and let it come back out. Stop that foe's attack and make one attack against them at impact 250.

Taken Through.name: Taken Through
Taken Through.description: Name one foe to your patron and open the sign wide beneath them; the patron drags them halfway into its realm and hurls them back out. Make one attack at impact 300 that deals shadow damage, or your patron's own damage type if it has one.

The Sign in Full.name: The Sign in Full
The Sign in Full.description: Raise your holy symbol and bring your deity's sign down whole on one foe: a column of sunfire, a single storm-bolt, a falling iron weight, or a shaft of grave-light. Make one attack at impact 300 using the sign's damage type.

Not Yet.name: Not Yet
Not Yet.description: Kneel over one living creature, raise your holy symbol, and refuse to let it go. Heal them for 60% of their maximum health and defend them.

The Old Root.name: The Old Root
The Old Root.description: Call one ancient root as thick as a tower from deep beneath one foe; it bursts up through the ground, strikes them, and lifts them high. Make one attack at impact 300 that deals impact or piercing damage, as the root strikes.

Bark and Bramble.name: Bark and Bramble
Bark and Bramble.description: Call living bark and thorn up over yourself or one ally; it hardens against blows and knits into the wounds beneath it. Defend that target and heal them for 50% of their maximum health.

Body and Soul.name: Body and Soul
Body and Soul.description: Step your spirit fully out of your body as you strike, so your flesh hits one foe's body and your spirit hits the soul inside it in the same instant. Make one attack at impact 300; struck without a weapon, it deals psychic damage.

Out of the Body.name: Out of the Body
Out of the Body.description: Reach out, pull one foe's spirit a pace out of its body, and hold it there while the body stands empty-eyed and still. Subdue one foe.

One Big Disaster.name: One Big Disaster
One Big Disaster.description: Cram every charge you can cage into one fist-sized knot of charm-wire, arm it, and lob it at one foe, choosing acid, fire, or shock as it leaves your hand. Make one attack at impact 300 that deals the chosen damage type.

Folding Fort.name: Folding Fort
Folding Fort.description: Slam a palm-sized brass box to the ground; it springs open into a wall of plates, springs, and snapping gears in front of you and one ally, and the gears bite the nearest attacker. Defend yourself and one ally, and make one attack against one foe at impact 250.

Not a Sound.name: Not a Sound
Not a Sound.description: Come at one foe from the side they aren't watching, clamp a hand over their mouth, and bear them down out of sight until they go limp. Subdue one foe.

Someone Else Entirely.name: Someone Else Entirely
Someone Else Entirely.description: Take on one real or invented person's walk, voice, and habits. Gain +20 on the attempt to pass as someone you are not.

Under My Vow.name: Under My Vow
Under My Vow.description: Plant yourself over one ally and say aloud that they are under your vow; the blow aimed at them breaks against a wall of white light while your free hand turns aside a second foe's attack. Defend one ally and stop one foe's attack.

The Sentence.name: The Sentence
The Sentence.description: Name aloud the wrongs of the foes before you and raise your hand; a ring of white fire falls from above onto up to three of them at once. Make one attack against each of up to three foes at impact 275 that deals radiant damage.

Every Tooth and Claw.name: Every Tooth and Claw
Every Tooth and Claw.description: Give one call, and whatever lives nearby comes at once (wolves from the trees, crows from the sky, hornets, rats, a boar from the brush) and falls on up to three foes. Make one attack against each of up to three foes at impact 275 that deals piercing or poison damage, as the creatures bite or sting.

Green Mending.name: Green Mending
Green Mending.description: Press your palm over one creature's wound and let moss and fine root climb out of the earth, even through cracks in stone, and stitch it shut. Heal one target for 60% of their maximum health.

The Breaking Note.name: The Breaking Note
The Breaking Note.description: Fill your lungs to the bottom and loose one note so loud it hits up to three foes like a falling wall, cracking shields, rattling teeth, and throwing them off their feet. Make one attack against each of up to three foes at impact 275 that deals impact damage.

Close Your Eyes.name: Close Your Eyes
Close Your Eyes.description: Sing one foe a cradle-song low beneath the noise of the fight, so old and soft that their eyes droop, their weapon sags, and they sink down asleep where they stand. Subdue one foe.

Pull the Pin.name: Pull the Pin
Pull the Pin.description: Spot the one rivet, strap, or joint that holds one foe together (an armor seam, a war-beast's harness, a construct's linkage) and break it with a single hard blow. Make one attack at impact 300.

Sprung Clamp.name: Sprung Clamp
Sprung Clamp.description: Snap a spring clamp together from whatever you are carrying and throw it so it locks fast on one foe's weapon or wrist, then hit them while they wrench at it. Stop that foe's attack and make one attack against them at impact 275.

Between the Palms.name: Between the Palms
Between the Palms.description: Step into the blow meant for one ally, catch the weapon or fist between your palms, and turn its own force into a throw that slams the attacker to the ground. Defend one ally and make one attack against that foe at impact 275.

Breathe With Me.name: Breathe With Me
Breathe With Me.description: Hold one wounded creature still, breathe slowly beside them until their heart slows to match yours, and press two fingers to the points that stop the bleeding and the pain. Heal one target for 50% of their maximum health.

Bloodfire.name: Bloodfire
Bloodfire.description: Draw your own blood out along your weapon or open hand, set it burning, and cut one foe with the flame. Spend 10% of your maximum health and make one attack at impact 300 that deals fire damage.

Into the Wound.name: Into the Wound
Into the Wound.description: Cut your palm, press it hard to one ally's wound, and drive your own blood into them until the wound closes from the inside. Spend 10% of your maximum health and heal one ally for 60% of their maximum health.

Spear of Heaven.name: Spear of Heaven
Spear of Heaven.description: Raise your empty hand and close it on a spear of blazing light as it forms there, then throw it across the fight through one foe. Make one attack at impact 200 that deals radiant damage, or your deity's own damage type if it has one.

Thornhail.name: Thornhail
Thornhail.description: Close your fist, and when you open it toward one foe a hail of thorns as long as knives bursts from your palm and drives into them. Make one attack at impact 200 that deals piercing damage.

Shout Without Sound.name: Shout Without Sound
Shout Without Sound.description: Clench your jaw and throw one silent shout into every mind in front of you, and up to three foes reel and clutch their heads. Make one attack against each of up to three foes at impact 150 that deals psychic damage.

What They Really Want.name: What They Really Want
What They Really Want.description: Watch one person's eyes, hands, and pauses until you can say out loud what they really want, then speak straight to it. Gain +15 on the attempt to persuade, bargain with, or pressure that person.

Gentle the Beast.name: Gentle the Beast
Gentle the Beast.description: Go to one frightened or furious beast slowly, low, and with empty hands, and keep talking until its ears come forward. Gain +15 on the attempt to calm, tame, or win over that beast.

Trample.name: Trample
Trample.description: Put your mount straight at one foe at full gallop and ride over them, hooves and weapon together, then turn without slowing. Make one attack at impact 200 that deals impact damage.

Murder Stroke.name: Murder Stroke
Murder Stroke.description: Grip your sword by the blade in both hands and swing it like a hammer, bringing the crossguard down on one foe's helm or guard. Make one attack at impact 200 that deals impact damage.

Double Feint.name: Double Feint
Double Feint.description: Show one foe your point high, then low, until their blade chases both, and put the real thrust through the space they left. Make one attack at impact 200.

Ricochet.name: Ricochet
Ricochet.description: Throw once, hard and flat, so the weapon glances off armor, wall, and bone from one foe to the next. Make one attack against each of up to three foes at impact 150.

Tackle.name: Tackle
Tackle.description: Hit one foe at a dead run, wrap them up, and drive them into the ground under your full weight. Make one attack at impact 200 that deals impact damage.

Hard Country.name: Hard Country
Hard Country.description: Read the sky, the ground, and the way the animals move, and take the land on its own terms. Gain +15 on one attempt to find the way, water, food, or shelter, or to read what the weather will do.

Dig Through.name: Dig Through
Dig Through.description: Find the line where the stone wants to split and work it with whatever tool you have until it gives. Gain +15 on the attempt to dig, break, or tunnel through rock, stone, or masonry.

Stay Their Hand.name: Stay Their Hand
Stay Their Hand.description: Close your fist at one foe as they swing, and an unseen grip locks their arm in place mid-blow. Stop that foe's attack.

Wrath Stroke.name: Wrath Stroke
Wrath Stroke.description: Raise your sword high behind your shoulder and bring it down with your whole body behind it, straight through one foe's guard and whatever they wear. Make one attack at impact 300.

Riposte.name: Riposte
Riposte.description: Take one foe's attack on your blade, turn it past your body with a flick of the wrist, and put your point into them before they can recover. Stop that foe's attack and make one attack against them at impact 250.

Hook and Hew.name: Hook and Hew
Hook and Hew.description: Hook your axe over the rim of one foe's shield or the haft of their weapon, wrench it aside, and bring the axe back down through the opening. Stop that foe's attack and make one attack against them at impact 250.

Set for the Charge.name: Set for the Charge
Set for the Charge.description: Drop low, plant the butt of your spear against the ground, and take one foe's rush or blow onto the point, so their own weight drives it home. Stop that foe's attack and make one attack against them at impact 250.

Knock Senseless.name: Knock Senseless
Knock Senseless.description: Bring your weapon round in one short, heavy swing to the side of one foe's head, and they drop senseless where they stand. Subdue one foe.

Break the Shell.name: Break the Shell
Break the Shell.description: Swing the warhammer flat into one foe's shield or breastplate with everything you have, so the plate caves in and the blow carries on into the body behind it. Make one attack at impact 300.

Into the Gap.name: Into the Gap
Into the Gap.description: Step inside one foe's reach, close enough to feel their breath, and slide your dagger into the gap at throat, armpit, or ribs where no armor covers. Make one attack at impact 300.

Dead Center.name: Dead Center
Dead Center.description: Draw to your ear, let out half a breath, and hold it until there is nothing in the world but one foe, then loose. Make one attack at impact 300.

Three at Once.name: Three at Once
Three at Once.description: Loose a fan of throws in a single sweep of the arm, each one taking a different foe. Make one attack against each of up to three foes at impact 250.

Both Ends.name: Both Ends
Both Ends.description: Spin your staff to take one foe's blow on its middle, and snap the far end down across a second foe's wrist before they can swing. Defend yourself and stop one foe's attack.

Take It From Them.name: Take It From Them
Take It From Them.description: Catch one foe's weapon arm against your body, twist the weapon out of their grip, and drive your elbow into their face as it falls. Stop that foe's attack and make one attack against them at impact 250.

Behind Me.name: Behind Me
Behind Me.description: Swing your shield across one ally to take the blow meant for them, then drive its rim into the attacker's face. Defend one ally and make one attack against one foe at impact 250.

Sea of Fire.name: Sea of Fire
Sea of Fire.description: Spread your arms and let fire roll out from you in a wave across up to three foes, so hot the stones glow where it passes. Make one attack against each of up to three foes at impact 250 that deals fire damage.

Skybolt.name: Skybolt
Skybolt.description: Raise one hand to the sky and drag a bolt of lightning down out of it onto one foe, with a crack of thunder that shakes the ground. Make one attack at impact 300 that deals shock damage.

Ice Wall.name: Ice Wall
Ice Wall.description: Throw up a wall of ice in front of one ally or yourself, then burst its face outward in a storm of shards into one foe. Defend one ally or yourself and make one attack against one foe at impact 250 that deals frost damage.

Swallowing Ground.name: Swallowing Ground
Swallowing Ground.description: Open the ground under one foe and slam it shut on them like a pair of stone jaws, then spit them back out onto the surface. Make one attack at impact 300 that deals impact damage.

Tear the Shadow.name: Tear the Shadow
Tear the Shadow.description: Reach down, grip one foe's shadow where it lies on the ground, and tear it in two. Make one attack at impact 300 that deals shadow damage.

Not Where You Think.name: Not Where You Think
Not Where You Think.description: Lay a false image over one ally so the blow aimed at them lands on empty air beside them, and raise a sheet of false fire in front of one foe so they pull back from their own swing. Defend one ally and stop one foe's attack.

Grave Cold.name: Grave Cold
Grave Cold.description: Close your hand toward one foe and pull the warmth of life out of them, until frost forms on their skin and lips and the cold of the grave runs through them. Make one attack at impact 300 that deals shadow damage.

Three Circles.name: Three Circles
Three Circles.description: Trace three summoning circles in the air at once and pull a planar beast through each, every one falling on a different foe before its circle snaps shut. Make one attack against each of up to three foes at impact 250.

Where It Lies.name: Where It Lies
Where It Lies.description: Close your eyes and follow the thread that ties you to one person or thing until you see where it is right now, and which way it is moving. Gain +20 on the attempt to find or follow one person or thing.

Ancestor's Guard.name: Ancestor's Guard
Ancestor's Guard.description: Call one of your ancestors to stand over one ally as a tall figure of pale light, where it takes the blow meant for them and strikes the attacker through the soul. Defend one ally and make one attack against one foe at impact 250 that deals psychic damage.

Still the Blood.name: Still the Blood
Still the Blood.description: Close your fist, and the blood in one foe's arm stops dead mid-swing. Then clench harder and it bursts from their skin. Stop that foe's attack and make one attack against them at impact 250 that deals shadow damage.

Made Whole.name: Made Whole
Made Whole.description: Lay both hands on one living creature and pour golden light into every wound at once, until bone sets, flesh closes, and color comes back to their face. Heal one target for 60% of their maximum health.

Ward and Bar.name: Ward and Bar
Ward and Bar.description: Trace a ward over one ally that flashes white and turns aside the blow meant for them, and flick a second ward across one foe's weapon that holds it fast. Defend one ally and stop one foe's attack.

High Noon.name: High Noon
High Noon.description: Draw a burning line across the air and open it into a full noon sun that sweeps across up to three foes in front of you. Make one attack against each of up to three foes at impact 250 that deals radiant damage, or your deity's own damage type if it has one.

Root and Bind.name: Root and Bind
Root and Bind.description: Stamp once, and roots as thick as your arm burst from the ground around one foe, wrap them hand, foot, and chest, and pull them down until they cannot move. Subdue one foe.

Held in the Air.name: Held in the Air
Held in the Air.description: Reach out with your mind and lift one foe off the ground, arms pinned to their sides, and hold them there helpless in the air. Subdue one foe.

Sure Hands.name: Sure Hands
Sure Hands.description: Lay your hands on one object, read every working already bound into it, and set your own into it in a single steady pass. Gain +20 on the attempt to enchant, repair, or break the enchantment on one object.

One True Blow.name: One True Blow
One True Blow.description: Watch one foe until their whole fight shows itself to you, then step in and strike once with everything you have ever learned behind it, through their guard and whatever they wear. Make one attack at impact 350.

Three Spells at Once.name: Three Spells at Once
Three Spells at Once.description: Cast three spells you know in the same instant, one from each hand and one on your breath, and send each at a different foe. Make one attack against each of up to three foes at impact 300, each with its own spell's damage type.

Between Two Guards.name: Between Two Guards
Between Two Guards.description: Step out of nowhere between two foes: one hand closes over the first one's mouth and bears them down limp, while your other hand strikes the second before either can cry out. Subdue one foe and make one attack against a second foe at impact 300.

Not While I Stand.name: Not While I Stand
Not While I Stand.description: Step over one ally and call your vow aloud; the blow meant for them breaks on you, and your answering strike lands on the foe who threw it in a sheet of white fire. Defend one ally and make one attack against one foe at impact 300 that deals radiant damage.

The Weather Turns.name: The Weather Turns
The Weather Turns.description: Raise your arms and drag a storm out of a clear sky in a single breath, hail and lightning and a wind that throws people flat, down onto up to three foes. Make one attack against each of up to three foes at impact 300 that deals frost or shock damage.

Everyone Sings.name: Everyone Sings
Everyone Sings.description: Climb onto a table, a wall, or a cart and start the one song this crowd already knows (a marching song, a lament, a song with a tyrant's name in it) and lead it. Gain +25 on the attempt to sway a crowd.

One Great Machine.name: One Great Machine
One Great Machine.description: Tear apart everything within reach (carts, chains, doors, scrap) and bolt it in moments into one towering machine that swings through up to three foes and falls apart. Choose piercing, impact, acid, fire, or shock. Make one attack against each of up to three foes at impact 300 that deals the chosen damage type.

Form: The Quiet Hand.name: Form: The Quiet Hand
Form: The Quiet Hand.description: Touch one foe once with an open palm, so lightly no one hears it; a breath later every ounce of force you have gathered goes through them at once and throws them to the ground. Make one attack at impact 350.

One Vein to Another.name: One Vein to Another
One Vein to Another.description: Close your fist toward one foe and drag the blood out through their skin in a red stream across the air, then open your hand over one ally or yourself and pour it into the wounds. Make one attack at impact 300 that deals shadow damage, and heal one ally or yourself for 50% of their maximum health.

Second Nature.name: Second Nature
Second Nature.description: Cast a spell you have practiced a thousand times with a master's ease. Gain +15 on one spell.

Between Them and Harm.name: Between Them and Harm
Between Them and Harm.description: Step in front of one ally and take the blow meant for them on your shield, your arm, or your vow. Defend one ally.

Lamp of the Vow.name: Lamp of the Vow
Lamp of the Vow.description: Lift your vow like a lamp and drive its light into one foe. Make one attack at impact 200 that deals radiant damage.

Every Oath Kept.name: Every Oath Kept
Every Oath Kept.description: Speak aloud every vow you have kept, and white light falls on up to three foes at once. Make one attack against each of up to three foes at impact 250 that deals radiant damage.

Read the Ground.name: Read the Ground
Read the Ground.description: Read the land at a glance: the tracks, the water, the weather, the safe line through. Gain +10 on an attempt to track, find a way, or read what passed here.

Hold the Room.name: Hold the Room
Hold the Room.description: Take a room's attention and keep it with a song, a story, or a toast. Gain +10 on an attempt to hold an audience.

Turn the Crowd.name: Turn the Crowd
Turn the Crowd.description: Move a crowd that is hostile or doesn't care: cool a mob, sway a hall, break a gang's nerve. Gain +12 on an attempt to persuade or subdue a group.

Make It Hold.name: Make It Hold
Make It Hold.description: Jury-rig a fix from whatever is to hand; it holds exactly as long as it must. Gain +10 on an attempt to repair something or improvise a device.

See the Flaw.name: See the Flaw
See the Flaw.description: Find how one thing fails, then hit it there: a gate's hinge, a construct's seam, the rivets of a shield. Make one attack at impact 200 that deals piercing damage.

It Shouldn't Work.name: It Shouldn't Work
It Shouldn't Work.description: Build one impossible device for a single turn and make it do one thing: lift the portcullis, stop the flood, bring down the tower. If it attacks, make one attack at impact 300 that deals fire or shock damage.

Still Point.name: Still Point
Still Point.description: Breathe once and hold your center against whatever is trying to move you: pain, fear, a shove, a charm, a fall. Gain +10 on an attempt to keep control of your body or mind.

Past the Limit.name: Past the Limit
Past the Limit.description: Make your body do one thing it should refuse: hold up a falling gate, run along a wall, walk across the coals. Gain +12 on one physical feat.

Blood Hardens.name: Blood Hardens
Blood Hardens.description: Spend 10% of your maximum health and let your blood set into a red shell over you or one ally. Defend yourself or one ally.

Find the Gap.name: Find the Gap
Find the Gap.description: Spot the one gap in a foe's defense, call it out, and strike through it yourself before it closes.

March of Iron.name: March of Iron
March of Iron.description: Strike up a marching song in the middle of a fight. If it lands, every player in your party gains strength while it plays, more with your Song rank, until the fight ends or another song starts.

Quickstep Reel.name: Quickstep Reel
Quickstep Reel.description: Strike up a quick reel in the middle of a fight. If it lands, every player in your party gains dexterity while it plays, more with your Song rank, until the fight ends or another song starts.

Hymn of the Deep.name: Hymn of the Deep
Hymn of the Deep.description: Sing a slow, deep hymn in the middle of a fight. If it lands, every player in your party gains attunement while it plays, more with your Song rank, until the fight ends or another song starts.

Steady Breath.name: Steady Breath
Steady Breath.description: Sing a steady breathing song in the middle of a fight. If it lands, every player in your party regains stamina each turn while it plays, more with your Song rank, until the fight ends or another song starts.

The Deep Well.name: The Deep Well
The Deep Well.description: Sing a song that draws on something old and deep. If it lands, every player in your party regains mana each turn while it plays, more with your Song rank, until the fight ends or another song starts.

Rout.name: Rout
Rout.description: Sing the one song a beaten enemy can't stand against. Gain +15 on the attempt. On a Great Success or better, every wounded foe in the fight who can still feel fear breaks and leaves the scene.

Steady Overchannel.name: Steady Overchannel
Steady Overchannel.description: Pour more power into a spell than is safe. Gain +10 on the attempt; a spell attack has impact 150. It costs extra mana, taken automatically, unless the casting is a Great Success or better; on a Failure or worse the power burns back through you.

Deep Overchannel.name: Deep Overchannel
Deep Overchannel.description: Pour more power into a spell than is safe. Gain +10 on the attempt; a spell attack has impact 175. It costs extra mana, taken automatically, unless the casting is a Great Success or better; on a Failure or worse the power burns back through you.

Full Overchannel.name: Full Overchannel
Full Overchannel.description: Pour more power into a spell than is safe. Gain +15 on the attempt; a spell attack has impact 200. It costs extra mana, taken automatically, unless the casting is a Great Success or better; on a Failure or worse the power burns back through you.

Great Overchannel.name: Great Overchannel
Great Overchannel.description: Pour more power into a spell than is safe. Gain +15 on the attempt; a spell attack has impact 250. It costs extra mana, taken automatically, unless the casting is a Great Success or better; on a Failure or worse the power burns back through you.

Legendary Overchannel.name: Legendary Overchannel
Legendary Overchannel.description: Pour more power into a spell than is safe. Gain +20 on the attempt; a spell attack has impact 300. It costs extra mana, taken automatically, unless the casting is a Great Success or better; on a Failure or worse the power burns back through you.

Aspect of the Hawk.name: Aspect of the Hawk
Aspect of the Hawk.description: Call the hawk's eye into yourself in a fight. If it lands, your ranged attacks hit harder for the rest of the fight, more with your Wild rank. It costs mana. One aspect at a time.

Aspect of the Bear.name: Aspect of the Bear
Aspect of the Bear.description: Call the bear's hide and weight into yourself in a fight. If it lands, blows and cuts hurt you half as much and your bare-handed strikes land like a bear's, for the rest of the fight. It costs mana. One aspect at a time.

Aspect of the Serpent.name: Aspect of the Serpent
Aspect of the Serpent.description: Call the serpent's venom into yourself in a fight. If it lands, your attacks carry poison and poison hurts you half as much, for the rest of the fight. It costs mana. One aspect at a time.

Aspect of the Oak.name: Aspect of the Oak
Aspect of the Oak.description: Call the oak's slow strength into yourself in a fight. If it lands, you regain health every turn for the rest of the fight. It costs mana. One aspect at a time.

Aspect of the Wolf.name: Aspect of the Wolf
Aspect of the Wolf.description: Call the wolf into yourself in a fight. If it lands, your attacks hit harder and any beasts fighting beside you recover each turn, for the rest of the fight. It costs mana. One aspect at a time.

Smoke Pot.name: Smoke Pot
Smoke Pot.description: Smash a smoke pot at your feet in a fight. Thick smoke swallows your whole party and every player becomes Hidden. Once per fight.

Patch Kit.name: Patch Kit
Patch Kit.description: Make quick field repairs on everyone near you in a fight. Every player and every construct fighting beside you recovers health, more as you rise in level. Once per fight.

Spring Shields.name: Spring Shields
Spring Shields.description: Throw out spring-loaded shields for your party in a fight. Piercing damage against every player is halved until the fight ends. Once per fight.

Spark Coil.name: Spark Coil
Spark Coil.description: Clamp a spark coil to your weapon in a fight. Your attacks deal shock damage and hit harder until the fight ends, more with your Work rank. Once per fight.

Overclock.name: Overclock
Overclock.description: Push every device in your kit past its limit in a fight. Your attacks hit far harder for the next two turns; then your kit is burnt out and no gadget works again this fight.

Champion's Stroke.name: Champion's Stroke
Champion's Stroke.description: Strike the most dangerous foe in the fight with everything a League champion has learned. On success it deals an impact-300 hit with your weapon's damage type.

Great Hunt's Strike.name: Great Hunt's Strike
Great Hunt's Strike.description: Put one strike or shot into the place a monster can least afford it, the way the Order's greatest hunters are taught. On success it deals an impact-300 hit with your weapon's damage type.

acrobatics.name: acrobatics
acrobatics.description:
Balance, tumbling, falls, and fitting where bodies shouldn't go.
Easy: walk a wide beam, roll out of a low fall, slip through a crowd untouched.
Medium: cross a narrow ledge, vault a table mid-fight, land a one-story drop clean.
Hard: fight on a rope bridge, tumble through a melee unscathed, squeeze through a gap half your size.
Extreme: run a crumbling rooftop line, fall two stories and keep running, dodge through a volley.
Raw power — lifting, forcing, brute climbing — is athletics.

athletics.name: athletics
athletics.description:
Running, climbing, jumping, swimming, lifting — the body at full effort.
Easy: climb a knotted rope, swim a calm pond, clear a ditch.
Medium: climb a rough wall, swim against a current, force a stuck door.
Hard: climb a sheer cliff, swim armored through rapids, leap a gap most would balk at.
Extreme: scale a fortress wall in the rain, out-swim a riptide, lift what two men couldn't.
Balance, tumbling, and tight squeezes are acrobatics.

intimidation.name: intimidation
intimidation.description:
Menace as a tool: threats, presence, interrogation.
Easy: back down a drunk, move a loiterer along, make a pickpocket think twice.
Medium: make a thug reconsider, get a name out of a frightened informant, silence a heckler.
Hard: stare down an armed man, break a hardened prisoner's silence, cow a room.
Extreme: back down a foe who outmatches you, make a fanatic hesitate, hold a gate by presence alone.
Fear moves people only within what fear can reach; some cannot be cowed.

insight.name: insight
insight.description:
Reading people: sincerity, intent, mood, and whether a story holds together.
Easy: tell nervous from hostile, notice someone is pleased, see that a child is lying.
Medium: catch a rehearsed answer, read who in the room actually decides, tell real grief from performed grief.
Hard: spot a practised liar's single tell, read a hostile negotiator's limit, tell which of two accusers believes themselves.
Extreme: read a professional deceiver under their own roof, name the motive someone is hiding from themselves, tell truth from a compulsion or a planted memory.
This reads people, not evidence. Physical traces, searched rooms, and documents are investigation. What a custom or symbol means is lore. Persuading, frightening, or charming someone is a charisma skill.

investigation.name: investigation
investigation.description:
Finding things out: searching, noticing, connecting.
Easy: spot the scratches on a forced lock, notice who left the room, find what's hidden carelessly.
Medium: search a room properly, notice the detail that doesn't belong, reconstruct last night from what's left.
Hard: find the hidden compartment, connect three thin threads into one answer, catch the lie in a tidy story.
Extreme: solve what the city watch gave up on, find the one altered line in a ledger of thousands, name the culprit from almost nothing.
What a fact means is often lore. Reading the person telling it — sincerity, intent, whether they believe themselves — is insight.

performance.name: performance
performance.description:
Holding an audience: music, story, acting — and playing a role, on stage or off.
Easy: a tavern song well received, a story that holds a table, pass as staff with the right clothes.
Medium: win over a cold room, busk a day's wages, hold a borrowed name through small talk.
Hard: play a court without a misstep, move a crowd to tears or anger, hold a cover under pointed questions.
Extreme: perform for a king and be remembered, hold a hostile hall spellbound, live a false face among people who'd kill the real one.
Disguise checks are acting checks: the donning is prep — the moments under scrutiny are performance. One-off lies are persuasion.

persuasion.name: persuasion
persuasion.description:
Moving people with words: convincing, charming, haggling, bluffing, and lying.
Easy: friendly directions, a small discount, a plausible excuse for being somewhere.
Medium: talk your way past a minor rule, win a stranger's small favor, hold a simple lie to a casual listener.
Hard: talk a guard into looking away, haggle a merchant well below his floor, lie to a suspicious questioner.
Extreme: turn a hostile witness, talk a mob out of violence, sell a falsehood to someone paid to catch them.
Lies move people only as far as they could plausibly believe. Threats are intimidation; holding a false identity over time is performance.

survival.name: survival
survival.description:
Living off the land: travel, forage, shelter, weather, fieldcraft.
Easy: find water in green country, make camp before dark, read tomorrow's weather in the sky.
Medium: forage a meal in lean country, keep direction in deep forest, weather a cold night without fire.
Hard: cross a desert on planning alone, find food where there's none to find, keep a party alive through a blizzard.
Extreme: survive weeks in dead country, lead a crossing veterans call impossible, read ground for what's buried — water, ore, the old road.
Fieldcraft includes foraging herbs and wild food, dressing a kill for its hide, meat, and parts, and reading terrain. Gathering anything worth keeping is never Simple. Following game is tracking; navigation at sea is sailing.

fire magic.name: fire magic
fire magic.description:
Calling, shaping, and quenching flame.
Easy: light or snuff a candle, warm yourself, a flame in the palm.
Medium: a hurled firebolt, ignite a campfire from nothing, burn a rope at distance.
Hard: a sheet of flame across a street, melt an iron lock, hold fire steady in rain.
Extreme: a firestorm, flame shaped to spare allies, turning an elemental's fire back on it.
Deals fire damage. Easier near abundant flame; falters in downpour and deep cold.

water magic.name: water magic
water magic.description:
Shaping water and ice: pull it from the air, freeze it, drive it like a fist.
Easy: purify a cup, frost a windowpane, gather drinking water from mist.
Medium: a lance of ice, freeze a lock solid, part a stream.
Hard: freeze a river crossing, a crushing wave, ice armor that holds under blows.
Extreme: freeze a harbor, walk a storm-sea, pull the water from a living thing.
Deals frost damage as ice, impact as driven water. Easier near abundant water; falters in desert air. Weather belongs to storm magic.

storm magic.name: storm magic
storm magic.description:
Wind, lightning, and weather.
Easy: a gust that snuffs candles, a static snap, fill a sail.
Medium: a lightning bolt, knock a man down with wind, cushion a fall.
Hard: chain lightning through several foes, a gale that clears a street, lightning from a clear sky.
Extreme: ride the wind aloft, turn a storm aside, a thunderbolt that splits a tower.
Deals shock damage. Easier under open sky and gathering weather; falters underground and in still air.
The Extreme line carries you aloft for one immediate movement; remaining in flight or using the sky as a road requires Ride the Storm, wings, or another concrete means.

earth magic.name: earth magic
earth magic.description:
Stone and soil: cracking, raising, shaping.
Easy: shape a handful of clay, sense hollow ground underfoot, loosen packed earth.
Medium: a hurled stone fist, crack a flagstone, raise a knee-high wall.
Hard: raise a rampart from bare ground, open a trench under charging foes, seal a tunnel clean.
Extreme: drop a cliff face, swallow a siege engine whole, shape stone fine as a mason's year in a moment.
Deals impact damage. Strongest on rock and soil; falters on water and in the air.

divine magic.name: divine magic
divine magic.description:
Wielding holy power: blessing, smiting, banishing, consecrating.
Easy: a blessing over a meal, light a shrine-candle with holy fire, steady a frightened soul.
Medium: smite an undead thing with radiant force, bless a blade, sanctify a doorway against evil.
Hard: turn a pack of undead, break a curse, consecrate ground a fiend cannot cross.
Extreme: banish a demon to its plane, sanctify a defiled temple, a radiance that routs an undead host.
Deals radiant damage. Easier in sacred places; falters on corrupted ground. Mending flesh belongs to healing magic. Becoming the god's vessel is divine channeling.

healing magic.name: healing magic
healing magic.description:
Mending living bodies: wounds, poison, sickness.
Easy: close a small cut, dull pain, ease a fever.
Medium: knit a deep wound, purge a common poison, set and mend a broken bone.
Hard: pull someone back from death's edge, cure a wasting disease, grow clean flesh over burns.
Extreme: restore a withered limb, purge a magical plague, hold a dying soul in its body.
Healing ordinarily mends the living only. The dead are necromancy's country; True Resurrection is the sole rite that calls one fully back. The undead cannot be mended. Willing patients are easier; magical wounds and curses resist.

warding magic.name: warding magic
warding magic.description:
Protection, barriers, and the unmaking of other magic.
Easy: deflect a thrown stone, seal a door for the night, snuff a candle-small spell.
Medium: a shield that holds through a skirmish, unravel a simple curse or lock-spell, ward a camp against beasts.
Hard: a barrier that stops a charging ogre, dispel a mage's working mid-cast, ward a house against the dead.
Extreme: a dome that holds against an army's volleys, strip the enchantment from an artifact, suppress a true curse until the scene ends.
Dispelling contests the caster: the stronger the working, the harder the unraveling. Lasting protections bound into objects are enchanting.
Simple hexes, lock-spells, and temporary suppression belong to this ladder. Permanently breaking a lasting trait-backed affliction or an item's binding requires Sunder the Binding, an authored rite, or a consecrated shrine. Warding deals no damage; it raises barriers and unmakes workings.

enchanting.name: enchanting
enchanting.description:
Binding magic into objects so it holds.
Easy: a light that lasts the evening, warm a blade's edge, mark an object to find again.
Medium: a blade that burns for one fight, a lock sealed against picks, a cloak that sheds rain for a season.
Hard: a lasting work — a sword of flame, armor that turns arrows, a ward-stone that guards a door for years.
Extreme: bind a spell any hand can loose, armor proof against a damage type, work that outlives its maker.
Slow, deliberate craft — done at a bench, not in a fight. Battle-cast protections are warding magic.

conjuration magic.name: conjuration magic
conjuration magic.description:
Calling things from elsewhere and binding them to your will.
Easy: dismiss your own active conjuration, a darting light-sprite, a conjured tool that fades by morning, call a small bound servant.
Medium: summon a lesser beast to fight, a bridge of solid force, dismiss what another novice called.
Hard: summon a dangerous creature and hold it, keep a servant bound past sunset, call something by its true name.
Extreme: summon a greater being and bargain, hold a door between places open, bind a creature to a year of service.
Conjured force deals arcane damage; summons fight with their own. What you call must be held — a slipped leash is your problem. The dead answer necromancy, not conjuration. A successful dismissal of your own conjuration takes effect immediately unless another power is actively holding it in the world.
Holding open a found or existing way is this ladder's Extreme. Threshold Step permits one visible step; making a new way between known places requires The Ways Between.

illusion magic.name: illusion magic
illusion magic.description:
False senses: making people see what isn't there and miss what is.
Easy: a flicker of light, change your cloak's color, throw your voice.
Medium: a convincing figure that holds at a distance, mask a face, hide a doorway.
Hard: an illusion that bears close inspection, cloak a group from sight, a scene with sound and motion sustained.
Extreme: an illusion true at arm's length, veil a building, deceive a watching crowd at once.
Easier against the distracted and those who want to believe; harder against wary, keen eyes. Illusions have no substance and deal no damage; touching the mind itself is psionics.

divination magic.name: divination magic
divination magic.description:
Seeing what is hidden and what is coming.
Easy: sense nearby magic, find true north, feel whether you are watched.
Medium: find a lost thing nearby, read an object's recent past, glimpse a familiar person far away.
Hard: scry a distant place, read tomorrow's danger in signs, trace one man through a city.
Extreme: a clear vision of what comes, find a single soul across a kingdom, pierce wards woven to blind seers.
The future shows in glimpses and symbols, never certainty. Warded places and people resist; the willing and the known come easier. Divination deals no damage.

nature magic.name: nature magic
nature magic.description:
The living wild: green growth and beasts.
Easy: coax a flower open, calm a small animal, ripen an apple on the branch.
Medium: roots that grab and bind, speak with beasts, quicken a garden by a season.
Hard: a wall of thorn, call a pack of beasts to your aid, draw blight out of a field.
Extreme: wake a tree to fight, command the beasts of a whole valley, turn a barren hill green in a day.
Thorn and briar deal piercing damage; venoms deal poison. Strong in the wild; falters on dead stone and deep city streets. Wearing a beast's shape is shape shifting.

necromancy magic.name: necromancy magic
necromancy magic.description:
Power over the dead: speaking with them, raising them, drawing on death itself.
Easy: sense recent death, quiet a restless grave, a corpse-candle light.
Medium: question a fresh corpse, raise a skeleton servant, command a lesser shade.
Hard: raise several dead at once, bind a ghost to service, draw power from a battlefield.
Extreme: raise a champion of bone, command an unwilling wraith, hold a soul back from the Shadelands.
Deals shadow damage. Easier in places of death; falters on consecrated ground. Curses on the living are dark magic; living blood is blood magic.
Raised servants begin to fail at dawn. Keeping any beyond it requires an available Gray working; the working used determines how many can remain.

dark magic.name: dark magic
dark magic.description:
Curses, dread, and shadow given shape.
Easy: deepen the shadows around you, a chill of dread down a neck, wither a flower in the hand.
Medium: a lash of shadow, a curse of stumbling misfortune, blind a foe in darkness for a breath.
Hard: a curse that rides a man for weeks, terror that breaks a fighting line, shadow shaped into grasping hands.
Extreme: a withering curse on a whole household, darkness that smothers light and warmth, dread that routs a war-host.
Deals shadow damage. Falters on consecrated ground and against the stout of heart. The dead belong to necromancy; the body's blood to blood magic.

blood magic.name: blood magic
blood magic.description:
Power through blood in a living body—your own or another’s—and blood freshly shed from one.
Easy: close one of your own small cuts; sharpen your senses with a token drop; feel fresh blood touching or very close to you.
Medium: shape blood freely given or already spilled; trade a deliberate cut for a brief surge of speed, strength, or force.
Hard: force a resisting living foe’s wound to remain Bleeding; drain vigor from a resisting living foe; knit one of your own deep wounds in battle; still a limb through its blood.
Extreme: drain several resisting living foes at once; stop a heart; rip the strength from a giant; burn years of your life for one impossible moment.
Willing targets are easier. Bloodless, dead, and incorporeal targets cannot be bled or drained. Mending another person is healing magic; moving or binding the dead is necromancy; curses at a distance are dark magic. Blood spilled as a weapon deals piercing damage; life drained through blood deals shadow damage.

psionics.name: psionics
psionics.description:
Thought and will acting beyond the body: moving matter, touching minds, and extending perception.

Easy: move a small unattended object, sense a strong nearby emotion, or draw someone’s attention.

Medium: speak silently with a willing person, hurl a loose object, sense a nearby thinking presence, or read an unguarded surface thought.

Hard: restrain a resisting creature with unseen force, probe a guarded mind for an answer, induce a strong emotion, or strike directly at a mind.

Extreme: move a great weight, reach several minds together, enter a sleeper’s dream, or penetrate trained mental defenses.

Mental intrusion is harder against strong wills and trained minds. Mindless creatures cannot be read, influenced, or harmed psychically, but physical objects and telekinetic force can still strike them. Direct mental attacks deal psychic damage; physical attacks use the damage type of the object or force.

Possession and alteration of established memories require a specific ability or other explicit license.

shape shifting.name: shape shifting
shape shifting.description:
Taking and holding another shape, and fighting in it.
Easy: hold a familiar shape at rest, shift in calm, take a small harmless form.
Medium: shift under pressure, fight in a familiar shape, hold a form through pain.
Hard: shift mid-fight, take a shape studied but never worn, hold a form against wards.
Extreme: take a shape many times your size, shift as a blow lands, take a shape seen only once.
While shifted, shape shifting is the active skill for attacks and exceptional physical feats that depend on that body. Claws and fangs deal slashing or piercing damage; a great form's bulk deals impact damage. A shifted body cannot wield or use gear it cannot physically fit. What that body cannot do, you cannot do in it.

spirit channeling.name: spirit channeling
spirit channeling.description:
Letting a spirit ride your body, and acting as one while it does.
Easy: carry a small familiar spirit for an hour, let it sharpen one sense, speak a dead tongue it knows.
Medium: fight with an ancestor's skill at your hands, hold a channel through pain, carry a spirit through a rite it knows.
Hard: channel a powerful spirit in battle, hold two wills in one body under duress, refuse a rider's demand mid-channel.
Extreme: carry a great spirit of place or storm, hold the channel while near death, expel a rider that will not leave.
While a spirit rides you, spirit channeling is the active skill for attacks and supernatural feats supplied by the rider. Damage follows the rider's nature—an ancestor's blade deals slashing, a storm-spirit deals shock, and a grave-spirit deals shadow. The spirit has a will: what it would not do, it will not do through you. A willing named spirit already in the character's court is easier to carry; a stranger, hostile rider, violated taboo, or request against the spirit's nature is harder. Dealing with spirits from outside is spirit magic.

divine channeling.name: divine channeling
divine channeling.description:
Giving your body to your god's power, and acting as its vessel.
Easy: carry the presence through a vigil, let it steady your hands, speak one word in its voice.
Medium: fight as the vessel, strike with radiant force, hold the presence through pain.
Hard: channel through a full battle, keep the vessel while your faith is tested, make the presence visible across a crowded hall.
Extreme: carry radiance enough to contest a great shadow-thing, hold the presence while near death, survive more power than a mortal body should bear.
While the presence fills you, divine channeling is the active skill for attacks and supernatural feats of the vessel; its attacks deal radiant damage. A Vow Focus makes the specific divine aspect it carries easier for that paladin to channel. The god chooses what flows: the vessel serves, it does not command. Prayers and workings cast from your own strength use divine magic.

gadgetry.name: gadgetry
gadgetry.description: Fighting with made things: spring-arms, wound wheels, clatter-boxes, sparkers, and whatever the bench built this week. Damage follows the device — a striking arm deals impact, a needle-thrower piercing, a sparker shock, a vial-slinger what the vial holds. Signature work: the weapon nobody has seen before, the fight won by winding something up in advance, the device that does two jobs at once. Thrown blades and stones are throwing; a rigged trap waiting on the ground is trapcraft; building and mending the device is engineering.

sword.name: sword
sword.description: Arming swords, longswords, bastard swords, greatswords: blades swung with weight behind them. Deals slashing damage. Signature work: the precise parry, the disarm, the duel won clean. Rapiers, sabers, and other light blades are fencing.

fencing.name: fencing
fencing.description: Rapiers, sabers, smallswords, scimitars, cutlasses: light blades fought with speed, the point, and footwork. Deals piercing damage with the thrust and slashing damage with the cut. Signature work: the lunge, the feint that opens a guard, the riposte. Heavier swords are sword.

axe.name: axe
axe.description: Hand axes through great axes. Committed, shield-splitting blows. Deals slashing damage. Signature work: breaking guards, hewing through cover, the overhand finish.

blunt weapons.name: blunt weapons
blunt weapons.description: One-handed maces, clubs, flails, cudgels, morningstars. Deals impact damage. Signature work: denting plate, stunning blows, fighting in a press where blades can't swing. Two-handed hammers and mauls are warhammer.

warhammer.name: warhammer
warhammer.description: Two-handed hammers, mauls, great-clubs. One swing, one answer. Deals impact damage. Signature work: ruining armor, breaking shields, stopping a charge dead. One-handed maces and flails are blunt weapons.

spear.name: spear
spear.description: Spears, pikes, polearms, lances. Reach and control of the space between. Deals piercing damage. Signature work: holding a line, keeping three foes at the point, the mounted charge.

staff.name: staff
staff.description: Quarterstaves and walking staves: two ends, all angles. Deals impact damage. Signature work: sweeps, trips, defense against multiple attackers, winning without killing.

dagger.name: dagger
