Third-Year Student.name: Third-Year Student
Third-Year Student.description: An advanced Tarnholme student trusted with dangerous independent fieldwork and difficult College assignments.
abilities: Name the Spell
Third-Year Student.traitNarrativeEffects: A Third-Year student of Tarnholme Academy, trusted with dangerous work on their own. The Midsummer Dance on the Muster Court ends the Third Year, after three Practica and a year-end mission. Not yet.

Fourth-Year Student.name: Fourth-Year Student
Fourth-Year Student.description: A senior Tarnholme student entitled to lead Practica, mentor junior students, and undertake master-sponsored work.
abilities: Second Nature
Fourth-Year Student.traitNarrativeEffects: A Fourth-Year student of Tarnholme Academy, who may lead younger students in the field. The Final Trial and Commencement end the Fourth Year, after three Practica. Not yet.

College of Battle Mages.name: College of Battle Mages
College of Battle Mages.description: The battle College of Tarnholme, devoted to combat magic, wards, counter-magic, protection, and confronting hostile sorcery.
College of Battle Mages.traitNarrativeEffects: Tarnholme recognizes this character as a member of the College of Battle Mages. This College affiliation shapes their mentors, specialist opportunities, Practica, and institutional relationships without preventing broader magical study.

College of Artificers.name: College of Artificers
College of Artificers.description: The making College of Tarnholme, devoted to enchantment, magical construction, devices, and repair.
College of Artificers.traitNarrativeEffects: Tarnholme recognizes this character as a member of the College of Artificers. This College affiliation shapes their mentors, specialist opportunities, Practica, and institutional relationships without preventing broader magical study.

College of Summoners.name: College of Summoners
College of Summoners.description: The summoning College of Tarnholme, devoted to calling, sealing, bargaining with, and banishing otherworldly beings.
College of Summoners.traitNarrativeEffects: Tarnholme recognizes this character as a member of the College of Summoners. This College affiliation shapes their mentors, specialist opportunities, Practica, and institutional relationships without preventing broader magical study.

College of Healers.name: College of Healers
College of Healers.description: The restorative College of Tarnholme, devoted to healing, repair, purification, and breaking curses.
College of Healers.traitNarrativeEffects: Tarnholme recognizes this character as a member of the College of Healers. This College affiliation shapes their mentors, specialist opportunities, Practica, and institutional relationships without preventing broader magical study.

Shadow Initiate.name: Shadow Initiate
Shadow Initiate.description: A sworn Initiate of the Shadow Inquisition who bears the Mark of Rhadan but has not yet completed the Rite of Bonding.
Shadow Initiate.traitNarrativeEffects: The Black Tower recognizes this character as an Initiate. The Shadow Inquisition is a heroic and prestigious institution in Drusavia. Its Inquisitors protect the living from ghosts, necromancers, vampires, ghouls, and other threats from the dead. The Mark is a sanctioned sign of service, not a curse or proof of evil. Drusavian rulers, guards, and citizens generally respect the order's authority and do not interfere with its work lightly. They may undertake one supervised qualifying case but are not Shade-Bonded, may not claim full Inquisitor authority, and cannot make unsanctioned Shadelands descents. This standing changes only when the Black Tower names the next rank; until then, no slip, token, badge, or partial title stands in for it.

Shadow Inquisitor.name: Shadow Inquisitor
Shadow Inquisitor.description: A full Shade-Bonded field operative of the Shadow Inquisition, trusted with independent occult cases and sanctioned descents.
Shadow Inquisitor.traitNarrativeEffects: The Black Tower recognizes this character as a full Inquisitor. The Shadow Inquisition is a heroic and prestigious institution in Drusavia. Its Inquisitors protect the living from ghosts, necromancers, vampires, ghouls, and other threats from the dead. The Shade-bond is a sanctioned sign of service, not a curse or proof of evil. Drusavian rulers, guards, and citizens generally respect the order's authority and do not interfere with its work lightly. They may carry true hunts, investigate occult threats independently, and undertake sanctioned work with their Shade. This standing changes only when the Black Tower names the next rank; until then, no slip, token, badge, or partial title stands in for it.

Inquisition Adept.name: Inquisition Adept
Inquisition Adept.description: A proven senior Inquisitor trusted to lead deep descents, linked investigations, and less experienced operatives.
Inquisition Adept.traitNarrativeEffects: The Black Tower recognizes this character as an Adept with authority to lead difficult occult work, deep descents, linked cases, and junior Inquisitors. The Shadow Inquisition is a heroic and prestigious institution in Drusavia. Its Inquisitors protect the living from ghosts, necromancers, vampires, ghouls, and other threats from the dead. The Shade-bond is a sanctioned sign of service, not a curse or proof of evil. Drusavian rulers, guards, and citizens generally respect the order's authority and do not interfere with its work lightly. This standing changes only when the Black Tower names the next rank; until then, no slip, token, badge, or partial title stands in for it.

Master Inquisitor.name: Master Inquisitor
Master Inquisitor.description: A member of the Black Tower's inner circle, entrusted with its gravest cases, assignments, methods, and the defense of the Pit.
abilities: Unmask the Dead
Master Inquisitor.traitNarrativeEffects: The Black Tower recognizes this character as a Master Inquisitor with senior authority over major cases, sanctioned descents, assignments, and defense of the boundary with the Shadelands. The Shadow Inquisition is a heroic and prestigious institution in Drusavia. Its Inquisitors protect the living from ghosts, necromancers, vampires, ghouls, and other threats from the dead. The Shade-bond is a sanctioned sign of service, not a curse or proof of evil. Drusavian rulers, guards, and citizens generally respect the order's authority and do not interfere with its work lightly.

New-Sworn.name: New-Sworn
New-Sworn.description: A newly oathbound member of the Knights Vigilant who bears the moonstone oath-brooch and must complete one first ride under a veteran’s eye.
New-Sworn.traitNarrativeEffects: The Knights Vigilant recognize this character as New-Sworn. They may take one supervised first ride, but have not yet earned authority to answer Vigilant hunts independently. This standing changes only when the Temple of the Sword Vigilant names the next rank; until then, no slip, token, badge, or partial title stands in for it.

Moor-Knight.name: Moor-Knight
Moor-Knight.description: A proven Knight Vigilant trusted to ride independently against the restless dead and carry the order’s name to threatened settlements.
abilities: Ride Them Down
Moor-Knight.traitNarrativeEffects: The Knights Vigilant recognize this character as a Moor-Knight trusted with independent rides against the dead. This standing changes only when the Temple of the Sword Vigilant names the next rank; until then, no slip, token, badge, or partial title stands in for it.

Banner-Knight.name: Banner-Knight
Banner-Knight.description: A recognized field leader of the Knights Vigilant who bears a personal banner and may lead other knights on larger rides.
Banner-Knight.traitNarrativeEffects: The Knights Vigilant recognize this character as a Banner-Knight with authority to lead rides, bear a personal banner, and accept younger knights or willing companions under that banner. This standing changes only when the Temple of the Sword Vigilant names the next rank; until then, no slip, token, badge, or partial title stands in for it.

Champion Vigilant.name: Champion Vigilant
Champion Vigilant.description: A celebrated champion of the Knights Vigilant trusted to command great rides and rally whole settlements against the dead.
abilities: Banner Charge
Champion Vigilant.traitNarrativeEffects: The Knights Vigilant recognize this character as a Champion Vigilant with authority to command the order’s greatest rides, judge deeds, and speak for the order during major undead crises.

Restoring an Adventuring House.name: Restoring an Adventuring House
Restoring an Adventuring House.description: The captain of a dormant League adventuring house working under the sponsorship of its resident Gold-ranked veteran. Three recognized House deeds will earn the right to raise its League standard again.
Restoring an Adventuring House.traitNarrativeEffects: This character leads the effort to restore a former League adventuring house. The resident Gold-ranked veteran may bring forward work, recognize completed House deeds, introduce capable people, and sponsor the company until it earns the right to raise the League standard.

League Adventuring House.name: League Adventuring House
League Adventuring House.description: The captain of a restored League adventuring house whose standard was raised after three recognized deeds.
League Adventuring House.traitNarrativeEffects: This character leads an active League adventuring house. Its resident veteran, companions, clients, and regulars recognize this character as its field captain, and the House may offer serious regional work, introductions, recruits, and League recognition.

Adventuring House Founder.name: Adventuring House Founder
Adventuring House Founder.description: The founder of a new adventuring house seated at a home tavern, with a keeper receiving petitioners while the founder leads important work in the field.
Adventuring House Founder.traitNarrativeEffects: This character leads a newly founded adventuring house. The company may accept its first field contract, establish its name, gather willing associates, and begin building a reputation from its home tavern.

Locally Known Adventuring House.name: Locally Known Adventuring House
Locally Known Adventuring House.description: The leader of an adventuring house whose first successful deed has made its name known around its home community.
Locally Known Adventuring House.traitNarrativeEffects: This character leads a locally known adventuring house. Local clients, recruits, regulars, and rivals recognize the company name and bring substantial local opportunities to its home tavern.

Established Adventuring House.name: Established Adventuring House
Established Adventuring House.description: The leader of an adventuring house with several completed deeds and a substantial headquarters facility supporting field work.
abilities: On the House
Established Adventuring House.traitNarrativeEffects: This character leads an established adventuring house with useful headquarters facilities. Serious clients, institutions, specialists, and prospective recruits may seek a continuing relationship with it.

Renowned Adventuring House.name: Renowned Adventuring House
Renowned Adventuring House.description: The leader of an adventuring house whose reputation, clients, and work reach across its home region.
Renowned Adventuring House.traitNarrativeEffects: This character leads a regionally renowned adventuring house. Consequential clients travel to its headquarters, and the company may choose major commissions, field specialists, transport, patrons, or independence on its own terms.

Legendary Adventuring House.name: Legendary Adventuring House
Legendary Adventuring House.description: The leader of an adventuring house whose defining commission has established a lasting regional legacy.
abilities: The Regulars Talk
Legendary Adventuring House.traitNarrativeEffects: This character leads a legendary adventuring house with a lasting regional legacy. The company may choose its own great commissions, attract exceptional companions and clients, delegate lesser work, and shape the future of its headquarters without becoming a passive management game.

League Copper Standing.name: League Copper Standing
League Copper Standing.description: The League recognizes this character as a Copper adventurer: a new member trusted with local work and the first chance to prove judgment under pressure.
League Copper Standing.traitNarrativeEffects: League halls recognize this character as Copper standing and offer local proving work, modest contracts, and a clear path toward Bronze. This standing changes only when a League hall names the next standing; until then, no slip, token, badge, or partial title stands in for it.

League Bronze Standing.name: League Bronze Standing
League Bronze Standing.description: The League recognizes this character as Bronze standing, trusted with regional work and the dangers that ordinary local crews cannot handle.
League Bronze Standing.traitNarrativeEffects: League authorities recognize this character as Bronze standing and offer regional contracts, safehouse access, and work with meaningful local stakes. This standing changes only when a League hall names the next standing; until then, no slip, token, badge, or partial title stands in for it.

League Silver Standing.name: League Silver Standing
League Silver Standing.description: The League recognizes this character as Silver standing, a proven adventurer trusted with dangerous hunts, sensitive clients, and regional threats.
abilities: Low Sweep
League Silver Standing.traitNarrativeEffects: League authorities recognize this character as Silver standing and offer dangerous hunts, restricted archives, difficult travel, and work tied to larger powers. This standing changes only when a League hall names the next standing; until then, no slip, token, badge, or partial title stands in for it.

League Gold Standing.name: League Gold Standing
League Gold Standing.description: The League recognizes this character as Gold standing, an elite adventurer trusted with severe threats, major faction entanglements, and crisis-level missions.
League Gold Standing.traitNarrativeEffects: League authorities recognize this character as Gold standing and may entrust them with powerful monsters, politically sensitive work, and crises threatening cities or provinces. This standing changes only when a League hall names the next standing; until then, no slip, token, badge, or partial title stands in for it.

League Platinum Standing.name: League Platinum Standing
League Platinum Standing.description: The League recognizes this character as Platinum standing, the highest ordinary rank, trusted with legendary threats and Council-sealed work.
League Platinum Standing.traitNarrativeEffects: League authorities recognize this character as Platinum standing. The party may receive legendary threats, League-wide crises, Council-sealed work, and an invitation to pursue an exceptional Champion commission. This standing changes only when a League hall names the next standing; until then, no slip, token, badge, or partial title stands in for it.

League Champion.name: League Champion
League Champion.description: The League has permanently named this character League Champion: a Council member trusted to protect Larion at the highest level.
abilities: Through the Guard
League Champion.traitNarrativeEffects: The League recognizes this character as League Champion. This character holds a permanent final title, a seat on the Council, and authority to protect Larion, direct major responses, and accept Council-level commissions.

Crimson Company Hired Blade.name: Crimson Company Hired Blade
Crimson Company Hired Blade.description: The Crimson Company carries this character on its writ as a Hired Blade: an outsider paid to cull strigoi and ghouls, hold cordons, and escort what the vampire lords of the Shadow Summits trade.
Crimson Company Hired Blade.traitNarrativeEffects: Crimson Company halls recognize this character as a Hired Blade and offer local, survivable work in the Shadow Summits — culls, escorts, silver runs, and cordon rotations — with a bed, good clothes, and better pay than the work looks worth. Redblade is the next standing, and it is earned by the record and by surviving enough of it. This standing changes only when the Company or the Blood names the next standing; until then, no slip, token, badge, or partial title stands in for it.

Crimson Company Redblade.name: Crimson Company Redblade
Crimson Company Redblade.description: The Crimson Company recognizes this character as a Redblade: a proven soldier of the lords, marked by the lord they serve so that no other vampire may feed on them.
Crimson Company Redblade.traitNarrativeEffects: Crimson Company halls recognize this character as a Redblade and trust them with the houses’ own business rather than valley work. The lord’s mark is visible to vampires and respected by them: this one is spoken for. The Company’s elite are occasionally Embraced, and a Redblade is who that is offered to. This standing changes only when the Company or the Blood names the next standing; until then, no slip, token, badge, or partial title stands in for it.

Fledgling of the Blood.name: Fledgling of the Blood
Fledgling of the Blood.description: Recognized at the lowest rung of the Lords of the Blood: a Crimson Company captaincy, soldiers to command, and a standing earned when the Blood came into this company. Someone here carries it.
Fledgling of the Blood.traitNarrativeEffects: Vampires of the Shadow Summits recognize this character as someone’s get — a made vampire, not a lord, and owed to whoever made them. They hold a Crimson Company captaincy and command soldiers. The Company no longer issues them silver. Sunlight is lethal, and the hunger returns every night. This standing changes only when the Company or the Blood names the next standing; until then, no slip, token, badge, or partial title stands in for it.

Blooded.name: Blooded
Blooded.description: Recognized as Blooded by the Lords of the Blood: mastery of the hunger proven by a ghoul made and kept, and standing to act for a house among the houses rather than be sent by one.
Blooded.traitNarrativeEffects: Vampires of the Shadow Summits recognize this character as Blooded and deal with them as a principal rather than a servant. They may speak at the Hall of Witnesses, and their household — ghoul, retainers, soldiers — is their own. A vampire of standing who is not a lord is also a change in the balance, and rivals notice. This standing changes only when the Company or the Blood names the next standing; until then, no slip, token, badge, or partial title stands in for it.

Lord of the Blood.name: Lord of the Blood
Lord of the Blood.description: This character passed the Black Gate alone, killed and drank a Fiend of the Blood, and returned a lord. They hold a valley of the Shadow Summits and answer to no one above them.
abilities: The Lord's Word
Lord of the Blood.traitNarrativeEffects: The Lords of the Blood recognize this character as one of their own: a made lord with a seat, a domain, and a levy. No house, crown, or order stands above them. Other lords treat them as a rival, a neighbor, and a permanent fact.

Blood Hunger.name: Blood Hunger
Blood Hunger.description: The night has turned and you have not fed. The hunger is present, constant, and getting louder.
Blood Hunger.traitNarrativeEffects: The world reads as food. Ordinary people register first as warmth, pulse, and throat, and only second as people. Social scenes go badly and spilled blood is hard to look away from. Feeding on a living person clears this.

Starving.name: Starving
Starving.description: A second night without blood. The hunger is no longer something you have; it is something that has you.
Starving.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is visibly wrong: too still, too pale, pupils blown, breath forgotten. Composure costs effort and sometimes fails. Near open blood or an isolated living person, the character is at genuine risk of acting before deciding to. Feeding on a living person clears this.

Lord's Mark.name: Lord's Mark
Lord's Mark.description: A vampire lord of the Shadow Summits has marked this character as their own. Other vampires respect the mark, and the lord who set it enforces it.
Lord's Mark.traitNarrativeEffects: The mark is worn openly at the throat, a pale line of scar or silver-work, and every vampire in the Shadow Summits can read it at a glance: they will not feed on this character, and they treat harming them as a matter between houses rather than a private one. The protection is real and it is not friendship: the mark says property, and it lasts exactly as long as the lord who set it finds them useful.

Bound Ghoul.name: Bound Ghoul
Bound Ghoul.description: This character has deliberately made a ghoul and kept it — the difference between a household and a plague, and the proof that they can hold the hunger.
Bound Ghoul.traitNarrativeEffects: A made strigoi belongs to this character and follows them: fast, silent, tireless, and obedient in the narrow way a hand is obedient. It was somebody, once, and the character chose who. It does not speak, it does not improve, and it does not stop being what the character made it. Other vampires read it as competence and read the choice of victim as character. It can be destroyed, and it cannot be replaced casually.

Gift of the Glance.name: Gift of the Glance
Gift of the Glance.description: This character has found the old trick of the eyes: a mortal mind will bend, briefly, if it looks at them.
abilities: The Glance
Gift of the Glance.traitNarrativeEffects: Mortals meeting this character's gaze feel a moment of not being wholly their own. Vampires notice them using it and think better of them for it.

Gift of Old Shapes.name: Gift of Old Shapes
Gift of Old Shapes.description: This character can put the body down and take one of the old shapes: mist, bat, or wolf.
abilities: Old Shapes
Gift of Old Shapes.traitNarrativeEffects: Getting in, getting out, and crossing ground stop being the same problems they were. What they were wearing and carrying does not come with them, which shapes every plan that uses it.

Malren's Teaching.name: Malren's Teaching
Malren's Teaching.description: House Malren study the curse itself, and they teach what they learn to vampires who bring them something worth having. This character has been taught.
abilities: Crimson Reaping
The Red Price
Malren's Teaching.traitNarrativeEffects: House Malren treat this character as a colleague of sorts, and will trade instruction for specimens, pages, and access. Other houses notice who has been in Malren's laboratories.

Ridden.name: Ridden
Ridden.description: A spirit is riding this body — welcomed or not. While it rides, spirit channeling is the active skill for attacks and supernatural feats the rider supplies, and damage follows the rider's nature: an ancestor's blade deals slashing, a storm-spirit deals shock, a grave-spirit deals shadow. The spirit has a will; what it would not do, it will not do through you. The ride ends when the spirit departs, is expelled, or the channel breaks.
Ridden.traitNarrativeEffects: A spirit is visibly riding this character — another presence shows in the face, voice, bearing, or air around them. While it remains, spirit channeling is the active skill for attacks and supernatural feats the rider supplies; damage follows the rider's nature, and the spirit will not act against its own will. Those who know spirit-work recognize the state at once; others find it deeply unsettling.

Long Watch Recruit.name: Long Watch Recruit
Long Watch Recruit.description: A sworn recruit of the Long Watch, the knighthood that keeps the signal-fires burning across the ice of the north.
Long Watch Recruit.traitNarrativeEffects: This character is a sworn recruit of the Long Watch and wears its plain iron lamp-badge.

Long Watch Lamp-Bearer.name: Long Watch Lamp-Bearer
Long Watch Lamp-Bearer.description: A lamp-bearer of the Long Watch, trusted to cross the ice alone and relight a dark watchfire.
Long Watch Lamp-Bearer.traitNarrativeEffects: This character is a lamp-bearer of the Long Watch and wears its silver lamp-badge.

Long Watch Knight.name: Long Watch Knight
Long Watch Knight.description: A knight of the Long Watch, carrying a spark from a watchfire in their weapon, freely given by the hearth-spirit that kept it.
abilities: Watchfire Blade
Long Watch Knight.traitNarrativeEffects: This character is a knight of the Long Watch; a spark from a watchfire lives in their weapon and can wake into flame.

Rimewolf Sled Team.name: Rimewolf Sled Team
Rimewolf Sled Team.description: A sled and a team of white rimewolves of your own, won on the lake at Warmwater Township and kept at its Kennels.
Rimewolf Sled Team.traitNarrativeEffects: This character owns a trained rimewolf sled team kept at the Kennels in Warmwater Township, which can pull them across the ice far faster than walking.

Tevantian Hired Blade.name: Tevantian Hired Blade
Tevantian Hired Blade.description: A hired blade of Tevantia's great houses, paid to fight their duels and answer their slights.
Tevantian Hired Blade.traitNarrativeEffects: This character has fought as a hired blade for Tevantia's great houses.

Sworn Champion of House Montrose.name: Sworn Champion of House Montrose
Sworn Champion of House Montrose.description: A sworn champion of House Montrose of Tevantia, who defends its honor on the bridges and in the Amphitheater and wears its crimson and gold.
abilities: Grand Classical Lunge
Sworn Champion of House Montrose.traitNarrativeEffects: This character is a sworn champion of House Montrose of Tevantia, wears its crimson and gold, and fences in its school.

Sworn Champion of House Marenne.name: Sworn Champion of House Marenne
Sworn Champion of House Marenne.description: A sworn champion of House Marenne of Tevantia, who defends its honor on the bridges and in the Amphitheater and wears its sea-green and pearl.
abilities: Flowing Water Riposte
Sworn Champion of House Marenne.traitNarrativeEffects: This character is a sworn champion of House Marenne of Tevantia, wears its sea-green and pearl, and fences in its school.

Sworn Champion of House Ravissant.name: Sworn Champion of House Ravissant
Sworn Champion of House Ravissant.description: A sworn champion of House Ravissant of Tevantia, who defends its honor on the bridges and in the Amphitheater and wears its violet and silver.
abilities: Crowd-Thrilling Flourish
Sworn Champion of House Ravissant.traitNarrativeEffects: This character is a sworn champion of House Ravissant of Tevantia, wears its violet and silver, and fences in its school.

Sworn Champion of House Levantine.name: Sworn Champion of House Levantine
Sworn Champion of House Levantine.description: A sworn champion of House Levantine of Tevantia, who defends its honor on the bridges and in the Amphitheater and wears its sky-blue and white.
abilities: High-Wind Leap
Sworn Champion of House Levantine.traitNarrativeEffects: This character is a sworn champion of House Levantine of Tevantia, wears its sky-blue and white, and fences in its school.

First Blade of Tevantia.name: First Blade of Tevantia
First Blade of Tevantia.description: The victor of Tevantia's Grand Tournament, named First Blade of the city.
abilities: Bind and Thrust
First Blade of Tevantia.traitNarrativeEffects: This character won the Grand Tournament and is named First Blade of Tevantia.

Kobold.name: Kobold
Kobold.description:
Small, scaled, and far bolder than their size suggests. Kobolds are a clannish, clever, tunnel-born people who dig, build, and trap better than almost anyone. They turn up as miners, trap-makers, tunnel-guides, lamplighters, and salvagers, and a kobold with a plan and a pocketful of wire is a dangerous thing to underestimate.

Small and wiry, standing two and a half to three and a half feet tall, with scales in shades of copper, rust, umber, slate, or pale gold, often darker along the arms and tail. Narrow reptilian faces with short snouts, large bright eyes in gold, amber, or green, short swept-back horns, and long expressive tails that give away every mood. Quick clawed hands made for fine work.

Most people meet kobolds as raiders from the Hollows or warren-thieves, and assume the worst. Guards watch a kobold's hands, merchants count their stock twice, and strangers expect a bite. Miners, engineers, delvers, and anyone who has ever needed a trap disarmed know better, and a kobold who proves themselves once is remembered.
Kobold.traitNarrativeEffects: A kobold can rig a snare, tripwire, or quick trap from almost anything at hand, and slips through tight spaces, low gaps, and crawlways that stop bigger folk.

Provisional Hand.name: Provisional Hand
Provisional Hand.description: A provisional member of Kit Ravel and Hadrik Rell's Thieves' Guild Hand in the Dry Cistern beneath the Basement of Ardan's Watch. One theft that Hadrik accepts as valid work earns a real place in the crew.
Provisional Hand.traitNarrativeEffects: Kit, Hadrik, and the Guild people around the Dry Cistern treat this character as a promising new thief on trial: welcome at the table, trusted with small things, and watched. This standing changes only when Hadrik or a Guild authority names the next standing; until then, no slip, token, badge, or partial title stands in for it.

Working Hand.name: Working Hand
Working Hand.description: A working member of a Thieves' Guild Hand, with a key to the Dry Cistern, a bunk, and a share of the take.
Working Hand.traitNarrativeEffects: The Hand and the Guild people of Ardan's Watch treat this character as a working thief who has proved they can bring a take home clean. This standing changes only when Hadrik or a Guild authority names the next standing; until then, no slip, token, badge, or partial title stands in for it.

Trusted Hand.name: Trusted Hand
Trusted Hand.description: A trusted member of a Thieves' Guild Hand, relied on for jobs with real security, rival crews, and corrupt guards.
abilities: Clean Getaway
Trusted Hand.traitNarrativeEffects: Fences, Guild contacts, and rival Hands know this character as a thief whose word and work hold up, and bring them better jobs and sharper trouble. This standing changes only when Hadrik or a Guild authority names the next standing; until then, no slip, token, badge, or partial title stands in for it.

Guild-Recognized Hand.name: Guild-Recognized Hand
Guild-Recognized Hand.description: A thief whose Hand the Thieves' Guild of Ardan's Watch recognizes as ready for serious Guild work.
abilities: Ask the Guild
Guild-Recognized Hand.traitNarrativeEffects: The Guild treats this character as a recognized professional: Guild contacts open, serious work comes their way, and the long road toward a seat at the Table begins.

Renowned League Adventuring House.name: Renowned League Adventuring House
Renowned League Adventuring House.description: The captain of a restored League adventuring House whose deeds have made it renowned across its home region.
abilities: In the House's Name
Renowned League Adventuring House.traitNarrativeEffects: This character is a captain of a renowned League adventuring House. Its resident veteran, regional clients, and the League recognize the House's name, and serious regional work, recruits, and patrons seek it out.

Legendary League Adventuring House.name: Legendary League Adventuring House
Legendary League Adventuring House.description: The captain of a restored League adventuring House whose defining commission has given it a lasting regional legacy.
abilities: Call for Hands
Legendary League Adventuring House.traitNarrativeEffects: This character is a captain of a legendary League adventuring House with a lasting regional legacy. The House may choose its own great work, attract exceptional companions and clients, and shape its future without becoming a management game.

Silver Sword Hunt Being Recorded.name: Silver Sword Hunt Being Recorded
Silver Sword Hunt Being Recorded.description: A recognized deed is being written into this character's record. This mark clears on its own as soon as the record is kept.

Wolfpack Deed Being Recorded.name: Wolfpack Deed Being Recorded
Wolfpack Deed Being Recorded.description: A recognized deed is being written into this character's record. This mark clears on its own as soon as the record is kept.

Vigilant Ride Being Recorded.description: A recognized deed is being written into this character's record. This mark clears on its own as soon as the record is kept.

Inquisition Case Being Recorded.description: A recognized deed is being written into this character's record. This mark clears on its own as soon as the record is kept.

Practicum Being Recorded.description: A recognized deed is being written into this character's record. This mark clears on its own as soon as the record is kept.

Hand Theft Being Recorded.description: A recognized deed is being written into this character's record. This mark clears on its own as soon as the record is kept.

Company Deed Being Recorded.name: Company Deed Being Recorded
Company Deed Being Recorded.description: A recognized deed is being written into this character's record. This mark clears on its own as soon as the record is kept.

Entered in a Sanctioned Bout.name: Entered in a Sanctioned Bout
Entered in a Sanctioned Bout.description: This character has accepted a sanctioned arena bout and is on the card until it ends.
Entered in a Sanctioned Bout.traitNarrativeEffects: Arena officials treat this character as a declared entrant in the bout now being fought.

Guild Apprentice.name: Guild Apprentice
Guild Apprentice.description: An apprentice on the roll of the Guild of All Arts in Forge-town. Commissions this character makes for clients and hands over in person count toward their record in the Guild.
Guild Apprentice.traitNarrativeEffects: Guild members in Forge-town treat this character as a new apprentice of the Guild of All Arts: welcome at the commission board, trusted with ordinary work, and watched to see whether their work holds. This standing changes only when the Guild of All Arts names the next rank at one of its trials (the Proving Yard, the Craft Fair judging, or the Council of Masters); until then, no slip, token, badge, or partial title stands in for it.

Guild Journeyman.name: Guild Journeyman
Guild Journeyman.description: A journeyman of the Guild of All Arts, whose work passed its trial in Forge-town's Proving Yard. A journeyman takes commissions under their own name.
Guild Journeyman.traitNarrativeEffects: Forge-town's craftspeople and clients treat this character as a proven journeyman of the Guild of All Arts, trusted with Fine work and commissions under their own name. This standing changes only when the Guild of All Arts names the next rank at one of its trials (the Proving Yard, the Craft Fair judging, or the Council of Masters); until then, no slip, token, badge, or partial title stands in for it.

Guild Artisan.name: Guild Artisan
Guild Artisan.description: An artisan of the Guild of All Arts, whose work won over the judges of Forge-town's Craft Fair. An artisan may stamp their own work with the Guild seal.
abilities: Guild Seal
Guild Artisan.traitNarrativeEffects: Buyers, masters, and rival makers across Whitecliff Downs know this character as a Guild Artisan whose seal means the work is sound, and bring them Superior commissions and harder judges. This standing changes only when the Guild of All Arts names the next rank at one of its trials (the Proving Yard, the Craft Fair judging, or the Council of Masters); until then, no slip, token, badge, or partial title stands in for it.

Master of the Guild.name: Master of the Guild
Master of the Guild.description: A Master of the Guild of All Arts, named by the Council of Masters for a masterpiece now shown in the Masters' Chamber. A Master sits with the Council and takes Masterwork commissions.
abilities: Masterpiece
Master of the Guild.traitNarrativeEffects: The Council of Masters, Guild members, and serious clients recognize this character as a Master of the Guild: a maker whose masterpiece hangs in the Masters' Chamber, who judges disputes and apprentices, and who is sought out for Masterwork commissions.

Guild Commission Being Recorded.name: Guild Commission Being Recorded
Guild Commission Being Recorded.description: A recognized deed is being written into this character's record. This mark clears on its own as soon as the record is kept.

Stealth.name: Stealth
Stealth.description: You have learned to move without being seen or heard: when to wait, where to step, and which shadow will hold you. (Dexterity)
abilities: Strike from Cover

Athletics.name: Athletics
Athletics.description: You have trained your body to run, climb, jump, and swim hard, and to keep going when the ground fights back. (Strength)
abilities: Over the Top

Survival.name: Survival
Survival.description: You know how to live off the land: find water, forage a meal, read the weather, and make camp where camping works. (Wisdom)
abilities: What Grows Here

Mining.name: Mining
Mining.description: You have worked underground: you can read a seam, cut ore cleanly, and smell bad air before it takes you. (Constitution)
abilities: Strike the Seam

Handcraft.name: Handcraft
Handcraft.description: You have spent long hours at forge, bench, needle, and still, and you can make an honest version of most things a household needs. (Intelligence)

Mighty.name: Mighty
Mighty.description: Years of hard use have made you stronger than you started. Strength governs raw physical power.

Deft.name: Deft
Deft.description: Your hands and feet have grown quicker and surer with every scrape you came through. Dexterity governs agility and fine control.

Hardy.name: Hardy
Hardy.description: You have been hurt, cold, and hungry often enough that your body has stopped minding. Constitution makes you harder to kill.

Learned.name: Learned
Learned.description: Everything you have studied on the road has added up to real learning. Intelligence governs study, design, and making.

Perceptive.name: Perceptive
Perceptive.description: You have learned to notice what other people miss and to trust what you notice. Wisdom governs perception and judgment.

Commanding.name: Commanding
Commanding.description: People have started to listen when you speak, and to follow when you move. Charisma governs social influence and force of personality.

Resonant.name: Resonant
Resonant.description: Magic moves through you more easily than it did, as if you have worn a channel for it. Attunement governs every school of magic.

Discipline of Ash.name: Discipline of Ash

Discipline of the Gift.name: Discipline of the Gift

Powerful.name: Powerful
Powerful.description: You are stronger than anyone has a right to be, and people stop arguing when you lift things. Strength governs raw physical power.

Nimble.name: Nimble
Nimble.description: Your body goes where you send it before you have finished deciding. Dexterity governs agility and fine control.

Tireless.name: Tireless
Tireless.description: You keep going long after everyone around you has dropped. Constitution makes you harder to kill.

Sturdy.name: Sturdy
Sturdy.description: You are built to take a knock: a blow that would fold someone else only rocks you back a step.

Weathered.name: Weathered
Weathered.description: Seasons of cold, rain and hard roads have toughened your hide, so cuts close quicker and bruises barely slow you.

Toughened.name: Toughened
Toughened.description: Years of hard fighting have packed muscle over bone, and it takes a heavy, well-placed blow to really hurt you.

Iron Constitution.name: Iron Constitution
Iron Constitution.description: Your body holds together through blood loss and broken ribs that would lay another fighter out, and keeps you on your feet.

Unbowed.name: Unbowed
Unbowed.description: You have been knocked down more times than you can count and stood back up every time; it takes a great deal of punishment to keep you on the ground.

Enduring.name: Enduring
Enduring.description: You fight on through wounds that would end another warrior's day, holding your ground long after a fight should have finished you.

Unbreakable.name: Unbreakable
Unbreakable.description: Blades, claws and falling stone have all tried to break you, and your frame takes a beating that would kill most people without giving way.

Indomitable.name: Indomitable
Indomitable.description: You are among the hardest people alive to kill: it takes overwhelming force, not one lucky blow, to bring you down.

Brilliant.name: Brilliant
Brilliant.description: You see the answer while other people are still reading the question. Intelligence governs study, design, and making.

Clear-Eyed.name: Clear-Eyed
Clear-Eyed.description: Little escapes you any more, and less fools you. Wisdom governs perception and judgment.

Magnetic.name: Magnetic
Magnetic.description: Rooms turn toward you when you walk in, and people remember what you said. Charisma governs social influence and force of personality.

Wellspring.name: Wellspring
Wellspring.description: Magic rises in you like water from a deep spring and never quite runs dry. Attunement governs every school of magic.

Proof Against Fire.name: Proof Against Fire
Proof Against Fire.description: Flame and heat no longer bite as deep: you can walk through a burning room and come out singed rather than cooked. You have permanent resistance to fire damage.

Proof Against Frost.name: Proof Against Frost
Proof Against Frost.description: Cold no longer bites as deep: ice and killing winter slide off you where they would freeze anyone else. You have permanent resistance to frost damage.

Proof Against Shock.name: Proof Against Shock
Proof Against Shock.description: Lightning no longer bites as deep: it runs over you and into the ground instead of stopping your heart. You have permanent resistance to shock damage.

Proof Against Poison.name: Proof Against Poison
Proof Against Poison.description: Poison no longer bites as deep: venoms, toxins, and bad water pass through you with far less harm. You have permanent resistance to poison damage.

Proof Against Shadow.name: Proof Against Shadow
Proof Against Shadow.description: Shadow no longer bites as deep: the cold of the dark and the grave finds little in you to hold. You have permanent resistance to shadow damage.

Proof Against Radiant.name: Proof Against Radiant
Proof Against Radiant.description: Holy light no longer bites as deep: radiance that would sear anyone else washes over you. You have permanent resistance to radiant damage.

Legend of the Blade.name: Legend of the Blade
Legend of the Blade.description: Your fighting has passed into the stories people tell about the blade. This permanent Legend specialization grants +5 strength and One True Blow. Power: Momentum can climb to Peerless (impact 250).
abilities: One True Blow

Legend of the Vessel.name: Legend of the Vessel
Legend of the Vessel.description: Your capacity has become a measure other casters use for their own. This permanent Legend specialization grants +5 attunement and Three Spells at Once. Power: Grants Legendary Overchannel (+20, impact 300), and Overchannel no longer burns you.
abilities: Three Spells at Once
Legendary Overchannel

Legend of the Cloak.name: Legend of the Cloak
Legend of the Cloak.description: Guards tell each other stories about you to explain the posts they found empty. This permanent Legend specialization grants +5 dexterity and Between Two Guards. Power: Unseen Strikes can climb to Unseen Strike V (impact 400).
abilities: Between Two Guards

Legend of the Oath.name: Legend of the Oath
Legend of the Oath.description: Your vow is held up as the example when others swear theirs. This permanent Legend specialization grants +5 charisma and Not While I Stand. Power: Shelter heals 25 more and adds the Radiant Bulwark.
abilities: Not While I Stand

Legend of the Wild.name: Legend of the Wild
Legend of the Wild.description: Frontier folk say the weather itself takes your side. This permanent Legend specialization grants +5 wisdom and The Weather Turns. Power: Your aspects reach their strongest tier.
abilities: The Weather Turns

Legend of the Song.name: Legend of the Song
Legend of the Song.description: Your songs are sung in places you have never been, by people who don't know they are yours. This permanent Legend specialization grants +5 charisma and Everyone Sings. Power: Your songs and performances are stronger, and Rout sends foes below 40% health running.
abilities: Everyone Sings

Legend of the Work.name: Legend of the Work
Legend of the Work.description: Makers argue about how you built what you built, and never agree. This permanent Legend specialization grants +5 intelligence and One Great Machine. Power: Spark Coil and Overclock hit harder.
abilities: One Great Machine

Legend of the Will.name: Legend of the Will
Legend of the Will.description: The Sky Temple of the Ascension teaches your stillness as a lesson of its own. This permanent Legend specialization grants +5 dexterity and Form: The Quiet Hand. Power: The Center can climb to Beyond Reach.
abilities: Form: The Quiet Hand

Legend of Blood.name: Legend of Blood
Legend of Blood.description: The Chantry names you when it explains that the red art can give as well as take. This permanent Legend specialization grants +5 attunement and One Vein to Another. Power: Blood Calls hits at impact 300 and draws back the most.
abilities: One Vein to Another

Chose the College of Healers.traitNarrativeEffects: Has told the College of Healers they want to join it. The College will claim them at Colors Night, not before.

Ready for Adept of the Blade.name: Ready for Adept of the Blade
Ready for Adept of the Blade.description: Your skill is now enough for Adept of the Blade: 15 in sword, fencing, axe, blunt weapons, warhammer, spear, staff, dagger, archery, throwing, shield or unarmed combat. To pursue Adept rank, first vow a concrete feat that explicitly names Adept of the Blade as the rank you seek and demonstrates a named martial technique or controlled result against capable resistance. Declare the technique, a meaningful constraint, and a clear success condition before attempting it. For example, swear to take a weapon from a veteran without drawing blood, or defeat a shield fighter without yielding the center of a marked circle. Simply beating or killing a dangerous enemy does not count: the feat must show the technique you named, within the constraint you declared.

Ready for Expert of the Blade.name: Ready for Expert of the Blade
Ready for Expert of the Blade.description: Your skill is now enough for Expert of the Blade: 25 in sword, fencing, axe, blunt weapons, warhammer, spear, staff, dagger, archery, throwing, shield or unarmed combat. To pursue Expert rank, first vow a concrete feat that explicitly names Expert of the Blade as the rank you seek and in which you take responsibility for a dangerous engagement beyond your own survival. Declare the people or larger objective you will safeguard, the tactical constraint you will uphold, the real opposition, and a clear success condition. For example, swear to hold a gate alone until every civilian has crossed without allowing an enemy through. Surviving or fighting bravely does not count: you must control the fight while carrying the lives or objective you named.

Ready for Master of the Blade.name: Ready for Master of the Blade
Ready for Master of the Blade.description: Your skill is now enough for Master of the Blade: 40 in sword, fencing, axe, blunt weapons, warhammer, spear, staff, dagger, archery, throwing, shield or unarmed combat. To pursue Master rank, first vow an exceptional martial capstone that explicitly names Master of the Blade as the rank you seek. Declare the extreme opposition or stakes, an exacting constraint, and a decisive success condition worthy of a life's discipline. For example, swear to end a renowned champion's undefeated run using no weapon but the one they choose for you, while sparing their life. A hard victory or a famous kill does not count unless it meets the exact vow.

Ready for Adept of the Cloak.name: Ready for Adept of the Cloak
Ready for Adept of the Cloak.description: Your skill is now enough for Adept of the Cloak: 15 in stealth, lockpicking, pickpocketing or acrobatics. To become an Adept of the Cloak, complete quiet work cleanly enough that a credible contact, scoutmaster, fixer, handler, League officer, rebel agent, noble agent, guild contact, or underworld patron is willing to put their name behind you.

Ready for Expert of the Cloak.name: Ready for Expert of the Cloak
Ready for Expert of the Cloak.description: Your skill is now enough for Expert of the Cloak: 25 in stealth, lockpicking, pickpocketing or acrobatics. To become an Expert of the Cloak, complete dangerous quiet work: infiltrate a guarded place, recover something without open violence, expose a secret, smuggle someone out, sabotage a threat, map a dangerous route, or bypass traps without raising alarm.

Ready for Master of the Cloak.name: Ready for Master of the Cloak
Ready for Master of the Cloak.description: Your skill is now enough for Master of the Cloak: 40 in stealth, lockpicking, pickpocketing or acrobatics. To become a Master of the Cloak, complete high-stakes quiet work that serious powers thought impossible, then be named, promoted, hired, sought out, or openly recognized as someone who can handle impossible entries, exits, secrets, and recoveries.

Ready for Adept of the Vessel.name: Ready for Adept of the Vessel
Ready for Adept of the Vessel.description: Your skill is now enough for Adept of the Vessel: 15 in fire magic, water magic, storm magic, earth magic, divine magic, healing magic, warding magic, conjuration magic, illusion magic, divination magic, nature magic, necromancy magic, dark magic, blood magic, psionics, spirit magic, divine channeling or spirit channeling. To pursue Adept rank, first vow a feat that explicitly names Adept of the Vessel as the rank you seek and sustains a named magical working safely under meaningful pressure. Declare the working, the pressure or limitation, what control requires, and a clear success condition before attempting it. For example, swear to maintain a healing current through pain and distraction without allowing it to falter or draw strength from the patient. Routine casting, a finished lesson, or praise does not count: you must sustain the working under pressure within your limit.

Ready for Expert of the Vessel.name: Ready for Expert of the Vessel
Ready for Expert of the Vessel.description: Your skill is now enough for Expert of the Vessel: 25 in fire magic, water magic, storm magic, earth magic, divine magic, healing magic, warding magic, conjuration magic, illusion magic, divination magic, nature magic, necromancy magic, dark magic, blood magic, psionics, spirit magic, divine channeling or spirit channeling. To pursue Expert rank, first vow a difficult magical feat that explicitly names Expert of the Vessel as the rank you seek and takes place under serious adverse conditions. Declare the working, the opposition or strain, what must remain controlled or protected, and a clear success condition. For example, swear to close a hostile breach while wounded without allowing its magic to strike anyone behind you. Surviving strain or recovering afterward does not count: you must keep control through it.

Ready for Master of the Vessel.name: Ready for Master of the Vessel
Ready for Master of the Vessel.description: Your skill is now enough for Master of the Vessel: 40 in fire magic, water magic, storm magic, earth magic, divine magic, healing magic, warding magic, conjuration magic, illusion magic, divination magic, nature magic, necromancy magic, dark magic, blood magic, psionics, spirit magic, divine channeling or spirit channeling. To pursue Master rank, first vow a large, complex, or opposed magical capstone that explicitly names Master of the Vessel as the rank you seek. Declare the exceptional stakes, an exacting limit on control or harm, and a decisive success condition worthy of a life's discipline. For example, swear to bind a raging ley rupture before dawn without letting its force take a life or permanently scar the surrounding land. Recognition or surviving great power does not count: the working must keep the exact limit you vowed.

Ready for Adept of the Oath.name: Ready for Adept of the Oath
Ready for Adept of the Oath.description: Your skill is now enough for Adept of the Oath: 15 in divine magic, divine channeling, healing magic, leadership or shield. To become an Adept of the Oath, uphold your vow under pressure, then report, pray over, present proof of, ask judgment about, or receive recognition for the deed from someone or something that matters.

Ready for Expert of the Oath.name: Ready for Expert of the Oath
Ready for Expert of the Oath.description: Your skill is now enough for Expert of the Oath: 25 in divine magic, divine channeling, healing magic, leadership or shield. To become an Expert of the Oath, accept greater sacred duty from a temple, shrine, holy order, priest, paladin, village, rescued community, sacred witness, or oath-bound authority.

Ready for Master of the Oath.name: Ready for Master of the Oath
Ready for Master of the Oath.description: Your skill is now enough for Master of the Oath: 40 in divine magic, divine channeling, healing magic, leadership or shield. To become a Master of the Oath, complete great sacred service and be publicly blessed, titled, named, called upon, or widely recognized as a living example of your vow.

Ready for Adept of the Wild.name: Ready for Adept of the Wild
Ready for Adept of the Wild.description: Your skill is now enough for Adept of the Wild: 15 in survival, tracking, animal handling, nature magic or shape shifting. To become an Adept of the Wild, bring yourself or others through country that could have killed you: bad weather, a hard crossing, a lean season, hostile ground, or a route nobody sensible takes.

Ready for Expert of the Wild.name: Ready for Expert of the Wild
Ready for Expert of the Wild.description: Your skill is now enough for Expert of the Wild: 25 in survival, tracking, animal handling, nature magic or shape shifting. To become an Expert of the Wild, take responsibility for wild places or the people crossing them: guide a party through real danger, hold a frontier route open, tend sick land, or stand between a settlement and what the wild sent at it.

Ready for Master of the Wild.name: Ready for Master of the Wild
Ready for Master of the Wild.description: Your skill is now enough for Master of the Wild: 40 in survival, tracking, animal handling, nature magic or shape shifting. To become a Master of the Wild, do something for the wild, or against what threatens it, that frontier folk repeat afterwards, and be named, sought out, or openly acknowledged for it.

Ready for Adept of the Song.name: Ready for Adept of the Song
Ready for Adept of the Song.description: Your skill is now enough for Adept of the Song: 15 in performance, persuasion, intimidation or insight. To become an Adept of the Song, carry a hard occasion: a hostile court, a funeral, a riot on the turn, a mutinous camp, or a crowd that came to see someone else.

Ready for Expert of the Song.name: Ready for Expert of the Song
Ready for Expert of the Song.description: Your skill is now enough for Expert of the Song: 25 in performance, persuasion, intimidation or insight. To become an Expert of the Song, be trusted with something that matters to other people: a story they need told right, a message that must land, a grief that must be given shape, or a peace that depends on how it is said.

Ready for Master of the Song.name: Ready for Master of the Song
Ready for Master of the Song.description: Your skill is now enough for Master of the Song: 40 in performance, persuasion, intimidation or insight. To become a Master of the Song, make something other performers take up, or move an occasion so completely that people repeat it afterwards.

Ready for Adept of the Work.name: Ready for Adept of the Work
Ready for Adept of the Work.description: Your skill is now enough for Adept of the Work: 15 in engineering, gadgetry, trapcraft, smithing, alchemy, enchanting, carpentry, leatherworking or tailoring. To become an Adept of the Work, have your work hold when it mattered: under load, in the field, in weather, in a fight, or with someone's life resting on it.

Ready for Expert of the Work.name: Ready for Expert of the Work
Ready for Expert of the Work.description: Your skill is now enough for Expert of the Work: 25 in engineering, gadgetry, trapcraft, smithing, alchemy, enchanting, carpentry, leatherworking or tailoring. To become an Expert of the Work, be brought dangerous work: a mechanism that has already hurt someone, a device nobody else will touch, a repair that has to hold first time, or a commission with real consequences.

Ready for Master of the Work.name: Ready for Master of the Work
Ready for Master of the Work.description: Your skill is now enough for Master of the Work: 40 in engineering, gadgetry, trapcraft, smithing, alchemy, enchanting, carpentry, leatherworking or tailoring. To become a Master of the Work, build or repair something other makers come to study, and be named, commissioned, sought out, or openly acknowledged for it.

Ready for Adept of the Will.name: Ready for Adept of the Will
Ready for Adept of the Will.description: Your skill is now enough for Adept of the Will: 15 in unarmed combat, acrobatics, athletics, psionics or staff. To become an Adept of the Will, hold it under real pressure: pain, fear, provocation, exhaustion, grief, or a moment where losing control would have cost something.

Ready for Expert of the Will.name: Ready for Expert of the Will
Ready for Expert of the Will.description: Your skill is now enough for Expert of the Will: 25 in unarmed combat, acrobatics, athletics, psionics or staff. To become an Expert of the Will, be the steady one for other people: hold a line without moving, guard someone through terror, keep a group calm, or refuse a provocation that would have broken anyone else.

Ready for Master of the Will.name: Ready for Master of the Will
Ready for Master of the Will.description: Your skill is now enough for Master of the Will: 40 in unarmed combat, acrobatics, athletics, psionics or staff. To become a Master of the Will, demonstrate control that people who train for it recognise as complete, and be named, tested, sought out, or openly acknowledged for it.

Ready for Adept of Blood.name: Ready for Adept of Blood
Ready for Adept of Blood.description: Your skill is now enough for Adept of Blood: 15 in blood magic or dagger. To become an Adept of Blood, use the craft under real stakes and stop when you meant to — no slide, no overreach, and nothing taken that you did not intend to take.

Ready for Expert of Blood.name: Ready for Expert of Blood
Ready for Expert of Blood.description: Your skill is now enough for Expert of Blood: 25 in blood magic or dagger. To become an Expert of Blood, be given work that would corrupt someone with less control: the war-dead, a blood-curse, a Gravebound working, or a rite that has to be closed cleanly.

Ready for Master of Blood.name: Ready for Master of Blood
Ready for Master of Blood.description: Your skill is now enough for Master of Blood: 40 in blood magic or dagger. To become a Master of Blood, close something the Chantry would otherwise have had to burn, and be named, sought out, or openly acknowledged for it.

Ready for Novice of the Blade.name: Ready for Novice of the Blade
Ready for Novice of the Blade.description: You can now earn Novice of the Blade. To pursue Novice rank, first declare a concrete martial feat before attempting it, explicitly naming Novice of the Blade as the rank you seek. Enact the declaration as a vow, promise, pledge, or sworn undertaking to a god, master, witness, opponent, institution, or yourself. Name the feat, a meaningful danger or constraint, and a clear success condition. A suitable Novice feat requires disciplined weapon use under genuine danger; for example, swear to disarm a dangerous opponent without killing them or hold a named position until others escape. A win or a kill does not count by itself: the vow must hold you to a limit you chose, such as sparing the foe or holding a place, and the feat must keep it.

Ready for Novice of the Cloak.name: Ready for Novice of the Cloak
Ready for Novice of the Cloak.description: You can now earn Novice of the Cloak. To become a Novice of the Cloak, find a suitable contact or patron, take a small quiet job, return with proof, and show that you can work with discretion.

Ready for Novice of the Vessel.name: Ready for Novice of the Vessel
Ready for Novice of the Vessel.description: You can now earn Novice of the Vessel. To pursue Novice rank, first declare a concrete magical feat before attempting it, explicitly naming Novice of the Vessel as the rank you seek. Enact the declaration as a vow, promise, pledge, or sworn undertaking to a god, master, witness, spirit, institution, or yourself. Name the working, a meaningful limit or pressure, and a clear success condition. A suitable Novice feat deliberately tests controlled magical capacity; for example, swear to hold a ward steady through a dangerous disturbance without letting its force touch those inside. Ordinary spellcasting, study, or surviving by luck does not count: the working must keep the limit you declared.

Ready for Novice of the Oath.name: Ready for Novice of the Oath
Ready for Novice of the Oath.description: You can now earn Novice of the Oath. To become a Novice of the Oath, swear, renew, accept, or dedicate yourself to a solemn vow before a sacred witness: a temple, shrine, chapel, holy order, grave, community, god, saint, spirit, or power.

Ready for Novice of the Wild.name: Ready for Novice of the Wild
Ready for Novice of the Wild.description: You can now earn Novice of the Wild. To become a Novice of the Wild, live with wild country rather than passing through it: read weather before it arrives, choose a camp or route that works, forage or shelter through a bad night, or handle terrain that would have stopped an untrained traveller.

Ready for Novice of the Song.name: Ready for Novice of the Song
Ready for Novice of the Song.description: You can now earn Novice of the Song. To become a Novice of the Song, read a room and turn it: start, stop, or shift a performance, speech, toast, story, or song so that the mood of the people present visibly changes.

Ready for Novice of the Work.name: Ready for Novice of the Work
Ready for Novice of the Work.description: You can now earn Novice of the Work. To become a Novice of the Work, make or repair something that then does exactly what you said it would: a device that works, a lock that opens, a mechanism that runs, or a repair that holds under use.

Ready for Novice of the Will.name: Ready for Novice of the Will
Ready for Novice of the Will.description: You can now earn Novice of the Will. To become a Novice of the Will, find stillness and control deliberately — breath, balance, or attention — at a moment when it is difficult, and have it hold.

Ready for Novice of Blood.name: Ready for Novice of Blood
Ready for Novice of Blood.description: You can now earn Novice of Blood. To become a Novice of Blood, use blood, pulse, pain, or blade-discipline knowingly and pay its cost deliberately rather than being surprised by it.

In Stride.name: In Stride
In Stride.description: Momentum, step 1 of 5: your weapon attacks hit at impact 125, or an ability's own impact if that is higher. Climbs when an attack or a defence of yours lands in a fight; Path of the Blade lets you reach this step. Lost on a failure, on a fight turn when you neither attack nor defend, or when the fight ends.
In Stride.traitNarrativeEffects: Each weapon attack this character makes has impact at least 125, including an attack made with an ability; if the ability states a higher impact, use the higher one.

In Full Stride.name: In Full Stride
In Full Stride.description: Momentum, step 2 of 5: your weapon attacks hit at impact 150, or an ability's own impact if that is higher. Climbs when an attack or a defence of yours lands in a fight; Adept of the Blade lets you reach this step. Lost on a failure, on a fight turn when you neither attack nor defend, or when the fight ends.
In Full Stride.traitNarrativeEffects: Each weapon attack this character makes has impact at least 150, including an attack made with an ability; if the ability states a higher impact, use the higher one.

Relentless.name: Relentless
Relentless.description: Momentum, step 3 of 5: your weapon attacks hit at impact 175, or an ability's own impact if that is higher. Climbs when an attack or a defence of yours lands in a fight; Expert of the Blade lets you reach this step. Lost on a failure, on a fight turn when you neither attack nor defend, or when the fight ends.
Relentless.traitNarrativeEffects: Each weapon attack this character makes has impact at least 175, including an attack made with an ability; if the ability states a higher impact, use the higher one.

Unstoppable.name: Unstoppable
Unstoppable.description: Momentum, step 4 of 5: your weapon attacks hit at impact 200, or an ability's own impact if that is higher. Climbs when an attack or a defence of yours lands in a fight; Master of the Blade lets you reach this step. Lost on a failure, on a fight turn when you neither attack nor defend, or when the fight ends.
Unstoppable.traitNarrativeEffects: Each weapon attack this character makes has impact at least 200, including an attack made with an ability; if the ability states a higher impact, use the higher one.

Peerless.name: Peerless
Peerless.description: Momentum, step 5 of 5: your weapon attacks hit at impact 250, or an ability's own impact if that is higher. Climbs when an attack or a defence of yours lands in a fight; Legend of the Blade lets you reach this step. Lost on a failure, on a fight turn when you neither attack nor defend, or when the fight ends.
Peerless.traitNarrativeEffects: Each weapon attack this character makes has impact at least 250, including an attack made with an ability; if the ability states a higher impact, use the higher one.

Momentum.name: Momentum
Momentum.description: You are building momentum in this fight. Your current step is on your sheet. Every attack or defence of yours that lands climbs a step, as far as your Blade rank allows. A failure, a fight turn when you neither attack nor defend, or the end of the fight loses it all.

Blade Landed.name: Blade Landed
Blade Landed.description: Marks, for this turn only, that a Blade holder's attack or defence landed. Cleared at the end of the turn.

Unseen.name: Unseen
Unseen.description: You are striking from hiding and staying hidden. Your current Unseen Strike step is on your sheet. An attack from hiding that lands well enough for your Cloak rank keeps you Hidden and climbs a step. The steps end when you are no longer Hidden.

Still Unseen.name: Still Unseen
Still Unseen.description: You struck from hiding and slipped back into cover this turn.

Struck Unseen.name: Struck Unseen
Struck Unseen.description: Marks, for this turn only, that a Cloak holder's attack from hiding landed well enough to stay hidden. Cleared at the end of the turn.

Unseen Strike I.name: Unseen Strike I
Unseen Strike I.description: Unseen Strike, step 1 of 5: while you stay Hidden, your attacks hit at impact 225 instead of Hidden's 200, or an ability's own impact if that is higher. Path of the Cloak lets you reach this step. Lost the moment you are no longer Hidden.
Unseen Strike I.traitNarrativeEffects: Each attack this character makes has impact at least 225, which replaces Hidden's impact 200, including an attack made with an ability; if the ability states a higher impact, use the higher one.

Unseen Strike II.name: Unseen Strike II
Unseen Strike II.description: Unseen Strike, step 2 of 5: while you stay Hidden, your attacks hit at impact 250 instead of Hidden's 200, or an ability's own impact if that is higher. Adept of the Cloak lets you reach this step. Lost the moment you are no longer Hidden.
Unseen Strike II.traitNarrativeEffects: Each attack this character makes has impact at least 250, which replaces Hidden's impact 200, including an attack made with an ability; if the ability states a higher impact, use the higher one.

Unseen Strike III.name: Unseen Strike III
Unseen Strike III.description: Unseen Strike, step 3 of 5: while you stay Hidden, your attacks hit at impact 300 instead of Hidden's 200, or an ability's own impact if that is higher. Expert of the Cloak lets you reach this step. Lost the moment you are no longer Hidden.
Unseen Strike III.traitNarrativeEffects: Each attack this character makes has impact at least 300, which replaces Hidden's impact 200, including an attack made with an ability; if the ability states a higher impact, use the higher one.

Unseen Strike IV.name: Unseen Strike IV
Unseen Strike IV.description: Unseen Strike, step 4 of 5: while you stay Hidden, your attacks hit at impact 350 instead of Hidden's 200, or an ability's own impact if that is higher. Master of the Cloak lets you reach this step. Lost the moment you are no longer Hidden.
Unseen Strike IV.traitNarrativeEffects: Each attack this character makes has impact at least 350, which replaces Hidden's impact 200, including an attack made with an ability; if the ability states a higher impact, use the higher one.

Unseen Strike V.name: Unseen Strike V
Unseen Strike V.description: Unseen Strike, step 5 of 5: while you stay Hidden, your attacks hit at impact 400 instead of Hidden's 200, or an ability's own impact if that is higher. Legend of the Cloak lets you reach this step. Lost the moment you are no longer Hidden.
Unseen Strike V.traitNarrativeEffects: Each attack this character makes has impact at least 400, which replaces Hidden's impact 200, including an attack made with an ability; if the ability states a higher impact, use the higher one.

The Center.name: The Center
The Center.description: You are fighting from the center. Your current step is on your sheet. Every defence or evade of yours that lands in a fight climbs a step, as far as your Will rank allows, and gives mana back. A failure drops one step; the end of the fight clears it.

Centered.name: Centered
Centered.description: The Center, step 1 of 4: impact damage against you is halved, and your unarmed and staff strikes hit at impact 125, or a Form's own impact if that is higher. Path of the Will lets you reach this step. A failure drops one step; the end of the fight clears it.
Centered.traitNarrativeEffects: Each unarmed or staff attack this character makes has impact at least 125, including an attack made with an ability; if the ability states a higher impact, use the higher one.

Still.name: Still
Still.description: The Center, step 2 of 4: impact and slashing damage against you is halved, and your unarmed and staff strikes hit at impact 150, or a Form's own impact if that is higher. Adept of the Will lets you reach this step. A failure drops one step; the end of the fight clears it.
Still.traitNarrativeEffects: Each unarmed or staff attack this character makes has impact at least 150, including an attack made with an ability; if the ability states a higher impact, use the higher one.

Untouchable.name: Untouchable
Untouchable.description: The Center, step 3 of 4: impact, slashing and piercing damage against you is halved, and your unarmed and staff strikes hit at impact 200, or a Form's own impact if that is higher. Master of the Will lets you reach this step. A failure drops one step; the end of the fight clears it.
Untouchable.traitNarrativeEffects: Each unarmed or staff attack this character makes has impact at least 200, including an attack made with an ability; if the ability states a higher impact, use the higher one.

Beyond Reach.name: Beyond Reach
Beyond Reach.description: The Center, step 4 of 4: impact, slashing, piercing, fire and poison damage against you is halved, and your unarmed and staff strikes hit at impact 250, or a Form's own impact if that is higher. Legend of the Will lets you reach this step. A failure drops one step; the end of the fight clears it.
Beyond Reach.traitNarrativeEffects: Each unarmed or staff attack this character makes has impact at least 250, including an attack made with an ability; if the ability states a higher impact, use the higher one.

Turned Aside.name: Turned Aside
Turned Aside.description: Marks, for this turn only, that a Will holder's defence or evade landed. Cleared at the end of the turn.

Bulwark I.name: Bulwark I
Bulwark I.description: Shelter: slashing and piercing damage against you is halved. Gained, with a heal for the whole party, when a blow or guard of yours lands as a Great Success or better in a fight; its size comes from your Oath rank. Lasts until the fight ends.

Bulwark II.name: Bulwark II
Bulwark II.description: Shelter: slashing, piercing and impact damage against you is halved. Gained, with a heal for the whole party, when a blow or guard of yours lands as a Great Success or better in a fight; its size comes from your Oath rank. Lasts until the fight ends.

Bulwark III.name: Bulwark III
Bulwark III.description: Shelter: slashing, piercing, impact and shadow damage against you is halved. Gained, with a heal for the whole party, when a blow or guard of yours lands as a Great Success or better in a fight; its size comes from your Oath rank. Lasts until the fight ends.

Radiant Bulwark.name: Radiant Bulwark
Radiant Bulwark.description: Shelter: radiant damage against you is halved. Gained, with a heal for the whole party, when a blow or guard of yours lands as a Great Success or better in a fight; its size comes from Legend of the Oath. Lasts until the fight ends.

Encore Spent.name: Encore Spent
Encore Spent.description: You have given your big performance. The countdown on your sheet shows when the next one can move a room.

Encore in 41 to 50 turns.name: Encore in 41 to 50 turns
Encore in 41 to 50 turns.description: Your next big performance is ready in about 41 to 50 turns.

Encore in 31 to 40 turns.name: Encore in 31 to 40 turns
Encore in 31 to 40 turns.description: Your next big performance is ready in about 31 to 40 turns.

Encore in 21 to 30 turns.name: Encore in 21 to 30 turns
Encore in 21 to 30 turns.description: Your next big performance is ready in about 21 to 30 turns.

Encore in 11 to 20 turns.name: Encore in 11 to 20 turns
Encore in 11 to 20 turns.description: Your next big performance is ready in about 11 to 20 turns.

Encore in 1 to 10 turns.name: Encore in 1 to 10 turns
Encore in 1 to 10 turns.description: Your next big performance is ready in about 1 to 10 turns.

Performed Well.name: Performed Well
Performed Well.description: Marks, for this turn only, that a bard's big performance landed. Cleared at the end of the turn.

Performed Brilliantly.name: Performed Brilliantly
Performed Brilliantly.description: Marks, for this turn only, that a bard's big performance landed brilliantly. Cleared at the end of the turn.

Song Playing.name: Song Playing
Song Playing.description: A bard's song is playing for your party in this fight. Its effect is on your sheet; it ends when the fight ends or another song starts.

Sang March of Iron.name: Sang March of Iron
Sang March of Iron.description: Marks, for this turn only, that a bard sang March of Iron well enough to carry. Cleared at the end of the turn.

March of Iron I.name: March of Iron I
March of Iron I.description: March of Iron is playing: +3 strength. Ends when the fight ends or another song starts.

March of Iron II.name: March of Iron II
March of Iron II.description: March of Iron is playing: +4 strength. Ends when the fight ends or another song starts.

March of Iron III.name: March of Iron III
March of Iron III.description: March of Iron is playing: +5 strength. Ends when the fight ends or another song starts.

March of Iron IV.name: March of Iron IV
March of Iron IV.description: March of Iron is playing: +6 strength. Ends when the fight ends or another song starts.

March of Iron (Legend).name: March of Iron (Legend)
March of Iron (Legend).description: March of Iron is playing: +2 strength on top of the song itself. Ends when the fight ends or another song starts.

Sang Quickstep Reel.name: Sang Quickstep Reel
Sang Quickstep Reel.description: Marks, for this turn only, that a bard sang Quickstep Reel well enough to carry. Cleared at the end of the turn.

Quickstep Reel I.name: Quickstep Reel I
Quickstep Reel I.description: Quickstep Reel is playing: +3 dexterity. Ends when the fight ends or another song starts.

Quickstep Reel II.name: Quickstep Reel II
Quickstep Reel II.description: Quickstep Reel is playing: +4 dexterity. Ends when the fight ends or another song starts.

Quickstep Reel III.name: Quickstep Reel III
Quickstep Reel III.description: Quickstep Reel is playing: +5 dexterity. Ends when the fight ends or another song starts.

Quickstep Reel IV.name: Quickstep Reel IV
Quickstep Reel IV.description: Quickstep Reel is playing: +6 dexterity. Ends when the fight ends or another song starts.

Quickstep Reel (Legend).name: Quickstep Reel (Legend)
Quickstep Reel (Legend).description: Quickstep Reel is playing: +2 dexterity on top of the song itself. Ends when the fight ends or another song starts.

Sang Hymn of the Deep.name: Sang Hymn of the Deep
Sang Hymn of the Deep.description: Marks, for this turn only, that a bard sang Hymn of the Deep well enough to carry. Cleared at the end of the turn.

Blood Calling.name: Blood Calling
Blood Calling.description: You have paid in your own blood and it is reaching for living blood. Your Blood Calls tier is on your sheet. Your next attack that lands spends it and, against a living foe, draws health back. A failure wastes it; the end of the fight clears it.

Blood Drawn.name: Blood Drawn

Blood Calls I.description: Blood Calls, tier 1 of 5 (from Path of Blood or Novice): your next attack that lands hits at impact 175, or an ability's own impact if that is higher, and draws health back from a living foe. Then it is spent.
Blood Calls I.traitNarrativeEffects: The next attack this character makes has impact at least 175, including an attack made with an ability; if the ability states a higher impact, use the higher one.
