completionCondition.query: The accepted matter The Play They Tried to Stop has been resolved: The campaign of intimidation has ended and the troupe completes a public performance safely. A promise, fabricated account, or partial result does not count. The player actually contributed to the resolution.

onCompleteEffects.instruction: This matter is resolved. Let the people involved acknowledge the actual outcome and, when appropriate, remind participants that Velanthe at Ducal Square in Drusavia can recognize their service. Do not force an immediate return, award a title, or repeat the payment.

The Play They Tried to Stop.questDesignBrief:
A noble recognized his own vanity in a comedy performed in the Grand Arcade and hired bullies to smash the stage. They continue to threaten the company and prevent performances. The leading actress appealed through the troupe’s supporters to Velanthe. The public offer states the motive, ongoing violence, meeting place, and the actress’s commanding theatricality and generosity. Meet the company at its usual performance space within the existing Grand Arcade; add no mapped area or permanent NPC.

The leading actress is a magnificent show-off who loves applause and shares her earnings with the cast. She insists that quieter players receive recognition and can turn an ordinary disagreement into a speech. She wants the play performed and the company safe. She does not sacrifice other people for a grand gesture or dismiss a sensible plan because it lacks drama. Her generosity is genuine, as is her appetite for attention. The players have opinions, livelihoods, and the right to decline danger; they are not props for her courage.

The comedy mocks self-importance rather than revealing a secret crime. Its offended target uses money and hired muscle to suppress it. No hidden revelation is necessary to justify intervention. The actress and witnesses can identify the bullies and describe their threats without another preliminary task. Make the connection to their patron actionable through their known employment, threats made in his name, or direct testimony. Do not turn it into an unrelated conspiracy or require finding a document.

Let participants confront or outmaneuver the bullies, pressure their patron, gather witnesses and public support, enlist appropriate protection, guard the performance, or combine approaches. Violence is optional. No forced duel, fixed negotiation script, or mandatory acting role. Players may help with the show if they wish, but repairing scenery, gathering props, rehearsals, and logistics are not completion requirements. The company can perform with simple staging once it is safe.

Completion requires the campaign of intimidation ended and a public performance completed safely. A quiet show while the same threats remain in force is insufficient. Do not demand the patron’s friendship, humiliation, or approval of the satire. Once resolved, preserve the result instead of restarting harassment whenever the players visit. The troupe’s supporters pay 160 florins once; ordinary performances and after-show suppers offer continuing company without compulsory work. Participants can return to Velanthe at Ducal Square for recognition once each. Shared recognition mechanics belong to final integration.

The Ransom She Refused.name: The Ransom She Refused
The Ransom She Refused.questStatement:
A bandit lord in the Daravaine Reaches holds a young noblewoman and her treasure-hunting companions for ransom. Her family offered to buy her freedom alone; proud, loyal, and unwilling to abandon the people she led into trouble, she refused. Velanthe asks you to meet her exasperated younger brother at the Red Moon Inn: he has the bandits’ terms, their camp’s location, and a ransom purse, but needs help bringing the whole party home.

Secure the whole expedition’s freedom through negotiation, escape, force, or another workable plan. The family provides ransom funds; your own money is not required.

Reward: 300 florins and introductions to the family’s court acquaintances. Return to Velanthe at Ducal Square for recognition.
The Ransom She Refused.mainObjective: Free the noblewoman and all her captive companions and bring them to safety.

completionCondition.query: The accepted matter The Ransom She Refused has been resolved: The noblewoman and all her captive expedition companions are free of the band’s control and have reached safety. A promise, fabricated account, or partial result does not count. The player actually contributed to the resolution.

onCompleteEffects.instruction: This matter is resolved. Let the people involved acknowledge the actual outcome and, when appropriate, remind participants that Velanthe at Ducal Square in Drusavia can recognize their service. Do not force an immediate return, award a title, or repeat the payment.

The Ransom She Refused.questDesignBrief:
One Hill Lord’s band captured a young noblewoman and her treasure-hunting expedition in the Daravaine Reaches. Her family offered to pay for her release alone. She refused to abandon the people she led into danger. The public offer states this situation and her pride and loyalty, identifies the exasperated younger brother as the first contact, and makes clear that he has the captors’ terms, camp location and ransom purse. Meet him at the Red Moon Inn in Drusavia. He approached Velanthe for capable help bringing everyone home.

The brother knows the camp from earlier ransom negotiations and immediately shares the usable information. Do not require another clue hunt or persuasion test to begin. Establish the number of captive companions, the band’s demands and the available family funds consistently when staging the matter. Negotiation funds are separate from the 300-florin reward. A successful approach never requires the participants to spend personal money; a demand beyond the available purse leaves bargaining, escape and other approaches open. Do not invent an execution deadline or an abduction timed to arrival. The band holds the expedition for its ransom value.

The noblewoman is adventurous, proud and loyal. She accepts responsibility for the expedition and contributes what she knows about the camp, captors and companions. She refuses a settlement that abandons anyone, not a sensible staged escape that frees everyone. Do not make her obstruct evacuation merely to prove her principles. Her companions have abilities, opinions and a stake in their own freedom; let them help according to the plan and their condition.

Her younger brother is practical and exasperated by her appetite for danger. He believes the expedition was a dreadful idea and also respects her refusal to leave anyone behind. His irritation and love coexist. He can discuss the expense without treating her companions as expendable, and supports a practical solution instead of demanding obedience to one scripted negotiation. The siblings need not settle every disagreement for the matter to succeed.

Preserve Daravaine canon: the Hill Lords are rival bands, not one unified army. They rob those they can take, ransom captives worth coin and trade with people strong enough to approach with something to sell. Use a single band’s incidental camp in The Hill Lords’ Crags, reached through the existing Reaches. Do not turn the whole region friendly or require defeating every band. Credible negotiators can approach because these captors seek ransom; traders, infiltration, exploiting rivalries, organizing an escape, force or combined tactics are also available. No forced duel, specific negotiation script or requirement to substitute a player character as hostage.

Completion requires the noblewoman and all her captive expedition companions free of the band’s control and at safety. A promise to release them, freeing only the noblewoman or paying while the band retains the prisoners is insufficient. Do not create an escort encounter chain after freedom merely to prolong the task. The family pays 300 florins once after success and offers introductions to court acquaintances; friendship or romance is not automatic. Participants may return to Velanthe at Ducal Square for recognition once each. Shared recognition mechanics belong to final integration.

The Unwelcome Protector.name: The Unwelcome Protector
The Unwelcome Protector.questStatement:
A vineyard owner near Rovena hired ghost-hunters who now occupy her home and bully her household. Meet her at the Dead be Damned Tavern and help her take it back.

Reward: 180 florins and a standing invitation to her harvest suppers.

Return to Velanthe at Ducal Square in Drusavia for recognition.
The Unwelcome Protector.mainObjective: End the hunters’ occupation and restore the household’s safe control of its home.

completionCondition.query: The accepted matter The Unwelcome Protector has been resolved: The hunters’ occupation has ended, and the owner and household have safe control of the estate again. A promise, fabricated account, or partial result does not count. The player actually contributed to the resolution.

onCompleteEffects.instruction: This matter is resolved. Let the people involved acknowledge the actual outcome and, when appropriate, remind participants that Velanthe at Ducal Square in Drusavia can recognize their service. Do not force an immediate return, award a title, or repeat the payment.

The Unwelcome Protector.questDesignBrief:
Velanthe received the vineyard owner’s appeal and offers this opportunity to capable visitors. The occupation already exists when the matter is accepted. The hunters control the estate’s gate and main house; the owner has reached Rovena to seek help, while her household remains on the estate. Their bullying and violence are real, not an ambush awaiting the party’s arrival.

The owner is young, proud, outspoken, and furious that she spent months boasting about the man now treating her home as his own. She knows the house, its approaches, and the people still there, and actively helps a workable plan. She need not become humble or apologize for seeking protection. The hunter genuinely cleared a haunting. He believes that saving these people entitles him to their hospitality indefinitely, and presents his occupation as gratitude owed. His companions need not share that conviction or remain loyal when challenged.

Let force, intimidation, persuasion, dividing the hunters, or another workable approach succeed according to play. No mandatory duel, document hunt, ownership dispute, or fixed sequence of negotiations. The household’s safety matters: a promise to depart while the hunters retain control is insufficient. Do not replace them with another coercive occupier. The owner retains her home.

Use a vineyard estate near Rovena within the existing location, reached from the meeting at the Dead be Damned Tavern; no new mapped location is required. Preserve Rovena’s ghost rules: dangerous ghosts rise at night, sunlight drives them away, living hearths protect thresholds, and radiant weapons or balefire can destroy them. Occupied buildings retain their hearths. Do not force a new haunting or night attack as the solution.

After success the owner pays 180 florins and welcomes the participants to future harvest suppers. Let ordinary food, wine, friends, and celebrations continue without turning hospitality into recurring work. Participants may return to Velanthe at Ducal Square for recognition, once each for this matter. Shared recognition mechanics belong to final integration.

The Wrong Quarry.name: The Wrong Quarry
The Wrong Quarry.questStatement:
A manticore has begun hunting the hunting parties in the Harrowwood, killing hounds and attacking riders; survivors traced it to an abandoned sawpit in the Working Wood. Velanthe asks you to meet a young noble huntswoman at Kolbeck’s White Rooster—fastidious about her clothes, devoted to her dogs, and furious over those she has lost—and help her kill or drive off the beast so the wood-road is safe again.

Reward: 240 florins from the hunting party’s patrons and invitations to future hunts and suppers. Return to Velanthe at Ducal Square for recognition.
The Wrong Quarry.mainObjective: End the manticore’s attacks on the worked forest and its routes.

completionCondition.query: The accepted matter The Wrong Quarry has been resolved: The manticore is dead or driven away from the worked forest and its routes without redirecting its attacks toward another settlement. A promise, fabricated account, or partial result does not count. The player actually contributed to the resolution.

onCompleteEffects.instruction: This matter is resolved. Let the people involved acknowledge the actual outcome and, when appropriate, remind participants that Velanthe at Ducal Square in Drusavia can recognize their service. Do not force an immediate return, award a title, or repeat the payment.

The Wrong Quarry.questDesignBrief:
Velanthe has received the hunting party’s appeal after a manticore killed hounds and attacked riders in the Harrowwood. Survivors traced it to an abandoned sawpit in the Working Wood. The offer already states the threat, known lair, meeting place, and the huntswoman’s fastidious vanity, love of her dogs, and anger over their loss. Meet her at the White Rooster in Kolbeck. She can explain what happened and guide participants to the sawpit; do not withhold the starting lead behind a test or a secret.

The young noble huntswoman is elegant, outspoken, and particular about her clothing. She complains about a muddy cuff and then kneels in the dirt to tend an injured hound. Her vanity and affection are both real. She knows the trails, contributes to a practical plan, and wants the surviving dogs protected. Anger does not make her insist on using them as bait or pursuing a suicidal charge. She accepts help without becoming a passive employer and can accept safely driving the creature away even if she would prefer its death.

The attacks and occupation of the sawpit already exist; do not trigger an ambush or a hound’s injury on arrival. Stage the sawpit and its approaches as incidental terrain in the existing Working Wood. Use an ordinary manticore, without inventing a new legendary creature or unusual immunity. Allow scouting, lures, traps, direct combat, or another workable plan. Do not force the creature to remain motionless or prescribe one tactic, but give participants a fair chance to act on what they learn.

Respect the Harrowwood’s marked burial plots: disturbing them raises the dead. The sawpit is an old working site outside those plots. Do not require cutting a Watch-Oak, disturbing a grave, or undertaking a second haunting to finish this hunt. No mandatory bait animal or scripted animal death. Resolved injuries and combat outcomes follow play.

Completion requires the manticore dead or driven away from the worked forest and its routes, not merely startled out of the sawpit. Redirecting it toward another settlement does not count. The hunting party’s patrons pay 240 florins once. Future hunts and suppers offer ordinary social company without compulsory membership or further work. Participants can return to Velanthe at Ducal Square for recognition once each. Shared recognition mechanics belong to final integration.

A Night in Beggarsbridge.name: A Night in Beggarsbridge
A Night in Beggarsbridge.questStatement:
A visiting young baron from Carendon wants a night among the smugglers of Beggarsbridge, disguised as a common sailor. Rosalba asks you to humor him and bring him safely home. Take him to the Waterline Inn; he will pay for the drinks.

Reward: 180 florins from the ducal household and an invitation to visit the baron in Carendon.

Return to Rosalba in the Ducal Palace’s Gilded Hall in Tevantia for recognition.
A Night in Beggarsbridge.mainObjective: Spend an evening with the visiting baron at the Waterline Inn and return him safely to Tevantia.

completionCondition.query: The accepted matter A Night in Beggarsbridge has actually been resolved: Spend an evening with the visiting baron at the Waterline Inn and return him safely to Tevantia. The player contributed; plans or unsupported claims do not count.

onCompleteEffects.instruction: The matter A Night in Beggarsbridge is resolved. The participants may return to Rosalba in Tevantia’s Gilded Hall for recognition. Do not award service or a title until the herald recognizes their contribution; do not pay a reward already received.

A Night in Beggarsbridge.questDesignBrief:
Invent a name for this visiting young baron from Carendon. His expensive sailor costume includes a silk waistcoat. He is grandiose and generous, buys drinks, asks for adventure, introduces the player as capable and takes a joke. He is brave but listens to a clear warning; do not repeat stupid provocations. Rosalba must indulge a visiting noble without a visible escort of soldiers ruining the outing. A smuggler recognizes wealth and offers an upstairs game to cheat and extort him; accomplices are already present. Avoid, expose or turn the trap, negotiate or fight. Completion does not require falling for it or keeping him ignorant. The invitation is hospitality, not a new estate grant.

Completion: Spend an evening with the visiting baron at the Waterline Inn and return him safely to Tevantia. Do not count a plan, unsupported claim, or merely accepting the matter. The player must have accepted this matter and contributed to its resolution.

Reward: 180 florins from the ducal household and an invitation to visit the baron in Carendon. The patron pays in the story; recognition never pays twice. Return to Rosalba for recognition of actual participants only. Offer choices; do not script the player’s decisions.

A Second Hunt.name: A Second Hunt
A Second Hunt.questStatement:
A huge wild boar wounded Amadis Marenne’s horse and threw him into the mud. His friends keep telling the story. Meet him at Marenne Palace, then hunt the beast together in the woods outside Tevantia. He supplies horses and hunting spears.

Reward: 120 florins from Amadis and a feast at Marenne Palace.

Return to Rosalba in the Ducal Palace’s Gilded Hall in Tevantia for recognition.
A Second Hunt.mainObjective: Hunt and kill the boar together with Amadis.

completionCondition.query: The accepted matter A Second Hunt has actually been resolved: Hunt and kill the boar together with Amadis. The player contributed; plans or unsupported claims do not count.

onCompleteEffects.instruction: The matter A Second Hunt is resolved. The participants may return to Rosalba in Tevantia’s Gilded Hall for recognition. Do not award service or a title until the herald recognizes their contribution; do not pay a reward already received.

A Second Hunt.questDesignBrief:
The horse will recover; this is a return hunt for Amadis’s honor, not an emergency. His companions drove the wild boar off after it wounded his horse. He asks Rosalba for a capable hunting companion. Track the same beast in woodland outside the city. Amadis fights actively alongside the player. A shared kill counts; neither must deliver the final blow. Riding is optional, not a specialized skill requirement.

Completion: Hunt and kill the boar together with Amadis. Do not count a plan, unsupported claim, or merely accepting the matter. The player must have accepted this matter and contributed to its resolution.

Reward: 120 florins from Amadis and a feast at Marenne Palace. The patron pays in the story; recognition never pays twice. Return to Rosalba for recognition of actual participants only. Offer choices; do not script the player’s decisions.

Opposite Sides.name: Opposite Sides
Opposite Sides.questStatement:
Elia Ravissant wants a partner to prove her brother Ezio does not carry her in their paired duels. Join her at Ravissant Palace and beat Ezio and his friend. The blades are blunted; either opponent yielding ends the match.

Reward: 100 florins from Elia and an invitation to a Ravissant celebration.

Return to Rosalba in the Ducal Palace’s Gilded Hall in Tevantia for recognition.
Opposite Sides.mainObjective: Win a paired match alongside Elia against Ezio and his friend.

completionCondition.query: The accepted matter Opposite Sides has actually been resolved: Win a paired match alongside Elia against Ezio and his friend. The player contributed; plans or unsupported claims do not count.

Opposite Sides.questDesignBrief:
Elia challenged Ezio after he bragged that he carries her, then asked Rosalba to find her a partner. Optional practice and rematches are welcome. Both twins are excellent fighters who attack decisively and protect their partners; banter never replaces fighting. Elia may mock her brother but objects if someone calls him useless.

Completion: Win a paired match alongside Elia against Ezio and his friend. Do not count a plan, unsupported claim, or merely accepting the matter. The player must have accepted this matter and contributed to its resolution.

Reward: 100 florins from Elia and an invitation to a Ravissant celebration. The patron pays in the story; recognition never pays twice. Return to Rosalba for recognition of actual participants only. Offer choices; do not script the player’s decisions.

Rosalind’s Borrowed Brilliance.name: Rosalind’s Borrowed Brilliance
Rosalind’s Borrowed Brilliance.questStatement:
A noble borrowed Rosalind’s necklace for a portrait and now claims it was a gift. Servants say they will wear it again at the Palace of Mirrors gala—the best chance to recover it. Rosalind supplies admission. Get her necklace back and return it to her.

Reward: 150 florins from Rosalind.

Return to Rosalba in the Ducal Palace’s Gilded Hall in Tevantia for recognition.
Rosalind’s Borrowed Brilliance.mainObjective: Recover the borrowed necklace and return it to Rosalind.

completionCondition.query: The accepted matter Rosalind’s Borrowed Brilliance has actually been resolved: Recover the borrowed necklace and return it to Rosalind. The player contributed; plans or unsupported claims do not count.

onCompleteEffects.instruction: The matter Rosalind’s Borrowed Brilliance is resolved. The participants may return to Rosalba in Tevantia’s Gilded Hall for recognition. Do not award service or a title until the herald recognizes their contribution; do not pay a reward already received.

Rosalind’s Borrowed Brilliance.questDesignBrief:
The borrower normally keeps the necklace locked at home but is already wearing it at the gala. Rosalind wants her property, not someone else to defend her honor in a mandatory duel. The player can confront, bargain, wager, trick, steal, or devise another workable approach. Stage the necklace and borrower clearly; do not hide the objective behind a chain of clues.

Completion: Recover the borrowed necklace and return it to Rosalind. Do not count a plan, unsupported claim, or merely accepting the matter. The player must have accepted this matter and contributed to its resolution.

Reward: 150 florins from Rosalind. The patron pays in the story; recognition never pays twice. Return to Rosalba for recognition of actual participants only. Offer choices; do not script the player’s decisions.

The Beast in the Menagerie.name: The Beast in the Menagerie
The Beast in the Menagerie.questStatement:
Maxence bought a “young griffin” that proved to be a full-grown manticore. It killed a keeper and escaped into the walled menagerie at Ravissant Palace. Go with Elia and kill it or secure it so it can hurt nobody else.

Reward: 250 florins from Maxence; compensation for the keeper’s family is separate.

Return to Rosalba in the Ducal Palace’s Gilded Hall in Tevantia for recognition.
The Beast in the Menagerie.mainObjective: Kill the escaped manticore or securely contain it so the menagerie is safe.

completionCondition.query: The accepted matter The Beast in the Menagerie has actually been resolved: Kill the escaped manticore or securely contain it so the menagerie is safe. The player contributed; plans or unsupported claims do not count.

onCompleteEffects.instruction: The matter The Beast in the Menagerie is resolved. The participants may return to Rosalba in Tevantia’s Gilded Hall for recognition. Do not award service or a title until the herald recognizes their contribution; do not pay a reward already received.

The Beast in the Menagerie.questDesignBrief:
Maxence closed the menagerie under the excuse of improvements and wants it dealt with before his reception. Elia joins, furious that he ignored warnings, and fights decisively. The beast is already loose inside the walls, shoots spines from rooftops and repeats Maxence’s boasts in a cruel talking voice. Killing it, luring it into secure capture, or another lasting containment counts. Secrecy is not a completion requirement. Maxence has promised compensation to the keeper’s family when the danger is ended; that money is not the player’s reward.

Completion: Kill the escaped manticore or securely contain it so the menagerie is safe. Do not count a plan, unsupported claim, or merely accepting the matter. The player must have accepted this matter and contributed to its resolution.

Reward: 250 florins from Maxence; compensation for the keeper’s family is separate. The patron pays in the story; recognition never pays twice. Return to Rosalba for recognition of actual participants only. Offer choices; do not script the player’s decisions.

The Boast at Supper.name: The Boast at Supper
The Boast at Supper.questStatement:
Belisande Montrose bet Julien she could spend a night in the Black Palace. The wager allows one companion. Join her, survive until dawn, and leave together. She brings food and a sword; whatever stirs after dark will have to deal with both of you.

Reward: 200 florins as your share of the wager and breakfast with Belisande.

Return to Rosalba in the Ducal Palace’s Gilded Hall in Tevantia for recognition.
The Boast at Supper.mainObjective: Spend the night with Belisande in the Black Palace until dawn, then leave together alive.

completionCondition.query: The accepted matter The Boast at Supper has actually been resolved: Spend the night with Belisande in the Black Palace until dawn, then leave together alive. The player contributed; plans or unsupported claims do not count.

onCompleteEffects.instruction: The matter The Boast at Supper is resolved. The participants may return to Rosalba in Tevantia’s Gilded Hall for recognition. Do not award service or a title until the herald recognizes their contribution; do not pay a reward already received.

The Boast at Supper.questDesignBrief:
Belisande is a capable fighter and candid company, not a helpless escort. The dead stir after dark for this overnight adventure; do not describe a permanent crowd of burning dead in the city. Allow fighting, stealth, appeasement, barricades and creative survival. Retreat remains possible and permits another attempt, but leaving early does not win the wager.

Completion: Spend the night with Belisande in the Black Palace until dawn, then leave together alive. Do not count a plan, unsupported claim, or merely accepting the matter. The player must have accepted this matter and contributed to its resolution.

Reward: 200 florins as your share of the wager and breakfast with Belisande. The patron pays in the story; recognition never pays twice. Return to Rosalba for recognition of actual participants only. Offer choices; do not script the player’s decisions.

The Champion’s Sword.name: The Champion’s Sword
The Champion’s Sword.questStatement:
A pirate captain is wearing Vianne’s stolen championship sword at the Waterline Inn in Beggarsbridge. A sailor brought word of his boasting. Vianne wants a companion to go with her and recover it; she intends to confront the man herself.

Reward: 180 florins from Vianne and a private table at the Two Swords.

Return to Rosalba in the Ducal Palace’s Gilded Hall in Tevantia for recognition.
The Champion’s Sword.mainObjective: Recover the championship sword and return it to Vianne.

completionCondition.query: The accepted matter The Champion’s Sword has actually been resolved: Recover the championship sword and return it to Vianne. The player contributed; plans or unsupported claims do not count.

onCompleteEffects.instruction: The matter The Champion’s Sword is resolved. The participants may return to Rosalba in Tevantia’s Gilded Hall for recognition. Do not award service or a title until the herald recognizes their contribution; do not pay a reward already received.

The Champion’s Sword.questDesignBrief:
Vianne once defeated this captain and left him a scar. His crew later stole her old championship sword from the Two Swords. He is already at the Waterline Inn wearing it and boasting. Vianne joins as a formidable fighter, not someone sending a stranger to defend her. Allow negotiation, a wager, deception, theft or combat; no mandatory duel.

Completion: Recover the championship sword and return it to Vianne. Do not count a plan, unsupported claim, or merely accepting the matter. The player must have accepted this matter and contributed to its resolution.

Reward: 180 florins from Vianne and a private table at the Two Swords. The patron pays in the story; recognition never pays twice. Return to Rosalba for recognition of actual participants only. Offer choices; do not script the player’s decisions.

The Duke’s Birthday.name: The Duke’s Birthday
The Duke’s Birthday.questStatement:
Rosalind has found a case of the Duke’s favorite rare wine among the prizes at Gavarra’s Tower of Fortune. Go with Ezio and secure an unopened bottle for his birthday. Another guest wants the case for a party tonight. Rosalind supplies money toward acquiring it.

Reward: 200 florins from Rosalind and a supper invitation for you and Ezio.

Return to Rosalba in the Ducal Palace’s Gilded Hall in Tevantia for recognition.
The Duke’s Birthday.mainObjective: Bring Rosalind an unopened bottle of the Duke’s favorite wine from the Tower of Fortune.

completionCondition.query: The accepted matter The Duke’s Birthday has actually been resolved: Bring Rosalind an unopened bottle of the Duke’s favorite wine from the Tower of Fortune. The player contributed; plans or unsupported claims do not count.

onCompleteEffects.instruction: The matter The Duke’s Birthday is resolved. The participants may return to Rosalba in Tevantia’s Gilded Hall for recognition. Do not award service or a title until the herald recognizes their contribution; do not pay a reward already received.

The Duke’s Birthday.questDesignBrief:
The wine was lost at the gambling tables and is a visible prize, not hidden contraband. Rosalind provides an acquisition allowance agreed before departure, separate from the reward. The rival guest wants the case for a party this evening and competes through offers, wagers or outrageous bargains. Allow buying, winning, trading, entertaining an owner, or another plan; do not require one particular game. Ezio joins in and makes the outing lively.

Completion: Bring Rosalind an unopened bottle of the Duke’s favorite wine from the Tower of Fortune. Do not count a plan, unsupported claim, or merely accepting the matter. The player must have accepted this matter and contributed to its resolution.

Reward: 200 florins from Rosalind and a supper invitation for you and Ezio. The patron pays in the story; recognition never pays twice. Return to Rosalba for recognition of actual participants only. Offer choices; do not script the player’s decisions.

The Raiders Above the City.name: The Raiders Above the City
The Raiders Above the City.questStatement:
Birdfolk raiders have occupied one of Cyprian’s windmills outside Tevantia. The workers escaped, but cannot return. Meet Rilo at the Windworks, go with him to the mill, and make it safe for the workers again.

Reward: 220 florins from Cyprian and an invitation to the reopening feast.

Return to Rosalba in the Ducal Palace’s Gilded Hall in Tevantia for recognition.
The Raiders Above the City.mainObjective: Defeat or drive away the raiders and make the occupied windmill safe for its workers to return.

completionCondition.query: The accepted matter The Raiders Above the City has actually been resolved: Defeat or drive away the raiders and make the occupied windmill safe for its workers to return. The player contributed; plans or unsupported claims do not count.

onCompleteEffects.instruction: The matter The Raiders Above the City is resolved. The participants may return to Rosalba in Tevantia’s Gilded Hall for recognition. Do not award service or a title until the herald recognizes their contribution; do not pay a reward already received.

The Raiders Above the City.questDesignBrief:
This is Cyprian’s household responsibility: the mill must work again. Rilo knows it and joins a small capable party. The raiders are already there, with a captain in the loft, a lookout and stolen cargo. Birdfolk fly naturally; they need no wind gliders. Let their flight shape an exciting fight rather than requiring the player to fly or operate machinery. Sneak, fight, bargain with their captain or devise another solution. A temporary truce leaving workers unsafe does not complete it.

Completion: Defeat or drive away the raiders and make the occupied windmill safe for its workers to return. Do not count a plan, unsupported claim, or merely accepting the matter. The player must have accepted this matter and contributed to its resolution.

Reward: 220 florins from Cyprian and an invitation to the reopening feast. The patron pays in the story; recognition never pays twice. Return to Rosalba for recognition of actual participants only. Offer choices; do not script the player’s decisions.

The Stolen Voice.name: The Stolen Voice
The Stolen Voice.questStatement:
Nerio Marenne traded his voice to a sea witch for a song no mortal had heard. Now he wants it back. Meet him at Marenne Palace and accompany him to her coastal grotto. His voice is kept in a pearl; break it beside him to restore it.

Reward: 200 florins from Nerio and a Marenne celebration.

Return to Rosalba in the Ducal Palace’s Gilded Hall in Tevantia for recognition.
The Stolen Voice.mainObjective: Recover the pearl holding Nerio’s voice and break it beside him, restoring his voice.

completionCondition.query: The accepted matter The Stolen Voice has actually been resolved: Recover the pearl holding Nerio’s voice and break it beside him, restoring his voice. The player contributed; plans or unsupported claims do not count.

onCompleteEffects.instruction: The matter The Stolen Voice is resolved. The participants may return to Rosalba in Tevantia’s Gilded Hall for recognition. Do not award service or a title until the herald recognizes their contribution; do not pay a reward already received.

The Stolen Voice.questDesignBrief:
The witch uses Nerio’s voice to draw sailors toward her coastal grotto. Place the pearl visibly in a silver cage and let the witch sing in his voice. Nerio accompanies the player, writes and gestures, and fights effectively with his sword. Bargain, trick, steal or fight; the witch attacks with surging water if threatened. The grotto is an excursion from Tevantia, not a new named map destination. Restoring the voice, not merely taking the pearl, resolves the matter.

Completion: Recover the pearl holding Nerio’s voice and break it beside him, restoring his voice. Do not count a plan, unsupported claim, or merely accepting the matter. The player must have accepted this matter and contributed to its resolution.

Reward: 200 florins from Nerio and a Marenne celebration. The patron pays in the story; recognition never pays twice. Return to Rosalba for recognition of actual participants only. Offer choices; do not script the player’s decisions.

The Unwanted Guest.name: The Unwanted Guest
The Unwanted Guest.questStatement:
Honorine Marenne always sets a place for the sea at her annual feast. This year a sea ogre has accepted. She wants a capable guest to sit beside it and help the evening end without anyone getting badly hurt. Attend the feast at Marenne Palace.

Reward: 150 florins from Honorine and a standing invitation to Marenne suppers.

Return to Rosalba in the Ducal Palace’s Gilded Hall in Tevantia for recognition.
The Unwanted Guest.mainObjective: Finish the feast with the sea ogre gone and no guest or servant seriously injured.

completionCondition.query: The accepted matter The Unwanted Guest has actually been resolved: Finish the feast with the sea ogre gone and no guest or servant seriously injured. The player contributed; plans or unsupported claims do not count.

onCompleteEffects.instruction: The matter The Unwanted Guest is resolved. The participants may return to Rosalba in Tevantia’s Gilded Hall for recognition. Do not award service or a title until the herald recognizes their contribution; do not pay a reward already received.

The Unwanted Guest.questDesignBrief:
Honorine intends to honor the custom and stays composed. The ogre genuinely wants dinner: enormous portions, respect, stories, and boasting, not a secret massacre. It is touchy and extremely strong. Amadis has promised it more food than the kitchen expects. Entertain it, impress it, challenge it, arrange food, or use another approach. A happy departure counts; driving it out if it becomes violent also counts. Keep the danger visible and give the player room to act.

Completion: Finish the feast with the sea ogre gone and no guest or servant seriously injured. Do not count a plan, unsupported claim, or merely accepting the matter. The player must have accepted this matter and contributed to its resolution.

Reward: 150 florins from Honorine and a standing invitation to Marenne suppers. The patron pays in the story; recognition never pays twice. Return to Rosalba for recognition of actual participants only. Offer choices; do not script the player’s decisions.

The Windwright’s Debt.name: The Windwright’s Debt
The Windwright’s Debt.questStatement:
Venn bought an injured windwright’s debt and has seized him in Beggarsbridge’s Underhang. He refuses repayment: he wants the craftsman and access to Tevantia’s harbor. Go with Rilo, free the worker, and bring him home. Cyprian Levantine will reward you.

Reward: 200 florins from Cyprian and an invitation to supper with the Levantines.

Return to Rosalba in the Ducal Palace’s Gilded Hall in Tevantia for recognition.
The Windwright’s Debt.mainObjective: Free the captive windwright and return him safely to Tevantia.

completionCondition.query: The accepted matter The Windwright’s Debt has actually been resolved: Free the captive windwright and return him safely to Tevantia. The player contributed; plans or unsupported claims do not count.

onCompleteEffects.instruction: The matter The Windwright’s Debt is resolved. The participants may return to Rosalba in Tevantia’s Gilded Hall for recognition. Do not award service or a title until the herald recognizes their contribution; do not pay a reward already received.

The Windwright’s Debt.questDesignBrief:
The windwright borrowed while injured. Cyprian offers repayment, but Venn refuses because the worker is leverage over harbor access. Venn already holds him under guard in the Underhang. Rilo knows the worker and joins the rescue. Allow bargaining, trickery, escape or a fight. Returning the rescued worker completes the matter: Cyprian rejects the coercive claim and protects him. Venn’s agreement is not required.

Completion: Free the captive windwright and return him safely to Tevantia. Do not count a plan, unsupported claim, or merely accepting the matter. The player must have accepted this matter and contributed to its resolution.

Reward: 200 florins from Cyprian and an invitation to supper with the Levantines. The patron pays in the story; recognition never pays twice. Return to Rosalba for recognition of actual participants only. Offer choices; do not script the player’s decisions.

Earn Your Place.name: Earn Your Place
Earn Your Place.questStatement: Complete a proper first score for the Hand, return the take or credible proof to Hadrik Rell in the Dry Cistern, and have him recognize it as valid Hand work: valid target, worthwhile stolen loot, and no unresolved heat brought home.
Earn Your Place.mainObjective: Bring home one Hadrik-recognized first score and earn a working place in the Hand

completionCondition.query: After explicitly joining Kit Ravel and Hadrik Rell's Hand, the player returns a completed theft to Hadrik Rell in the Dry Cistern and Hadrik explicitly recognizes the returned take as the player's first valid Hand theft: valid target, valid loot, and no unresolved heat. Guild knowledge, Guild cuts, Guild sanctions, or Guild recognition are not heat.

Build the Hand.name: Build the Hand
Build the Hand.questStatement: Complete two additional thefts that Hadrik Rell recognizes as valid Hand work, then have him formally acknowledge that the player has become a Trusted Hand. The jobs may use different methods and targets, but each must pass the valid-target, valid-loot, and no-unresolved-heat standard.
Build the Hand.mainObjective: Complete two additional recognized thefts and become a Trusted Hand

completionCondition.query: After the player's first recognized Hand theft, the player has completed two additional thefts that Hadrik Rell recognized as valid Hand work and Hadrik formally names the player a Trusted Hand. Each recognized theft had a valid target, valid stolen loot, and no unresolved heat brought back to the Hand.

Earn Guild Recognition.name: Earn Guild Recognition
Earn Guild Recognition.questStatement: Complete three further thefts that Hadrik Rell recognizes as valid Hand work, then have the Hand formally recognized by Hadrik or a credible Guild authority as ready for serious Guild work and a wider place in Ardan's underworld.
Earn Guild Recognition.mainObjective: Complete three additional recognized thefts and earn Guild recognition for the Hand

completionCondition.query: After becoming a Trusted Hand, the player has completed three additional thefts that Hadrik Rell recognized as valid Hand work and Hadrik or a credible Thieves' Guild authority formally recognizes the Hand as ready for serious Guild work. Each recognized theft had a valid target, valid stolen loot, and no unresolved heat brought back to the Hand.

Earn Bronze Standing.name: Earn Bronze Standing
Earn Bronze Standing.questStatement: Complete two Copper deeds through the League, then return with proof, witnesses, rescued people, trophies, or a straight account the guildmaster can recognize before the hall.
Earn Bronze Standing.mainObjective: Complete two Copper deeds and earn Bronze standing from a League guildmaster

completionCondition.query: A League authority formally grants Bronze standing to a current Copper player character whose visible personal record has reached 2/2 Copper deeds. The final single accepted deed and ceremony may occur together. Do not infer eligibility from a promotion announcement alone, a generic account, or another person’s progress. This shared milestone confers no rank and unlocks no further standing by itself.

Earn Silver Standing.name: Earn Silver Standing
Earn Silver Standing.questStatement: Complete three Bronze-level deeds through the League, then bring the account back to a guildmaster or chaptermaster and have the higher standing named before the hall.
Earn Silver Standing.mainObjective: Complete three Bronze-level deeds and earn Silver standing

completionCondition.query: A League authority formally grants Silver standing to a current Bronze player character whose visible personal record has reached 3/3 Bronze deeds. The final single accepted deed and ceremony may occur together. Do not infer eligibility from a promotion announcement alone, a generic account, or another person’s progress. This shared milestone confers no rank and unlocks no further standing by itself.

Earn Gold Standing.name: Earn Gold Standing
Earn Gold Standing.questStatement: Complete four Silver-level deeds through the League, then return with the proof and reputation needed for a senior League authority to name Gold standing.
Earn Gold Standing.mainObjective: Complete four Silver-level deeds and earn Gold standing

completionCondition.query: A League authority formally grants Gold standing to a current Silver player character whose visible personal record has reached 4/4 Silver deeds. The final single accepted deed and ceremony may occur together. Do not infer eligibility from a promotion announcement alone, a generic account, or another person’s progress. This shared milestone confers no rank and unlocks no further standing by itself.

Earn Platinum Standing.name: Earn Platinum Standing
Earn Platinum Standing.questStatement: Complete five Gold-level deeds through the League, then return with a reputation strong enough for a senior guildmaster, Council-backed champion, chaptermaster, or comparable League authority to name Platinum standing.
Earn Platinum Standing.mainObjective: Complete five Gold-level deeds and earn Platinum standing

completionCondition.query: A League authority formally grants Platinum standing to a current Gold player character whose visible personal record has reached 5/5 Gold deeds. The final single accepted deed and ceremony may occur together. Do not infer eligibility from a promotion announcement alone, a generic account, or another person’s progress. This shared milestone confers no rank and unlocks no further standing by itself.

Defeat Atravoraxis, the Dragon Queen.name: Defeat Atravoraxis, the Dragon Queen
Defeat Atravoraxis, the Dragon Queen.questStatement: Atravoraxis, the Dragon Queen, is trying to return to Larion through Fire Mountain. Defeat her Harbingers, recover fragments of the Seal of Suleyvan, and use them to overcome the guardian of Fire Mountain before stopping her return.
Defeat Atravoraxis, the Dragon Queen.mainObjective: Recover seal fragments from the Harbingers, breach Fire Mountain, and stop the Dragon Queen's return

completionCondition.query: At Fire Mountain, the party has stopped Atravoraxis's return, sealed the breach, defeated her manifestation, or otherwise prevented the Dragon Queen from entering Larion.

Defeat Draelkharion, Prince of the Dead.name: Defeat Draelkharion, Prince of the Dead
Defeat Draelkharion, Prince of the Dead.questStatement: Draelkharion is the Harbinger in Silvervale. Investigate his undead operation, destroy the Pyre altar that shields his work, descend into the City of Ancestors, neutralize him in his lair, and recover his fragment of the Seal of Suleyvan.
Defeat Draelkharion, Prince of the Dead.mainObjective: Neutralize Draelkharion in the City of Ancestors and recover his seal fragment

completionCondition.query: The party has neutralized Draelkharion, Prince of the Dead, in his lair beneath the City of Ancestors and recovered his fragment of the Seal of Suleyvan.

Defeat Ophialtha, Beast of the Deeps.name: Defeat Ophialtha, Beast of the Deeps
Defeat Ophialtha, Beast of the Deeps.questStatement: Ophialtha is the Harbinger in the Seadeep Kingdoms. Cross to the Drowned City of Orichala, get past the drowned who garrison its standing city, enter the Dome of All Worlds, neutralize her at the Queen's Lake, and recover her fragment of the Seal of Suleyvan.
Defeat Ophialtha, Beast of the Deeps.mainObjective: Neutralize Ophialtha at the Queen's Lake in drowned Orichala and recover her seal fragment

completionCondition.query: The party has neutralized Ophialtha, Beast of the Deeps, at the Queen's Lake in the Dome of All Worlds and recovered her fragment of the Seal of Suleyvan.

Defeat Nuur-Suthra, the Flame Undying.name: Defeat Nuur-Suthra, the Flame Undying
Defeat Nuur-Suthra, the Flame Undying.questStatement: Nuur-Suthra is the Harbinger worshipped along the Alar Coast and laired in the Celestial Citadel of Alar. Get past the Church's watch at the Sungate and the old defenses and fire-creatures in the citadel's halls, descend to the Engine Vault, free the djinn sealed in the Soul Engine or break the engine's seal so the dragon's next death is real, neutralize it, and recover its fragment of the Seal of Suleyvan.
Defeat Nuur-Suthra, the Flame Undying.mainObjective: Neutralize Nuur-Suthra at the Celestial Citadel of Alar and recover its seal fragment

completionCondition.query: The party has neutralized Nuur-Suthra, the Flame Undying, in its lair at the Celestial Citadel of Alar and recovered its fragment of the Seal of Suleyvan.

Defeat Astarieth the Risen.name: Defeat Astarieth the Risen
Defeat Astarieth the Risen.questStatement: Astarieth is the Harbinger ruling the closed Reedmoot Fens. Cross the closed fens to Astarieth's Court, get past the dragon-champions who ward its deep districts, wake her in the Gilded Cathedral, neutralize her, and recover her fragment of the Seal of Suleyvan.
Defeat Astarieth the Risen.mainObjective: Neutralize Astarieth in Astarieth's Court and recover her seal fragment

completionCondition.query: The party has neutralized Astarieth the Risen in Astarieth's Court and recovered her fragment of the Seal of Suleyvan.

Destroy the Pyre Altar.name: Destroy the Pyre Altar
Destroy the Pyre Altar.questStatement: The Church of the Pyre is feeding a false-fire ward from a hidden altar beneath Muckside. The ward is masking Draelkharion's work in the City of Ancestors and making League attempts to enter the necropolis fail. Find the altar, break the cult cell protecting it, and destroy the working.
Destroy the Pyre Altar.mainObjective: Find and destroy the Pyre altar beneath Muckside

completionCondition.query: The party has found and destroyed, purified, shattered, extinguished, or otherwise permanently neutralized the Pyre altar hidden beneath Muckside.

First Blood.name: First Blood
First Blood.questStatement: A woman has been killed on the Workshop Terraces in Fallsmeet, the village has seized the wrong suspect, and Tarain Rethford believes a newly risen vampire is loose nearby. Investigate the killing, find the true culprit, and end the threat before it feeds again.
First Blood.mainObjective: Find and destroy the vampire threatening Fallsmeet

completionCondition.query: The vampire threatening Fallsmeet has been destroyed.

Complete Your Initiate Trial.name: Complete Your Initiate Trial
Complete Your Initiate Trial.questStatement: Prove yourself as an Initiate of the Black Tower by decisively resolving one assigned Shadow Inquisition case under a mentor's supervision. Success qualifies you to return to the Pit of Shadow for the Rite of Bonding; it does not yet make you a full Inquisitor.
Complete Your Initiate Trial.mainObjective: Complete one supervised Initiate case and earn authorization for the Rite of Bonding

completionCondition.query: The player has decisively resolved the Shadow Inquisition case assigned as their qualifying Initiate field trial, and the case's supervising mentor can attest that the trial is complete.

Take the Shade.name: Take the Shade
Take the Shade.questStatement: Return to the Black Tower, descend to the Pit of Shadow with the order's sanction, undergo the Rite of Bonding, and rise as a Shade-Bonded Inquisitor.
Take the Shade.mainObjective: Undergo the Rite of Bonding at the Pit of Shadow

completionCondition.query: At the authorized Rite of Bonding in the Pit of Shadow, the player has become Shade-Bonded and been formally recognized as an Inquisitor.

Hunt the Seven Named Dead.name: Hunt the Seven Named Dead
Hunt the Seven Named Dead.questStatement: Seven mighty dead of the Fourth Empire — Vortigar the Unburied, Sethelle of the Nine Sorrows, Karneth Draghmar, the Lady Mavrocine, Ossarine the Pale Crown, Belugar Thoth-Amon, and Druathyr the Thrice-Drowned — have returned from the Shadelands. Hunt each to its root, end it by the means its nature demands, and lay to rest the dead that rise in their wake.
Hunt the Seven Named Dead.mainObjective: Permanently resolve all seven of the Named Dead

completionCondition.query: All seven of the Named Dead — Vortigar the Unburied, Sethelle of the Nine Sorrows, Karneth Draghmar, the Lady Mavrocine, Ossarine the Pale Crown, Belugar Thoth-Amon, and Druathyr the Thrice-Drowned — have been permanently resolved so they can no longer threaten the living.

Earn Your Silver.name: Earn Your Silver
Earn Your Silver.questSource: The Order of the Silver Sword
Earn Your Silver.questStatement: Complete one trial hunt under a Veteran Silverblade's eye and prove that you are ready to seek admission as a Silverblade.

completionCondition.query: A party member completes or decisively resolves the monster hunt serving as their supervised trial for admission as a Silverblade.

Claim Your Silver.name: Claim Your Silver
Claim Your Silver.questSource: The Order of the Silver Sword
Claim Your Silver.questStatement: Return to Castle Harstone, tell the trial hunt before the Great Hall, and swear the Order's oath at Taking the Silver.
Claim Your Silver.mainObjective: Be sworn as a Silverblade at Taking the Silver

completionCondition.query: A party member swears the Order's oath and is sworn as a Silverblade at Taking the Silver in the Great Hall.

Prove Your Blade.name: Prove Your Blade
Prove Your Blade.questSource: The Order of the Silver Sword
Prove Your Blade.questStatement: Work contracts as a sworn Silverblade — the monsters that outmatch the people meant to stop them — and be named a Veteran Silverblade at Tempering the Silver.
Prove Your Blade.mainObjective: Complete four recognized Silverblade hunts and be named Veteran Silverblade

completionCondition.query: The Grandmaster names a party member Veteran Silverblade at Tempering the Silver in the Great Hall.

Master of the Hunt.name: Master of the Hunt
Master of the Hunt.questSource: The Order of the Silver Sword
Master of the Hunt.questStatement: Take the hunts that have killed the hunters sent before you, and earn a seat at the high table of the Order of the Silver Sword at Mastering the Silver.
Master of the Hunt.mainObjective: Complete five recognized Veteran hunts and be named a Master of the Hunt

completionCondition.query: The Grandmaster names a party member Master of the Hunt at Mastering the Silver in the Great Hall.

Prove Yourself to the Pack.name: Prove Yourself to the Pack
Prove Yourself to the Pack.questStatement: Choose and decisively complete one witnessed proving deed for Wolfpack Lodge.

completionCondition.query: The Trial-Hunter has decisively completed the specific proving deed chosen at Wolfpack Lodge, and the witnessing Packmate can attest to it.

Take Your Place in the Pack.name: Take Your Place in the Pack
Take Your Place in the Pack.questStatement: Return to the Great Lodge with the witness or proof of your proving deed and earn recognition as a Packmate.
Take Your Place in the Pack.mainObjective: Return to the Great Lodge and become a Packmate

completionCondition.query: Wolfpack Lodge has formally accepted the player as a Packmate and awarded the pack clasp.

Become a Proven Hunter.name: Become a Proven Hunter
Become a Proven Hunter.questStatement: Complete three recognized pack deeds as a Packmate and earn the name Proven Hunter in the Great Lodge.
Become a Proven Hunter.mainObjective: Complete three recognized pack deeds and become a Proven Hunter

completionCondition.query: The Wolfpack has formally recognized three Packmate deeds and named the player a Proven Hunter.

Seek the Beast Bond.name: Seek the Beast Bond
Seek the Beast Bond.questStatement: If you choose, go to the Spirit Hearth as a Proven Hunter and seek a willing, mutual bond with a beast-spirit whose nature accords with your own.
Seek the Beast Bond.mainObjective: Choose whether to seek the Beast Bond at the Spirit Hearth

completionCondition.query: At the Spirit Hearth, the player and one specific beast-spirit have knowingly and mutually accepted a lasting Beast Bond.

Rise as Pack-Captain.name: Rise as Pack-Captain
Rise as Pack-Captain.questStatement: Complete four serious recognized deeds as a Beast-Bonded hunter and earn the trust to lead lodge contracts and willing packmates as a Pack-Captain.
Rise as Pack-Captain.mainObjective: Complete four serious recognized deeds and become a Pack-Captain

completionCondition.query: The Wolfpack has formally acclaimed the player as a Pack-Captain and entrusted them to lead lodge contracts and willing packmates.

Walk Galard's Proving Year.name: Walk Galard's Proving Year
Walk Galard's Proving Year.questStatement: Travel Larion, undertake dangers worthy of Galard's virtue, and have three distinct deeds of courage recognized at the Hall of Shields in Drusavia, the Feast-Hall above Aldwall, or the Shrine of Galard in Rovena. The deeds may involve protection, rescue, confrontation, endurance, or another substantial act freely undertaken for a worthy purpose. You belong to neither estranged order while the Proving Year continues.
Walk Galard's Proving Year.mainObjective: Earn recognition for three deeds of valor

completionCondition.query: Galard's faithful have formally recognized the player's third distinct deed of valor during the Proving Year.

Choose Your Oath.name: Choose Your Oath
Choose Your Oath.questStatement: Your three deeds have completed the demanded proof. If you choose, go to the Temple of Galard in Drusavia to seek the Shieldbearer oath of the Templars Adamant, or to the Temple of the Sword Vigilant above Aldwall to seek the Swordbearer oath of the Knights Vigilant. You may visit both, postpone the choice, or swear to neither.
Choose Your Oath.mainObjective: Choose whether and where to swear an oath to Galard

completionCondition.query: After completing the Proving Year, the player freely swears either the Shieldbearer oath of the Templars Adamant or the Swordbearer oath of the Knights Vigilant.

Stand the First Shield-Work.name: Stand the First Shield-Work
Stand the First Shield-Work.questStatement: As a Templar Initiate, complete one supervised work from the Hall of Shields: protect a sealing rite, defend people or sacred ground, recover a pursued relic, destroy an undead anchor, or help purge one contained breach. Return so the work can be recognized and you can be received as a Templar Adamant.
Stand the First Shield-Work.mainObjective: Complete one supervised shield-work and become a Templar Adamant

completionCondition.query: The Templars Adamant have formally recognized the player's completed first shield-work and received them as a Templar Adamant.

Take the Captain's Ward.name: Take the Captain's Ward
Take the Captain's Ward.questStatement: Complete three recognized independent shield-works as a Templar Adamant, then earn authority to direct warders and other Templars as a Templar Captain.
Take the Captain's Ward.mainObjective: Complete three recognized shield-works and become a Templar Captain

completionCondition.query: The Templars Adamant have formally promoted the player to Templar Captain and entrusted them to direct field wards and willing Templars.

Rise as Templar Champion.name: Rise as Templar Champion
Rise as Templar Champion.questStatement: Direct four recognized great shield-works as a Templar Captain and earn acclamation as a Templar Champion trusted with the order's largest purges, defenses, and sealing campaigns.
Rise as Templar Champion.mainObjective: Complete four recognized great works and become a Templar Champion

completionCondition.query: The Templars Adamant have formally acclaimed the player as a Templar Champion.

Win Your First Ride.name: Win Your First Ride
Win Your First Ride.questStatement: Take one supervised hunt from the Feast-Hall board, decisively put down or settle its named restless dead, then return so the ride can be recognized and you can be named Moor-Knight.
Win Your First Ride.mainObjective: Complete your first Vigilant ride and become a Moor-Knight

completionCondition.query: The Knights Vigilant have publicly recognized the player's completed first ride and named them a Moor-Knight.

Win Your First Ride.questLocation: The Temple of the Sword Vigilant

Earn Your Banner.name: Earn Your Banner
Earn Your Banner.questStatement: Complete three recognized independent rides as a Moor-Knight, return to the Feast-Hall, and earn a personal banner and authority to lead as a Banner-Knight.
Earn Your Banner.mainObjective: Complete three recognized rides and become a Banner-Knight

completionCondition.query: The Knights Vigilant have formally raised the player to Banner-Knight and recognized their personal banner.

Earn Your Banner.questLocation: The Temple of the Sword Vigilant

Rise as Champion Vigilant.name: Rise as Champion Vigilant
Rise as Champion Vigilant.questStatement: Lead four recognized great rides as a Banner-Knight and earn acclamation as a Champion Vigilant trusted to command the order against its gravest undead threats.
Rise as Champion Vigilant.mainObjective: Complete four recognized great rides and become Champion Vigilant

completionCondition.query: The assembled Knights Vigilant have formally acclaimed the player as Champion Vigilant.

Rise as Champion Vigilant.questLocation: The Temple of the Sword Vigilant

Pest Control.name: Pest Control
Pest Control.questStatement: Summoned imps overran the Pennant Market in Tarnport, and their self-proclaimed Imp Lord vanished into the town with a sack of stolen charms and Temyn Raskwood's Tarnholme star. Catch the imps left behind, track down the Imp Lord, find out who loosed or lost the imps, and stop whatever he means to do with the charms.
Pest Control.mainObjective: Find the Imp Lord in Tarnport and end his kingdom

completionCondition.query: The party has found the Imp Lord in Tarnport and stopped him and his imps, by banishing, capturing, out-bargaining or sending them home; recovered or dealt with the stolen charms; and learned who loosed or lost the imps.

Pass the First Year.name: Pass the First Year
Pass the First Year.questStatement: Take three Practica from the board in the Great Hall and finish them, then complete the year-end mission Bridie Cahill gives you. Colors Night, at the end of the First Year, is when the Colleges claim the First-Years.
Pass the First Year.mainObjective: Finish three Practica and the year-end mission, and be claimed at Colors Night

completionCondition.query: A College claims a party member at Colors Night on the Muster Court, and they become a Second-Year.

Pass the Second Year.name: Pass the Second Year
Pass the Second Year.questStatement: Finish three Second-Year Practica and the year-end mission your College gives you. The Dueling Tournament on the Muster Court ends the Second Year.
Pass the Second Year.mainObjective: Finish three Practica and the year-end mission, and fight in the Dueling Tournament

completionCondition.query: The masters name a party member a Third-Year at the close of the Dueling Tournament.

Pass the Third Year.name: Pass the Third Year
Pass the Third Year.questStatement: Finish three Third-Year Practica and the year-end mission your College gives you. The Midsummer Dance on the Muster Court ends the Third Year.
Pass the Third Year.mainObjective: Finish three Practica and the year-end mission, and be named a Fourth-Year at the Midsummer Dance

completionCondition.query: The masters name a party member a Fourth-Year at midnight at the Midsummer Dance.

Find Your College.name: Find Your College
Find Your College.questStatement: The four Colleges court the First-Years all year: Battle Mages, Artificers, Summoners and Healers. Visit their isles, let them test you, and tell the one you want. They claim the First-Years at Colors Night.
Find Your College.mainObjective: Tell a College you want to join it, and be claimed at Colors Night

completionCondition.query: A College claims a party member at Colors Night on the Muster Court.

Rise to Adept.name: Rise to Adept
Rise to Adept.questStatement: Serve the Black Tower as a Shade-Bonded Inquisitor: work its true hunts, master your Shade, and earn promotion to the rank of Adept.
Rise to Adept.mainObjective: Complete Inquisitor casework and rise from Inquisitor to Adept

completionCondition.query: An authorized Shadow Inquisition representative has formally promoted the player from Inquisitor rank to Adept rank.

Rise to Master.name: Rise to Master
Rise to Master.questStatement: Prove yourself among the Black Tower's finest: carry its hardest cases as an Adept and be raised to the rank of Master by the order's inner circle.
Rise to Master.mainObjective: Complete Adept casework and rise from Adept to Master

completionCondition.query: Iliora or another inner-circle Inquisition authority has formally promoted the player from Adept rank to Master rank.

The First Door.name: The First Door
The First Door.questStatement: Odisia Santhari entered the crew's Old Town hideout with a lead-cased soulstone and a pitch. The Thieves' Guild and the Syndicate are quietly stealing soulstones, safehouse goods, and Basement routes from each other because neither side can complain to the Guard. Tersavi, a low Syndicate broker in Muckside, wants deniable talent that can make the Guild look weak without starting open war. Meet him at The Still Standing, sell the crew as useful, and get hired for the first job against the Guild.
The First Door.mainObjective: Meet Tersavi at The Still Standing and get hired for work against the Thieves' Guild

completionCondition.query: The party has met Tersavi at The Still Standing and secured a first Syndicate job, proof assignment, introduction route, or other concrete way to begin working against the Thieves' Guild.

Raise the Standard.name: Raise the Standard
Raise the Standard.questStatement: Restore the House as an active League adventuring house. Take serious field work under its banner, complete three recognized House deeds, return after each one so the resident Gold-ranked veteran can hear the account, and raise the League standard again.
Raise the Standard.mainObjective: Complete three recognized House deeds and raise the League standard

completionCondition.query: After three recognized House deeds, the resident Gold-ranked veteran and the gathered House have formally restored the House as an active League adventuring house and raised its League standard.

Make the House Renowned.name: Make the House Renowned
Make the House Renowned.questStatement: Lead the restored House through three further recognized field deeds. Let its work reach across the region until serious clients seek it out, capable adventurers want a place in its company, and its name carries weight beyond its home city.
Make the House Renowned.mainObjective: Complete three further recognized House deeds and earn regional renown

completionCondition.query: After three further recognized House deeds, the adventuring House has been publicly acknowledged as renowned across its home region.

Establish the House's Legacy.name: Establish the House's Legacy
Establish the House's Legacy.questStatement: Choose and complete a defining regional commission worthy of the renowned House. The work should express what its company stands for, change something that matters in its region, and establish the story people will remember about it.
Establish the House's Legacy.mainObjective: Complete a defining regional commission and establish the House's legacy

completionCondition.query: The renowned adventuring House has completed a defining regional commission whose visible consequences establish its lasting legacy.

Found an Adventuring House.name: Found an Adventuring House
Found an Adventuring House.questStatement: Turn the tavern into the seat of your own free adventuring company. Establish a chosen, tavern-derived, or provisional company name and make clear that the house will accept field work under it.
Found an Adventuring House.mainObjective: Establish the adventuring company at the home tavern

completionCondition.query: The player has explicitly established their adventuring company at the home tavern under a chosen, tavern-derived, or provisional name.

Make the Name Mean Something.name: Make the Name Mean Something
Make the Name Mean Something.questStatement: Accept and complete the company's first field contract, then return home so clients, companions, and regulars begin using the company's name as something earned.
Make the Name Mean Something.mainObjective: Complete the company's first accepted field job

completionCondition.query: The company has completed its first accepted field job and returned to its home tavern to receive payment, gratitude, or recognition.

Build the Adventuring House.name: Build the Adventuring House
Build the Adventuring House.questStatement: Build the locally known company into an established adventuring house: complete further field deeds and choose at least one substantial headquarters facility that changes what the company can do.
Build the Adventuring House.mainObjective: Complete three company deeds and improve the headquarters

completionCondition.query: The company has completed at least three deeds and established a substantial adventuring facility at its home tavern.

Establish the Company.name: Establish the Company
Establish the Company.questStatement: Develop the established company through serious contracts, a chosen relationship to patrons or institutions, useful specialists, and a reputation reaching beyond the immediate neighborhood.
Establish the Company.mainObjective: Build an established company toward regional renown

completionCondition.query: The company has completed six recognized field deeds and become known beyond its home community as an established adventuring house.

Build a Renowned Company.name: Build a Renowned Company
Build a Renowned Company.questStatement: Lead the renowned adventuring house into defining regional work, choose the contracts that shape its legacy, and continue developing its crew, headquarters, relationships, and field capabilities.
Build a Renowned Company.mainObjective: Choose and complete defining work as a renowned adventuring company

completionCondition.query: The adventuring company has completed a defining major commission that establishes its lasting regional legacy.

Settle the Old Obligation.name: Settle the Old Obligation
Settle the Old Obligation.questStatement: The old owner left an obligation behind, and its holder expects the new adventuring house to answer it. Resolve the matter through the dangerous recovery, investigation, escort, confrontation, or negotiated field service at its root—not through routine tavern income.
Settle the Old Obligation.mainObjective: Resolve the tavern's inherited obligation through adventure or confrontation

completionCondition.query: The tavern's inherited debt has been fully paid, cleared, forgiven, or otherwise permanently settled, and the tavern is no longer under it.

The Rival Adventuring House.name: The Rival Adventuring House
The Rival Adventuring House.questStatement: A rival adventuring house competes for clients, recruits, patrons, and the stories people believe. Outperform, outmaneuver, reconcile with, or decisively answer the rival through deeds and social choices until the contest is settled.
The Rival Adventuring House.mainObjective: Settle the rivalry between the two adventuring houses

completionCondition.query: The rival establishment's owner has conceded, relented, been won over, or been decisively beaten at their own game, and the contest between the two houses is settled.

Win the House.name: Win the House
Win the House.questStatement: The keeper who holds the home base together is still deciding whether the new captain deserves their loyalty. Earn it through leadership, promises kept, people brought home, support for the company and its members, and the kind of adventuring house you build together.

completionCondition.query: The tavern's keeper has fully and openly committed their loyalty to the new owner.

Make Your Arena Debut.name: Make Your Arena Debut
Make Your Arena Debut.questStatement: Complete your first sanctioned arena bout. A victory earns recognition, but an exceptional performance may establish your name even in defeat.
Make Your Arena Debut.mainObjective: Complete a successful or memorable arena debut

completionCondition.query: After a sanctioned debut bout, an arena official or promoter publicly recognizes the player as a Prizefighter because they won or gave an exceptional, crowd-stirring performance.

Become a Proven Contender.name: Become a Proven Contender
Become a Proven Contender.questStatement: Earn three further recognized arena performances as a Prizefighter. Victories count, and an exceptional defeat may count when officials and the crowd clearly recognize the showing.
Become a Proven Contender.mainObjective: Earn three recognized performances and become a Contender

completionCondition.query: An arena official or promoter recognizes that the player has earned three further notable performances and is now a Proven Contender.

Win an Arena Championship.name: Win an Arena Championship
Win an Arena Championship.questStatement: Earn four recognized Contender performances, then win a formally declared championship match at one eligible circuit arena.
Win an Arena Championship.mainObjective: Qualify for and win a circuit arena championship

completionCondition.query: The player decisively wins a formally declared championship match at an eligible Grand Arena Circuit venue and is publicly named that venue’s Champion.

Win Three Arena Championships.name: Win Three Arena Championships
Win Three Arena Championships.questStatement: Tour Larion’s arenas and win formally declared championships at three distinct eligible circuit venues.
Win Three Arena Championships.mainObjective: Win championships at three distinct circuit arenas

completionCondition.query: The player has won recognized championships at three distinct eligible Grand Arena Circuit venues and is declared eligible for the Grand Champion’s Contest.

Win the Grand Champion's Contest.name: Win the Grand Champion's Contest
Win the Grand Champion's Contest.questStatement: Go to the Champions' Ring at the Field of Valor, accept the Grand Champion's Contest, and win the circuit's highest title.

completionCondition.query: The player wins the Grand Champion’s Contest in the Champions’ Ring at the Field of Valor and is publicly acclaimed Grand Champion of the Arenas.

The Champion's Commission.name: The Champion's Commission
The Champion's Commission.questStatement: At Platinum standing, undertake one exceptional League commission whose stakes rise beyond ordinary deed work, complete its decisive objective, and return to League authority for the account that can lead to Champion recognition.
The Champion's Commission.mainObjective: Complete one exceptional commission and qualify for League Champion recognition

completionCondition.query: League authority accepts the completed decisive objective of the specific exceptional Champion commission previously assigned to and accepted by named Platinum characters. They must have undertaken that outstanding assignment before completing it. Acceptance, a retroactive assignment, an unrelated prior victory, and routine deeds do not count. This shared quest milestone alone does not qualify anyone for a hearing or grant Champion standing.

What Sethira Knows.name: What Sethira Knows
What Sethira Knows.questStatement: Meet Sethira Drelovar at The Stonetome and hear what she knows about House Drelovar's plans, wavering supporters, and possible ways into the house's growing network.
What Sethira Knows.mainObjective: Meet Sethira Drelovar at The Stonetome and hear what she knows

Convince Othrel Namaris.name: Convince Othrel Namaris
Convince Othrel Namaris.questStatement: Uncover enough concrete evidence and leverage to convince Othrel Namaris, the reclusive leader of House Namaris, that House Drelovar's corruption threatens Maanvalta's survival, then give him a credible path to act.
Convince Othrel Namaris.mainObjective: Convince Othrel Namaris that House Drelovar threatens Maanvalta

Meet with Baska.name: Meet with Baska
Meet with Baska.questStatement: Find Baska at the Imperial Shrine to Avarice and learn what she wants the League to know about the danger below Silvervale.
Meet with Baska.mainObjective: Meet with Baska and learn what she wants you to know

completionCondition.query: The player has witnessed the organized kobold muster at the Imperial Shrine to Avarice and broken or bypassed the rearguard blocking escape.

Report the Grell Muster.name: Report the Grell Muster
Report the Grell Muster.questStatement: Return to the League and report the organized kobold muster, the Horn of the First Host, and the war-shrieker network.
Report the Grell Muster.mainObjective: Report the situation to the League

Defeat Grindmaw and Seal the Breach.name: Defeat Grindmaw and Seal the Breach
Defeat Grindmaw and Seal the Breach.questStatement: Respond to the breach at Greenmeadow, defeat the stone-boring beetle Grindmaw, and seal the fresh passage by disabling Big Buzzer and securing the weakened tunnel throat.
Defeat Grindmaw and Seal the Breach.mainObjective: Defeat Grindmaw and seal the breach at Greenmeadow

Break the Unquiet Host.name: Break the Unquiet Host
Break the Unquiet Host.questStatement: Follow the war-shrieker's challenge into the Imperial Arsenal, break through Kragga's newly unified host, and end the kobold emperor's attempt to impose Grell sovereignty on the surface.
Break the Unquiet Host.mainObjective: Reach The Command Hall of The Imperial Arsenal and defeat Kragga the First, Emperor of All Grell

Earn Redblade Standing.name: Earn Redblade Standing
Earn Redblade Standing.questStatement: Complete three jobs for the Crimson Company and report each one to an officer at a Company hall. Work finished in the field counts for nothing until an officer hears the account and writes it down. When all three are recognized, ask an officer to name you Redblade.
Earn Redblade Standing.mainObjective: Complete three recognized Crimson Company deeds and be named Redblade

completionCondition.query: A Crimson Company officer has named the party Redblade after hearing their account of three completed deeds. Do not match merely accepting work, finishing a deed without reporting it to an officer, or an officer refusing them for want of recognized deeds.

Earn the Blood.name: Earn the Blood
Earn the Blood.questStatement: Take the houses' own work as a Redblade and have four more deeds recognized at a Company hall. That is what puts a Redblade in front of the lords. When they have seen enough of you, one of them will offer you the Blood. Whether you take it is a separate decision and it is yours.
Earn the Blood.mainObjective: Complete four recognized deeds as a Redblade and be offered the Blood by a vampire lord

completionCondition.query: A vampire lord of the Shadow Summits has personally offered a member of the party the Blood. Do not match rumour, general talk about the Embrace, an offer from anyone who is not a lord, or the party asking about it.

Master the Hunger.name: Master the Hunger
Master the Hunger.questStatement: Feed on your own terms and keep the hunger in hand. Deliberately make a ghoul of your own and keep it, which is what separates a vampire who has mastered the hunger from one who breeds strigoi by accident. Take four more recognized deeds as house work, and the Lords of the Blood will acknowledge you as Blooded.
Master the Hunger.mainObjective: Make and keep a ghoul, complete four recognized deeds, and be acknowledged as Blooded

completionCondition.query: A vampire lord of the Shadow Summits, or a house speaking for one, has acknowledged a member of the party as Blooded. Do not match the making of a ghoul on its own, ordinary praise, or the party claiming the standing themselves.

Win a Sponsor.name: Win a Sponsor
