She is terrified, her fingers are black with frost, and the high priest who leads the cult already knows she has run and wants her back at the dead spring, so she must be brought out alive with what she knows and the high priest stopped or broken. Reward: 3,500 florins from the watch and a flask of the first warm water to rise from the Hearth's own spring."}, {"id": "aur_underbreaks_kraken", "kind": "monster", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Aurora", "location": "The Underfloes", "text": "**The Deep Ice Is Thawing** (The Underbreaks, The Underfloes). A kraken locked in the deep ice since the freeze has begun to thaw beneath the Underbreaks, and its arms now reach up through the breaks to pull whole salvage camps into the dark. A fearless snowlander salvage-captain who has lost two camps to it says it grows stronger with every camp it takes, and that if it breaks free, no ship or sled on the northern ice will be safe. Reward: 4,500 florins and the pick of the salvage from every ship the kraken has dragged down."}, {"id": "aur_white_hall_mummy_lords", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Aurora", "location": "The Crevasse", "text": "**The Old Rulers Are Waking** (The White Hall, The Crevasse). The frost-preserved rulers of the white city in the Crevasse are stirring in their White Hall, and every night they are awake the cold across Aurora bites harder. An elven scholar who went down once and came back speaking a tongue no one knows has not slept since, and she insists the party must go into the Hall before the rulers wake fully, and that she must go with them. Reward: 5,000 florins and whatever the party can carry out of the White Hall."}, {"id": "aur_stillwater_frost_witch", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Aurora", "location": "Stillwater", "text": "**Stillwater Is Choosing** (The Frozen Streets, Stillwater). A frost witch who froze Stillwater in a single night walks its streets again, and each night she lights one lamp in the dead town for the town she means to take next. A solemn stead child who dreams of Stillwater's streets every night says the witch has already chosen, and that the lamps now burn in the shape of Warmwater. Reward: 6,000 florins and the standing gratitude of every warm-spring town in the north."}, {"id": "bos_stew_heat_saboteur", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Crescent Bay Isle", "text": "**Salt in the Pot** (The Anchorage, Crescent Bay Isle). Every week of the tasting season, the surfacer and merfolk cooks bring their stews to the Anchorage's long table for a practice heat, and every week someone ruins a pot first: sand in one, a fistful of salt in another. Each side blames the other. The heats' judge, a fretful half-mer fisherman who loves both kitchens equally, is sure the next spoiled pot ends the friendliest feud on the island. Reward: 40 florins and a lagoon pearl, which means the village trusts you."}, {"id": "bos_bench_card_sharp", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Coriva", "text": "**The Friendly Throw** (The Harpoon House, Coriva). A smiling harpooner works the long benches of the Harpoon House every payday, betting the green hands who sign onto hunting crews that they cannot outthrow him at the target under the jawbone, and they keep losing their whole advance before they ever see the water. Davor Vey, the former deck harpooner and arena champion who owns the Harpoon House, is sure the throws are rigged but cannot catch him at it, and he will not have a brawl bring down the bones over his tables. Reward: 50 florins from Davor and a round bought in your crew's name under the jawbone."}, {"id": "bos_big_raft_bully", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Confluence", "text": "**Overboard Again** (The Big Raft, Confluence). A huge sealion-folk bruiser has decided the best spot on the Big Raft is his, and every evening he shoves whoever is standing in it off the barge and into the channel, barking with laughter. Nobody has been hurt yet, but the halflings have stopped coming. The frogkin brewer who keeps the raft's barrels, a grumbler who complains about everything and means every word, wants the bruiser taught some manners, by fist, wit, or wager. Reward: 35 florins and the brewer's second-best barrel, which he insists is his best."}]

offer_pool_league_data_006.name: offer_pool_league_data_006
offer_pool_league_data_006.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "bos_false_pen_places", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Drakerider Isle", "text": "**No Such Place in the Pens** (Bridle Row, Drakerider Isle). Hopefuls keep landing on Drakerider Isle with a token they bought on the mainland promising them a place in this season's breaking pens, and there is no such thing: the breaker-families choose who they teach. The smooth talker who sells the tokens meets each boat on Bridle Row with a fresh story. A gruff one-eyed saddler who has turned away three weeping buyers this month wants him caught before he sells another. Reward: 45 florins and a hand-stitched riding strap from the saddler."}, {"id": "bos_hermit_crab_stalls", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Crescent Bay Isle", "text": "**A Crab Shopping for a House** (The Shore Village, Crescent Bay Isle). A giant hermit crab has outgrown its shell, and every low tide it wades up to the Shore Village stalls that stand in the shallows and tries them on for size, lifting awnings, crushing counters, and scattering wares. A flustered merfolk shell-seller whose stall it prefers above all others wants it gone, though she admits it is rather sweet and would be happy if someone simply found it a better shell. Reward: 30 florins and first pick of the shell-seller's stall."}, {"id": "bos_reef_serpent_bar", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "The Serpent Runs", "text": "**Serpents on the Practice Bar** (The Shallow Banks, The Serpent Runs). A pack of man-length reef serpents has moved onto the sandbar where the young crews practise their throws, and they swarm the little boats as soon as a lesson starts. The stern one-armed harpooner who teaches there will not send children out until the bar is clear, and says it would be a fine first lesson for a new crew to show them how it is done. Reward: 60 florins and a lesson from the teacher, who does not give compliments."}, {"id": "bos_mudflat_grindylows", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "The Tanglewater Estuary", "text": "**Long Fingers on the Flats** (The Mudflats, The Tanglewater Estuary). A small pack of grindylows has started coming out of the mangrove edge at dusk to swarm the cockle-pickers on the mudflats, dragging off baskets and anyone who stumbles. A cheerful halfling cockle-picker who refuses to stop working her beds, and who has already bitten one of them, wants company on the flats until the pack learns to leave them alone. Reward: 40 florins and a pot of cockles cooked the halfling way."}, {"id": "bos_foal_shallows_octopus", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Drakerider Isle", "text": "**Arms in the Shallows** (Warmsands Beach, Drakerider Isle). A giant octopus has moved into the rocks at the end of Warmsands Beach, and every morning it reaches out of the shallows to snatch the fish tossed to the drake foals, and lately to wrap an arm around a foal itself. The gap-toothed old foal-minder who watches the young ones, and swears at the octopus in a voice that carries the length of the strand, wants it gone before a foal is dragged under. Reward: 55 florins and a ride on a gentled drake along the strand."}, {"id": "bos_rack_night_thief", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Coriva", "text": "**One Piece a Night** (Scale Street, Coriva). Every night one finished piece of scale armor vanishes from the racks outside a Scale Street shop, taken over the rooftops without a sound, and the smiths have started accusing each other of stealing to sell cheap. A deaf dwarf scale-smith who has lost a gauntlet, a helm, and her temper wants the thief caught and the stolen pieces found before the street's craftsmen come to blows. Reward: 50 florins and a fitted scale bracer from the dwarf's forge."}, {"id": "bos_pearl_garden_thief", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Crescent Bay Isle", "text": "**Pearls Gone from the Deep Garden** (The Lagoon, Crescent Bay Isle). Someone keeps cutting into the merfolk pearl-gardens in the lagoon's deep middle at night, and pearls are missing. On this island a pearl means trust, and whispers have started about surfacers who dive too well. A grave old merfolk pearl-gardener, who has tended those beds since before the whisperers were born, wants the truth found before it poisons the village. Reward: 70 florins and a pearl given in thanks, which everyone here will notice."}, {"id": "bos_surf_race_cheat", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Drakerider Isle", "text": "**The Man Who Always Wins** (The Home Beach Inn, Drakerider Isle). A loud visitor with a borrowed drake keeps challenging the isle's young riders to surf races for coin, and he always wins, by fouling lines and startling their mounts. Naia Vescari, a tide rider from a breaker family who teaches racing out of the Home Beach Inn, wants him beaten on the water or caught at it and the young riders' coin returned, and she would love a crew with the nerve to race him. Reward: 45 florins and a racing lesson from Naia."}, {"id": "bos_lashings_wisp", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Confluence", "text": "**The Light Between the Hulls** (The Lashings, Confluence). A pale light has been drifting through the channels of the Lashings after midnight, and people who follow it end up in the water between hulls, where one has already nearly drowned. Nobody agrees what it is. An insomniac halfling net-mender who sits up every night on her deck and has watched it pass a dozen times wants it dealt with, and has a very long list of theories. Reward: 35 florins and a mended net that will last a lifetime."}, {"id": "bos_drugged_arena_beasts", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Coriva", "text": "**The Sleepy Serpent** (The Water Arena, Coriva). Twice a week a captured beast in the Water Arena fights like it is half asleep, and one betting stall always has the long odds covered. The scarred old gate-crew chief who keeps the pens swears his creatures are being drugged before bouts, and a fighter nearly drowned when a dosed beast woke up mid-bout. He wants the bookmaker behind it caught before someone dies in the pool. Reward: 150 florins and ringside seats for a season."}, {"id": "bos_prodigy_recruiter_war", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Coriva", "text": "**Everyone Wants Her** (Serpentsbane Square, Coriva). Agents of Coriva's two ruling hunting houses, one that kills the bay's monsters and one that captures and breaks them, both want the same young fighter who won three bouts in her first week, and their recruiters now brawl in the square wherever she goes. She is irritable, proud, and sick of being fought over like a prize fish. She wants the brawling stopped so she can choose for herself, or choose neither. Reward: 120 florins from the prodigy's arena winnings and a favor from whichever house she picks."}, {"id": "bos_muster_yard_hazing", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Coriva", "text": "**Washed Out in the Muster-Yard** (Tessaro Hall, Coriva). A knot of veteran harpooners in the Tessaro Hall muster-yard has been making the candidates' trials unbearable, cutting lines, fouling targets, and beating anyone who complains, until the promising ones quit. A stubborn fisher-girl who refuses to wash out has a black eye and no intention of leaving. She wants proof, a champion, or both, and the recruiting officer will listen to proof. Reward: 130 florins and a word in the recruiting officer's ear."}]

offer_pool_league_data_007.name: offer_pool_league_data_007
offer_pool_league_data_007.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "bos_lashing_cutters", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Confluence", "text": "**Cut Loose at Night** (The Lashings, Confluence). A gang of divers has been cutting the lashings between boats at night, letting a hull drift clear of its cluster, and stripping it before the owners wake up far out on open water. In a city that owns nothing but its boats, that is everything. The oldest sea-turtle-folk elder moored at the rim knows more than he has said, and he says it very, very slowly. Reward: 110 florins pooled by the cluster and a meal at every deck that chipped in."}, {"id": "bos_breaker_foal_claim", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Drakerider Isle", "text": "**Whose Foal Is It** (The Tide-Pens, Drakerider Isle). A wild-born sea-drake foal of rare color came into the tide-pens this season, and the heads of two breaker-families both claim its line. Every morning the argument over whose pen it goes into ends in shoving on the breaking-yard, and last week in knives. The shy teenager who found the foal in the shallows, and who the foal follows everywhere, wants the feud ended before anyone decides the foal is the problem. Reward: 140 florins and the goodwill of the breaker-families."}, {"id": "bos_channel_snapdragon", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "The Tanglewater Estuary", "text": "**The Log That Spits** (The Channels, The Tanglewater Estuary). A big snapdragon has taken to lying like a drifting log in the widest skiff channel into the tangle, spitting acid into boats and lunging at whoever is left standing. Two crews have lost polers this month. A boastful alchemist who buys glands from the hunting crews wants it killed with its acid gland whole, and brags he will pay double if they are. Reward: 160 florins, doubled for intact glands, and the drake-hide."}, {"id": "bos_lagoon_moray", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Crescent Bay Isle", "text": "**Something in the Coral Garden** (The Lagoon, Crescent Bay Isle). A great moray, thick as a man, has somehow slipped through the reef-mouth and denned in the coral gardens where children of both peoples learn to dive. The lagoon has been safe for generations and the village is frightened. A merfolk swim-teacher who took a bite to her fin pulling a child clear wants it out of her lagoon, and would sooner see it put back to sea than killed. Reward: 120 florins and a lagoon pearl from the teacher's family."}, {"id": "bos_small_boat_silverback", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "The Serpent Runs", "text": "**It Only Takes Small Boats** (The Boiling Bay, The Serpent Runs). A silverback serpent in the Boiling Bay has learned that small boats break easier, and it passes the big hunting ships by to breach and crash down on the two-man skiffs. It has sunk four. A grizzled halfling bow-harpooner, too small for a big ship's crew and too proud to quit, wants to kill it from a skiff of her own, and needs a crew mad enough to row. Reward: 180 florins and a share of the silverback's scale and crest."}, {"id": "bos_skerry_larder_rescue", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "The Sea-Troll Skerries", "text": "**Still Alive in the Larder** (The Larder Caves, The Sea-Troll Skerries). The currents keep throwing boats onto the Sea-Troll Skerries, and the trolls keep dragging crews into their larder caves alive to eat later. A frantic sealion-folk skipper whose fishing boat broke there three nights ago swam out, and her crew did not. She is certain they are still alive in the caves and will go back alone if she must. Fire advised. Reward: 200 florins and whatever wreck cargo the trolls were hoarding."}, {"id": "bos_yard_dragon_turtle", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Coriva", "text": "**Loose in the Harbor** (The Cavarin Yards, Coriva). A young dragon turtle broke out of its flooded paddock in the Cavarin Yards and has been living under the harbor piers ever since, biting holes in hulls and breathing scalding steam at dockhands. Remo Belluc, a rising beast-wright at the Yards who works with a young stonescale eel, wants it back in its pen alive and unharmed, and he will teach anyone who helps how to hold a line on it. Reward: 170 florins from Remo, less if it comes back hurt, and a handling lesson."}, {"id": "bos_wreck_field_ghouls", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Shipfall Isle", "text": "**The Wreck-Field After Dark** (The Wreck-Field, Shipfall Isle). Salvagers working the Shipfall wreck-field in fair weather keep losing hands at dusk, and the ones who get away swear the sailors of the old wrecks climb out of the holds, grey and hungry. A one-eyed salvage diver with a lucky knife, who has worked the field for twenty years and refuses to leave a good hold unstripped, wants whatever is down there put back down. Reward: 150 florins and first cut of the salvage from the hold the diver has been saving."}, {"id": "bos_fake_repellent", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Coriva", "text": "**The Repellent That Doesn't** (Serpentsbane Square, Coriva). A peddler under an awning in Serpentsbane Square sells cheap serpent-repellent oil to hunting crews, and two crews who trusted it this month did not come home. The renderer's widow whose husband made the real oil, and who sells it at a price the peddler undercuts, knows his is lamp oil and scent. She wants him stopped and his supplier found, and she has a temper to match her grief. Reward: 130 florins and a flask of the real repellent."}, {"id": "bos_jawbone_poltergeist", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Coriva", "text": "**The Rattling Bones** (The Harpoon House, Coriva). Every night at closing time, the bones of famous kills hung from the Harpoon House's beams begin to rattle, tankards fly, and last week a harpoon came off the wall on its own. Hunters are a superstitious lot and some crews have stopped drinking there. The sealion-folk potboy who sweeps up afterward, more superstitious than any of them, is sure it is the ghost of the harpooner who made one of those kills, and has a theory about which bone. Reward: 120 florins and free drinks at the Harpoon House for a month."}, {"id": "bos_reef_mouth_siren", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Crescent Bay Isle", "text": "**The Song at the Reef-Mouth** (The Shore Village, Crescent Bay Isle). For a month a voice has been singing from the reef-mouth at dusk, sweeter than the merfolk evening songs, and villagers walk into the water toward it with glazed eyes. So far all have been pulled back. A worried surfacer father whose half-mer daughter is the most taken by it, and who swims badly, wants the singer silenced or sent away, and does not much care which. Reward: 140 florins and the village's thanks, spoken in both tongues."}, {"id": "bos_line_cutting_crew", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "The Serpent Runs", "text": "**Somebody Else's Serpent** (The Deep Current, The Serpent Runs). A flashy hunting crew has been shadowing smaller boats out on the Deep Current, cutting their lines once a serpent is struck and tired, then landing the kill as their own at the quays to cheers. An earnest young orc harpooner who lost her first kill this way, and who the crowd laughed at when she said so, wants the truth known and her crew's name back. Reward: 160 florins and a place at the next great hunt."}]

offer_pool_league_data_008.name: offer_pool_league_data_008
offer_pool_league_data_008.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "bos_yard_beast_poisoner", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Coriva", "text": "**Poison in the Paddocks** (The Cavarin Yards, Coriva). Someone is poisoning the broken beasts in the Cavarin Yards, one prize tow-serpent every few nights, and the house that trains them blames the rival house that hunts. Words in the square are turning to steel. A haughty old beast-wright matriarch who lost her finest animal wants the poisoner found quietly, because the truth, whatever it is, may embarrass her own house. Reward: 400 florins and a trained hunting-beast's service for a season."}, {"id": "bos_stern_castle_ransom", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "The Bronze Wreck", "text": "**The Ransom in the Stern Castle** (The Stern Castle, The Bronze Wreck). The sharkfolk raiders who squat on the Bronze Wreck took a merchant ship and are holding its young captain in the barred cabins of the stern castle, sending demands that grow each week. The proud widowed ship-owner who is his mother will not pay, on principle, and will not sleep until he is home. She wants him back alive, by bargain, trickery, or blade. Reward: 450 florins from the ship-owner and a berth on any of her ships."}, {"id": "bos_catch_press_gang", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Confluence", "text": "**Nobody's Crew** (The Catch, Confluence). Drinkers at The Catch have been waking up chained in the hold of a ship far out at sea, drugged over supper, and pressed to work her oars. Confluence owns no masters and has no one to send. A loud, grieving sealion-folk mother whose son vanished this way barks the story at every deck she passes, and wants the captain buying these drugged crews stopped and her son and the other taken crews home. Reward: 350 florins gathered from every cluster and a boat of your own if you want one."}, {"id": "bos_champion_blackmail", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Coriva", "text": "**The Champion's Bad Nights** (The Water Arena, Coriva). The Water Arena's reigning champion, vain, aging, and still beloved, has started losing bouts she should win, and only in front of the biggest crowds. In private she admits someone holds a secret that would ruin her, and names a price for every bout she throws. She will not say what the secret is. She wants the blackmailer found and silenced without the secret getting out. Reward: 480 florins from the champion's purse and her public gratitude."}, {"id": "bos_drake_buyer_pressure", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Drakerider Isle", "text": "**Drakes Are Not for Sale** (Bridle Row, Drakerider Isle). A wealthy buyer has taken rooms on Bridle Row and wants saddled sea-drakes, which the isle does not sell. He began with bribes, moved to threats, and now his hired hands wait for the breakers after dark. A prickly teenage breaker prodigy who spat at his offer has had her tack shed burned. She wants him off the isle and says she can handle the rest herself. Reward: 300 florins from the breaker-families and a place in the next breaking season."}, {"id": "bos_black_pool_kraken", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "The Tanglewater Estuary", "text": "**Down in the Black Pools** (The Black Pools, The Tanglewater Estuary). A bog kraken has anchored itself in the roots of the largest of the Black Pools, and it has taken three skiffs and their crews from below this season. Its ink and arm-hide would pay a crew for a year. The nervous frogkin guide who knows the way in, and who lost his brother's skiff to it, will take a crew to the pool if they swear not to leave him behind. Reward: 450 florins and the ink and hide."}, {"id": "bos_scarred_bull_serpent", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "The Serpent Runs", "text": "**The Bull That Keeps the Harpoons** (The Deep Current, The Serpent Runs). A bull serpent grown huge out on the Deep Current carries a dozen broken harpoons in its hide from every crew that failed, and lately it has started hunting the hunters. An obsessed elderly hunter who lost his leg to it thirty years ago has spent his savings on a boat and wants a crew for one last try. He is shrewd, bitter, and much more dangerous than he looks. Reward: 500 florins and a hunter's name for life."}, {"id": "bos_wreck_hull_sea_hag", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Confluence", "text": "**What the Hag Was Promised** (The Lashings, Confluence). A sea hag lives under a derelict hull at the edge of the Lashings, and for years she has traded fair winds for small promises. Now she is collecting, and the children of those who bargained are sickening one by one. A boastful halfling cutter captain who struck the first bargain, and has never admitted it until now, wants her broken and the sick children well before his own daughter is taken. Reward: 380 florins and the captain's fast cutter for a season."}, {"id": "bos_outer_bank_sharks", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Shipfall Isle", "text": "**Teeth on the Outer Banks** (The Outer Banks, Shipfall Isle). A pack of dire sharks, each longer than a boat, has followed the inward currents to Shipfall's outer banks, and now takes anyone who falls in the water there, oars and all. A careful salvage captain who counts every crate, coin, and man twice, and has been short two men this month, wants the pack broken so her crews can work the banks again. Reward: 320 florins and a share of the salvage season."}, {"id": "bos_rogue_bull_drake", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Drakerider Isle", "text": "**The Bull That Will Not Be Ridden** (Warmsands Beach, Drakerider Isle). A huge wild bull sea-drake has taken over the far end of Warmsands Beach, throwing riders, rolling on anyone who comes near, and driving the herd off their basking grounds. It is not cruel, only enormous and angry. The grieving breaker patriarch whose line it belongs to, and whose son it crushed, will not hear of it being killed. He wants it gentled or taken off the isle, and there is not much time left. Reward: 360 florins from the patriarch and a drake-rider's thanks."}, {"id": "bos_stormcaller_captives", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Shipfall Isle", "text": "**Before the Next Storm** (The Hillside, Shipfall Isle). The storm sorcerers of Shipfall Isle strip every ship the currents drive onto the banks and take the survivors to their hillside caves to feed the next storm. A merchant crew went aground last week. Its cook, shaken and ashamed of running, got away over the wrecks and says the rest are still in the caves. The sky over the Stormspire is already turning. Reward: 420 florins and the cargo recovered from the cook's ship."}, {"id": "bos_cove_chained_herder", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Flensers' Cove", "text": "**Chained in the Cove** (The Caches, Flensers' Cove). An outlaw hunting crew butchers leviathan calves in a hidden cove, and when merfolk herders catch them at it the crew takes the herders for leverage or sale. A stone-faced merfolk calf-herder says her brother is chained in the barred caves behind the cove, and she knows how to reach the passage. The crew burns everything when threatened, so it will have to be done quick or quiet. Reward: 400 florins from the herders and a merfolk guide in any water in the bay."}]

offer_pool_league_data_009.name: offer_pool_league_data_009
offer_pool_league_data_009.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "bos_bow_vault_golem", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "The Bronze Wreck", "text": "**The Guardian in the Bow Vaults** (The Bow Vaults, The Bronze Wreck). Whenever the raiders leave the Bronze Wreck, salvagers slip into the bow vaults, and lately something in there has started killing them: a bronze guardian as old as the ship itself, walking the holds. A reckless gnome salvage scholar who believes it guards an intact vault wants it stopped, studied, or talked to, and insists it may understand orders if anyone can find the right ones. Reward: 450 florins and a share of whatever the guardian was protecting."}, {"id": "bos_hunter_doppelganger", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Coriva", "text": "**The Other Me** (Serpentsbane Square, Coriva). One of Coriva's most famous serpent hunters keeps hearing she was somewhere she wasn't: collecting her shares, signing crews, kissing strangers in the square. Last night her double, a glamour-wearing trickster, turned up at her own door. The hunter, vain, furious, and now a little afraid, wants whoever is wearing her face caught before it takes her place altogether. Reward: 380 florins and a night as the hunter's guest of honor."}, {"id": "bos_anchorage_wereshark", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Crescent Bay Isle", "text": "**Blood in the Lagoon** (The Anchorage, Crescent Bay Isle). At every full moon for three months, someone has been found torn in the lagoon, the one water in the bay where nothing hunts. The merfolk blame something from outside the reef, but the bites came from inside. The jovial dwarf who keeps the Anchorage, who knows everyone at his long table and hates to suspect any of them, thinks the killer, a wereshark by the bites, eats there, and wants it found before the next full moon. Reward: 420 florins and the Anchorage's best room whenever you visit."}, {"id": "bos_house_duel_crisis", "kind": "social", "rank": "gold", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Coriva", "text": "**A Duel of Houses** (The Water Arena, Coriva). A broken beast belonging to Coriva's monster-taming house got loose and killed a crew of the rival monster-hunting house, and now each side's greatest captain has challenged the other to a death-duel in the Water Arena, with half the city ready to take the loser's side. A stiff-necked old banner-keeper who has seen the houses nearly go to war before wants it stopped without a death and the truth of the beast's escape known, and believes the beast was set loose on purpose. Reward: 1,200 florins and the gratitude of both ruling houses."}, {"id": "bos_would_be_king", "kind": "social", "rank": "gold", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Confluence", "text": "**A King for Confluence** (The Big Raft, Confluence). A charismatic captain is lashing cluster after cluster of Confluence to his own ship with promises of protection, and those who refuse find their boats burned. His crews collect a share of every catch, the first rent the floating city has ever paid. A lazy-eyed sealion-folk storyteller at the Big Raft, who remembers what the city was for, wants him dethroned before anyone gets used to kneeling. Reward: 1,000 florins gathered from the clusters and a story told about you forever."}, {"id": "bos_serpent_baiting_captain", "kind": "social", "rank": "gold", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "The Serpent Runs", "text": "**Blood on the Water** (The Boiling Bay, The Serpent Runs). The serpents of the Boiling Bay have been spilling into the southern shipping lanes in numbers no one remembers, and the bounties on them are the highest in a generation. A blunt retired lane pilot is sure a celebrated hunting captain has been dumping chum and blood along the lanes at night to draw them in. She wants it proved and stopped before the lanes close and the coast starves. Reward: 900 florins from the lane pilots and a lifelong berth on any ship that pays them."}, {"id": "bos_stormspire_drake", "kind": "monster", "rank": "gold", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Shipfall Isle", "text": "**The Drake on the Stormspire** (The Stormspire, Shipfall Isle). A storm drake nests on the Stormspire's glassy peak and rides the island's storms out over the shipping lanes, breaking masts with lightning and taking sailors off the decks. Three ships have gone down this season. A lightning-scarred shipwright who survived its last strike has built a rig he swears can ground it, and he wants a crew to climb up and use it. Reward: 1,400 florins and a harness of drake-hide."}, {"id": "bos_leviathan_cow_rampage", "kind": "monster", "rank": "gold", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Flensers' Cove", "text": "**The Mother Who Lost Her Calf** (The Outer Water, Flensers' Cove). A leviathan cow whose calf was butchered in Flensers' Cove has been circling the cove's mouth for weeks and ramming any ship that passes, innocent or not. The bay's coastal lanes are closing. A fearless merfolk leviathan-singer, who says the cow can be calmed and led home, needs the outlaws in the cove kept off her while she tries, and someone to finish it if she fails. Reward: 1,300 florins from the merfolk herders and a leviathan-bone blade."}, {"id": "bos_mudflat_hydra", "kind": "monster", "rank": "gold", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "The Tanglewater Estuary", "text": "**The Hydra on the Flats** (The Mudflats, The Tanglewater Estuary). A hydra has come down out of the deep tangle onto the estuary mudflats, where every skiff crew launches, and it is eating its way along the coast. Each head cut off has come back as two. A retired orc snapdragon hunter who has lived at the estuary mouth for forty years has a plan involving fire and a great deal of lamp oil, and needs hands who will not run. Reward: 1,100 florins and the hunter's fire-lance."}, {"id": "bos_reef_mouth_breakers", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "gold", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Crescent Bay Isle", "text": "**Breaking the Reef-Mouth** (The Lagoon, Crescent Bay Isle). A salvage crew has been cutting coral from the reef-mouth that shelters Crescent Bay's lagoon, selling it by the boatload in Coriva. Every night they widen the gap, and if it opens far enough the serpents come in and the one gentle water in the bay is gone. A fierce half-mer relay champion who swims the reef-mouth daily wants them stopped and the gap closed. Reward: 800 florins from both peoples of the island and a pearl from each."}, {"id": "bos_skerry_ghost_ship", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "gold", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "The Sea-Troll Skerries", "text": "**The Lantern Ship** (The Channels, The Sea-Troll Skerries). On dark nights a lantern-lit ship sails the channels of the Sea-Troll Skerries, and captains who follow its lights to safety are led straight onto the rocks, where the trolls wait. It is the ghost of a ship that wrecked there a generation ago. The last surviving mate of her crew, gruff and grey and never forgiven for living, believes he knows what holds her crew there. Reward: 950 florins and a charm the mate says the ship's captain wore."}, {"id": "bos_wreck_hall_raiders", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Pearl Cave Island", "text": "**The Bow in the Dark Water** (The Wreck Hall, Pearl Cave Island). A powerful salvage admiral is assembling a fleet to raise the Serpentsbane's sheared bow from the Wreck Hall of Pearl Cave Island, where the Mother of Serpents keeps the ships she breaks. If he robs her collection she will come for Coriva. The granddaughter of a shipwright who worked on the Serpentsbane wants the bow home too, but not like this, and she knows the cave better than anyone living. Reward: 2,500 florins and a plank of the Serpentsbane to swear oaths on."}]

offer_pool_league_data_010.name: offer_pool_league_data_010
offer_pool_league_data_010.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "bos_skerry_kraken", "kind": "monster", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "The Sea-Troll Skerries", "text": "**The Trolls Are Fleeing** (The Outer Rocks, The Sea-Troll Skerries). A kraken has risen from the deep water beside the Sea-Troll Skerries and is eating the trolls, and the survivors are fleeing into the shipping lanes and wading ashore along the coast, starving and savage. Nothing in the bay can stand against the thing on the rocks. A weather-beaten old fish-spotter who has watched the skerries from his boat for fifty years has seen where it sleeps. Reward: 4,000 florins sealed by the Council and a kraken-beak trophy."}, {"id": "bos_wreck_bronze_dragon", "kind": "monster", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "The Bronze Wreck", "text": "**Tribute to the Wreck** (The Broken Decks, The Bronze Wreck). A wild bull sea-drake, far bigger than any the drake-riders of the bay fly, has driven the sharkfolk raiders off the Bronze Wreck and claimed the ancient warship as its roost. It now rises against every ship in the southern lanes and sinks those that pass too near. A sharkfolk outcast who fled the raiders long before the drake came knows the wreck's hidden ways, and hates both the drake and her old band about equally. Reward: 5,000 florins sealed by the Council and a claim on the raiders' plunder in the bow vaults."}, {"id": "bos_chapterhouse_traitor", "kind": "social", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Coriva", "text": "**Someone in This Hall** (The Coriva League Chapterhouse, Coriva). For a year, every great hunt posted on this board has been met by raiders who knew its route, and good crews have died. The Council believes the leak sits inside the Chapterhouse itself, likely one of the chaptermaster's own deputies. A paranoid veteran archivist who keeps every posting ever made, and trusts no one, has found the pattern and wants help proving it and finding out who buys the routes. Reward: 2,000 florins sealed by the Council and a mark of the League's trust."}, {"id": "bos_drake_war_envoy", "kind": "social", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Drakerider Isle", "text": "**Drakes for a War Fleet** (The Home Beach Inn, Drakerider Isle). An imperious envoy of a warlike prince has taken over the Home Beach Inn with a guard of soldiers, and demands the isle's drakes and breakers for a war fleet, with warships said to be close behind if they refuse. The unbending eldest breaker-matriarch will not give a single foal and would sooner see the herds swim away forever. The Council wants the envoy turned back without starting a war. Reward: 2,500 florins sealed by the Council and a drake of your own breaking."}, {"id": "bos_house_heir_assassin", "kind": "social", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Coriva", "text": "**The Knife at the Muster** (Tessaro Hall, Coriva). Someone has hired a master assassin to kill the heads of both of Coriva's ruling houses at the great hunt muster, and to make each look like the other's work, which would tear the port apart and close the southern lanes. Two attempts have failed. The monster-hunting house's reckless young heir refuses to cancel the muster or hide, and wants the killer, and whoever hired them, found before it goes ahead. Reward: 3,500 florins sealed by the Council and the heir's lifelong friendship."}, {"id": "bos_scale_strand_binder", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Bay of Serpents", "location": "Pearl Cave Island", "text": "**The Binding on the Scale Strand** (The Scale Strand, Pearl Cave Island). A sorcerer has been gathering the Mother of Serpents' shed scales on Pearl Cave Island's strand and carving them into a binding meant to make her answer to whoever holds it. If it works, the owner commands the whole sea. An ancient mother-of-pearl carver who once sold the sorcerer his tools has recognized what he is making, and wants it stopped. Reward: 3,000 florins sealed by the Council and a carved scale of your own."}, {"id": "car_sham_hunter", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Carendon", "text": "**The Hunter Who Never Hunts** (The White Hart, Carendon). A swaggering stranger in a borrowed silver-trimmed coat holds court at the White Hart most evenings, taking coin from travelers to hunt beasts that never existed and showing off trophies bought in Houndsditch. His latest mark, a gullible young squire who paid his whole purse for a wolf-hunt, still believes in him and will not hear a word against his hero, so the fraud will have to be shown up in front of the White Hart's regulars. Reward: 40 florins from the squire's embarrassed uncle and a round at the White Hart on the house."}, {"id": "car_crooked_weighman", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Houndsditch", "text": "**The Heavy Thumb** (The Ditch, Houndsditch). The weighman at the hide-yard scales in Houndsditch has been shorting every renderer who brings in a carcass, and he keeps a pair of bravos at his elbow to settle complaints. A hulking half-orc renderer matron with a cleaver on her belt has had enough, and she means to settle it herself on the next market day unless someone proves the scales are rigged first. Reward: 35 florins pooled by the renderers and a well-cured hide of the crew's choosing."}, {"id": "car_sabotaged_crew", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Argenval", "text": "**Somebody Wants Us to Lose** (The Deep Cup, Argenval). Every week the Deep Cup's crew contests end with the same young mining crew losing: a knife-dart that breaks, an arm-wrestler who falls sick, a song-sheet gone missing. Their spokesman, a lanky young miner with a terrible singing voice and boundless optimism, is sure a rival foreman who hates losing is behind it, and he wants someone to catch him at it. Reward: 30 florins from the young crew and a jug of miner's tea strong enough to strip paint."}, {"id": "car_stolen_boar_boast", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Vaudania", "text": "**Whose Boar Was It?** (The Hound and Horn, Vaudania). A loud, well-liked hunter at the Hound and Horn is telling everyone how he killed the biggest boar of the season, and the tusks now hang over the bar with his name beside them. A shy freckled huntress who hates speaking up swears she made that kill alone, and she has the scar to prove it, but no one in the tavern will take her word over his. Reward: 45 florins from the huntress and a hunting bow from the village bowyer."}, {"id": "car_lamp_trows", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "The Silver Mine", "text": "**Trows in the Upper Workings** (The Workings, The Silver Mine). A handful of trows has found a way up into the safe upper workings of the Silver Mine and comes out at shift change to steal lamp oil, dinner pails, and anything shiny, biting whoever gets in the way. A superstitious dwarf shift-boss who whistles against bad luck wants them cleared out and their crack found before his crew refuses to go down. Reward: 50 florins from the shift-boss and a miner's lamp that never seems to run dry."}, {"id": "car_eel_trap_leeches", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Drowner's Deep", "text": "**Something in the Eel Traps** (The Fen-Edge, Drowner's Deep). Leeches as long as a man's arm have moved into the shallows at the Fen-Edge, emptying the eel traps overnight and fastening onto anyone who wades out to check them. A toothless old eel-snarer who talks to her traps as if they were her children wants the shallows cleaned out before winter, and she has opinions about how it should be done. Reward: 35 florins in fenfolk coin, smoked eels, and the old woman's cure for leech bites."}]

offer_pool_league_data_011.name: offer_pool_league_data_011
offer_pool_league_data_011.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "car_preserve_boar", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "The Dauvigne Preserve", "text": "**The Boar at the Feeding Stations** (The Riding Trails, The Dauvigne Preserve). A giant tusked boar has taken over the feeding stations along the Dauvigne Preserve's riding trails, splintering the hunting blinds and charging any horse that comes near. A jumpy young under-gamekeeper, the only one willing to walk the trails right now, wants it killed or driven back into the wild before the family's guests arrive for the season. Reward: 60 florins from the preserve's keepers and a haunch of the boar if it is killed."}, {"id": "car_hide_loft_weasels", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Carendon", "text": "**Weasels in the Hide Lofts** (Silver Row, Carendon). A pack of giant weasels has followed the carcass carts in from the wood and denned under Silver Row, slipping into the tanners' lofts at night to tear up the best hides and bite anyone who comes up the ladder. A squeamish elf perfumer whose shop shares a wall with the worst-hit loft wants the den found and the pack gone before the smell of them ruins her stock for good. Reward: 40 florins from the tanners of Silver Row and a bottle of the perfumer's best scent."}, {"id": "car_bowyers_wager", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Carendon", "text": "**The Bowyer's Wager** (The River Market, Carendon). Ysra Pell, the half-elf master bowyer of the River Market who is cheerfully certain elven bows beat everything, keeps losing her market-day shooting matches to a swaggering barge archer who never misses. She is sure he is cheating somehow, and she wants a crew to shoot against him, catch the trick, and win back her pride. Reward: 50 florins from Ysra and a bow of her own make fitted to the winner."}, {"id": "car_crows_on_steps", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Ducal Hill", "text": "**Dead Crows on the Steps** (The Quarter, Ducal Hill). Every few nights a dead crow appears on the front steps of a Ducal Hill townhouse, and the servants have started whispering about curses and giving notice. The house's prim elderly housekeeper, who trusts no one below stairs, wants the culprit found quietly before the family returns from the country and asks why half the staff has left. Reward: 55 florins from the housekeeper and a word in the right ear on Ducal Hill."}, {"id": "car_polite_highwayman", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Reaver Road", "text": "**The Courteous Robber** (The Road, Reaver Road). A lone highwayman with fine manners has been stopping wagons on Reaver Road, bowing to the drivers, taking exactly a tenth of every load, and riding off without a drop of blood spilled. A stout wagon-widow who drives her own timber team refuses to pay him a single plank, and she wants him caught, unmasked, or talked out of it before she does something rash. Reward: 45 florins from the widow and a ride on her timber wagons anywhere they go."}, {"id": "car_pup_thief", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Vaudania", "text": "**The Missing Pups** (The Village, Vaudania). Someone keeps slipping into Vaudania's hound-runs on moonless nights and taking the best pups of the breeder's pack, and they are too quiet to be wolves. The village hound-breeder, a loud cheerful man who names every pup and sings to the litters, wants the pups found and the thief stopped before the whole village starts accusing each other. Reward: 50 florins from the breeder and first pick of the next litter."}, {"id": "car_boar_bravos", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Houndsditch", "text": "**Bad Blood at the Black Boar** (The Black Boar, Houndsditch). A crew of struck-off hunters has taken the corner table at the Black Boar and picks a fight with every working hunter who drinks there, and two have left with broken hands. The Boar's one-eyed barkeep, who misses nothing and says less, wants it ended without the watch, because a watch that comes in once tends to come back. Reward: 120 florins from the barkeep and a standing welcome at a table no stranger usually gets."}, {"id": "car_club_card_sharp", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Ducal Hill", "text": "**The Winning Hand at the Coronet** (The Coronet Club, Ducal Hill). A charming newcomer at the Coronet Club has been winning the fortunes of young heirs at cards, night after night, and two of them have lost family land to him. Lucan Valcourt, the generous young lord who holds court at the club and cannot bear to see his friends ruined, is sure the man cheats and wants a crew who can sit at the table as his guests and prove it without a scandal. Reward: 180 florins from Lucan Valcourt, and an evening at his table for anyone he likes."}, {"id": "car_claim_jumpers", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Argenval", "text": "**Grandmother's Seam** (The Town, Argenval). An outsider prospecting crew with hired muscle has started working a seam that an old Argenval family has mined for three generations, and every week the two sides come closer to open fighting in the square. The family's fierce dwarf delver grandmother, who opened the seam herself, will not give an inch and wants someone to make the outsiders go before her grandsons do something stupid. Reward: 150 florins from the family and a silver ring cut from the seam's first ore."}, {"id": "car_bitten_stranger", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Vaudania", "text": "**The Bitten Man** (The Village, Vaudania). A traveler came into Vaudania with a wolf bite on his arm, and now a crowd gathers every evening outside the apothecary's shop demanding he be driven into the wood before he turns. The village apothecary, a brisk widow who has hidden him in her stillroom, swears the bite is from an ordinary wolf, and wants someone to prove it before the crowd breaks down her door. Reward: 100 florins from the apothecary and a satchel of Vaudania's best field-remedies."}, {"id": "car_tin_silver", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Carendon", "text": "**Silver That Isn't** (Silver Row, Carendon). Cheap silvered arrowheads and bolts have been sold along Silver Row for weeks, and hunters are coming home hurt when the silver flakes off against the things it is meant to kill. Odrum Krail, the dwarf smith of the River Market who cannot abide shoddy work, has traced the fakes to peddlers who move stalls every few days, and he wants them shut down before a hunter dies. Reward: 140 florins from the smiths of Silver Row and a set of true silver bolts from Odrum's forge."}, {"id": "car_noble_initiate", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Castle Harstone", "text": "**The Lordling in the Yard** (The Trials Yard, Castle Harstone). A noble-born initiate in the Trials Yard has been bullying the common-born recruits and sabotaging their practice, and his family has let it be known that failing him would cost the castle friends at court. Ona Weskbrin, the loud demonborn weapons-master of the Trials Yard, cannot touch him without starting a feud, so she wants outsiders to take him down a peg where everyone can see. Reward: 130 florins from Ona and a week of her personal training, which is worse than it sounds."}]

offer_pool_league_data_012.name: offer_pool_league_data_012
offer_pool_league_data_012.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "car_ford_drowners", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Drowner's Deep", "text": "**The Bad Ford** (The Black Water, Drowner's Deep). Drowners have claimed the one ford the fenfolk use to reach their peat-cuttings, rising at dusk to cut the guide-ropes and drag down whoever is still in the water. A flat-voiced fenfolk punt-woman who has lost two brothers at that ford will pole a crew out to it, and she wants the drowners broken so badly that she will not take payment for the ride. Reward: 160 florins from the fenfolk, and whatever the drowners dragged down that can be raised."}, {"id": "car_boulder_troll", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "The Argenval Crags", "text": "**The Troll Who Throws Stones** (The Crag-Trails, The Argenval Crags). A troll has come down from the high dens to the lower crag-trails and hurls boulders at goatherds and their flocks, then climbs down to eat whatever it hit. A boastful teenage goatherd, sure he can outrun it and bitterly proud of the goat he lost, has offered to act as bait, and nobody can talk him out of coming along. Reward: 180 florins from Argenval's herders and a wheel of goat cheese as big as a shield."}, {"id": "car_smokehouse_bugbears", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Wolvesholt Range", "text": "**Raiders at the Woodsman's Hut** (The Woodsman's Hut, Wolvesholt Range). A band of bugbears has discovered the smokehouse at the Woodsman's Hut and comes back every few nights to break in, kill a hound or two, and carry off the curing meat. The hut's keeper, a taciturn half-orc trapper with a soft spot for runt hounds, refuses to leave, and he wants the band broken before the snows cut him off. Reward: 150 florins from the trapper and a winter coat of wolf fur."}, {"id": "car_gatehouse_spiders", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Harpy's Peak Ruins", "text": "**Webs in the Gatehouse** (The Broken Gate, Harpy's Peak Ruins). Giant spiders have strung the ruined gatehouse of Harpy's Peak with webs, and they drop onto anyone who shelters under its arches from the harpies overhead. A nervous fur-train master who lost two drivers there last month says there is no other cover on that stretch, and he wants the nest burned out before his next train comes through. Reward: 130 florins from the fur-train master and a bale of prime pelts."}, {"id": "car_preserve_poachers", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "The Dauvigne Preserve", "text": "**Over the Preserve Wall** (The Preserve Gate, The Dauvigne Preserve). A gang of poachers has been slipping over the Dauvigne Preserve's wall at night to take the stocked deer and sell them in Houndsditch, and each week they push deeper toward the wild covert where gamekeepers have gone missing. A poacher's remorseful teenage son came to the gate asking for help: he wants his father stopped, caught if need be, but alive, before the wood takes him. Reward: 120 florins from the preserve's keepers and the right to hunt one stag in the preserve."}, {"id": "car_feast_saboteur", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Ducal Hill", "text": "**Sickness at the Duke's Table** (The Palace, Ducal Hill). Every banquet at the Palace this season has ended with half the guests sick, never quite poisoned, always just enough to spoil the night. The duke's harried master of revels, who fears for his post, suspects someone below stairs wants the ducal hunting feast ruined, and he needs discreet people in the kitchens and the hall before the next one. Reward: 200 florins from the master of revels and invitations to the ducal hunting feast."}, {"id": "car_sweetheart_swindle", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Argenval", "text": "**Three Rings, One Suitor** (The Lantern Steps, Argenval). A handsome stranger on the Lantern Steps is courting three miners' daughters at once and has taken savings from each family to invest in a mine claim that does not exist. The sharp-eyed jeweler who makes every courting ring on the Steps has noticed him buying three of the same, and wants him exposed before the feast-night dances, when he means to vanish with the money. Reward: 110 florins from the grateful families and a ring from the jeweler's best tray."}, {"id": "car_lift_saboteur", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "The Silver Mine", "text": "**The Cage That Drops** (The Mine Mouth, The Silver Mine). Twice this month the lift cage at the Silver Mine's main shaft has dropped with miners inside, and each time a rope or pawl turned out to be cut. The mine's anxious halfling winch-master, who built half the gear and is being blamed for it, is not sure whether it is a person with a grudge or trows coming up at night, and he wants it found before it kills someone. Reward: 140 florins from the mine's crews and the winch-master's eternal, voluble thanks."}, {"id": "car_puppeteer_ransom", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Reaver Road", "text": "**The Price Keeps Rising** (The Reaver Camp, Reaver Road). A reaver band is holding a traveling player for ransom in their camp off the road, and every time the money is raised the price goes up. His partner, an elderly elf puppeteer with a sharp tongue and no patience for outlaws, is camped by the roadside refusing to leave, and she wants a crew to get him out by trade, trick, or force. Reward: 150 florins raised by the troupe and a private show that is mostly about the crew."}, {"id": "car_dowager_blackmail", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Ducal Hill", "text": "**The Letters in the Steward's Keeping** (The Quarter, Ducal Hill). A former steward of the old family that gave Castle Harstone to the monster-hunters holds letters showing the family has schemed to take the castle back, and he bleeds them for coin every month. The family's proud, threadbare dowager would sooner die than see the letters read at court, and wants discreet outsiders to end the blackmail and destroy the letters or put them in her hands, without a breath of it reaching the Palace. Reward: 400 florins from the dowager and the lasting goodwill of an old Ducal Hill house."}, {"id": "car_market_pamphleteer", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Carendon", "text": "**Blame the Beastfolk** (The River Market, Carendon). A pamphleteer with a gift for rousing a crowd has been blaming the beastfolk traders of the River Market for every poached kill in the duchy, and every market day ends in a brawl. A soft-spoken badgerkin fur trader whose stall was burned last week wants to know who is paying the pamphleteer, and wants it stopped before someone is killed. Reward: 300 florins from the market's traders and a cloak of the badgerkin's finest fur."}, {"id": "car_protected_parts", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Houndsditch", "text": "**Horn That Shouldn't Exist** (The Ditch, Houndsditch). Ri Vandar, the cheerful ratkin of the Ditch who can tell where any part came from at a glance, has been seeing antler and hide from the duke's own deer, which no one but the duke may hunt, and more of it every week. He wants the ring moving it found and its buyer named, and he knows that asking loudly in Houndsditch is a good way to end up in a tanning-pit. Reward: 350 florins from Ri's friends in the honest trade and his appraisal of anything the crew brings back."}]

offer_pool_league_data_013.name: offer_pool_league_data_013
offer_pool_league_data_013.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "car_court_spy", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Castle Harstone", "text": "**Someone Is Reporting to Ducal Hill** (The Grandmaster's Tower, Castle Harstone). Tamsin Dain, the Grandmaster of the Hunt, who gives out the grave commissions in the Grandmaster's Tower, has learned that everything said at the castle is repeated at court within a week, by someone among the new initiates. She needs outsiders the castle has no reason to suspect to find the informer, and to learn which courtier is paying them. Reward: 450 florins and a standing welcome at Castle Harstone's hearth."}, {"id": "car_cavein_coverup", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Argenval", "text": "**The Song They Won't Let Her Sing** (The Deep Cup, Argenval). Three miners died in a cave-in last month, and their foreman swears it was bad luck, but the widows say the crew breached a seam the town had sealed. Maribel Halm, who sings and serves at the Deep Cup and remembers every crew's name, wrote a song about it and was warned never to sing it, and now she wants the truth found out before the whole town, so the widows have their answer. Reward: 250 florins from the widows and the Deep Cup, and Maribel sings the song for the crew."}, {"id": "car_witch_finder", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Vaudania", "text": "**Silver at Every Throat** (The Hound and Horn, Vaudania). A traveling witch-finder has set up at the Hound and Horn and tests villagers for the wolf-curse by pressing silver to their throats, and two families have already been driven into the wood on his word. Vaudania's jovial one-legged hunt-captain wants him gone, but half the village now believes him, and the captain needs outsiders who can break his hold without splitting the village. Reward: 300 florins from the hunt-captain and a place of honor on Vaudania's next great hunt."}, {"id": "car_road_harpies", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Harpy's Peak Ruins", "text": "**The Flock Has Grown** (The Roosts, Harpy's Peak Ruins). The harpy flock of Harpy's Peak has bred so large under a huge old broodmother that it now stoops on armed wagon trains, not just stragglers, and carries off drivers and horses to its roosts in the broken towers. The one-handed keeper of the waystation below the Peak, who keeps a tally of every traveler taken, wants the broodmother dead and the flock broken before the road closes for good. Reward: 450 florins from the waystation keeper and the road's merchants, plus what glitters in the nests."}, {"id": "car_fen_hag", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Drowner's Deep", "text": "**What the Hag Is Owed** (The Black Water, Drowner's Deep). A fen-hag in the deepest reeds of Drowner's Deep cures any sickness in return for a promise, and this season she has started collecting on those promises, taking children from the stilt-huts one by one. A desperate peat-cutter who struck a bargain to save his wife knows he is next to pay, and he will guide a crew to her reeds if they swear to break the bargain. Reward: 400 florins from the fenfolk and the hag's store of rare marsh reagents."}, {"id": "car_seam_roper", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "The Silver Mine", "text": "**The Stone That Eats** (The Deep Seams, The Silver Mine). The deep crews broke into a new cave last month, and since then miners keep vanishing near its mouth, their lamps found still burning on the floor. Something there looks like a stone pillar until it lashes out with sticky tendrils. The grim widow who runs the lamp shed, and has counted every lamp that did not come back, wants it dead before the richest seam in the mine is abandoned. Reward: 500 florins from the mine's owners and a sliver of radiant silver fit for a blade."}, {"id": "car_white_she_wolf", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Wolvesholt Range", "text": "**The Pack That Hunts Back** (The Wolvesholt Deep Wood, Wolvesholt Range). A pack of dire wolves led by a huge white she-wolf has started hunting the hunters in the Wolvesholt, driving them into draws and taking them from behind. A soot-black charcoal burner who works his kilns deep in the range and will not leave them has seen the pack circle his clearing every night, and he will show a crew where they run in return for being left alive. Reward: 400 florins in bounty and the white wolf's pelt, which any furrier in Carendon would bid on."}, {"id": "car_masked_duelist", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Ducal Hill", "text": "**The Duelist Behind the Mask** (The Coronet Club, Ducal Hill). A masked duelist has been challenging members of the Coronet Club in the gardens at dawn, beating every one of them, and cutting a small mark on their cheek to remember him by. The club's stout steward, who dreads the members' tempers and is being blamed for letting him in, wants the duelist beaten or unmasked and the reason for his challenges brought out, and has noticed that every victim voted the same way at court. Reward: 350 florins from the club, and honorary guest rights at the Coronet Club."}, {"id": "car_secret_tributes", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "The Argenval Crags", "text": "**Offerings at the Old Shrine** (The Old Shrine, The Argenval Crags). Argenval stopped leaving tribute for the trolls years ago, but someone has started leaving it again at the old shrine: livestock, silver, and lately a pair of children's shoes. The stiff-backed retired watch-captain who ended the tributes wants whoever is doing it caught, and wants to know what they are afraid of, before the trolls learn that the tolls have begun again. Reward: 300 florins from the old captain and the town watch's thanks."}, {"id": "car_crooked_patrol", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Reaver Road", "text": "**The Soldiers Who Rob** (The Road, Reaver Road). Wagons keep being robbed on Reaver Road on the very days the duke's patrols ride it, and the survivors say the robbers knew the escorts' signals. A timber merchant's clever daughter, who keeps a ledger of every robbery on the road, believes one of the patrols is robbing the traffic it guards and blaming the reavers, and she wants proof no court can ignore. Reward: 450 florins from the timber merchants and a contract to ride their trains at a fat fee."}, {"id": "car_lure_maps", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Carendon", "text": "**The Map to Nowhere Good** (Silver Row, Carendon). Someone on Silver Row is selling maps to rich monster lairs, and the hunters who follow them keep meeting reaver ambushes at the end of the trail instead. A gruff one-armed silversmith who lost his nephew to one of those maps wants the seller found and the ambushers who share his take stopped, and he is not particular about how. Reward: 350 florins from the silversmith and a silvered blade of his making."}, {"id": "car_merchant_succubus", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Carendon", "text": "**The Companion Who Never Eats** (The White Hart, Carendon). Nella Quist, the White Hart's warm, sharp-eyed landlady, has watched a wealthy fur merchant who has drunk in her house for twenty years fall for a dazzling new companion who never touches her food. He grows thinner and paler each week, and he has started signing his business over to her. Nella wants a crew to find out what the woman really is and break her hold before there is nothing left of him. Reward: 350 florins from the merchant's family and free rooms at the White Hart for a season."}]

offer_pool_league_data_014.name: offer_pool_league_data_014

skip = true
const data = [{"id": "car_wolf_preacher", "kind": "social", "rank": "gold", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Ducal Hill", "text": "**The Sermon of the Wolf** (The Quarter, Ducal Hill). A magnetic preacher has been gathering the servants of Ducal Hill in back kitchens at night, telling them that the wolf-curse is freedom and that the Heights will take anyone brave enough to climb. Twelve have already gone. A nervous scullery maid whose brother is next means to follow him, and she wants a crew to break the preacher's hold before the whole quarter's servants go up the mountain. Reward: 900 florins from the great houses of Ducal Hill and a quiet favor from each of them."}, {"id": "car_silver_revolt", "kind": "social", "rank": "gold", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Argenval", "text": "**Argenval Keeps Its Silver** (The Town, Argenval). A firebrand among Argenval's miners wants the town to stop sending silver downhill until the duke pays what it is worth, and each week more crews swear to him. If the silver stops, every monster-hunter in the duchy goes to the wood with bare steel. The town's weary silver-bearded reeve agrees with half of what the firebrand says and fears the rest, and wants a settlement before the duke sends soldiers. Reward: 1,200 florins from the duke and a silver-work gift from Argenval's makers."}, {"id": "car_gang_war", "kind": "social", "rank": "gold", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Houndsditch", "text": "**Fires in the Hide-Yards** (The Black Boar, Houndsditch). Veya Crowe, the stylish, soft-spoken fixer who keeps every debt in the Black Boar in her head, wants the newcomers gone before the fighting brings the duke's soldiers into the quarter, and she would rather outsiders did it. Reward: 1,000 florins from Veya and a favor she will remember, which cuts both ways."}, {"id": "car_ogre_truce", "kind": "monster", "rank": "gold", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Reaver Road", "text": "**The Ogres on Reaver Road** (The Reaver Camp, Reaver Road). A scarred reaver lieutenant has come out of the trees under a white rag, offering the band's knowledge of the ogres' lair in return for a truce while they are hunted, and every patrol on the road wants to hang him. Reward: 1,300 florins from the duke's road purse, plus whatever the ogres have piled up from the wagons."}, {"id": "car_umber_hulk", "kind": "monster", "rank": "gold", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "The Silver Mine", "text": "**Something Is Digging Toward Us** (The Workings, The Silver Mine). Reward: 1,400 florins from the mine's owners and the duke, and a share of the next month's ore."}, {"id": "car_royal_hunt_lure", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "gold", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "The Dauvigne Preserve", "text": "**The Duke's Hunt at the Preserve** (The Riding Trails, The Dauvigne Preserve). Garran Valere, the grizzled old hunter keeping watch at the Preserve Gate, reads it as a rival family's plot to shame the preserve's owners, and wants it stopped before the duke rides into the ravine. Reward: 1,200 florins from the preserve's owners, and a place riding with the duke's hunt."}, {"id": "car_pin_killer", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "gold", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Castle Harstone", "text": "**Someone Is Killing the Hunters** (The Muster, Castle Harstone). Four hunters of Castle Harstone have been found dead on the roads this season, each with their Order horn taken, and the wounds are too clean for any beast. Arvek Taal, the blue-scaled dragonkin armorer at the Muster who can read a weapon from the wound it leaves, has worked out what killed them, and wants outsiders the killer is not watching to catch whoever wields it and learn why. Reward: 1,100 florins from the hunters and a piece of Arvek's work made from the crew's choice of monster material."}, {"id": "car_river_arsonist", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "gold", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Carendon", "text": "**Fire on the River** (The River Market, Carendon). Every few nights another timber stack or moored barge along the River Market goes up in flames, and the city has begun blaming Houndsditch, with mobs gathering at the east gate. A barrel-chested barge captain who has lost two boats swears he has seen the same hooded figure at three of the fires, and wants the arsonist caught before the mob burns the carcass-quarter in return. Reward: 1,000 florins from the river merchants and free passage on any barge on the river."}, {"id": "car_usurper", "kind": "social", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Ducal Hill", "text": "**The Duke Is Unwell** (The Palace, Ducal Hill). The duke has taken ill and grows weaker each week, and a cousin of the duke who stands close to the ducal seat is gathering the great houses, the captains of the army, and a story that the duke is past saving. The duke's sharp-tongued old physician says the illness is not natural and trusts no one in the Palace, and she wants outsiders to find the truth before the cousin takes the duchy. Reward: 3,000 florins from the duke and a ducal writ naming the crew friends of the duchy."}, {"id": "car_crown_against_order", "kind": "social", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Castle Harstone", "text": "**The Writ Against Harstone** (The Great Hall, Castle Harstone). A ducal general has persuaded the court that the monster-hunters of Castle Harstone must be brought under the duke, and his soldiers are camped in the hills around the castle waiting for the writ. Tava Rell, the half-orc hunter who looks after the recruits in the Great Hall, knows the hall will fight rather than bend, and wants a crew with no side in it to stop a war that would leave the duchy's woods unguarded. Reward: 3,500 florins from the duke and the hunters together, and the hall's oath to answer one call."}, {"id": "car_reaver_warlord", "kind": "social", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Duchy of Carendon", "location": "Reaver Road", "text": "**The King of Reaver Road** (The Reaver Camp, Reaver Road). His weary second, a former knight of the duke's household who went to the woods after a disgrace, has sent word that he wants a way out for his people and a crew who can negotiate, or end the warlord if talk fails. Reward: 3,000 florins from the duke and a knight's patent for whoever brings the peace."}]

skip = true
