Elio Veyr, a young moon elf regular at the Red Moon with more charm than sense, lost his family signet to the man last week and wants it back before his relatives notice his bare hand. Reward: 45 florins from Elio and a standing invitation to his table, which is never dull."}, {"id": "dru_galleries_sabotage", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "Drusavia", "text": "**Cracked Moonstone in the Galleries** (The Grand Galleries, Drusavia). Someone keeps cracking the moonstones and fouling the enchantments on showpieces in the Grand Galleries the night before noble buyers come to look. Oriel Vant, a young moon elf spellwright in the Galleries who studies every object as if pricing it, is certain the dwarf armorer across the balcony is ruining her work, and he is equally certain she is ruining his. Reward: 50 florins split between the two makers, and a small warded trinket from whichever of them was wronged."}, {"id": "dru_rovena_harvest_brawl", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "Rovena", "text": "**Locked In with a Grudge** (The Dead be Damned Tavern, Rovena). Two vineyard harvest gangs have fallen out over a stolen row of grapes, and because no one in Rovena goes outside after the hearth-bell, they end up shut inside the Dead be Damned Tavern together every night. The enormous orc cellarwoman who bars the doors at sunset is tired of breaking up brawls until dawn, and she wants the feud settled before someone goes out the door in a temper and meets the ghosts. Reward: 40 florins from the tavern and a glass demijohn of the good hill-wine."}, {"id": "dru_kolbeck_defaced_housewain", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "Kolbeck", "text": "**Noses Off the Housewains** (Oldwain Square, Kolbeck). Someone keeps sneaking into Oldwain Square by night and chiseling the noses off the carved housewain figures on one painted townhouse, the one whose carvings hold the best corner of the square. Its owner, a loud old master-carver with sawdust in his beard and an opinion on everyone's work, has named three rivals as suspects and is about to take a mallet to all of their doors. Reward: 35 florins and a small grimwood charm carved by the old man himself."}, {"id": "dru_mistbat_stirges", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "Fallsmeet", "text": "**Stirges in the Roosts** (The Mistbat Roosts, Fallsmeet). A swarm of stirges has found its way into the deep caves of the Mistbat Roosts and slips in each night to drink from the young mistbats, which are growing weak and skittish in the harness. A soft-spoken gnome handler who knows every pup by name wants the swarm burned out or driven off without spooking the older bats off their ledges. Reward: 45 florins and a supervised first flight on a gentle mistbat."}, {"id": "dru_demijohn_poltergeist", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "Rovena", "text": "**Broken Glass in the Cellar** (Demijohn Square, Rovena). A poltergeist has taken up in the deep cellar under a cordial shop on Demijohn Square and smashes a few glass demijohns every day, always the most expensive ones. The shop's owner, a nervous gnome cordial-maker who talks to her barrels to keep them calm, cannot afford to lose another week of stock and has begun sleeping on the cellar stairs. Reward: 30 florins and a crate of the cordials that survive."}, {"id": "dru_mirgreth_leeches", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "Mirgreth Mire", "text": "**Leeches in the Eel-Traps** (Mirgreth Stead, Mirgreth Mire). Giant leeches the length of a man's arm have been rising out of the black water under Mirgreth Stead, emptying the eel-traps and latching onto anyone who wades in to check them. A one-eyed fenwife eel-catcher who plainly thinks city folk are soft has offered coin to anyone who will clear them, mostly to watch them try. Reward: 35 florins in small silver, a hot meal, and the fenwife's grudging respect."}, {"id": "dru_harrowwood_badger_sett", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "The Harrowwood", "text": "**The Badger Under the Stakes** (The Working Wood, The Harrowwood). A giant badger has dug her sett right under a stake-line in the Working Wood, and every new tunnel tilts another grimwood stake out of true over the cursed plot behind it. A sooty dwarf charcoal-burner who sleeps beside his mounds nearby wants the badger moved or killed, and the tilted stakes set straight, before she loosens enough of them to wake what lies under the earth. Reward: 50 florins and a sack of the best charcoal in the Harrowwood."}]

offer_pool_league_data_016.name: offer_pool_league_data_016
offer_pool_league_data_016.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "dru_chapterhouse_whispering_helm", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "Drusavia", "text": "**The Helm That Whispers** (The League Chapterhouse, Drusavia). One of the old trophies above the League Chapterhouse hearth, a battered helm brought back from the haunted dales, has started whispering after midnight, and the young Coppers keep daring each other to sleep beneath it. The one-armed retired Bronze who tends the hearth wants to know whose spirit is still in it and what it wants, and to see it laid to rest, before one of the youngsters gets hurt proving a point. Reward: 40 florins from the chapterhouse and the old Bronze's story of how the helm was won."}, {"id": "dru_ducal_square_pickpockets", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "Drusavia", "text": "**Light Fingers on the Palace Steps** (Ducal Square, Drusavia). A ring of quick young pickpockets works the petitioners queuing on the palace steps in Ducal Square, and they are gone into the carriage traffic before anyone shouts. A stout watch sergeant a year from retirement who hates running has asked the League for help, and he suspects someone grown is taking the children's takings. Reward: 45 florins from the watch and a sergeant who owes the crew a favor."}, {"id": "dru_open_grounds_bookmaker", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "Fallsmeet", "text": "**A Target That Moves** (The Open Grounds, Fallsmeet). Favorites in the Open Grounds archery matches keep missing by a hand's width at the worst moment, and a bookmaker in the galleries keeps collecting on the upsets. A fussy gnome Games official with three pairs of spectacles is sure the butts are being tampered with, but cannot prove how, and the next match day is always coming. Reward: 50 florins from the Games officials and good seats for the next contest day."}, {"id": "dru_temple_steps_false_relics", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "The Temple of Galard", "text": "**Bones of Castian, Cheap** (The Temple Steps, The Temple of Galard). A peddler has been selling pilgrims chips of bone he swears came from Castian's own tomb, and he always slips away down the Temple Steps before the guards reach him. Theo Valarin, a handsome, easy-smiling temple knight who keeps watch on the Temple Steps, is embarrassed that the man keeps outrunning him and would like someone less shiny to catch him. Reward: 40 florins from the temple and Theo's blessing on the crew's weapons."}, {"id": "dru_kolbeck_crooked_guards", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "Kolbeck", "text": "**Double Pay in the Deep Wood** (The Mustering Ground, Kolbeck). A band of sell-swords has been hiring on as guards for the felling crews, then stopping halfway into the Harrowwood and demanding double pay before they will walk anyone back out. A weathered felling-boss who has buried two crews and hates hiring strangers wants the band broken, but still needs guards for the next felling at the Mustering Ground. Reward: 140 florins from the felling crews and a grimwood axe handle cut to the crew's grip."}, {"id": "dru_saravel_dueling_cousin", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "House Saravel", "text": "**Friendly Duels at Saravel** (Saravel Grounds, House Saravel). A young Saravel cousin, a gifted and bored swordsman, has spent the season challenging guests to friendly bouts on the lawns of Saravel Grounds and leaving three of them scarred. The house's immaculate elderly steward, who has never raised his voice in forty years, wants the young man humbled or turned from the habit without anyone being able to say the house did it. Reward: 180 florins and an invitation to one of Saravel's card evenings."}, {"id": "dru_white_wheel_crooked_sponsor", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "Fallsmeet", "text": "**Paid to Lose** (The White Wheel, Fallsmeet). A rich patron has a promising young competitor tied up in a sponsorship contract and forces the youngster to throw bouts whenever the patron has bet against them. Noll Avenay, who owns the White Wheel and knows every rivalry in Fallsmeet, likes the kid and wants the contract broken, and he warns that the patron keeps hard men at his table. Reward: 150 florins from Noll and a room at the White Wheel whenever the crew is in Fallsmeet."}, {"id": "dru_harrans_fake_exorcist", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "Black Tower", "text": "**Exorcisms, Half Price** (Harran's Place, Black Tower). A man in a borrowed black coat has been meeting frightened petitioners in the Black Tower's shadow and selling them exorcisms that do nothing, and two of his customers have since been found dead in their homes. Vesna Calloway, a young demonborn inquisitor who drinks at Harran's Place and wears a different ring on every finger, wants him found and stopped, and wants his customers warned before the next one dies. Reward: 160 florins from the Black Tower and a silver ward-charm Vesna picked out herself."}, {"id": "dru_ondrave_moneylender", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "Castle Ondrave", "text": "**The Duns at Ondrave Hall** (Ondrave Hall, Castle Ondrave). A moneylender who bought up House Ondrave's debts sends his men to the hall every week by daylight to carry off another heirloom, and he has begun hinting that he will take the hall itself. The old lord of Ondrave receives them with threadbare formality and will not ask anyone for help, but his household will, quietly. Reward: 120 florins from the household and a night by the hearth that has never gone out."}, {"id": "dru_hollowhill_ghouls", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "The Hollowhill Catacombs", "text": "**Goblins at Dusk** (The Shallows, The Hollowhill Catacombs). A goblin tribe has moved into the Shallows to loot the robbers the risen dead leave behind, and now they climb out at dusk to try the doors of the hillside farms. A sheepish young grave-robber who knows every break-in on the hill will show the way to their warren in exchange for nobody asking what he was doing there. Reward: 150 florins from the farms and whatever the goblins dragged into their warren, at the crew's own risk."}, {"id": "dru_daravaine_barghests", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "The Daravaine Reaches", "text": "**Black Hounds on the Estate Roads** (The Old Estate Roads, The Daravaine Reaches). A pack of barghests has taken to running down the dig-crews' carts on the Old Estate Roads at dusk, and it is picking off the slowest wagon each time. A scarred dwarf foreman whose crew has lost two carts swears the lead hound laughed at him in words, and he will pay well for anyone who can stop it. Reward: 190 florins from the dig-crews and a share in their next strongroom find."}, {"id": "dru_harrowwood_ettercap", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "The Harrowwood", "text": "**Webs Across the Drag-Road** (The Working Wood, The Harrowwood). An ettercap and its giant spiders have strung webs across a drag-road in the Working Wood, and the timber teams keep losing oxen to it in the half-light. A young ox-driver who sings to her team to keep them calm lost her lead ox last week, and she knows exactly which stand of trees the webs are strung from. Reward: 130 florins from the timber teams and a spider-silk rope strong enough to hold an ox."}]

offer_pool_league_data_017.script:
skip = true

A deaf old dwarf millwright who says he has worked those wheels by feel with his eyes shut for thirty years refuses to stop the hammers, and he wants the thing dealt with before it takes anyone else. Reward: 200 florins from the mill-owners and a blade finished on the Watermills' hammers."}, {"id": "dru_tribute_stones_wisps", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "Mirgreth Mire", "text": "**Lights at the Tribute Stones** (The Tribute Stones, Mirgreth Mire). Will-o'-wisps have been dancing over the meres near the Tribute Stones since two of the stones were knocked over, and they have drowned three fenfolk they led off the causeways at dusk. A barefoot fen girl who has left the offerings there since she could walk knows which stones fell, and she thinks the wisps are hunting whoever did it. Reward: 110 florins in fen silver and a dry bed in any house in Mirgreth Stead."}, {"id": "dru_arcade_gargoyle", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "Drusavia", "text": "**Something in the Vaults** (The Grand Arcade, Drusavia). Nobody believes her, and she wants proof, and her stolen goods back, before she loses the rest of her stock or her reputation. Reward: 120 florins and one piece from the jeweler's case, chosen with the loupe firmly in place."}, {"id": "dru_rovena_hearth_bell", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "Rovena", "text": "**The Bell Rang Late** (The Shrine of Galard, Rovena). The stooped, half-deaf bell-priest insists he rang it on time both nights, and he wants the crew to prove it, and to find whoever is making the valley doubt the bell. Reward: 130 florins from the shrine and a blessing the priests do not give lightly."}, {"id": "dru_crypt_offering_thief", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "The Temple of Galard", "text": "**Empty Hands at Castian's Tomb** (The Crypts of Castian, The Temple of Galard). Offerings keep disappearing from the foot of Castian's tomb in the Crypts of Castian, past wards that should stop any thief, and the lamps nearest the tomb keep going out. The young acolyte who trims the crypt lamps is terrified of the dark and of being blamed, and has come to the League because the temple knights have started looking at him. Reward: 150 florins from the temple and a blessed candle that will not go out."}, {"id": "dru_white_rooster_extra_man", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "Kolbeck", "text": "**One More Than Went In** (The White Rooster, Kolbeck). A felling crew came back out of the Harrowwood with one more man than went in, a silent woodsman nobody hired who now sits at the crew's table in the White Rooster every night and will not leave. The crew's jittery cook counted heads twice and is sure the stranger is one of the risen, and wants to know who buried him and who he is bound to. Reward: 140 florins from the crew and a grimwood stake blessed by the carvers' guild."}, {"id": "dru_lowlamp_preacher", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "Black Tower", "text": "**Torches on Lowlamp Lane** (Lowlamp Lane, Black Tower). A wild-eyed street preacher gathers a crowd on Lowlamp Lane every week and tells them the Black Tower breeds the very dead it hunts, and each crowd is angrier than the last. A hoarse ducal herald who has been shouted down there all month wants to know who is paying the preacher, and wants the crowds gone before someone throws a torch through a Tower door. Reward: 170 florins from the duke's household and the herald's hoarse thanks."}, {"id": "dru_saravel_blackmailer", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "House Saravel", "text": "**Letters at the Card Table** (Saravel Great Hall, House Saravel). Someone among the guests of House Saravel's season has been slipping notes to other guests, quoting letters they thought burned and naming a price. A sharp-eyed Saravel dowager who cheats at whist and enjoys it wants the blackmailer found among her own guests and the letters recovered or destroyed, and she will not have the house embarrassed by a public accusation. Reward: 400 florins from the dowager and a place on Saravel's guest list for the season."}, {"id": "dru_red_moon_broken_engagement", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "Drusavia", "text": "**Spell-Duels over a Broken Match** (The Red Moon Inn, Drusavia). The bride-to-be, a lovesick young moon elf who writes terrible poetry about the whole affair, still wants the marriage, and she has hired the League to find out why it was broken and to mend it before someone dies. Reward: 350 florins from the bride-to-be and a poem in the crew's honor, whether they want one or not."}, {"id": "dru_crags_ransomed_heir", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "The Daravaine Reaches", "text": "**The Heir Who Likes It There** (The Hill Lords' Crags, The Daravaine Reaches). The family's last messenger came back puzzled: the heir seems to be having the time of their life among the bandits and may not want to leave. The family wants the heir home and the price paid in something other than their fortune. Reward: 450 florins from the heir's family, more if the ransom is never paid."}, {"id": "dru_closed_court_death_matches", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "Fallsmeet", "text": "**Bouts in the Closed Court** (The Closed Court, Fallsmeet). Behind the shutters of the Closed Court beneath Castle Twinfall, a promoter has been running private bouts for rich patrons, and the fighters are debtors who cannot refuse and do not always walk out. A young dwarf fighter with a broken nose and more debt than sense has come to the League to end the bouts and the promoter's hold on the debtors before his name is called, and he knows which night the patrons gather next. The humorless grimwood guild-mistress of Oldwain Square, whose hands are white with sawdust to the elbow, wants the counterfeiters found before the guild's name is worthless, and she suspects someone inside her own guild. Reward: 400 florins from the heir and a place riding in the great hunt."}, {"id": "dru_ducal_square_chancellor", "kind": "social", "rank": "gold", "region": "Duchy of Drusavia", "location": "Drusavia", "text": "**The Chancellor's Two Letters** (Ducal Square, Drusavia). Cursed tomb-pieces that the Sunfire Sanctum refuses to bless are leaving by its back door anyway, sold by a senior priest to buyers who want the old rites still in them. An idealistic young radiant-mage found his sales book and wants the trade ended, but the priest is powerful, well liked, and very good at making accusers look mad. Reward: 350 florins and a warded radiant amulet from the mage's own teacher."}, {"id": "dun_hollow_bandit_crew", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Widow's Way", "text": "**A Price for the Hollow** (The Hollow, Widow's Way). The bandit crew that camps in the Hollow off Widow's Way takes a share of nearly every caravan that crosses, and the gnoll packs take the rest. A silver-tongued caravan broker thinks the bandits could be bought into a truce, a fixed toll in exchange for safe passage and their blades against the gnolls, and he wants a crew bold enough to walk into the Hollow and make the offer stick. Reward: 450 florins from the broker's clients."}, {"id": "dun_first_pyramid_company", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Tombs of the Sun Kings", "text": "**The Company on the First Pyramid** (The First Pyramid, Tombs of the Sun Kings). The raider company that holds the First Pyramid under a jackalkin chief has started attacking any crew that digs within sight of its walls, and it now claims three pyramids by force. A big-hearted minotaur crew-captain whose people were driven off twice wants a fair share of the necropolis back, and would settle for a deal if the company would ever talk. Reward: 400 florins and a place on the minotaur's next dig."}, {"id": "dun_sweetwater_lamia", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Sweetwater Pool", "text": "**The Sweetest Water** (The Palm Grove, Sweetwater Pool). A family of lamia holds Sweetwater Pool, passing for women at the edge of the palms until the thirsty come close, and every season they take their share of those who wander in. A stubborn caravan water-master, who swears the spring was open to caravans in her mother's day, wants it open again and will pay for the lamia to be killed, driven out, or bargained with. Reward: 500 florins and first water-rights at the spring."}]

offer_pool_league_data_023.name: offer_pool_league_data_023
offer_pool_league_data_023.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "dun_wrapping_hall_ghouls", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Tomb of the Embalmers", "text": "**Our Own Dead** (The Wrapping-Halls, Tomb of the Embalmers). Raiders who died in the Wrapping-Halls of the Tomb of the Embalmers have come back as ghasts, and unlike the slow wrapped dead around them they are clever, hungry, and know every trick their crews used. The hollow-eyed cook of one lost crew, the only one who got out, wants his old friends put down and knows each of their habits. Reward: 380 florins and the lost crew's cached sun-gold, if the cook's memory is good."}, {"id": "dun_spire_automata", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "The Mirror-Waste", "text": "**Mirror Soldiers in the Spires** (The Spires, The Mirror-Waste). The mirror-bright war-automata of the fallen sky-citadels have begun patrolling out into the Spires, where crews used to scavenge safely, standing unseen among the glass until they move. A meticulous gnome artificer wants one taken whole, not scrapped, and will pay handsomely for it; everyone else just wants the Spires safe again. Reward: 450 florins, and a bonus from the artificer if one automaton is taken whole."}, {"id": "dun_plaza_basilisk", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Tombs of the Sun Kings", "text": "**The New Statues** (The Plaza of Kings, Tombs of the Sun Kings). A basilisk has denned in the shadow of one of the seven pyramids on the Plaza of Kings, and the plaza gains new statues every week, raiders frozen mid-step with their packs still on. A grieving halfling swears one of them is her husband and wants the basilisk killed and a way found to turn him back. Reward: 420 florins and whatever her husband was carrying, if he comes back to hand it over."}, {"id": "dun_hunt_gate_lions", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Tomb of the Beast-King", "text": "**Lions Out of the Hunt-Gate** (The Hunt-Gate, Tomb of the Beast-King). The embalmed lions of the Tomb of the Beast-King have started padding out through the Hunt-Gate by night, killing raiders in their camps and dragging them back inside. A leonin big-game hunter, vain about his mane and keen for the rarest trophy in the desert, wants to hunt them in their own halls and needs a crew to keep him alive while he does. Reward: 360 florins and a gold-worked lion collar from the tomb."}, {"id": "dun_foresighted_dervish", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "The Lodge of the Wind Dancers", "text": "**He Sees You Coming** (The Outer Pillars, The Lodge of the Wind Dancers). A dervish who reached the deepest trance of the Lodge left before finishing his teaching, and now waits in the Outer Pillars challenging travelers to duels for their purses, seeing every blow a few heartbeats before it comes. The ancient, tiny master who taught him wants him beaten or brought home, and says the trick is to fight him without deciding anything. Reward: 300 florins and a lesson in the trance from the old master."}, {"id": "dun_rest_house_doppelganger", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Hillwatch", "text": "**Guests Who Never Eat** (The Rest-House, Hillwatch). Travelers keep vanishing from the Hillwatch rest-house, and the guests who take their cots are always a quiet, well-dressed few who eat nothing and ask a great deal about the road ahead. The rest-house cook, a jittery halfling who notices everything, saw one of them grow a jackal's muzzle over its untouched supper, and she is terrified the faithful will blame her for the missing. Reward: 320 florins and the valuables they took from their victims."}, {"id": "dun_beam_turning_crew", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Tomb of the Sun's Eye", "text": "**Burned in the Mirror Halls** (The Mirror Halls, Tomb of the Sun's Eye). One crew has learned to turn the pivoting mirrors of the Tomb of the Sun's Eye, and they use the focused beams to burn out any rival crew that enters the Mirror Halls behind them. A blind lensmaker, who reads mirrors and lenses by touch and helped them learn it, is ashamed and will teach a better crew how to turn the halls back on them. Reward: 480 florins and a hand-ground lens that focuses sunlight into a blade of heat."}, {"id": "dun_crypt_robbing_fence", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Oasis", "text": "**Grandmother's Ring** (The Great Serpent Market, Oasis). Grave-goods from the crypts where Oasis buries its own people have turned up on a sunstone dealer's bench in the Great Serpent Market, and in this city that crime is punished by burning. Khalo Merrat, a jackalkin swordsman with rings in one ear who works the market, recognized his grandmother's ring among them and wants the robbers behind the fence found before he burns the stall himself. Reward: 380 florins, and the stolen grave-goods go back to their families."}, {"id": "dun_roc_chick", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Oasis", "text": "**Something Circles the City** (The Caravanserai of the Thousand Roads, Oasis). Every evening a phoenix circles low over Oasis, screaming, and wherever its burning feathers fall, awnings and roofs catch fire. Someone is keeping its chick hidden in one of the Caravanserai's storehouses to sell, and a soft-spoken lizardfolk beast-handler who has been feeding it in secret thinks the only way to end this is to give the chick back, alive. Reward: 450 florins and a phoenix feather that never stops glowing."}, {"id": "dun_demon_taint_riots", "kind": "social", "rank": "gold", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Oasis", "text": "**The Demon in the Blood** (The Citadel of Seven Winds, Oasis). Agitators paid by one of the city's rival great houses are spreading the old rumor that the ruling family's blood is demon-tainted, and the crowds under the Citadel of Seven Winds grow angrier each week, with two carpet workshops already burned. The palace chamberlain, haughty and far sharper than he lets on, wants the agitators exposed and their paymaster shamed before Oasis tears itself apart. Reward: 1,200 florins and a guest's welcome at the Citadel."}, {"id": "dun_hillwatch_water_hostage", "kind": "social", "rank": "gold", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Hillwatch", "text": "**Water for a Soul** (The Yard, Hillwatch). The sun-cult that holds Hillwatch has begun refusing water to any caravan that will not leave one traveler behind to join the faith, and with no other well for days, caravans are paying it. A formidable elderly djinnborn caravan-master who has crossed this road for forty years refuses to hand anyone over, and wants the well opened by argument, bargain, or force before the whole desert road bends to the cult. Reward: 1,000 florins raised by the caravan-masters of the Caravanserai, and their friendship on every road."}, {"id": "dun_cult_sworn_champion", "kind": "social", "rank": "gold", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Oasis", "text": "**The Champion Preaches** (The Red Sands, Oasis). The reigning champion of the Red Sands has begun preaching the return of the Sun Kings from the sand after every win, and the crowds who adore him now walk out to Hillwatch by the hundred to join the cult. The fierce old arena-mistress who trained him from a boy wants him beaten in the sand, turned back, or proven a fraud before half the city's young fighters follow him into the desert. Reward: 1,300 florins and a fighter's cell under the stands, with the arena-mistress as trainer."}]

offer_pool_league_data_024.name: offer_pool_league_data_024
offer_pool_league_data_024.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "dun_marching_ranks", "kind": "monster", "rank": "gold", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Tomb of the Risen Host", "text": "**The Host Marches** (The Hall of Ranks, Tomb of the Risen Host). Each night the dead soldiers of the Tomb of the Risen Host march a little farther out of the Hall of Ranks in formation, and last night the leading rank reached the threshold of the war-gate, spears lowered toward the camps on the flats. A laconic half-giant tomb-mapper, who has charted every lane between the pillars, believes something in the hall is drilling them for war and wants it found before they walk out into the desert. Reward: 1,400 florins and first pick of the army's war-gear."}, {"id": "dun_far_crags_manticore", "kind": "monster", "rank": "gold", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Tomb Crags", "text": "**The Drake on the Far Crags** (The Far Crags, Tomb Crags). A crag drake has taken the highest of the Far Crags, climbing rock nothing else can reach, and it ranges across the province from there, spitting acid on caravans and raider camps and carrying off camels as far as the palm-farms of Oasis. A greedy, cheerful goblin raider-captain wants it dead so her crew can strip the Far Crags it guards, and she will share the sun-gold with whoever helps kill it. Reward: 900 florins and a share of the Far Crags' sun-gold."}, {"id": "dun_beast_king_chimera", "kind": "monster", "rank": "gold", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Tomb of the Beast-King", "text": "**The Beast-King's Hunter** (The King's Den, Tomb of the Beast-King). The embalmed giant cobra that lay coiled beside the Beast-King in his den has risen, and every few nights it slides out along the tomb's old water-channels to kill the herds and farmers around Oasis, each time a little nearer the city. A furious camel-breeder who has lost half her herd to it has raised a purse from every farm and caravan it has struck, and wants it put down in the den it came from. Reward: 1,500 florins pooled by the herders, and the breeder's finest racing camel."}, {"id": "dun_eye_beam", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "gold", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Tomb of the Sun's Eye", "text": "**The Eye Looks Outward** (The Crystal Vault, Tomb of the Sun's Eye). The great crystal at the heart of the Tomb of the Sun's Eye has begun throwing its gathered light out through the Eye at night, a burning line that sweeps farther across the badlands each week toward Oasis, and the tomb's brass hawks fly out along it to hunt whatever it lights. An excitable elderly astronomer-mage from the Sunfire Sanctum has plotted its path and wants the crystal turned, shrouded, or shattered before the beam reaches the city. Reward: 1,200 florins and the astronomer's star-charts of the tombs, which show things no other map does."}, {"id": "dun_bound_efreet_loom", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "gold", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Oasis", "text": "**The Fire in the Loom** (Skyweavers' Lane, Oasis). The oldest loom in Skyweavers' Lane has an efreet bound into it, and every carpet it ever wove flew on that fire; now the efreet has woken, and it burns a workshop on the lane every week until it is freed. The secretive master weaver who inherited the loom wants the burning stopped without the city learning what really makes its carpets fly. Reward: 1,000 florins and a carpet from the old loom, if it still weaves."}, {"id": "dun_rakshasa_vizier", "kind": "social", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Oasis", "text": "**The Hands Bend Backward** (The Citadel of Seven Winds, Oasis). A trusted vizier of the house that rules Oasis has been replaced by a rakshasa wearing his face, and from the Citadel of Seven Winds it steers the carpets, the sun-gold trade, and the city's quarrels toward a war that would reach every corner of the realm. A clever, bored princess of the house has noticed that his hands bend the wrong way, and no one else believes her. Reward: 3,000 florins and a flying carpet of the ruling house's own weave."}, {"id": "dun_drowned_king_wakes", "kind": "monster", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Tomb of the Drowned King", "text": "**The Drowned King Stirs** (The Sunken Vault, Tomb of the Drowned King). The Drowned King himself is stirring in the black water of the Sunken Vault, a mummy lord whose touch rots flesh, and each night more of his honor-guard wade up through the flooded halls toward the desert air. A stone-deaf retired pearl-diver, the only one living who has touched his sarcophagus, will lead a crew down into the dark to end him before he rises with his guard behind him. Reward: 4,000 florins and the Drowned King's sun-gold crown."}, {"id": "dun_widows_way_blue_dragon", "kind": "monster", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Widow's Way", "text": "**The Wyrm Under the Road** (The Narrows, Widow's Way). A great sand-wyrm has come to lie beneath Widow's Way, feeling the caravans through the sand and bursting up to swallow wagons whole, and it has made the only road across this desert its hunting ground. An unflappable elderly gnome water-seller who has kept a stall at the Narrows for sixty years has watched it hunt and knows where it surfaces, and he wants the road open before the realm's southern trade dies. Reward: 5,000 florins and the pick of what it has swallowed."}, {"id": "dun_plaza_sphinx", "kind": "monster", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Tombs of the Sun Kings", "text": "**The Riddle on the Plaza** (The Plaza of Kings, Tombs of the Sun Kings). A sphinx the size of a temple has woken on the Plaza of Kings and sealed the whole necropolis, asking a riddle of every crew that comes near and devouring those who answer wrong; some say it was set to guard the sleep of the Sun Kings until their waking. A pompous but brilliant riddle-collector wants to answer it, and everyone else would settle for slaying it or learning what it is waiting for. Reward: 3,500 florins and one true answer from the sphinx, to any question the crew asks."}, {"id": "dun_djinn_engine", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "The Mirror-Waste", "text": "**The Heart of the Fallen Hull** (The Fallen Hull, The Mirror-Waste). The burst djinn-engine that fused this desert to glass is rekindling in the Fallen Hull, its fire-spirits swarming thicker every week and the glass around it running soft. A soot-streaked ifrit scholar who has studied it for years wants it running again under control and is sure she can manage it; if she is wrong, the glass could spread across half the realm. Reward: 4,000 florins and a shard of the engine's heart, still warm."}, {"id": "dun_worm_caller", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Tomb Crags", "text": "**The Song That Drives the Worms** (The Sand-Sea, Tomb Crags). Someone has learned the old song the Sun Kings used to drive the sand-wyrms, and now the great worms rise wherever the caller wishes, swallowing rival crews on the Sand-Sea and surfacing each month closer to the caravan roads. A soft-spoken desert-elf lore-singer knows fragments of the song and believes it can be answered, or broken, before the caller turns the worms on Oasis itself. Reward: 3,000 florins and the fragments of the song, for whoever dares sing them."}, {"id": "dun_sun_gold_curse", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Dunelands", "location": "Oasis", "text": "**Redeemed Gold** (The Sunfire Sanctum, Oasis). Across the realm, radiant blades blessed by the Sunfire Sanctum have begun whispering in their owners' sleep, and the whisper is always the same: return to the king. The weary old priest who has blessed tomb-gold for fifty years has stopped sleeping himself, and he fears the blessing never redeemed the gold at all, only hid who it still belongs to, and he wants the curse broken at its source. Reward: 2,500 florins and a blade he swears is truly clean."}]

offer_pool_league_data_025.name: offer_pool_league_data_025
offer_pool_league_data_025.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "hig_clipped_florins", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Dun Solas", "text": "**Light Coin on the Market Ring** (Market Ring, Dun Solas). Traders who change their money on the Market Ring keep finding their new florins shaved thin, and they blame the lodging house where they sleep. Its keeper, an anxious gnome who counts her spoons twice a night, is losing guests by the week and is sure one of the money-changers down the street is clipping the coin; she wants it proved and her house's name cleared before her guests. Reward: 45 florins and a free room at the lodging house whenever the party is in the city."}, {"id": "hig_spilled_shield_boss", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Clanhold Stonewall", "text": "**The Shield That Won't Hold Ale** (The Brimfull Boss, Clanhold Stonewall). Every time a certain young shielddwarf is toasted at the Brimfull Boss, the upturned shield he must drink from springs a leak and soaks him in front of the whole hall. The tapster, a red-faced shielddwarf who treats the shield custom as holier than the wall itself, wants whoever is tampering with his shields caught before the clan decides the lad is cursed. Reward: 40 florins and a toast from the boss in the party's honor, drunk properly."}, {"id": "hig_steam_sneak_thief", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Tethwell Hotsprings", "text": "**Lighter Purses at the Springs** (The Welcome House, Tethwell Hotsprings). Guests at Tethwell Hotsprings keep coming back from the pools to find their rings and purses gone from their folded clothes, and the Tethwell family's peace means no one may be searched by force. A brisk teenage Tethwell girl who hands out towels and misses nothing has three suspects among the regulars and wants help proving which one it is and getting the stolen goods back, without breaking the house rule. Reward: 35 florins and a season's free soaks in the private pools."}, {"id": "hig_watered_moot_ale", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Highheath", "location": "The Folkmoot", "text": "**Water in the Match Ale** (The Steaming Pools, The Folkmoot). Someone at the Folkmoot has been watering one contestant's ale in the drinking matches while a bookmaker by the pools takes the bets, and two proud families have now lost standing they will not forgive. The match judge, an ancient dwarf who swears he can taste a drop of water in a barrel, cannot prove it alone and wants the fix caught in the act and made public, so the rigged matches can be rerun or struck. Reward: 50 florins and a seat at the judge's own table for the next match."}, {"id": "hig_myconid_beds", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Dun Solas", "text": "**Mushrooms That Walk** (Farm Ring, Dun Solas). A colony of myconids, small walking mushroom-folk, has taken root in a terrace on the Farm Ring and spreads its spores into the prize beds every night, turning rare brewing mushrooms to mush. The terrace belongs to a dour old lichen-farmer who talks to her beds like grandchildren; she wants the myconids gone, though she admits they seem to be trying to talk back. Reward: 40 florins and a sack of her rarest brewing lichen."}, {"id": "hig_calf_stealing_eagle", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Clachmore Village", "text": "**The Eagle Over the Bull Pens** (The Bull Pens, Clachmore Village). A giant eagle stoops on the Clachmore calves most mornings and carries them up to an eyrie on a ledge too narrow for giantborn to climb. The gangly giantborn youth who keeps the bull pens is terrified of heights and ashamed of it, and he wants someone smaller to drive the eagle off, or to find out whether it can be taught to hunt somewhere else. Reward: 55 florins, or a good young heifer if the party would rather."}, {"id": "hig_gorge_cave_fisher", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Rocky Gorge", "text": "**Lines from the Gorge Walls** (The Gorge Mouth, Rocky Gorge). A cave fisher has made its lair high in the crevices at the Gorge Mouth and lowers its sticky line after dark, reeling up packs, pack-ponies, and now and then a sleeping traveler. A cheerful gnome tinker who sets up her stall there each season, selling rope and nerve to travelers too impatient for the long pass, is losing her customers and wants the thing brought down off the wall. Reward: 30 florins and the pick of the tinker's climbing gear."}, {"id": "hig_pier_crayfish", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Dun Solas", "text": "**Claws at the Lakebottom Piers** (Lakebottom, Dun Solas). Giant crayfish have started climbing the Lakebottom piers after dark to snap up the day's catch and anyone slow enough to be standing near it. The one-armed dwarf who works the rope-ferry to Lake Isle swears a crayfish took his other arm years ago, which nobody believes, and he wants the things cleared off his pier before they prove him right about someone else. Reward: 40 florins and free ferry crossings for a year."}, {"id": "hig_runaway_automaton", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Dun Solas", "text": "**The Clockwork That Got Away** (Craft Ring, Dun Solas). A clockwork creature the size of a fox is loose in the Craft Ring, slipping into workshops at night and making off with lenses, springs, and the odd gold hinge. The flustered halfling apprentice who built it from his master's scraps, without permission, needs it caught before his master learns whose it is, and he would dearly like it caught intact. Reward: 35 florins and a small clockwork trinket of the apprentice's making."}, {"id": "hig_bully_wrestler", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Tuskhollow", "text": "**Someone Has to Beat Him** (The Vale Common, Tuskhollow). A young giantborn wrestler at Tuskhollow has taken to challenging every visitor to the ring, and he breaks arms because no one is allowed to refuse. His grandmother, who still throws better than he does and says so, wants someone to humble him in fair sight, or to talk him into a contest he cannot win by brute strength. Reward: 60 florins from the grandmother and a place at the stead's next feast."}, {"id": "hig_barrow_looters", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Highheath", "location": "The Rumblehorn Run", "text": "**Diggers Among the Cairns** (The Old Cairns, The Rumblehorn Run). A pair of prospectors have been digging into the settled barrows at the Old Cairns by night, and cairns are coming down with them. The elderly dwarf who tends the cairns, and sings to the dead there every evening, wants them run off and the opened barrows sealed again before they break into something that should stay shut, and she is not sure it hasn't happened already. Reward: 40 florins and one old grave-gift the cairn-tender says the dead will not miss."}, {"id": "hig_shock_bracer_cheat", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Clanhold Stormhammer", "text": "**A Spark in the Grip** (The Flash and Boom, Clanhold Stormhammer). A newcomer to the Flash and Boom has won every arm-wrestle for a month, and every opponent swears their arm went numb with a crack like a lightning strike. The bellowing hammerdwarf who runs the bar, unbeaten himself for years until last week, is sure there is stormsteel hidden up the cheat's sleeve and wants it found without a riot. Reward: 45 florins and a tankard of storm-ale on the house every visit."}]

offer_pool_league_data_026.name: offer_pool_league_data_026
offer_pool_league_data_026.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "hig_pier_protection", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Dun Solas", "text": "**Nobody Pays at the Landings** (Lakebottom, Dun Solas). Reward: 130 florins from the herd-warden and a wheel of highland cheese."}, {"id": "hig_steam_eavesdropper", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Tethwell Hotsprings", "text": "**Whispers in the Steam** (The Pools, Tethwell Hotsprings). The springs' whole standing rests on trust, and a sharp-eared Tethwell niece who works the pools wants the blackmailer found among the guests before the clans decide the family itself is selling secrets. Reward: 180 florins and a standing welcome at the springs for the whole party."}, {"id": "hig_bribed_lift_judge", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Highheath", "location": "The Folkmoot", "text": "**The Lift That Didn't Count** (The Contest Ground, The Folkmoot). A young dwarf stone-lifter at the Folkmoot has cleanly raised a stone no dwarf in years has lifted, and had it ruled a fault three times running by the same judge. He is honest to a fault and will not hear a word against the Moot, but his whole family is sure the judge has been paid, and they want it proved, or the lad given a fairly judged lift, before he quits for good. Reward: 100 florins from his family and a feast in the party's honor at the Moot."}, {"id": "hig_rumblehorn_wargs", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Highheath", "location": "The Rumblehorn Run", "text": "**The Pack in the Crags** (The Warg Crags, The Rumblehorn Run). The wargs of the high crags have stopped waiting for stragglers and started running rustling crews down on the Glen Floor, cutting a dwarf from the herd the way they would a calf. A scarred hammerdwarf rustler who lost her brother to the pack's grey leader wants it dead, and will fight beside anyone who will go up into the crags with her. Reward: 160 florins and the rustler's cut of her next prize beast."}, {"id": "hig_narrows_bulette", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Rocky Gorge", "text": "**Something Under the Narrows** (The Narrows, Rocky Gorge). A bulette has taken to burrowing beneath the clearings of Rocky Gorge's Narrows, bursting up under the abandoned camps to swallow whoever is resting there. Fror Stormhammer, a young hammerdwarf who hunts the gorge the clans will not clear, has learned to tell the ground it is under, and wants a crew to help him draw it up and kill it. Reward: 170 florins and a bulette-plate buckler, if the party can carry one."}, {"id": "hig_canopy_carrion_crawlers", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Dun Solas", "text": "**Kelpies Among the Shrines** (Lake Isle, Dun Solas). Kelpies have come up out of the lake shallows into the mushroom canopy of Lake Isle, and they appear to lone pilgrims at prayer as gentle grey horses, then carry off whoever climbs on into the lake. A soft-spoken dwarf shrine-keeper wants them gone, but will not allow a single mushroom burned or a shrine stone moved, and he means it. Reward: 140 florins and the shrine-keeper's blessing at the ancestor stones."}, {"id": "hig_pasture_bugbears", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Clachmore Village", "text": "**Ambush on the Summer Pasture** (The Drove Road, Clachmore Village). A band of bugbears has taken the rocks above Clachmore's drove road and ambushes the herd whenever it passes, dragging off cattle and any drover who chases them, and the summer drive cannot go up while they hold the heights. The chief's headstrong daughter means to drive the herd past them anyway to prove herself, and wants the bugbears dealt with first, or failing that, someone beside her who can keep them off the cattle. Reward: 190 florins or two fine highland cattle, and the daughter's lasting friendship."}, {"id": "hig_battlement_perytons", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Clanhold Stormhammer", "text": "**Stags on the Wind** (The High Battlements, Clanhold Stormhammer). A flock of perytons, winged stags that hunt people, has nested among the lightning rods of Clanhold Stormhammer's high walls, and they have plucked two sentries straight off the parapet. The only sentry still keeping a full watch is a half-blind old hammerdwarf who swears he can hear them coming, and he wants help clearing the rods before the clan loses anyone else. Reward: 150 florins and a Stormhammer dagger with a stormsteel edge."}, {"id": "hig_vent_mephits", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Dun Solas", "text": "**The Pools That Laugh** (The Warm Pools, Dun Solas). The Warm Pools keep turning scalding without warning, and the bathers who jump out hear giggling from the vents below. An elderly human attendant who has worked the pools for decades says the water is laughing at her; she wants whatever is down there found and stopped before the outlanders who keep the place in business stop coming. Reward: 110 florins and a lifetime pass to the Warm Pools."}, {"id": "hig_captive_camp_cook", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Highheath", "location": "The Crookback", "text": "**The Cook Who Stayed** (The Narrows, The Crookback). The goatfolk bandits of the Crookback took a caravan's cook as 'clan dues' this spring and have kept him at their fires ever since. His caravan wants him back, but word from the Narrows is that the round, cheerful dwarf is feeding the whole warren, has been given a horned helmet, and is in no hurry at all. Reward: 120 florins from the caravan, and a meal the cook swears is worth more."}]

offer_pool_league_data_027.name: offer_pool_league_data_027
offer_pool_league_data_027.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "hig_walking_armor", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Clanhold Stonewall", "text": "**The Suit That Walks** (The Armory-Hall, Clanhold Stonewall). A masterwork suit of plate in the Armory-Hall climbs down from its rack at night and beats the apprentices bloody, then is back on its stand, gleaming, by morning. The meticulous shielddwarf who forged it will not have it melted, and wants to know what got into her armor and how to put it out without a scratch on the plate. Reward: 180 florins and a piece of Stonewall armor made to fit."}, {"id": "hig_forged_brands", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Highheath", "location": "The Rumblehorn Run", "text": "**Both Brands on One Hide** (The Glen Floor, The Rumblehorn Run). Rumblehorns on the Glen Floor keep turning up with both a Stonewall and a Stormhammer brand on the same hide, and each clan swears the other did it on purpose. A laconic human drover who hires on to whichever clan pays best knows someone is forging both marks and selling the same beasts to both clans, and would consider telling for the right price; the clans need the forger exposed to both of them and the doubled beasts settled. Reward: 130 florins, and a rumblehorn calf if the party can get it home."}, {"id": "hig_sham_matchmaker", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Dun Solas", "text": "**A Most Advantageous Match** (High Ring, Dun Solas). A marriage broker has been matching High Ring families with suitors from the clan halls, taking a fat fee, and then watching the suitors vanish before the wedding. A proud widowed merchant who has just paid for her son's match refuses to believe she was fooled and wants the suitor found, but someone ought to find the broker first and get the families' fees back. Reward: 200 florins from the widow, if she can bring herself to admit why."}, {"id": "hig_turncoat_factor", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Dun Solas", "text": "**Someone Upstairs Is Selling Us** (The Wetted Whistle, Dun Solas). The goatfolk of the Crookback always seem to know which caravans carry stormsteel and when they leave, and the timing is too good to be luck. Jannik Copperbell, the Trade Guild's young host at the Wetted Whistle, believes one of the factors upstairs is selling the schedules, and he needs outsiders to prove it because accusing his own superiors would end him. Reward: 400 florins, quietly, and Jannik's word to the Guild on the party's behalf."}, {"id": "hig_bought_council_votes", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Dun Solas", "text": "**A Seat for Sale** (Trade Guild Headquarters, Dun Solas). Council votes in Dun Solas have started tilting toward one of the clans, and the factors who negotiate at the Trade Guild whisper that a clan agent is buying them one debt at a time. A silver-bearded merchant councillor who has refused the agent's offer, and now sleeps with a loaded crossbow, wants the buying exposed and the bought votes recast without handing the other clan an excuse to start a feud. Reward: 450 florins and the councillor's goodwill in city business."}, {"id": "hig_span_firebrand", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Clanhold Stormhammer", "text": "**Too Many Toasts to the Fallen** (The Thunder-Court, Clanhold Stormhammer). Someone in the Thunder-Court has been stirring the young hammerdwarves with speeches about the Day at Varric's Span, and every night the crowd is bigger and the talk of making Stonewall pay is louder. A weary Stormhammer skald who lost kin that day and wants no more graves is asking for help to find the agitator's backers and turn the crowd before they march. Reward: 350 florins and a verse in the party's honor in the skald's next saga."}, {"id": "hig_drunken_oath", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Highheath", "location": "The Folkmoot", "text": "**An Oath He Doesn't Remember** (The Steaming Pools, The Folkmoot). A swindler at the Folkmoot's pools has been getting clan heirs drunk and walking them to the Stone of Bonds to swear away grazing rights and mine-shares, and an oath sworn there binds. A furious young heir who woke up having sworn away half his family's summer grazing wants the swindler caught and a way found to undo the oath, perhaps by a contest before the Stone, before his father hears. Reward: 300 florins and a share of the next summer's grazing rent."}, {"id": "hig_blocked_drove_road", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Tuskhollow", "text": "**The Road They Say Is Theirs** (The Vale Common, Tuskhollow). The Tuskhollow giantborn have closed the Stormhammer drove-road through their vale, and every dwarf herd that tries it is turned back with broken bones. The stead is led by an enormous giantborn mother of nine who will only talk terms with someone who has wrestled her first, and she has not lost a bout in anyone's memory. Reward: 480 florins from the Stormhammer herders and a giantborn wrestling-belt if the party earns one."}, {"id": "hig_forge_air_elemental", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Clanhold Stormhammer", "text": "**Something Came Down the Rods** (The Stormforge, Clanhold Stormhammer). A lightning strike brought more than lightning down the conductor-rods of the Stormforge: a raging air elemental that now tears through the hall with every storm, scattering coals and throwing smiths into the walls. The master war-smith, whose eyebrows burned off decades ago, wants it bound, banished, or beaten before it wrecks the anvils, and privately wonders whether it could be put to work. Reward: 450 florins and a stormsteel weapon from the forge."}, {"id": "hig_thunder_road_behir", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Storm Crag", "text": "**The Lightning Serpent** (The Thunder Road, Storm Crag). A behir, a many-legged lightning serpent, has come down from Storm Crag to hunt the lower Thunder Road, swallowing climbers whole. A wiry hammerdwarf war-smith wants it dead for the lightning gland in its throat, which she swears will make the finest stormsteel in a generation, but only if it reaches her forge still crackling. Reward: 500 florins and first choice of the stormsteel forged from the gland."}, {"id": "hig_eye_griffons", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Dun Solas", "text": "**Griffons at the Eye** (Edge of the Eye, Dun Solas). A pair of griffons has nested on the rim of the Eye and dives on the pulley-lifts as they descend, tearing at the ropes and snatching anything that looks like food. The whistling old gnome who cranks the main lift has kept it running anyway, but the ropes will not hold much longer; the griffons are guarding eggs, and those eggs are worth a fortune to the right rider. Reward: 380 florins from the city, and whatever an honest trainer will pay for an egg."}, {"id": "hig_cairn_wraiths", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Highheath", "location": "The Rumblehorn Run", "text": "**The Barrows Are Open** (The Old Cairns, The Rumblehorn Run). Wraiths drift out of the split barrows at the Old Cairns every night now, and rustling crews on the upper droveway have been found cold and grey by morning. A young Stonewall rune-reader whose grandsire lies in the oldest barrow wants them put back to rest and the barrows sealed, and dreads what she will find at her grandsire's tomb. Reward: 420 florins and a silver-chased rune-charm against the dead."}]

offer_pool_league_data_028.name: offer_pool_league_data_028
offer_pool_league_data_028.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "hig_herd_gorgon", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Clachmore Village", "text": "**An Iron Bull in the Herd** (The Village Green, Clachmore Village). Something has been grazing among Clachmore's herds by night, and the drovers who went to look were found turned to stone beside their cattle. The Stone-Born chief, thirty years in the chair and still unbeaten in the wrestling ring, is sure it is a gorgon, an iron-hided bull whose breath petrifies, and he means to wrestle it himself unless someone brings it down first. Reward: 480 florins or a prize breeding bull, and a feast that shakes the valley."}, {"id": "hig_clockwork_songbirds", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Dun Solas", "text": "**The Birds Are Listening** (Craft Ring, Dun Solas). Clockwork songbirds from a Craft Ring workshop have become the fashionable gift in the High Ring, and Svala Durn, a composed dwarf runecaster of the Craft Ring, has found that the one she was given remembers every word said near it. She wants to know who built them, who collects what they hear, and how many rich households are already bugged. Reward: 400 florins and a ward-rune from Svala against listening devices."}, {"id": "hig_springs_assassin", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Tethwell Hotsprings", "text": "**A Killer Among the Guests** (The Steam Road, Tethwell Hotsprings). Word has come that an assassin is lodging at Tethwell Hotsprings, waiting for a particular thane to soak, and if blood is spilled in the springs' peace every clan will blame the Tethwells. The towering giantborn doorwarden at the Steam Road, who in twenty years has never had to throw anyone out, wants the killer found among the guests and removed without breaking the peace himself. Reward: 450 florins from the Tethwell family and a debt they will remember."}, {"id": "hig_goatfolk_recognition", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Highheath", "location": "The Crookback", "text": "**A Clan by Any Other Name** (The Gullies, The Crookback). The goatfolk bandit thane of the Crookback has sent a herald to Dun Solas offering to leave the high road alone for a season if the dwarves formally greet him as a thane. The herald, a pompous goatfolk in stolen dwarf finery who takes etiquette deadly seriously, will lead a crew into the Gullies to parley, and nobody knows whether to treat it as a trap, an opening, or a chance to end the bandits for good. Reward: 350 florins from the Trade Guild, and whatever the thane considers a gift."}, {"id": "hig_ringwall_xorn", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Clanhold Stonewall", "text": "**Someone Is Inside the Walls** (The Ringwalls, Clanhold Stonewall). Strongrooms deep inside Clanhold Stonewall's ringwalls keep turning up empty of gold and gems, with every lock and door untouched. The wall-captain is mortified, because the clan boasts to every visitor that no one has ever broken in; she wants the thief found quietly, and some of her guards whisper that whatever it is came through the stone itself. Reward: 480 florins and a Stonewall shield, if the party can keep the secret."}, {"id": "hig_trollwife_squatter", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Rocky Gorge", "text": "**The Trolls Want Help** (The Narrows, Rocky Gorge). A hill giant has moved into the upper caves of Rocky Gorge and is bullying even the mountain trolls who lair there. Tina, a sharp-eyed troll of the gorge who keeps her braid and her cave neater than any dwarf, has let it be known through a terrified peddler that she and her husband Barp will leave travelers alone for a year if someone rids them of the giant. Reward: 300 florins from the clans who use the pass, and whatever the trolls consider payment."}, {"id": "hig_wedding_provocateurs", "kind": "social", "rank": "gold", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Dun Solas", "text": "**Not Another Wedding** (Market Ring, Dun Solas). Dun Solas is readying a new Stonewall and Stormhammer wedding on the Market Ring, and everyone remembers that the last one became a three-day, five-ring riot. The harried gnome caterer hired for the feast, who hid under a table through the last one, has heard her staff being offered coin to hand certain guests certain toasts, and wants the plot stopped before the city picks sides again. Reward: 1,200 florins from the merchant council, and a place of honor at the feast."}, {"id": "hig_giantborn_warchief", "kind": "social", "rank": "gold", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Tuskhollow", "text": "**The Steads Are Gathering** (The Bull-Pens, Tuskhollow). A giantborn war-chief is going stead to stead calling the giantborn to push the dwarves off every meadow the first giants ever walked, and more steads answer every week. A gentle giantborn bull-breeder at Tuskhollow, who would rather talk to his bulls than fight anyone, wants the war-chief stopped before his whole stead marches, and knows the one challenge the war-chief cannot refuse. Reward: 1,000 florins from the dwarf clans, and a Tuskhollow bull named for the party."}, {"id": "hig_iris_extortion", "kind": "social", "rank": "gold", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Dun Solas", "text": "**They Have the Iris** (Edge of the Eye, Dun Solas). A band of extortionists has taken the winding-gear of the Iris, the great metal shutter over the Eye, and threatens to close it, cutting off Dun Solas from light, lifts, and air, unless the council pays every month. The stooped old Iris-keeper they threw out knows every gear by touch and a way back in, and wants a crew willing to take it back or to talk the gang down before they grow bored and close it anyway. Reward: 1,500 florins from the merchant council."}, {"id": "hig_span_troll_band", "kind": "monster", "rank": "gold", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Varric's Span", "text": "**The Trolls Are Massing Again** (The Spans, Varric's Span). The trolls under Varric's Span have grown into a war-band that no longer waits for night, and the great trade road across the gorge is closing, as it did before the Day. A small gnome lamplighter who has kept fires burning on the bridges for thirty years, the only reason crews still cross at dusk, wants the band broken before it overruns the spans, and knows that only fire keeps them down. Reward: 1,400 florins from the Trade Guild and both clans, a rare joint payment."}, {"id": "hig_run_ettin_warlord", "kind": "monster", "rank": "gold", "region": "Highheath", "location": "The Rumblehorn Run", "text": "**Two Heads Over the Run** (The Droveway, The Rumblehorn Run). An ettin warlord and the ogres who follow him have seized the Rumblehorn Run, penning the herd for themselves and smashing any clan crew that comes for a beast. An ancient giantborn herd-singer who can calm a stampede with her voice says the ettin's two heads hate each other more than they hate the dwarves, and that a clever crew could turn the herd, or the heads, against him. Reward: 1,100 florins from both clans, and the herd-singer's gratitude, which is worth something at every stead."}, {"id": "hig_farm_ring_umber_hulk", "kind": "monster", "rank": "gold", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Dun Solas", "text": "**Tunnels Under the Terraces** (Farm Ring, Dun Solas). A rampaging earth elemental has been moving up through the rock under the Farm Ring, collapsing terraces from beneath and swallowing whole rows of beds. The unflappable dwarf terrace-warden has already sealed three of its passages herself, and wants it hunted down in the dark before it moves under the ring roads and brings a tier of the city down. Reward: 1,300 florins from the city and a share of the next rare-mushroom harvest."}]

offer_pool_league_data_029.name: offer_pool_league_data_029
offer_pool_league_data_029.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "hig_cursed_thunder_hammer", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "gold", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Clanhold Stormhammer", "text": "**The Hammer That Calls the Storm** (The Thunder-Court, Clanhold Stormhammer). An ancient Stormhammer thunder-hammer, recovered from the gorge at Varric's Span, now calls lightning down on whoever holds it, and on everyone nearby. The clan's reckless young heir has claimed it anyway, swears he will carry it to the next Moot, and will not put it down; the clan wants the curse broken, or the hammer given up of his own free will, before he calls the storm down on the whole Thunder-Court. Reward: 1,200 florins and a Stormhammer warhammer of the party's choice."}, {"id": "hig_stone_breaker", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "gold", "region": "Highheath", "location": "The Folkmoot", "text": "**Cracks in the Stone of Bonds** (The Crossing, The Folkmoot). Hairline cracks have started showing in the Stone of Bonds, and a hedge-mage who takes lodgings at the Crossing every Moot has been seen at it after dark. The Stone's warden, a blind giantborn who says she can feel every oath sworn before it, warns that if the Stone breaks, every oath in Highheath breaks with it, and old grudges will come due all at once. Reward: 1,500 florins from the clans jointly, and an oath of friendship sworn before the Stone."}, {"id": "hig_stormsteel_dragon", "kind": "monster", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Clanhold Stormhammer", "text": "**The Drake Wants Stormsteel** (The High Battlements, Clanhold Stormhammer). A great fire drake, drawn by the heat of the stormsteel forges, now circles Clanhold Stormhammer and demands half of every stormsteel forging as tribute, burning a battlement each time it is refused. The Stormhammer thane, all swagger and bigger boasts, means to charge it with the whole clan, which would be glorious and fatal; the realm's armies depend on that stormsteel, and the Council wants the drake dealt with before the thane gets his way. Reward: 4,000 florins, a stormsteel masterwork, and the thane's everlasting envy."}, {"id": "hig_lake_aboleth", "kind": "monster", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Dun Solas", "text": "**Something in Lake Two-Waters** (Lake Isle, Dun Solas). Pilgrims to the shrines of Lake Isle have begun walking into Lake Two-Waters and not coming up, and those who are pulled out speak with one voice about something vast and patient in the underground rivers. An old ancestor-priest who hears it now in every prayer is sure it is an aboleth, rising from the deep water, and he wants it found and killed before it owns the minds of a city. Reward: 4,500 florins from the merchant council and the Council's seal of thanks."}, {"id": "hig_clan_war_hawks", "kind": "social", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Dun Solas", "text": "**The City Between Two Hammers** (High Ring, Dun Solas). War-hawks in both the Stonewall and Stormhammer kin-halls are preparing to seize Dun Solas outright, each certain the other will strike first, and a war between them would break the realm's stormsteel and armor trade overnight. The city's oldest councillor, a tiny gnome who has kept the two clans from open feud for fifty years, has a plan to pull both sides back, and needs a crew bold enough to carry it into both halls. Reward: 3,500 florins from the merchant council and the Council, and the freedom of Dun Solas."}, {"id": "hig_span_reconciliation", "kind": "social", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Varric's Span", "text": "**Peace at Varric's Span** (The Approach, Varric's Span). Both clans have agreed, for the first time since the Day, to meet at Varric's Span and swear an end to the grudge, and a band of assassins from both sides means to turn that meeting into a second massacre. An aged Stonewall shield-mother, who held the wall that day and watched the Stormhammers die, has pledged to stand with them and wants the assassins found before the oath is sworn. Reward: 3,000 florins from both clans, and a place in the song they will sing about it."}, {"id": "hig_stone_giant_bond", "kind": "social", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Clachmore Village", "text": "**The Giants Call in the Debt** (The Village Green, Clachmore Village). A stone giant elder has come down from the peaks to Clachmore demanding the giantborn honor an ancient bond and march against the Laughing Jarl, and she has made clear that a refusal will be taken as an insult by every giant in the mountains. The Stone-Born's ancient lore-singer is the only one who remembers the true terms of that bond, and wants a crew to help her argue it before the whole valley goes to war on one side or another. Reward: 2,500 florins from the clans and the Council, and a giant's gift of carved stone."}, {"id": "hig_summit_mind_flayer", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Tethwell Hotsprings", "text": "**One of the Thanes Is Not Himself** (The Welcome House, Tethwell Hotsprings). The thanes of Highheath and envoys of the Council are meeting in secret at Tethwell Hotsprings to settle the region's future, and one of them has begun speaking in another's words. The seventy-year-old Tethwell matriarch, sharp as broken glass, suspects a spirit naga coiled somewhere in the springs is charming a thane like a puppet, and wants it found and the thane freed without a single accusation made in error among the realm's most powerful guests. Reward: 3,000 florins from the Council and a secret the matriarch has kept for decades."}, {"id": "hig_meadow_golem", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Highheath", "location": "Tuskhollow", "text": "**The Meadow Stood Up** (The High Meadow, Tuskhollow). Digging over boundary-stones woke something under Tuskhollow's High Meadow: a stone golem the size of a hill, made in the first age, that walks a little farther toward the dwarf country every night. The wide-eyed giantborn herd-child who saw it stand up swears it spoke, and both the giantborn and the dwarves insist it is walking to prove their claim; someone must stop it or turn it aside before it reaches any hold. Reward: 4,000 florins from the clans and the Council, and whatever the golem was made to guard."}, {"id": "ntv_drum_troupe_sabotage", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Durg Sthira", "text": "**Slashed Drumskins at the Thunderfoot** (The Thunderfoot, Durg Sthira). Every week someone slashes the drumskins or waters the reed pipes of the troupe booked for the Thunderfoot's stone stage, and every week it is the same troupe that loses its night. Their drum-master, an old gajanari with a bad hip and a perfect memory for grudges, is sure a rival troupe is behind it and is about to settle it with his fists. Reward: 40 florins and a seat at the drum-master's table for the next feast night."}, {"id": "ntv_forge_rust_monster", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Durg Sthira", "text": "**Something Eats the Mail Shirts** (The Forge Quarter, Durg Sthira). A rust monster has found its way up from the river quays and comes back most nights to eat the finished mail and blades off one smithy's racks. The young gajanari armorer whose racks they are has been hiding the losses from her mother, the smithy's master, and wants it caught or driven off before the next inventory gives her away. Reward: 50 florins and a well-fitted piece of armor from her own hand."}]

offer_pool_league_data_030.name: offer_pool_league_data_030
offer_pool_league_data_030.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "ntv_goat_vampire_bats", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Revanasi Village", "text": "**Dusk on the Terraces** (The Greattree, Revanasi Village). A colony of giant vampire bats roosts somewhere in the orchards above Revanasi and comes down at dusk to drain the goats penned by the Greattree, and lately it has started trying the villagers too. A fierce little catkin goatherd who has named every goat in the pen wants them gone, and she has a list of the ones she has lost. Reward: 35 florins and free fish at the winning stall whenever you pass through."}, {"id": "ntv_feral_imp", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "New Anthara", "text": "**The Imp Who Taught Pickpockets** (The Dock Market, New Anthara). Reward: 45 florins from the handler and a well-behaved imp's service for a week."}, {"id": "ntv_training_ground_wasps", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Mounagiri", "text": "**Wasps on the Trial Routes** (The Training Ground, Mounagiri). The innkeeper, a weary monkeyfolk who keeps a chalk tally of guests hurt on dares, wants the game ended without insulting the warriors so badly that they start a real fight. Reward: 35 florins and a hammock on the terrace at no charge."}, {"id": "ntv_fake_antidotes", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Shilaghar", "text": "**Antidotes That Cure Nothing** (The Dispensary, Shilaghar).
