The apothecary, a serpentkin more amused than angry, wants the peddler found and his bottles gone before the mark stops meaning anything. Reward: 45 florins and a real antidote kit from the apothecary's own stall."}, {"id": "ntv_sleeping_croc_wisp", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Revanasi Village", "text": "**Lights Under the Sleeping Croc** (The Sleeping Croc, Revanasi Village). On misty nights a pale light bobs along the riverbank below the Sleeping Croc, and drinkers who follow it wake up waist-deep in the mud with their purses gone. The village is starting to blame the old crocodile that suns itself there, and the half-orc keeper of the common-house, who swears the croc has never hurt anyone, wants the real culprit found before someone spears it. Reward: 30 florins and a jar of the common-house's best rice wine."}, {"id": "ntv_rigged_dock_dice", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Kalanth Landing", "text": "**Loaded Dice on the Landing** (The River Bend, Kalanth Landing). A dice-runner among the barge crews at Kalanth Landing wins every night and leaves the new dockhands owing him a season's wages, then sends his friends to collect. The old demonborn warehouse watchman sees everything on that dock and says nothing, but he has let it be known that he would say something to the right people; the dockhands want the game broken and their debts to him wiped. Reward: 40 florins from the dockhands and the watchman's goodwill, which is worth more on this dock."}, {"id": "ntv_chapterhouse_specter", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Durg Sthira", "text": "**The Trophies Keep Moving** (The League Chapterhouse, Durg Sthira). Every morning the mounted tusks and relic fragments in the League Chapterhouse have moved in the night, and last week one came down on a visiting hunter's table. The gajanari clerk who keeps the hall remembers exactly where every trophy has hung for forty years and finds this unbearable, and she thinks a specter came in with one of the newer pieces. Reward: 50 florins and a trophy of your own on the chapterhouse wall."}, {"id": "ntv_float_snapping_turtle", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Sangamadi", "text": "**Keep Your Feet Out of the Water** (The Float, Sangamadi). A giant snapping turtle has taken to lurking under the Float's platforms in the evenings, biting through mooring lines and snapping at anyone who dangles a foot over the edge. The frogkin grandmother who hosts the evening tables refuses to move them an inch, and wants the turtle caught, moved, or eaten, in roughly that order of preference. Reward: 35 florins and a place at the grandmother's table, where the best stories are told."}, {"id": "ntv_garden_heir_duels", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "New Anthara", "text": "**Blood in the Burned Garden** (The Burned Garden, New Anthara). The heirs of two powerful New Anthara families keep meeting in the Burned Garden's pavilions on festival nights to fight with real blades, and their friends have started joining in. The demonborn pavilion-keeper has mended the same fountain eleven times and buried one bystander, and he wants the feud ended before the families take it into the streets. Reward: 150 florins from the garden's keepers and a standing table at the best pavilion."}, {"id": "ntv_proving_yard_sabotage", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Durg Sthira", "text": "**Armor That Fails the Trial** (The Proving Yard, Durg Sthira). One forge-family's armor keeps cracking at the Proving Yard trials that decide which smiths arm the war-forgers, and someone is weakening the rivets the night before. The rival family's own champion, a gruff gajanari war-forger who hates winning by default, has quietly asked the League to find out who, because he suspects it is his own kin. Reward: 180 florins and a masterwork buckle or clasp forged by the war-forger himself."}]

offer_pool_league_data_031.name: offer_pool_league_data_031
offer_pool_league_data_031.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "ntv_pilot_boat_wreckers", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Sangamadi", "text": "**Holes in the Pilots' Boats** (The Docks, Sangamadi). Sangamadi's pilot families have always competed for the rich upriver contracts, but this season someone is paying bruisers to hole the boats of one family's pilots at their moorings. That family's senior pilot, an unhurried frogkin who has never lost a boat on the river and does not intend to lose one at the dock, wants the bruisers stopped and their paymaster named. Reward: 140 florins and a free piloted passage above the confluence."}, {"id": "ntv_relic_map_swindler", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Kalanth Landing", "text": "**Maps to Nowhere** (The Great Hall, Kalanth Landing). A charming guest at Kalanth Landing has been selling the other guests maps to untouched vaults in the Swallowed Cities, and at least one buyer has not come back from looking. The demonborn house steward cannot throw out a guest without proof and cannot afford the scandal of a second disappearance, so he wants the swindler exposed quietly and the maps shown for what they are. Reward: 160 florins from the steward and an invitation to the next feast in the Great Hall."}, {"id": "ntv_stone_market_feud", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Citadel Uchaghar", "text": "**A Jeweler Among the Vanarin** (The Stone Market, Citadel Uchaghar). A gajanari jeweler has kept a carved stall in Uchaghar's Stone Market for years, and now a gang of young Vanarin toughs has decided the old feud between their peoples means she should go, and they overturn her trays every market day. She is far too proud to pack up, and she wants the harassment ended in a way that does not make her the cause of a new fight. Reward: 120 florins and a ring of her making, which is worth more than the coin."}, {"id": "ntv_hookmarsh_ransom_skimmer", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "The Hookmarsh", "text": "**The Ransom That Never Arrives** (The Reedways, The Hookmarsh). The lizardfolk of Hookmarsh return captives when the ransom is paid, and a frogkin boatwife has paid for her husband twice through the go-between who brokers such deals, and he is still held. She is frantic and certain the broker is pocketing the money, and she wants someone to go into the Reedways with her, find out, and bring her husband home. Reward: 130 florins, most of what she has left, and a boatwife's lifelong gratitude."}, {"id": "ntv_goliath_boar_trample", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "The Greatwild", "text": "**The Herd on the Trample** (The Trample, The Greatwild). A herd of goliath boars has taken to charging through the hunting camps on the Trample at dawn, flattening tents and boats alike, and three crews have gone back downriver with broken legs. A one-tusked half-orc hunter who admires the beasts rather too much wants the herd turned away from the camps, and he would rather it be done with fire and noise than with spears. Reward: 150 florins and a pair of goliath boar tusks from the hunter's own stock."}, {"id": "ntv_scarab_swarm_camps", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "The Swallowed Cities", "text": "**The Clicking in the Streets** (The Strangled Ways, The Swallowed Cities). A carrion swarm of goliath scarabs moves through the Strangled Ways every few nights, stripping relic crews' camps of food, leather, and anyone too slow to run. A catkin relic-digger who sings loudly to keep her nerve has worked out roughly where the swarm nests, and she wants a crew willing to go down there with her and end it. Reward: 170 florins and first pick of her crew's next find."}, {"id": "ntv_bridge_harpies", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Mounagiri", "text": "**Wings Over the Gorge** (The Cliff Village, Mounagiri). A flock of pteranodons has nested under the overhangs of Mounagiri's gorge, and at dusk they sweep the vine bridges and pluck walkers off them into the drop. The Mounari bridge-weaver who keeps the crossings, a quiet chameleon-kin who flushes grey whenever she is nervous, has been grey for a week and wants the flock gone. Reward: 160 florins and a vine-woven climbing harness from the bridge-weaver."}, {"id": "ntv_venom_garden_vine", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Shilaghar", "text": "**The Vine Left Its Bed** (The Venom Gardens, Shilaghar). An assassin vine grown for its sap has rooted its way out of the walled bed at the bottom of the Venom Gardens and now waits among the venomwood rows, seizing any tender who walks too close. A veiled serpentkin tender with a dry gallows humor says the vine is doing exactly what it was bred for and would like it cut back, burned out, or somehow coaxed home. Reward: 140 florins and a vial of its sap, which the tender assures you is extremely useful."}, {"id": "ntv_old_anthara_ghouls", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "New Anthara", "text": "**Empty Graves in Old Anthara** (Old Anthara, New Anthara). Ghouls have come up out of the overgrown tombs at the back of Old Anthara, first emptying fresh graves and now dragging off the sleeping poor. The demonborn street-priest who buries the quarter's dead for free has been keeping watch alone with a lamp and a cudgel, and he would like help destroying them and sealing the tombs before the ghouls come for him. Reward: 130 florins, gathered coin by coin by the quarter, and the priest's blessing."}, {"id": "ntv_grey_college_golem", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Durg Sthira", "text": "**Footsteps in the Grey College** (The Grey College, Durg Sthira). Something heavy walks the Grey College halls at night, cracking doors and smashing warded cabinets, and the masters suspect a runaway construct. The nervous gajanari student who built a clay golem for her trials and has not seen it for a week has worked out that it is hers, and she wants it stopped without anyone learning that before her trials. Reward: 150 florins and a small enchanted trinket from the student's workroom."}, {"id": "ntv_rogue_hellhound", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "New Anthara", "text": "**The Hound That Will Not Heel** (Dravanya Hold, New Anthara). One of the hellhounds that guard the terraces above New Anthara has stopped answering to anyone and savages whoever comes near its terrace. The hold wants it destroyed, but the demonborn trainer who raised it refuses to put a beast down and is sure something is being done to it, and she will only hand it over to someone who finds out what first. Reward: 180 florins and the trainer's offer to teach you the basics of handling an infernal beast."}, {"id": "ntv_frayed_rope_launch", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Citadel Uchaghar", "text": "**The Cut Rope** (The Rope Launch, Citadel Uchaghar). Twice this month a braided rope at the Rope Launch has parted under a Vanarin warrior in mid-drill, and both times the break was too clean to be wear. The scarred drill-master who trusts no rope he did not braid himself wants the saboteur found, and he suspects it is someone inside the citadel who is afraid of losing a coming contest. Reward: 160 florins and a run down the ropes with the drill-master, if you dare."}]

offer_pool_league_data_032.name: offer_pool_league_data_032
offer_pool_league_data_032.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "ntv_throne_dais_claim_jumpers", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "The Swallowed Cities", "text": "**The Crew on the Throne-Dais** (The Royal Court, The Swallowed Cities). A relic crew has dug in on the throne-dais of the Royal Court and ambushes anyone who comes within bowshot of the carved walls, which they are prying apart panel by panel. An elderly demonborn stone-reader who has spent years copying those carvings wants them left whole, and she does not much care whether the crew is talked off the dais, bought off, or thrown off it. Reward: 170 florins and the stone-reader's copy of a carving that hints at a buried vault."}, {"id": "ntv_floodforest_canopy_tiger", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "The Greatwild", "text": "**The One at the Back** (The Floodforest, The Greatwild). A canopy tiger hunts the channels of the Floodforest from above, dropping on whoever sits at the back of a boat and gone before the rest can turn, and it has taken four hunters this season. A silent frogkin tracker who bets on everything has put money on finding its lair within three days and wants a crew able to finish what she finds. Reward: 400 florins, the tiger's pelt if it is taken, and half the tracker's winnings."}, {"id": "ntv_river_drake_boats", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "The Greatwild", "text": "**The Drake on the Open River** (The Open River, The Greatwild). A boastful demonborn hunt-captain with a brand new boat means to take it and wants a crew who can hold their nerve when it rises beside the hull. Reward: 450 florins and a share of the drake's hide and fangs."}, {"id": "ntv_toppled_spire_apes", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "The Swallowed Cities", "text": "**Stones From the Spire** (The Toppled Spire, The Swallowed Cities). A grizzled catkin climber who lost her crew on that tower wants to go back up, and she needs people who can break the troop or find a way past it. Reward: 350 florins and a share of whatever the upper chambers hold."}, {"id": "ntv_workshop_gorgon", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Shilaghar", "text": "**A Student Turned to Stone** (The Workshops, Shilaghar). A gorgon kept for the gland that makes its petrifying breath broke out of its pen in Shilaghar's Workshops and now stamps among the stills, and the master alchemist's best student is standing in the east hall as a statue. The master, a serpentkin who has never raised her voice about anything, calmly wants the iron bull caught alive, because the cure for her student is in that gland. Reward: 400 florins and a set of the master's own antidotes, including the rare one."}, {"id": "ntv_still_pool_naga", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Sangamadi", "text": "**Something Lives in the Still Pool** (The Still Pool, Sangamadi). A water naga has coiled into the sacred Still Pool and demands offerings from every frogkin who comes to pray, and the ones who bring too little are dragged under. The pool-keeper, sworn to silence at the water's edge, communicates in patient gestures and tea, and makes it clear that killing the naga in the pool would defile it, so it must be bargained out or lured away. Reward: 350 florins from the village and the right to sit by the Still Pool whenever you wish."}, {"id": "ntv_landing_night_smugglers", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Kalanth Landing", "text": "**Boats That Land After Dark** (The River Bend, Kalanth Landing). Unlit boats have been putting in at Kalanth Landing's private moorings after midnight and unloading crates that smell of old graves, and an heir of the estate says the family knows nothing about it and wants it stopped discreetly. He is smooth, generous, and laughs a beat too late at his own jokes, and the job may be exactly what he says it is. Reward: 450 florins and the heir's promise of a favor, for whatever that is worth."}, {"id": "ntv_rigged_court_contest", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Citadel Uchaghar", "text": "**The Contest Is Rigged** (The High Court, Citadel Uchaghar). The contests for an open seat at the High Court have been won three rounds running by a courtier whose rivals somehow fall sick, lose their footing, or find their ropes loosened the night before. The contest-judge, a fussy Vanarin who loves the rules far more than any winner, wants proof before the final round, because cheating at a sacred contest is not something she can let stand. Reward: 400 florins and a guest's place at the High Court's feast."}, {"id": "ntv_matriarchs_disputed_memory", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Durg Sthira", "text": "**Two Memories, One Agreement** (The Matriarch's Court, Durg Sthira). Two gajanari family matriarchs remember an old river-rights agreement in two different ways, which among a people whose memory is perfect means one of them is lying before the whole court. The ancient relief-carver who cut that agreement into the court's wall a century ago says the carving has been altered, and she wants someone who is not gajanari to find out by whom and see the agreement restored as it was made. Reward: 500 florins and a small piece of relief-carving of the party, cut by the old carver."}, {"id": "ntv_dock_beast_poisoners", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "New Anthara", "text": "**The Beasts Are Dying** (The Dock Market, New Anthara). Working infernal beasts are dying in their stalls along New Anthara's quays, one handler at a time, and every handler who loses one sells out to the same hauling crew. A demonborn hauler who wept openly over his ox when it died foaming wants proof of who is doing it, and he wants it before he loses the rest. Reward: 300 florins pooled by the handlers and free hauling on the quays for a year."}, {"id": "ntv_big_ledge_weretiger", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Mounagiri", "text": "**Claw Marks on the Big Ledge** (The Big Ledge, Mounagiri). Twice in a month a guest on the Big Ledge has been found torn apart by claws, and the Mounari are sure one of the outsiders they took in is a weretiger. A stern Mounari elder who judges outsiders by how still they can sit has decided that the party is outside enough to be suspected and trusted enough to find the beast among the rest. Reward: 400 florins and a lesson in stillness from the elder."}, {"id": "ntv_green_hag_cures", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Revanasi Village", "text": "**A Healer Who Asks Too Much** (The Market, Revanasi Village). A stranger calling herself a traveling hedge-witch has set up at Revanasi's market, curing fevers overnight and asking only a lock of hair or a whispered name in payment. The proud old half-orc hedge-witch whose customers have all deserted her says that is how green hags work, and nobody believes her because she sounds jealous; the hag needs unmasking and the bargains made with her broken. Reward: 300 florins from the village and a charm of real protection from the old witch."}]

A generous benefactor has been holding court in the Burned Garden's pavilions all season, and one by one the city's great families have begun to ruin each other over slights he whispered. A sharp-eyed demonborn poet who writes in the garden every day noticed that his reflection never appears in the water channels, and wants someone to unmask the rakshasa in front of the city's families before the city burns. Reward: 1,400 florins from the families once they believe it, and a poem in your honor."}, {"id": "ntv_waking_idol_great_hall", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "gold", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Kalanth Landing", "text": "**The Idol at the Feast** (The Great Hall, Kalanth Landing). A demonborn idol displayed in the Great Hall at Kalanth Landing has woken, and every feast since, another guest has walked out stronger and less themselves. The bored heiress who roused it on a dare now cannot sleep, and she wants it put back to sleep or destroyed, and the guests it claimed freed or accounted for, before her family learns what she did and before it takes her. Reward: 1,000 florins from the heiress's own purse and a jewel she swears is not cursed."}, {"id": "ntv_confluence_blockade", "kind": "social", "rank": "gold", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Sangamadi", "text": "**The River Above Is Closed** (The Docks, Sangamadi). One of Sangamadi's pilot families has refused to guide any boat above the confluence until its rivals are ruined, and has sunk the boats of anyone who tries it without them. Their head, a serenely smug frogkin who knows the whole river needs her, is willing to talk, and the river towns downstream want the upper river open before their season is lost. Reward: 1,100 florins from the river towns and a lifetime of free piloting from whichever side you help."}, {"id": "ntv_cliff_village_traitor", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "gold", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Mounagiri", "text": "**The Unseen Are Being Seen** (The Cliff Village, Mounagiri). Mounari infiltrators who hunt the ruin-diggers upriver are being ambushed on routes no one outside the gorge should know, and three have not come back. The sharp-tongued Mounari spymistress who sends them out suspects everyone in the cliff village, the party included, and has chosen outsiders precisely because they are the ones she trusts least. Reward: 1,000 florins and a real lesson in the chameleon-craft."}]

offer_pool_league_data_034.name: offer_pool_league_data_034
offer_pool_league_data_034.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "ntv_mummy_lord_throne", "kind": "monster", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "The Swallowed Cities", "text": "**The King Carved on the Walls** (The Royal Court, The Swallowed Cities). The king carved along the walls of the Royal Court has risen from under the throne-dais as a mummy lord, and each night more of the carved dead climb from the stone to serve him. An ancient serpentkin historian who has waited her whole life to meet him wants a word before he is destroyed, and the Council has sealed the contract because his court grows every night. Reward: 3,000 florins sealed by the Council and a relic of the old king's regalia."}, {"id": "ntv_gorge_rim_roc", "kind": "monster", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Mounagiri", "text": "**The Shadow Over the Gorge** (The Gorge Rim, Mounagiri). A roc has made its nest on the peak above Mounagiri and hunts the gorge each dawn, tearing houses off the cliff faces and carrying the Mounari off in its talons. A chameleon-kin mother who lost her son to it climbs to the rim every dawn with a spear and no hope, and the Council has sealed the contract because the realm's finest infiltrators are being eaten one ledge at a time. Reward: 2,500 florins and the Mounari's standing welcome, which almost no outsider holds."}, {"id": "ntv_grey_college_forbidden_memory", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Durg Sthira", "text": "**The Rite She Cannot Forget** (The Grey College, Durg Sthira). A gajanari student of the Grey College witnessed a rite in the ruins that would open the door to Ur, and because her people forget nothing, she now carries it perfectly. Cultists who want the door opened have tried three times to take her, and the Council has sealed the contract to keep her alive and to find a way to lock the memory away without destroying her mind. Reward: 3,000 florins and a gajanari masterwork forged in the student's family's name."}, {"id": "ntv_river_war_warmongers", "kind": "social", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Citadel Uchaghar", "text": "**The War Nobody Can Win** (The Long Drop, Citadel Uchaghar). Captains on both sides of the old Vanarin and gajanari feud are drinking to war, and each night at the Long Drop the talk grows louder while the ruin-diggers upriver grow bolder. An old Vanarin war-hero who fought in the last war drinks alone and wants no more of it, and the Council has sealed the contract because the two peoples who hold the river against the cult are about to spend themselves on each other. Reward: 2,500 florins and a place of honor in both Uchaghar and Durg Sthira."}, {"id": "ntv_kalanth_second_ledger", "kind": "social", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Kalanth Landing", "text": "**The Richest Family on the River** (The Great Hall, Kalanth Landing). Everyone on the river knows the family of Kalanth Landing fences black ichor, waking idols, and cursed arms out of the ruins, and no one has ever caught them holding anything. A disgraced demonborn bookkeeper who kept a second set of accounts has come to the League in fear of her life, and the Council has sealed the contract for proof that will stand. Reward: 3,000 florins and the Council's quiet thanks, which is its own kind of protection."}, {"id": "ntv_river_poisoner", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "Shilaghar", "text": "**Poison in the Tributaries** (The Coil, Shilaghar). A renegade alchemist trained on the mesa has taken Shilaghar's most dangerous brew and is loosing it into the tributaries one village at a time, and the fish, then the frogkin, have begun to die. The serpentkin grandmaster who taught him is far too calm about the end of the world and knows how he thinks, and the Council has sealed the contract before the brew reaches the Saranadi itself. Reward: 3,500 florins and a cure the grandmaster makes for no one else."}, {"id": "ntv_idol_bound_warlord", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Ntar Vanna", "location": "The Hookmarsh", "text": "**The Marsh Stops Ransoming** (The Reed Fort, The Hookmarsh). The lizardfolk warlord of Hookmarsh has roused a demonborn idol from his plunder, and since then his warband no longer takes ransom: it takes boats, villages, and captives who are never sent home. A captive demonborn river-priestess has kept the prisoners in the Reed Fort alive by bargaining with the guards, and the Council has sealed the contract to destroy the idol, break the warlord, and free the captives before the warlord brings the marsh to the river towns. Reward: 2,500 florins and whatever the Reed Fort holds of the warband's plunder."}, {"id": "owl_ferry_pitch_feud", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Gorren Crossing", "text": "**First Blanket at the Landing** (The River Market, Gorren Crossing). A goblin knife-grinder and a dwarf ironmonger both claim the best pitch at the ferry landing, and every morning one of them turns up earlier than the other. They are now arriving before dawn with cudgels. The goblin, who never stops talking while his wheel spins, swears he held that patch of mud first and wants someone to make the dwarf see it before one of them ends up in the river. Reward: 35 florins and a lifetime of free sharpening at the landing."}, {"id": "owl_steam_room_brawls", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Gorren Crossing", "text": "**Whose Side of the Pool** (The Baths, Gorren Crossing). Young riders from Vorren's Hold and Camp Drokash have decided the hot pool at the Baths has a Vorren side and a Drokash side, and they brawl over the line most evenings. The half-orc bath-keeper, who snaps a wet towel like a whip and will not have blood in her water, wants an outsider to end it, since neither side will take her word as neutral. Reward: 40 florins and a season of free steam."}, {"id": "owl_sparring_circle_bully", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Wolfpack Lodge", "text": "**Lessons in the Mud** (The Training Grounds, Wolfpack Lodge). A hulking senior recruit runs the sparring circles like his own, beating new trial-hunters bloody and keeping their gear as payment for the lesson. Kesri Madovar, a young hyena-bonded hunter who witnesses proving deeds on the Training Grounds, cannot move against him without it looking like favoritism, and would dearly like an outsider to do it for her and see the stolen gear returned. Reward: 45 florins from the pot the trial-hunters raised, and Kesri's good word."}, {"id": "owl_false_vorren_blades", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Vorren's Hold", "text": "**Iron That Isn't** (The Gate Court, Vorren's Hold). A smooth-talking human peddler with a stall along the Gate Court wall keeps selling young orcs blades stamped as Vorren-forged, which bend at the first real blow. The gate-warden, a humorless orc who takes every forgery as an insult to the clan, cannot catch him with the goods, and wants someone to prove the fraud or run him off the tor. Reward: 50 florins and a real Vorren-forged knife."}, {"id": "owl_tannery_stirges", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Gorren Crossing", "text": "**Bitten in Downwind** (Downwind Ward, Gorren Crossing). A swarm of stirges has found the rendering yards of Downwind Ward and comes out every dusk to feed on the workers, who go home pale and dizzy. A dye-stained goblin tanner who claims he can smell the nest from his vat is sure it is somewhere in the ward's rooftops, and he will lead anyone brave enough to his best guess. Reward: 35 florins and a hide cloak that no insect will touch."}]

offer_pool_league_data_035.name: offer_pool_league_data_035
offer_pool_league_data_035.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "owl_kobold_lamp_raiders", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "The Mogra Mines", "text": "**The Lamps Keep Going Out** (The Upper Workings, The Mogra Mines). Kobolds have opened a crawlway into the Upper Workings and come up each night to snatch the hung lamps, leaving the miners working blind. An old mine-guard who talks to his own lamp for luck has been guarding the shaft-head alone and wants help finding the crawlway before the raiders take more than lamps. Reward: 40 florins from the miners and a good iron lantern."}, {"id": "owl_truce_ground_boar", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Gods-Anvil", "text": "**No Blood at the Mesa** (The Base Camps, Gods-Anvil). A giant boar has taken to rooting through the offering pits and firepits at the foot of Gods-Anvil, and it charges anyone who comes near. No blood may be shed on or around the mesa, so it cannot simply be killed there. A toothless ancient keeper who scolds clan chiefs and boars alike wants it gone before the next moot without breaking the truce. Reward: 30 florins and the keeper's blessing, which the clans respect."}, {"id": "owl_auction_griffon", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Gorren Crossing", "text": "**The Tame Griffon** (The Stockyards, Gorren Crossing). A young griffon brought up for auction broke its hood and now roosts on the Stockyards' auction block, dropping on the horse pens whenever it gets hungry. The gnome beast-dealer who brought it swears it was tame and is sweating through his coat, because the drovers want it dead and him fined. He would give a great deal to have it caught alive. Reward: 60 florins, more if the griffon comes back alive."}, {"id": "owl_loose_girth_colt_races", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Camp Drokash", "text": "**Thrown at the Colt Races** (The Contest Ground, Camp Drokash). Someone keeps slitting the girths of young riders before the colt races on the Contest Ground, and two have already been thrown hard. A gap-toothed orc horse-breaker who bets on the youngsters every race is furious, and wants the saboteur found before a rider breaks her neck and the whole camp starts accusing each other. Reward: 45 florins and a colt to ride in the next race."}, {"id": "owl_crowned_ox_card_sharp", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Gorren Crossing", "text": "**The House Keeps Losing** (The Crowned Ox, Gorren Crossing). A charming card sharp has been winning the Crowned Ox's house wagers every night for a week, and nobody can see how. Issa Dalcour, the tavern's young proprietor who never lets a guest see her flustered, cannot accuse a paying guest without proof, and wants someone at the table who can catch him or beat him at his own game. Reward: 50 florins and a seat at one of Issa's important tables."}, {"id": "owl_sunset_sneak_thief", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Gorren Crossing", "text": "**Before They Hang Him** (Sunset Ward, Gorren Crossing). A sneak-thief keeps lifting boots and purses from sleeping guests in the lodging houses of Sunset Ward. In Gorren Crossing theft means the rope. The orc landlady of a cheap flophouse thinks she knows it is a half-starved goblin youngster, and she wants the stealing stopped before the Watch catches him and hangs him. Reward: 30 florins and a free room in Sunset Ward whenever it is wanted."}, {"id": "owl_spirit_hearth_offerings", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Wolfpack Lodge", "text": "**The Hungry Fire** (The Spirit Hearth, Wolfpack Lodge). Carved tokens and offerings keep vanishing from the Spirit Hearth overnight, and the lodge is starting to whisper that the spirits are displeased. A half-deaf old shaman who argues with the fire out loud is not convinced the spirits have hands, and wants someone to sit the night and find out who, or what, is taking them. Reward: 35 florins and a carved token the shaman swears is lucky."}, {"id": "owl_stockyard_auction_ring", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Gorren Crossing", "text": "**Nobody Bids** (The Stockyards, Gorren Crossing). A ring of southern buyers has agreed among themselves never to bid against each other at the Stockyards, and Drokash horses are going for half their worth. A proud young rider from Camp Drokash, selling her first string, has refused every lowball offer and is spoiling to start a war over it. The auctioneers want the ring broken before she does. Reward: 150 florins and the pick of the young rider's string at a fair price."}, {"id": "owl_hired_street_duelist", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Gorren Crossing", "text": "**Legal on the Paving** (The Stone Quarter, Gorren Crossing). Street duels are legal in Gorren Crossing, and a polished duelist has learned to goad hot-blooded young riders into fights on the Stone Quarter's paving and kill them within the law. An orc harness-maker who lost a son this way wants to know who pays the duelist and why, and she wants it stopped, by the law, by steel, or by shame. Reward: 180 florins and harness made to measure for every mount in the party."}, {"id": "owl_mocking_skald", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Vorren's Hold", "text": "**The Song in the Great Hall** (The Great Hall, Vorren's Hold). A wandering skald has been singing mocking verses about an old Vorren family's lineage at the Great Hall's feasts, and each week the song gets crueler and the crowd laughs harder. The insulted elder, stiff-backed and unforgiving, is honing axes with his grandsons. Someone needs to find who taught the skald those verses before the feud turns bloody. Reward: 120 florins and a place at the elder's table."}, {"id": "owl_dead_guards_arms", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Gorren Crossing", "text": "**Blades Off Dead Guards** (The House of Many Banners, Gorren Crossing). Piri Askarra, a caravan outrider at the House of Many Banners who can name any goblin-made blade at a glance, keeps spotting the arms of murdered caravan guards for sale around the Crossing. Someone is buying them from the raiders who did the killing. She wants the fence found and the trade shut, and she knows the blades better than anyone. Reward: 160 florins and a goblin-made blade of Piri's choosing."}, {"id": "owl_rope_cutting_feather_hunters", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Roc Bluffs", "text": "**Frayed Ropes at the Tors** (The Windward Tors, Roc Bluffs). A crew of feather-hunters camped at the foot of the Roc Bluffs has been cutting other climbers' ropes so they alone can work the fallen roc-feathers and the lower shelves. A wiry goblin climber with more scars than fingers lost a partner that way and wants the crew driven off or made to answer for it. Reward: 140 florins and a roc flight-feather worth nearly as much again."}, {"id": "owl_churn_picket_shark", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "The Churn", "text": "**Up Through the Picket-Line** (The Broken Ground, The Churn). A big land-shark has claimed the Broken Ground beside a herding camp and comes up through the picket-line every few nights, taking a horse each time. Two orc sisters who hunt land-sharks from horseback and bicker about everything have tracked it, but they need more hands to bait it and more blades to finish it. Reward: 150 florins and one of its back-plates, worth a good shield."}]

offer_pool_league_data_036.name: offer_pool_league_data_036
offer_pool_league_data_036.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "owl_grass_edge_saber_tooth", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Saber-Grass", "text": "**One Last Fang** (The Grass Edge, Saber-Grass). A saber-tooth has learned to wait beside the herd-paths at the Grass Edge and take the last animal in every drove. The drovers now refuse the route. A limping old cat-hunter who took his first fang forty years ago wants to take his last one from this cat, and he needs a crew young enough to keep up with him. Reward: 130 florins and a knife hilted with one of its fangs."}, {"id": "owl_rimed_slope_yetis", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "The Northern Foothills", "text": "**The Widow Stays** (The Rimed Slopes, The Northern Foothills). A pack of yetis comes down the Rimed Slopes whenever the weather turns, and a goatherd widow's steading is the last one still standing up there. She will not move her flock for anyone, clan or yeti. The riders who keep that ground want the pack broken before the next storm brings it down on her. Reward: 160 florins, a share of anything in the yetis' den, and a goat-hair cloak."}, {"id": "owl_iron_forge_rust_monster", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Wolfpack Lodge", "text": "**Something Eats the Iron** (The Iron Forge, Wolfpack Lodge). Something is getting into the Wolfpack's Iron Forge at night and eating the steel: half-finished axes crumble to rust and a whole rack of shock-trooper armor is gone. The scorch-bearded smith who runs the forge loves his hammers more than people and is sleeping on the anvil to guard them. He wants the rust monster caught, and he wants to watch. Reward: 120 florins and one piece of armor made heavy enough for a berserker."}, {"id": "owl_hollow_ground_harpies", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "The Western Border Woods", "text": "**Singing in the Hollow Ground** (The Hollow Ground, The Western Border Woods). A dryad has woken in the deadfall of the Hollow Ground and sings at dusk, and herders keep wandering in after her voice and not coming back. A lovesick young drover is sure the song is meant for him and keeps riding out to listen. His family wants her stopped before he goes in for good, and the missing herders may still be somewhere in her trees. Reward: 140 florins from the drover's family and the thanks of the herders."}, {"id": "owl_pit_fighter_poisoner", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Gorren Crossing", "text": "**They Fall Before the Blow** (The Pit, Gorren Crossing). Favorites keep collapsing in the middle of bouts at the Pit, and somebody is getting rich betting against them. The scarred ogre pit-master prides himself on clean fights and is ashamed. He wants the poisoner found, and he would not mind a fresh fighter in the ring as bait. Reward: 170 florins and a sanctioned bout at the Pit with a real purse."}, {"id": "owl_downwind_frenzy_brewer", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Gorren Crossing", "text": "**Bottled Fury** (Downwind Ward, Gorren Crossing). Somebody in Downwind Ward is selling young riders a draught that makes them fight without feeling wounds, and the ones who drink it keep dying of injuries they never noticed. A tired dwarf physician who patches the ward's poor has buried three this month. She wants the brewer found and the stills smashed. Reward: 180 florins and the physician's care whenever the party needs it."}, {"id": "owl_drowned_miner_ghost", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "The Mogra Mines", "text": "**The Shift That Never Ends** (The Upper Workings, The Mogra Mines). Every shift change, the ghost of a miner lost in the flooding of the lower levels walks the Upper Workings and calls the crews toward the drowned shafts. Two have followed him and fallen. His daughter, a hard-drinking shaft foreman, wants to know what he is trying to say, and wants him at rest either way. Reward: 150 florins from the miners and a share of iron from the next good seam."}, {"id": "owl_spirit_cellar_voice", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Wolfpack Lodge", "text": "**The Fury That Won't Pass** (The Spirit Cellar, Wolfpack Lodge). A berserker chained in the Spirit Cellar has not come back from the fury in weeks, and at night something else speaks through him. The shamans fear a spirit of rage has got in. His shield-brother, a gentle giant of a half-orc who sits by the bars every night, wants outsiders to try what the lodge will not, before the elders decide the berserker cannot be saved. Reward: 180 florins and the shield-brother's axe at the party's side for one hunt."}, {"id": "owl_sunset_ward_kidnappers", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Gorren Crossing", "text": "**Rooms With No Questions** (Sunset Ward, Gorren Crossing). Lone travelers keep disappearing from the cheap rooms of Sunset Ward, and a one-armed goblin porter who notices everything has seen the same covered wagon leave at dawn after each one. He thinks they are being sold west to the shamans of Blood-Altar Mountain. He will point the way; he wants someone who can stop it. Reward: 200 florins and the porter's eyes on the ward for as long as the party wants them."}, {"id": "owl_steam_room_blackmailer", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Gorren Crossing", "text": "**What Is Said in the Steam** (The Baths, Gorren Crossing). Everyone in Gorren Crossing talks in the steam rooms of the Baths, and someone has been listening. Clan factors and merchant agents are getting letters quoting their own words back to them, with a price. A powerful dwarf iron-buyer, far too proud to admit he is frightened, wants the blackmailer found and his letters burned, quietly. Reward: 400 florins and the iron-buyer's discreet favor in any dealing with the mercantile houses."}, {"id": "owl_iron_cornering_house", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Gorren Crossing", "text": "**Every Bar of Iron** (The Stone Quarter, Gorren Crossing). A southern mercantile house in the Stone Quarter is quietly buying every bar of Vorren iron that crosses the ford, and the clans will soon be short of spearheads when the raiders come. A nervous gnome clerk in its employ has seen the ledgers and wants out before it all goes wrong. He will talk to the right people, and nobody else. Reward: 450 florins and a pair of Vorren-forged weapons from the hold's grateful traders."}, {"id": "owl_turncoat_company", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Gorren Crossing", "text": "**A Banner in the Rafters** (The House of Many Banners, Gorren Crossing). A company whose banner hangs in the House of Many Banners has started charging caravans on the southern road for protection from raiders it may be tipping off. Tula Vereskar, the House's Gold-ranked standard-bearer who vouched for them, takes the shame personally. She wants the truth, and then she wants the banner down or the company made to earn it back. Reward: 380 florins and Tula's vouching before the League for the party's next rank."}, {"id": "owl_runaway_armorer", "kind": "social", "rank": "silver", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Gorren Crossing", "text": "**The Smith Who Knows Too Much** (The Hearthstone, Gorren Crossing). A young Vorren armorer who knows the hold's forging secrets has fled to marry a Drokash rider, and the two are hiding upstairs at the Hearthstone while his cousins search the Crossing for them. The halfling innkeepers are feeding the lovers and hoping. The armorer wants a way out that doesn't end with his cousins' axes or the clans at war over him. Reward: 320 florins and a suit of armor made by a Vorren master who owes the party his life."}]

Reward: 500 florins from the drovers and whatever the party can carry down from the nest."}, {"id": "owl_cracked_flats_manticore", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "The Southern Badlands", "text": "**Spikes Over the Hardpan** (The Cracked Flats, The Southern Badlands). A manticore hunts the Cracked Flats, loosing tail-spikes on riders who cross the open hardpan and feeding where they fall. A dust-caked dwarf prospector who maps everything, including its hunting passes, has lost two partners to it and wants company for the hunt. He is quite willing to be the bait. Reward: 440 florins and the prospector's map of the badlands."}, {"id": "owl_petrified_galleries", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "The Mogra Mines", "text": "**The Statues Below the Flood** (The Lost Galleries, The Mogra Mines). The kobolds of the Lost Galleries keep a basilisk, and every clan party sent down comes back fewer, with statues left at the foot of the shaft. A Vorren miner goes down every day to talk to his brother, who stands in stone just past the flooded level. He wants the basilisk dead and has heard stone can be made flesh again. Reward: 460 florins and the clan's thanks, worth more to anyone who wants Vorren iron."}, {"id": "owl_feral_war_wolves", "kind": "monster", "rank": "silver", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Wolfpack Lodge", "text": "**The Litter That Ran** (The Beast Kennels, Wolfpack Lodge). A litter of great war-wolves broke out of the Beast Kennels last spring, and now they hunt the steppe as a wild pack with all the tricks they were taught, pulling down herds and riders alike. The handler who raised them from pups is heartbroken and wants them brought back if they can be, and put down cleanly if they cannot. Reward: 350 florins and first training with a war-wolf at the kennels."}, {"id": "owl_voice_of_the_anvil", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Gods-Anvil", "text": "**The Stone That Speaks** (The Summit, Gods-Anvil). A wild-eyed orc has been climbing Gods-Anvil and claiming the gods speak to him through the stone, and his prophecies all happen to favor one clan. Young riders are listening. An earnest young keeper of the summit believes him completely, which is the problem. The older keepers want the truth, fraud or genuine, shown before witnesses the clans will believe, and without blood on the mesa. Reward: 300 florins and the keepers' welcome on the summit."}, {"id": "owl_deep_timber_renegades", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "The Western Border Woods", "text": "**Fire at the Tree Line** (The Deep Timber, The Western Border Woods). A band of elf renegades strikes steadings along the forest edge every new moon and vanishes into the Deep Timber, leaving the dead arranged to enrage the clans. An orc herder who survived their last raid by lying among the bodies knows where they went in and wants to show someone who can follow and end it. Reward: 480 florins and the herder's clan's welcome at any fire."}, {"id": "owl_worg_rider_ambushes", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "The Southern Badlands", "text": "**Three Ambushes and a Cook** (The Dust Gullies, The Southern Badlands). Orc outcasts on worgs keep bursting out of the Dust Gullies onto the southern caravan route and cutting down everything that runs. A caravan cook has survived three of these ambushes and is sick of being the lucky one. She has worked out their favorite gullies and wants someone to go in and break them where they lie up. Reward: 420 florins and the gratitude of every caravan master on the southern route."}, {"id": "owl_shattering_blades", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Vorren's Hold", "text": "**Blades That Break** (The Forge Quarter, Vorren's Hold). Swords from one of the Forge Quarter's best foundries have started shattering in battle, and riders have died with broken hilts in their hands. The proud orc swordsmith whose mark is on every blade swears his iron is sound and that someone is fouling his melt. The clan has given him until the next moot to prove it. Reward: 400 florins and a sword from the swordsmith's own hand."}, {"id": "owl_lodge_contract_spy", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "silver", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Wolfpack Lodge", "text": "**They Always Know Where We Hunt** (The Great Lodge, Wolfpack Lodge). Raiders keep knowing where the Wolfpack will hunt before its hunters ride out, and twice now a pack has ridden into an ambush. Uro Madresh, the Wolfpack's Pack-Leader, hates the thought of suspecting his own and trusts outsiders to see what he will not. He wants the leak found, whoever it is. Reward: 450 florins and a Pack-Leader's favor, which the lodge honors."}, {"id": "owl_moot_war_on_the_forest", "kind": "social", "rank": "gold", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Gods-Anvil", "text": "**The Autumn Anvil Moot Votes for War** (The Base Camps, Gods-Anvil). A war-hungry chief is working the clan camps at the foot of Gods-Anvil ahead of the autumn moot, showing elf arrows pulled from murdered herders and calling for the clans to burn the forest edge. A Vorren elder who lost three sons to elves still argues for peace and cannot be heard over the drums. She wants the truth of those arrows before the moot votes. Reward: 1,200 florins from the elder's clan and a chief's invitation to the next moot."}, {"id": "owl_crossing_annexation", "kind": "social", "rank": "gold", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Gorren Crossing", "text": "**Owned by No One** (The Stone Quarter, Gorren Crossing). Envoys of one great clan have begun pressing the Crossing Court to recognize their clan's protection over Gorren Crossing, backed by riders camped outside town and gifts to half the merchants. If they succeed, the other clan will ride. The elderly half-orc judge who has kept the Crossing neutral for forty years wants the pressure broken without starting the war it would prevent. Reward: 1,400 florins from the Crossing Court and the town's freedom of the Stone Quarter."}]

offer_pool_league_data_038.name: offer_pool_league_data_038
offer_pool_league_data_038.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "owl_bride_price_herd", "kind": "social", "rank": "gold", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Camp Drokash", "text": "**The Bride-Price Herd** (The Muster-Ground, Camp Drokash). The war-chief of Camp Drokash has pledged the clan's finest herd as bride-price for a marriage that would bind the two great clans, and a band of hotheaded riders means to steal the herd and wreck the match. The bride, a lance-champion who would rather win her husband in the tilt, is not sure she wants the wedding either, and would like someone she can speak to plainly, so the marriage goes ahead or ends by her own choice, not by a raid. Reward: 1,100 florins and horses from the bride-price herd."}, {"id": "owl_churned_bone_wight", "kind": "monster", "rank": "gold", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "The Churn", "text": "**The Dragon's Bones Get Up** (The Dens, The Churn). The land-sharks heave old bones up out of the Churn, and they have heaved up a dragon's. It has risen in the Dens as a dracolich, and it raises the churned-up dead of riders and herds into a growing host that walks toward the pastures each night. A Drokash bone-singer who has spent her life burying the Churn's dead wants it put down before the host reaches the camps. Reward: 1,300 florins from both clans and a bone-carved charm the bone-singer swears wards off the dead."}, {"id": "owl_killing_ground_chimera", "kind": "monster", "rank": "gold", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Saber-Grass", "text": "**The Cats Are Running** (The Killing Grounds, Saber-Grass). A chimera has made the Killing Grounds its own and driven the saber-tooths out of the deep grass and into the herding camps, where they have killed more in a month than in a year. A grizzled saber-tooth hunter who respects the cats more than most people says the only fix is to kill the thing that frightens them. Reward: 1,200 florins from the herding camps and the chimera's heads as a trophy of legend."}, {"id": "owl_ore_road_stone_giant", "kind": "monster", "rank": "gold", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Vorren's Hold", "text": "**Boulders on the Ore Road** (The Gate Court, Vorren's Hold). A stone giant has settled on a tor above the ore road and hurls boulders at every wagon climbing from the mines to Vorren's Hold. The forges are going cold for want of ore, and a clan without iron cannot arm the Wold. The grim gate-captain who counts every lost wagon wants the giant dealt with by any means, including talking, if anyone can manage it. Reward: 1,500 florins and a set of arms from the hold's master smiths."}, {"id": "owl_slope_camp_captives", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "gold", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Blood-Altar Mountain", "text": "**Before the Knife** (The Wooded Slopes, Blood-Altar Mountain). Demon-sworn orc shamans have gathered captives in their camps on the Wooded Slopes, and when the rite comes, those captives will be killed on the red altar. A Vorren ore-hauler whose daughter is among them already climbed halfway up alone and came back with arrows in her. She is going again, with or without help. Reward: 1,000 florins raised by the captives' families and the ore-hauler's undying loyalty."}, {"id": "owl_truce_breaking_assassin", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "gold", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Gods-Anvil", "text": "**Blood on the Summit** (The Summit, Gods-Anvil). Someone means to kill a chief on the summit of Gods-Anvil during the moot, so the shame of broken truce falls on the other clan and the Wold goes to war with itself. The blind eldest keeper, who hears every step on the trail, has heard a stranger climb it at night twice now. He wants the assassin found without a drop of blood spilled on the mesa. Reward: 1,500 florins from the chiefs and the rare honor of a guest's seat at the moot."}, {"id": "owl_clan_war_brink", "kind": "social", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Vorren's Hold", "text": "**The Wold Against Itself** (The Great Hall, Vorren's Hold). A war-hungry heir in Vorren's Hold is pushing the clan toward open war with Camp Drokash over Gorren Crossing, and the young warriors cheer him in the Great Hall. If the two great clans fight, the raiders, the walking dead of the north, and the war-bands of the south will pour through behind them. The old chief, who fought that war once and swore never again, needs outsiders to do what his blood cannot. Reward: 3,000 florins under Council seal and a guest-right in the Great Hall for life."}, {"id": "owl_forest_edge_peace_talks", "kind": "social", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "The Western Border Woods", "text": "**A Truce at the Tree Line** (The Wood's Edge, The Western Border Woods). Elf and orc envoys have been meeting in secret at the Wood's Edge to end the border raids for good, and the renegades want every one of them dead. A grave high-elf envoy who comes disguised as a herder carries her people's offer, and she needs guards the renegades have not bought, and someone the clans will listen to when she speaks. Reward: 2,500 florins under Council seal and the thanks of two peoples."}, {"id": "owl_dead_war_chief_succession", "kind": "social", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Camp Drokash", "text": "**The Empty Pavilion** (The Chieftain's Pavilion, Camp Drokash). The war-chief of Camp Drokash is dead, and the challengers are gathering. The strongest has won every bout without bleeding, and the widow, a rider who could take the place herself and refuses, is certain he carries a demon's blessing. If he wins, the riding clan's horses go to the outcast raiders. She wants proof, and a champion. Reward: 2,000 florins under Council seal and a string of the clan's finest horses."}, {"id": "owl_wrath_walks", "kind": "monster", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Blood-Altar Mountain", "text": "**The Wrath Walks** (The Altar Plateau, Blood-Altar Mountain). The rite on the Altar Plateau went further than any before it, and a Wrath, a demon of rage and bloodshed, now walks the mountain in the flesh. Everything it passes turns to slaughter. A demon-sworn shaman who helped call it has turned back in horror and knows how it might be bound or banished, if someone can keep her alive long enough to try. Reward: 4,000 florins under Council seal and a weapon blessed against demons."}, {"id": "owl_worm_under_the_iron_hills", "kind": "monster", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "The Churn", "text": "**The Land-Sharks Are Fleeing** (The Broken Ground, The Churn). The land-sharks are fleeing the Churn onto the pastures, because something vastly larger is moving beneath it: a purple worm whose ridges run for miles and are heading toward the iron hills under Vorren's Hold. A Vorren mine-surveyor who has mapped every tremor says the hold's foundations will not survive its passing. Reward: 5,000 florins under Council seal and a share of whatever the worm has swallowed."}, {"id": "owl_white_dragon_descends", "kind": "monster", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "The Northern Foothills", "text": "**The Cold Comes Down** (The High Gullies, The Northern Foothills). A frost drake grown far past its kind, big as a longhouse and older than any clan's memory, has come down out of the white peaks and made the High Gullies its lair, and the yetis and lesser drakes are fleeing south ahead of it into the clans' pastures. A Wolfpack beast-bonded scout who has already been to its lair and back, with frost still in her hair, knows the way in. Reward: 6,000 florins under Council seal and a share of the drake's hoard."}]

offer_pool_league_data_039.name: offer_pool_league_data_039
offer_pool_league_data_039.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "owl_first_oathbreaker_risen", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "The Southern Badlands", "text": "**The First to Break the Oath** (The Ridges, The Southern Badlands). The outcast raiders of the Southern Badlands have never had one chief, until now. A draugr warlord, a dead orc in ancient grave-armor, holds the Ridges, and the scattered bands are gathering under him. A clan lore-singer who knows every verse of the old songs believes he is the first orc ever to break the clan-oath, returned, and knows what he fears. Reward: 4,500 florins under Council seal and a place in the lore-singer's songs."}, {"id": "owl_faces_at_the_tables", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "platinum", "region": "Orc Wolds", "location": "Gorren Crossing", "text": "**Faces at the Important Tables** (The Crowned Ox, Gorren Crossing). The clans' factors and envoys who meet at the Crowned Ox have started saying things they would never say, and some remember meetings they never attended. A hard-nosed halfling wine steward who remembers every guest's order has noticed old regulars ordering wrong. A coven of hags is wearing the faces of the people who keep peace between the clans, one at a time, and keeping the real ones asleep somewhere; they must be found alive or accounted for. Reward: 3,500 florins under Council seal and the Crowned Ox's best table for life."}, {"id": "red_stooping_insult", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Redrock", "location": "Copperstone", "text": "**Mind Your Head in Copperstone** (The Village Square, Copperstone). A wealthy tall-folk trader keeps coming back to Copperstone to buy, and keeps patting the pygmy smiths on the head, haggling in baby talk, and laughing at their doorways. The smiths have started refusing to sell to any tall folk at all. A stern pygmy coppersmith matriarch who runs the biggest stall in the square wants the trader taught some manners before the whole village shuts its shops to outsiders. Reward: 40 florins and a copper drinking-cup sized for a tall guest, engraved with a very small insult."}, {"id": "red_saffra_fake_relics", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Redrock", "location": "Saffra", "text": "**Old Work, Newly Made** (The Bazaar, Saffra). Someone in Saffra's bazaar keeps selling gnoll-fenced junk as true old djinnborn relics, and the buyers who get cheated blame the honest stalls around the forger's. A theatrical djinnborn spice-seller next door, who shouts every price as if it were poetry, is losing custom by the day and wants the forger caught out in front of the whole market. Reward: 45 florins and a pouch of fire-cured spice that makes grown adventurers weep."}, {"id": "red_refectory_brew_feud", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Redrock", "location": "The Sky Temple of the Ascension", "text": "**Sour Vats at the Refectory** (The Joyful Refectory, The Sky Temple of the Ascension). Two brewer-monks at the Joyful Refectory have fallen out over whose training potion works better, and someone keeps salting, souring, or tipping over the other's vats in the night. The hall has gone glum and quiet, which the booming dwarf cook who runs its kitchens cannot bear. She wants the saboteur found and the two brewers laughing at the same table again. Reward: 35 florins and a flask of the winning brew, whichever that turns out to be."}, {"id": "red_terrace_shell_game", "kind": "social", "rank": "copper", "region": "Redrock", "location": "Cloudtop", "text": "**The Shells on the Terrace Rail** (The Cloud Terrace, Cloudtop). A slick hustler runs a shell game at the brass rail of the Cloud Terrace, fleecing every wide-eyed traveler who steps off a condor, and has a pair of hired toughs to see off anyone who complains. A chatty tunnel-gnome who polishes the terrace railings on her knees all day has watched the trick a hundred times, knows exactly how it is done, and wants someone brave enough to beat him at it and win his marks their coin back. Reward: 30 florins from the gnome's savings and whatever the hustler has in his purse."}, {"id": "red_wadi_scorpion_reeds", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Redrock", "location": "Wadi of the Beasts", "text": "**The Scorpion Under the Reeds** (The Canyon Floor, Wadi of the Beasts). A young giant scorpion has dug itself in under the reed-bank where the wadi keepers water their goats, and every few days it takes another one. A druid apprentice who has named every goat in the herd, and grieves each one, wants it killed or driven off to the far pools where it belongs. Reward: 40 florins, a flask of scorpion venom, and the apprentice's undying friendship."}, {"id": "red_aerie_harpies", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Redrock", "location": "Cloudtop", "text": "**Harpies at the Condor Nests** (The Condor Aerie, Cloudtop). A small harpy flock has taken to raiding the condor nests on the outer spires at dawn, singing to lure the young handlers onto the ledges while the rest of them steal eggs. A grizzled eaglekin handler with one clipped wing has lost two eggs already and nearly an apprentice, and wants the flock gone before the hatching season. Reward: 50 florins and one free condor flight anywhere in the high country."}, {"id": "red_copperstone_fire_beetles", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Redrock", "location": "Copperstone", "text": "**Beetles in the Forge-Ash** (The Workshops, Copperstone). Giant fire beetles have crawled up out of the hot deep cuts of the mines and nest in the warm forge-ash of the Copperstone workshops, glowing like coals and biting any smith who reaches into a hearth. A fussy pygmy engraver who now sleeps in his shop with a lantern and a broom has had his hands bitten twice and his bench overrun, and wants the nest cleared, or the beetles lured back where they came from. Reward: 45 florins and a beetle-gland lantern that glows for a month."}, {"id": "red_recovery_pool_mephits", "kind": "monster", "rank": "copper", "region": "Redrock", "location": "The Sky Temple of the Ascension", "text": "**Scalded at the Recovery Pools** (The Recovery Pools, The Sky Temple of the Ascension). A clutch of steam mephits has bubbled up into the Recovery Pools and keeps boiling the water under anyone trying to soak an injury, cackling as they scald. A gentle halfling healer who tends the pools, and apologizes to her patients' bruises as she treats them, wants the little pests caught or chased out before someone already hurt gets hurt worse. Reward: 35 florins and free healing at the pools for the rest of the season."}, {"id": "red_rose_court_imp", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Redrock", "location": "Citadel of the Pact", "text": "**The Imp in the Colonnade** (The Rose Court, Citadel of the Pact). A gnome recruit at the Citadel of the Pact caught her very first fire-imp, and then let it out of the bottle while showing it off. It has been loose among the Rose Court's colonnades for days, scorching banners and stealing sweets, and the veterans are laughing at her. She is mortified and wants it back in a warded bottle before her masters notice. Reward: 30 florins, a spare sealing-ring, and a recruit who owes the party forever."}, {"id": "red_bone_ground_dare", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Redrock", "location": "The Bonecrags", "text": "**The Bone Ground Dash** (The Bone Ground, The Bonecrags). A braggart Copper crew keeps daring newer crews to race out onto the open Bone Ground beneath the vulture cliffs and snatch a trinket from the bones, and they always win because they cheat. A gap-toothed goblin bookmaker who takes bets on anything wants a crew who can beat them fairly, or prove the cheating, before the next challenger gets carried off. Reward: 50 florins from the bookmaker's pot and the braggarts' best trinket."}]

offer_pool_league_data_040.name: offer_pool_league_data_040
offer_pool_league_data_040.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "red_forge_clockwork_bird", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Redrock", "location": "Cloudtop", "text": "**The Brass Songbird** (The High Forges, Cloudtop). A vain mountain-dwarf jeweler at the High Forges built a clockwork songbird that works far too well: it escaped his bench and now flits across the forge-terraces stealing gems, rings, and loose gold from the other smiths. He blames the apprentices, the wind, and everyone but himself, and wants it caught whole, and the stolen pieces found, before the other masters decide to smash it. Reward: 60 florins and a small piece of the jeweler's work, which he insists is priceless."}, {"id": "red_rope_swing_cheat", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "copper", "region": "Redrock", "location": "The Sky Temple of the Ascension", "text": "**Races on the Practice Heights** (The Practice Heights, The Sky Temple of the Ascension). A visiting duelist keeps challenging the Temple's students to races across the rope swings and bridges of the Practice Heights, and keeps winning, because someone greases the ropes behind him. A tiny elderly monk who laughs at every fall, including her own, thinks it is hilarious but also that it is time someone beat him properly. Reward: 35 florins and a lesson from the old monk in falling well."}, {"id": "red_shattered_gate_toll", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Redrock", "location": "The Ruins of Naran-Kadish", "text": "**Double Toll at the Shattered Gate** (The Shattered Gate, The Ruins of Naran-Kadish). A gnoll toll-captain at Naran-Kadish's Shattered Gate has doubled the toll on every trader coming in, and seizes the goods of anyone who cannot pay, keeping the difference for himself. A cheerful halfling tinker who will trade with anyone has had his whole cart taken and is still smiling, barely. He wants his cart back and the tolls back to what the princes set, without starting a war with the ruin. Reward: 120 florins and the pick of the tinker's cart."}, {"id": "red_deep_cut_ringleader", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Redrock", "location": "Copperstone", "text": "**Too Far Down** (The Mines, Copperstone). Copperstone's elders have forbidden the deepest new cut in the mines, where the rock runs hot and the air goes bad, but a swaggering young miner has a crew digging it in secret every night, sure there is a rich vein just beyond. One of them has already come up burned. A pygmy grandmother who lost two sons to the deep cuts wants the digging stopped before she loses a grandson too. Reward: 90 florins and a set of fine copper tools."}, {"id": "red_skygate_recruiters", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Redrock", "location": "Cloudtop", "text": "**Sign Here, or Else** (Skygate House, Cloudtop). Recruiters from Cloudtop's great houses have started pressing young adventurers into house contracts at Skygate House, with gifts at first and then with threats, debts, and hired swords. Rielle Mazarane, a Gold-ranked League captain at Skygate House who left her own noble family's service to earn her name, wants the pressure stopped and the crews who signed under duress freed. Reward: 180 florins and Rielle's word on the party's behalf in Cloudtop."}, {"id": "red_raziya_slander", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Redrock", "location": "Saffra", "text": "**An Honest Appraisal** (Fountain Court Inn, Saffra). A rival relic appraiser has been telling every buyer in Saffra that Raziya Ahravan, a djinnborn relic appraiser and expedition broker at the Fountain Court Inn, passes fakes as true djinnborn work, and her clients are drifting to him. She knows he is the one selling fakes and wants proof that will stand up in front of the whole town. Reward: 150 florins and Raziya's help appraising anything the party brings back from the ruins."}, {"id": "red_training_yard_hazing", "kind": "social", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Redrock", "location": "Citadel of the Pact", "text": "**Locked in the Warded Pens** (The Training Yard, Citadel of the Pact). A veteran demon-hunter at the Citadel of the Pact keeps hazing new recruits by locking them overnight in the Training Yard's warded pens with a caught imp, and two have already quit. An earnest young orc recruit who apologizes for everything is next on the list and will not report it himself. He needs someone who can stand up to the veteran, or shame him in front of the Citadel. Reward: 100 florins and a warded vessel from the Citadel's workshops."}, {"id": "red_springs_lion_pride", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Redrock", "location": "Wadi of the Beasts", "text": "**The Pride at the Springs** (The Springs, Wadi of the Beasts). A pride of desert lions has claimed the Springs at the head of the wadi and grown bold enough to rush anyone who comes near the deep pools, keepers included. A barefoot human druid, who scolds the lions like unruly nephews, will sanction a cull but would rather see the pride driven down-canyon or its leader brought to heel. Reward: 140 florins and the keepers' leave to take one lion pelt."}, {"id": "red_ledges_dire_vulture", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Redrock", "location": "The Bonecrags", "text": "**The Vulture That Picks the Stragglers** (The Lower Ledges, The Bonecrags). One dire vulture of the Bonecrags, bigger and bolder than the rest, has learned to stoop on anyone who straggles on the canyon road below the cliffs, carrying them up and dropping them on the rocks. A half-deaf dwarf hermit who picks the bone ground for a living knows which ledge it roosts on, and will show the way to anyone who will finish it. Reward: 130 florins and the hermit's pick of the nest-glitter, split fairly."}, {"id": "red_mouth_ember_jackals", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Redrock", "location": "The Flamebleed", "text": "**Jackals at the Mouth of the Bleed** (The Mouth of the Bleed, The Flamebleed). A pack of ember-veined jackals, burned half-alive by long years in the Flamebleed, now dens at the canyon mouth and runs down anyone who camps there for the night. A scorched tiefling who once hunted treasure in the Bleed now sells maps of it from a tent at the mouth, and wants the jackals gone so that she can stay open and her customers can survive the first night. Reward: 110 florins, a jackal hide that turns fire, and a free map of the Glassways."}, {"id": "red_bone_yard_ghouls", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Redrock", "location": "Ghoultown", "text": "**The Dead Walk Out** (The Bone Yard, Ghoultown). Ghouls have started wandering out past the Bone Yard at dusk and onto the badland track beyond Ghoultown, something they never did before. An elderly halfling gravedigger who camps nearby to bury what the ghouls leave, humming hymns off-key the whole time, wants the pack that roams the Bone Yard put down so the dead stay inside their town. Reward: 160 florins and the gravedigger's blessing, whatever that is worth."}, {"id": "red_landing_griffon", "kind": "monster", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Redrock", "location": "The Sky Temple of the Ascension", "text": "**The Griffon at the Landing** (The Cloudwing Landing, The Sky Temple of the Ascension). A young wild griffon has been harrying the condors at the Temple's Cloudwing Landing, diving at them mid-flight and panicking riders. The handlers want it killed. A gangly teenage condor-handler wants it tamed instead, and swears it only needs a bold enough rider, if anyone would try. Reward: 150 florins, and if the griffon is tamed, it stays at the Landing for the party."}]

offer_pool_league_data_041.name: offer_pool_league_data_041
offer_pool_league_data_041.script:
skip = true

A crew of looters has been working the Drowned Gate of Suleyvan's Folly by smashing every sealed vessel they find to see if there is treasure inside, and the freed spirits are hunting everyone near the gate. A bespectacled gnome scholar trying to catalogue the lamps there is beside himself and wants the looters stopped, by persuasion, a better offer, or force. Reward: 130 florins and one sealed lamp from the scholar's catalogue."}, {"id": "red_diggings_stonecutter", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Redrock", "location": "The Ruins of Naran-Kadish", "text": "**The Singer in the Diggings** (The Diggings, The Ruins of Naran-Kadish). A defiant djinnborn stonecutter taken off the road is digging in the Diggings of Naran-Kadish for a brutal gnoll dig-boss, and sings the old songs of the burned city while she works, which he hates. Her people want her out by purchase, trickery, or a quiet escape, before he loses patience with the singing. Reward: 170 florins and a blade from her family's forge."}, {"id": "red_weight_wind_monkey", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "bronze", "region": "Redrock", "location": "The Sky Temple of the Ascension", "text": "**The Sandal Thief** (The Weight and Wind, The Sky Temple of the Ascension).
