Reward: 60 florins and Guild standing, and a song written about the maker, sung every night for a month."}, {"id": "gaa_revel_bell_hoods", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "apprentice", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Vilitara Grove", "text": "**Bell Hoods for the Masked Dance** (The Circle, Vilitara Grove). The satyr who leads the masked dance at the Circle's nightly revels wants six Cloth Hoods sewn with little brass bells, one for each dancer in the first ring. A band of pixies from the arbors steals the bells off every costume during the dance and rings them in the treetops until dawn. A hood takes 1 Wool Cloth; the bells must be sewn on well enough that small hands cannot pick them free. Reward: 50 florins and Guild standing, and a place in the first ring of the dance for as long as the party can keep up."}]

offer_pool_guild_of_all_arts_data_002.name: offer_pool_guild_of_all_arts_data_002
offer_pool_guild_of_all_arts_data_002.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "gaa_chalk_hollow_potions", "kind": "monster", "rank": "apprentice", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Moonbloom Woods", "text": "**Potions for the Chalk-Cutters** (The Chalk Hollow, Moonbloom Woods). The chalk-cutter who digs the white chalk for half of Hillhome's whitewash says a nest of giant adders has settled among the oak roots of the Chalk Hollow, and two of the crew have been bitten this month. Until someone clears the nest, the crew wants four of Mongo's Medium Health Potions in the cutting shed. Each takes 3 Healing Herbs at a still or a field kit; herbs grow along the woodland edges or sell cheaply in any market. Reward: 65 florins and Guild standing, and a cartload of chalk for any wall the party wants whitened."}, {"id": "gaa_backshadow_extract", "kind": "monster", "rank": "apprentice", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "The Wildmarket", "text": "**Extract for the Worg Trapper** (Backshadow, The Wildmarket). A trapper who works out of Backshadow, still counting her fingers after every hunt, says a pack of worgs has come out of the border forest and circles the hunters' fires at night. She wants four vials of Venomwood Extract to coat her blades and snares. Each vial takes 1 Venom Gland, sold on the Trading Ground and the Grove Market, pressed at a still or a field kit. Reward: 70 florins and Guild standing, and a worg pelt if the hunt goes well."}, {"id": "gaa_roadside_trail_food", "kind": "monster", "rank": "apprentice", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "The Wildmarket", "text": "**Trail Food a Bugbear Cannot Steal** (Roadside, The Wildmarket). A grizzled guide camped at Roadside is taking six hunters into the border forest and wants a week of smoked trail food for all of them, wrapped tight in waxed packs. A bugbear has been slipping into the Roadside camps at night and eating every larder it can sniff out, and she has lost two sacks to it already. Game Meat smoked or salted keeps for a journey; the Trading Ground sells it fresh by the haunch. Reward: 45 florins and Guild standing, and the guide's map of the safe paths through the near forest."}, {"id": "gaa_hobson_ale", "kind": "social", "rank": "apprentice", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Hillhome", "text": "**An Ale Worthy of a Champion** (The Saucy Chicken Tavern, Hillhome). A toothless halfling grandmother who has never lost a drinking contest at the Saucy Chicken Tavern has been challenged by a loud young drover who drinks at the next table and swears the tavern's ale is too thin to test a real champion. She wants a cask of dark ale brewed strong enough to settle it, and she will drink the first tankard herself. Ale is brewed in any proper kitchen from grain and hops any village store can supply. Reward: 40 florins and Guild standing, and a seat beside her at the hearth, which in Hillhome is an honor."}, {"id": "gaa_wortle_honeycakes", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "apprentice", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "The Truffle-Woods", "text": "**Honeycakes for the Quickling** (The Bramble Hollow, The Truffle-Woods). A quickling has taken up in the Bramble Hollow and snatches the basket off every forager who passes, too fast to see, then laughs from the thorns. It will stop for anything sweet. A halfling forager lad who lost his basket to it wants a basket of honeycakes good enough to tempt it out, whether to trade with it, trap it, or chase it off. The cakes take honey, flour, and a proper oven; any village store sells all three. Reward: 40 florins in small coin and Guild standing, and whatever the quickling has hoarded, if anyone finds its nest."}, {"id": "gaa_front_drive_shields", "kind": "social", "rank": "apprentice", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Ashbury Hall", "text": "**Shields for the Ashbury Gate** (The Front Drive, Ashbury Hall). A gang of poachers comes up through Ashbury Hall's ancient oaks most nights after the estate's deer, and laughs at the footmen who chase them off with lanterns. The proud footman who keeps the iron gates wants two Wooden Round Shields so he and his fellow can stand between the poachers and the drive. A round shield takes 2 Hardwood at a proper bench; the Timber Store in Forge-town sells seasoned wood. Reward: 65 florins and Guild standing, and the footman's word that the party will always be shown in at Ashbury Hall, never turned away."}, {"id": "gaa_smithy_pitchforks", "kind": "monster", "rank": "apprentice", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Willowford", "text": "**Pitchforks for the Willowford Farms** (The Smithy, Willowford). Goblin scouts from the hills have been raiding Willowford's hen-houses every few nights, and the farmers have asked the village smith for pitchforks faster than one forge can make them. The smith, who keeps a shrine to the Crafter hot with coals in the corner of the shop, wants six Pitchforks made to her pattern. Each takes about 2 Iron Ore for the tines at a proper forge and a shaft of Hardwood; she will lend her forge when it is free. Reward: 55 florins and Guild standing, and a coal from the shrine to the Crafter, which village smiths say brings a steady hand."}, {"id": "gaa_stable_tack", "kind": "monster", "rank": "apprentice", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Riverside Manor", "text": "**Blinkers Against the Kelpie** (The Stables, Riverside Manor). A kelpie has taken to standing in the river shallows below Riverside Manor at dusk and calling the horses to it, and one mare has already broken her halter and gone into the water. The head groom, who talks to every horse by name, wants six sets of leather blinkers and stout lead straps so the horses can be walked past the river without hearing its call. Straps and blinkers take about 1 Rawhide a set, tanned and worked at a leather bench. Reward: 50 florins and Guild standing, and the loan of a good horse from the manor whenever the party is at Riverside."}, {"id": "gaa_post_crossbow", "kind": "social", "rank": "apprentice", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Hillhome", "text": "**A Crossbow for the Cheese-Carter** (Hill Street, Hillhome). A fussy halfling carter who takes Hillhome's eggs and cheeses across the Downs has been stopped twice by footpads who wait at the stile at the bottom of Hill Street, rob the cart, and leave the eggs smashed in the hedge. He counts every cracked one. He wants a Light Crossbow small enough to carry on the cart seat, with a simple trigger that will not jam in the rain. The stock and prod take Hardwood and Iron Ore at a proper bench and forge; Mechanical Components from the Market Stalls make the trigger. Reward: 75 florins and Guild standing, and a wheel of the best Hillhome cheese every month for a year."}, {"id": "gaa_wasp_war_bow", "kind": "monster", "rank": "journeyman", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "The Wildmarket", "text": "**A Bow for the Wasp-Hunter** (The Trading Ground, The Wildmarket). A ranger who trades at the Wildmarket wants a War Bow of Fine work drawn to her own arm, and a sheaf of Emberglass Arrows of Fire, because a nest of giant wasps in the Backshadow has stung two of her hounds to death and plain arrows only anger them. A war bow takes 2 Hardwood at a proper bench, Fine on a great success with Woodworking Tools; 1 Emberglass tips the sheaf. Reward: 180 florins and Guild standing, and a place beside her when she goes back for the nest."}]

offer_pool_guild_of_all_arts_data_003.name: offer_pool_guild_of_all_arts_data_003
offer_pool_guild_of_all_arts_data_003.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "gaa_satyr_staff", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "journeyman", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Vilitara Grove", "text": "**A Staff for the Vintage Rite** (The Elder's Arbor, Vilitara Grove). The satyr elder of Vilitara Grove opens every vintage with a rite led by a witchwood staff, and the old one split when a jealous piper of the grove snapped it in a drunken contest. The elder wants a Witchwood Staff of Arcane of Fine work, carved with vines, and the piper boasts he will snap this one too. It takes 1 Witchwood, sold at the Wildmarket's Grove Market, worked at a proper bench with Woodworking Tools. Reward: 150 florins and Guild standing, and a cask of the grove's strongest vintage."}, {"id": "gaa_veller_cuirass", "kind": "social", "rank": "journeyman", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Forge-town", "text": "**Leather Worth Defending** (The Forge Quarter, Forge-town). A widowed saddler who works with her shop door open in the Forge Quarter has a client who wants a Leather Cuirass of Fine work, and a rival leatherworker in the Leather District telling every buyer that her leather rots in the rain. She wants the cuirass made at her open door, where the street can watch its making, so the rumor dies. It takes 3 Rawhide, tanned and worked at a leather bench, Fine on a great success with Leatherworking Tools. Reward: 120 florins and Guild standing, and a standing welcome at her bench."}, {"id": "gaa_goldspoon_cloak", "kind": "social", "rank": "journeyman", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Hillhome", "text": "**A Cloak for the Fair** (Hill Street, Hillhome). A rich halfling matriarch of Hillhome wants a plum-dyed Wool Cloak of Fine work to wear to the next Newmoon Fair, cut so well that every other family on Hill Street looks shabby beside her. Her old seamstress, furious at being passed over after twenty years, sits in the matriarch's kitchen telling anyone who will listen that no outsider can match her stitching. A cloak takes 2 Wool Cloth, Fine on a great success with a Sewing Kit. Reward: 110 florins and Guild standing, and the matriarch's favor, which is worth more in Hillhome than coin."}, {"id": "gaa_troll_blood_draughts", "kind": "monster", "rank": "journeyman", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "The Wildmarket", "text": "**Brewed from the Troll That Got Away** (Roadside, The Wildmarket). A captain of monster-slayers who works out of the Wildmarket carries a jar of Troll Blood from a hill troll her crew wounded and lost, and wants it brewed into three Greater Stamina Draughts before they go back for it. The troll has been seen again near the Roadside camps, healed. Each draught takes 2 Healing Herbs and 1 Troll Blood at a still or a field kit; she supplies the blood. Reward: 150 florins and Guild standing, and a share of the bounty if anyone hunts the troll with her."}, {"id": "gaa_copper_shortsword", "kind": "social", "rank": "journeyman", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Forge-town", "text": "**A Fine Blade for a New Copper** (Town Square, Forge-town). A young League Copper who polishes her badge every hour has been mocked in the Town Square every evening by an older crew, who have twice snapped her cheap blade in front of everyone. She has saved for a Fine Steel Shortsword made in Forge-town, and wants it made where they can watch. It takes about 2 Iron Ore at a proper forge, Fine on a great success with a Smith's Hammer. Reward: 140 florins and Guild standing, and her crew's promise to stand beside the party in any brawl in Forge-town."}, {"id": "gaa_rose_garden_arrows", "kind": "monster", "rank": "journeyman", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Riverside Manor", "text": "**Silver for the Rose Garden** (The Gardens, Riverside Manor). Riverside Manor's head gardener has named every rose in the walled garden, and for a month specters have come up the path from the Fallen Chapel each night and withered a bed of them by touch. She wants three sheaves of Silver-Tipped Arrows of Radiance for the manor's archers. 1 Silver Ore tips a sheaf at a proper forge, sold at the Market Stalls in Forge-town; 1 Hardwood makes the shafts. Reward: 130 florins and Guild standing, and a cutting of the rarest rose in the garden."}, {"id": "gaa_centaur_throwing_axes", "kind": "social", "rank": "journeyman", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "The Wildmarket", "text": "**Axes to Beat the Centaur** (The Satyr Stands, The Wildmarket). Every week at the Satyr Stands a centaur wins the axe-throwing wager with throwing axes so cleverly weighted that no other thrower can match them. The satyr who keeps the book loves an underdog and wants four Throwing Axes of Fine work, balanced true, so a local thrower can beat the centaur fairly. An axe head takes about 2 Iron Ore at a proper forge, Fine on a great success with a Smith's Hammer. Reward: 160 florins and Guild standing, and a tenth of the winnings when the centaur finally loses."}, {"id": "gaa_neama_long_bow", "kind": "monster", "rank": "journeyman", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Hillhome", "text": "**A Long Bow for the Poacher** (The Saucy Chicken Tavern, Hillhome). A one-eyed halfling poacher who swears he has gone straight drinks by the door of the Saucy Chicken Tavern and has been watching a band of gnoll raiders that camps on the downs above the village and raids the outlying farms. His bow cracked on the last hunt. He wants a Long Bow of Fine work drawn to his own arm, and will stand still for exactly one fitting. It takes 2 Hardwood at a proper bench, Fine on a great success with Woodworking Tools. Reward: 130 florins and Guild standing, and a place beside him when he goes after the gnolls."}, {"id": "gaa_dandy_lute", "kind": "social", "rank": "journeyman", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Hillhome", "text": "**A Lute to Answer a Challenge** (The Fairground, Hillhome). The young halfling lutenist who plays for the dances at the Fairground has been challenged by a visiting virtuoso who plays there every market day and declares every lute in Hillhome a firewood box. The lutenist wants a Maple Lute of Fine work to answer him at the next Fair, with fretwork fine enough to be admired from the back row. It takes Hardwood worked at a proper bench, Fine on a great success with Woodworking Tools. Reward: 150 florins and Guild standing, and the first dance at the next Fair played in the maker's honor."}, {"id": "gaa_venomwood_boar_arrows", "kind": "monster", "rank": "journeyman", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "The Wildmarket", "text": "**Arrows for the Tusk-Hunter** (The Trading Ground, The Wildmarket). A hunter on the Trading Ground who keeps a tally of tusks on his belt wants three sheaves of Venomwood Arrows of Poison for a dire boar that wallows on the forest edge behind the Trading Ground, has gored two horses, and shrugs off plain arrows. He would like a Fine Short Bow too, if the maker is good enough. 1 Venomwood makes a sheaf at a proper bench, sold at the Grove Market; 1 Hardwood makes the bow, Fine on a great success with Woodworking Tools. Reward: 120 florins and Guild standing, or 170 if the Fine Short Bow comes with them, and a tusk from the boar."}]

offer_pool_guild_of_all_arts_data_004.name: offer_pool_guild_of_all_arts_data_004
offer_pool_guild_of_all_arts_data_004.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "gaa_sheriff_wading_boots", "kind": "monster", "rank": "journeyman", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Hillhome", "text": "**Boots for the Brook** (The Sleeping Bear Inn, Hillhome). A retired halfling miller who would rather be fishing than anything has lost two pairs of boots to a giant pike that lurks under the brook bank south of the Fairground and snaps at anything that wades. He wants a pair of Leather Boots of Fine work, oiled to stay dry and thick enough at the ankle to turn teeth, and he tells everyone at the Sleeping Bear Inn about the pike. A pair takes 1 Rawhide at a leather bench, Fine on a great success with Leatherworking Tools. Reward: 100 florins and Guild standing, and the pike mounted over the inn's hearth with the maker's name under it, if anyone lands it."}, {"id": "gaa_minotaur_jerkin", "kind": "monster", "rank": "journeyman", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Vilitara Grove", "text": "**A Jerkin for the Wrestling Ring** (The Dell, Vilitara Grove). A visiting minotaur wrestles all comers among the wine casks of the Dell every revel night, and has thrown the grove's champion nine falls in a row, horns first. The satyr champion wants a Leather Jerkin of Fine work, hard enough at the ribs to take a horn and loose enough at the shoulders to grapple. It takes 2 Rawhide, tanned and worked at a leather bench, Fine on a great success with Leatherworking Tools. Reward: 130 florins and Guild standing, and a jar of the Dell's strongest wine, which the minotaur has been drinking for free."}, {"id": "gaa_percival_cloak", "kind": "social", "rank": "journeyman", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Hillhome", "text": "**A Cloak to Ask for a Dance** (Knothole, Hillhome). A shy young halfling clerk from Knothole means to ask a girl from Hill Street to dance at the next Newmoon Fair, and her other suitor, a swaggering drover, mocks his patched coat every evening on the Knothole stoops. The clerk has saved a year for a peacock-blue Wool Cloak and hood of Fine work and has rehearsed what he will say when he wears them. A cloak takes 2 Wool Cloth and a hood 1, Fine on a great success with a Sewing Kit. Reward: 120 florins and Guild standing, and an invitation to the wedding, if it comes to that."}, {"id": "gaa_ankheg_padding", "kind": "monster", "rank": "journeyman", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Forge-town", "text": "**Padding Against the Ankheg** (The Leather District, Forge-town). An armorer in the Leather District is fitting a League crew to hunt an ankheg that bursts up under the farm fields outside Forge-town and spits acid that eats through ordinary padding in a breath. She wants four sets of quilted padding to wear under armor, of Fine work, doubled at the collar and cuffs where the spit lands. Each set takes about 1 Wool Cloth in a proper tailor's workshop, Fine on a great success with a Sewing Kit. Reward: 110 florins and Guild standing, and a piece of ankheg shell if the crew comes back with one."}, {"id": "gaa_study_mana_philters", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "journeyman", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Riverside Manor", "text": "**Philters for the Study** (The Study, Riverside Manor). The lady of Riverside Manor who keeps its deep shelves of folklore tried one of the old rites in her books and called up a quasit, which now shreds her pages and hides behind the estate records. She knows the banishing, but it drains her dry before it is done. She wants four Mana Philters to see her through. Each takes 2 Healing Herbs and 1 Witchwood at a still or a field kit; members can buy witchwood at the Market Stalls in Forge-town. Reward: 160 florins and Guild standing, and the run of the Study's folklore shelves."}, {"id": "gaa_statue_vitriol", "kind": "monster", "rank": "journeyman", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Ashbury Hall", "text": "**Vitriol for the Sculpture Garden** (The Sculpture Garden, Ashbury Hall). One of the marble statues in Ashbury Hall's Sculpture Garden has started walking the gravel paths at night, and the gardener who trims the hedges found her shears snapped in its hand one morning. Steel only chips it. She wants four Vitriol Flasks to eat through its stone. Each takes 1 Acid Gland, sold at the Grove Market, pressed at a still or a field kit. Reward: 140 florins and Guild standing, and the walking statue's marble head, if anyone wants it."}, {"id": "gaa_brownie_hunt_feast", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "journeyman", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Riverside Manor", "text": "**A Hunt Feast and a Brownie** (The Kitchens, Riverside Manor). Riverside Manor's cook must put a hunt feast for twenty on the long oak table, and a brownie that lives behind the twin hearths has spoiled every dish this month that was not first offered a share. The cook wants a guest maker to cook the feast in the manor's real kitchen, and either feed the brownie or out-argue it. Game Meat for the roasts sells at the Wildmarket; the manor's herb garden supplies the rest. Reward: 120 florins and Guild standing, and a seat at the feast among the hunt."}, {"id": "gaa_basket_path_lamps", "kind": "wildcard", "rank": "journeyman", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Moonbloom Woods", "text": "**Lamps That Find the Way Home** (The Old Oaks, Moonbloom Woods). A pooka has taken up in the Old Oaks of Moonbloom Woods, and on foggy mornings it runs ahead of the truffle-foragers as a black goat, leading them in circles until dusk. The hog-keeper who works the Old Oaks wants three Homegoing Lamps keyed to the stump where the Basket Path begins, so the foragers can follow them home. A paper lamp and its small working are laid at an enchanter's bench with an Artificer's Toolkit. Reward: 150 florins and Guild standing, and a moonbloom truffle from every basket that comes home by lamplight this season."}, {"id": "gaa_garden_needle_traps", "kind": "monster", "rank": "journeyman", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Willowford", "text": "**Needles Under the Green** (The Village Green, Willowford). Giant moles have been tunneling under Willowford's green every night, and two sheep have broken legs in the holes. A shepherd who bought a Blueprint: Needle Trap of Poison at the Craft Fair and cannot read it wants three Needle Traps of Poison set at the burrow mouths, and will lend the blueprint to the maker. Each takes an Artificer's Toolkit, one bundle of Mechanical Components from the Market Stalls in Forge-town, one Venomwood Extract, and a maker with trapcraft 5. Reward: 170 florins and Guild standing, and a copy of one of her simpler blueprints for the party to keep."}, {"id": "gaa_ashbury_silver_sword", "kind": "monster", "rank": "artisan", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Ashbury Hall", "text": "**A Silver Blade for Ashbury Hall** (The Main Hall, Ashbury Hall). Ashbury Hall's heir has twice seen a revenant walking the riverbank below the hill at night, and the family's steward wants a Silver Shortsword of Radiant of Superior work, bearing its maker's mark, before the heir does something brave. The steward pays for the mark as much as the silver and will check it against the Guild's roll. It takes about 2 Silver Ore in place of iron at a proper forge, and is Superior only on a great success. Reward: 380 florins and Guild standing, and the family's gratitude, which opens doors across Whitecliff Downs."}]

It takes about 2 Frostjade in place of iron at a proper forge, Superior only on a great success; members can buy frostjade at the Market Stalls. Reward: 340 florins and Guild standing, and free rooms at the Willow Ford Inn for as long as the axe hangs over the bar."}, {"id": "gaa_scorpion_flame_sword", "kind": "monster", "rank": "artisan", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "The Wildmarket", "text": "**A Fire Blade for the Scorpion Hunt** (Backshadow, The Wildmarket). Plain steel skids off their plates. She wants a Steel Shortsword of Flame of Superior work: a blade forged at a proper forge, then laid with a fire-working along the fuller at an enchanter's bench with an Artificer's Toolkit and 1 Emberglass. The working holds, and the grade is Superior, only on a great success. Reward: 300 florins and Guild standing, and a scorpion sting worth a good price at the Grove Market."}, {"id": "gaa_construct_thunder_hammer", "kind": "monster", "rank": "artisan", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Forge-town", "text": "**A Shock Hammer for the Carved Guardian** (Woodworkers' Row, Forge-town). She wants an Iron Warhammer forged with Thunderglass in place of the iron, which deals shock, of Superior work, to shake its joints apart. It takes about 2 Thunderglass at a proper forge, Superior only on a great success. Reward: 330 florins and Guild standing, and the guardian's carved oak head, if anyone can bring it down whole."}, {"id": "gaa_cold_iron_redcap", "kind": "monster", "rank": "artisan", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "The Truffle-Woods", "text": "**Cold Iron for the Truffle Paths** (The Forager's Path, The Truffle-Woods). A redcap has come out of the older woods beyond the Bramble Hollow and lies in wait on the Forager's Path for halflings and their truffle-hogs. The old truffle-hunter who sings to her hogs as she walks has seen it twice, and steel does not trouble it. She wants a Cold Iron dagger of Superior work. Cold Iron is worked cold and never touched by the forge-fire, about 2 to the blade; it is rare and dear, and the Superior grade comes only of a great success. Reward: 350 florins and Guild standing, and the redcap's iron cap, which Forge-town smiths will pay well to see."}, {"id": "gaa_ettin_venomwood_dagger", "kind": "monster", "rank": "artisan", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "The Wildmarket", "text": "**A Venomwood Dagger for the Ettin Bounty** (Roadside, The Wildmarket). A bounty hunter who argues with herself out loud has taken the bounty on an ettin that comes to the Roadside camps every few nights, smashing wagons and eating the mules. She wants a Venomwood Dagger of Poison of Superior work: one deep cut, and both heads can argue about it for a week. It takes 1 Venomwood, carved at a proper bench with Woodworking Tools; the Grove Market sells it, and the Superior grade comes only of a great success. Reward: 280 florins and Guild standing, and a cut of the ettin bounty if the party hunts it with her."}, {"id": "gaa_manu_scale_jerkin", "kind": "social", "rank": "artisan", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Hillhome", "text": "**Scale for a Would-Be Knight** (The Sleeping Bear Inn, Hillhome). A knight-errant lodging at the Sleeping Bear Inn laughs every evening that no halfling will ever be knighted, and the inn's stable-girl, who practices her guard with a broom handle behind the stables, has heard him. She wants a scale jerkin of Drake Scale of Superior work to wear when she asks him for a bout. Drake Scale in place of hide makes scale armor that turns blades better than leather; 2 make a jerkin at a leather bench, Superior on a great success. Reward: 340 florins and Guild standing, and her family's old pony, which is better than it looks."}, {"id": "gaa_falconer_scale_gloves", "kind": "monster", "rank": "artisan", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Ashbury Hall", "text": "**Gloves to Hold a Hippogriff** (The Front Drive, Ashbury Hall). A wild hippogriff swoops on the Ashbury falcons every time they fly from the Front Drive, and the hall's falconer, who keeps a bird on her fist even at supper, means to catch it and break it to the glove. She wants Leather Gloves and a Leather Cap faced with Drake Scale, of Superior work, that hippogriff talons cannot pierce. Drake Scale in place of hide, about 1 each, worked at a leather bench, Superior on a great success. Reward: 260 florins and Guild standing, and the first ride on the hippogriff if it is ever tamed."}]

offer_pool_guild_of_all_arts_data_006.name: offer_pool_guild_of_all_arts_data_006
offer_pool_guild_of_all_arts_data_006.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "gaa_channel_mantle_duel", "kind": "social", "rank": "artisan", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "The Wildmarket", "text": "**A Mantle for the Spell-Duel** (The Satyr Stands, The Wildmarket). She wants a Superior Channel-Lined Mantle sewn with silver-thread channels that hold a little current close. 2 hanks of Spider Silk make the mantle in a proper tailor's workshop, and 1 Silver Ore draws the thread; Superior only on a great success. Reward: 380 florins and Guild standing, and every wager she wins wearing it, for a month."}, {"id": "gaa_beekeeper_silk_veil", "kind": "monster", "rank": "artisan", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Hillhome", "text": "**A Silk Veil for the Apiary** (Hill Street, Hillhome). She wants a Spider Silk veil, hood, and gloves of Superior work, light enough to work in, strong enough that a furious swarm cannot sting through while she rebuilds. 2 hanks of Spider Silk make the set in a tailor's workshop, Superior on a great success. Reward: 260 florins and Guild standing, and a jar of hillside honey every season for life."}, {"id": "gaa_guide_silk_greatcloak", "kind": "monster", "rank": "artisan", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "The Wildmarket", "text": "**A Greatcloak Against the Peryton** (The Grove Market, The Wildmarket). She wants a new Oiled Greatcloak lined with Spider Silk, of Superior work, that turns a peryton's antlers as well as rain. 2 Wool Cloth and 2 hanks of Spider Silk at a proper tailor's workshop; the Grove Market sells silk, and the Superior grade comes only of a great success. Reward: 300 florins and Guild standing, and first warning from her tree of anything dangerous coming out of the forest."}, {"id": "gaa_garden_greater_philters", "kind": "social", "rank": "artisan", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Vilitara Grove", "text": "**Philters to Beat the Grove** (The Garden, Vilitara Grove). One of those apprentices, who samples everything, wants four Greater Mana Philters of a maker's best work to set beside the satyr's at the next tasting. Each takes 2 Healing Herbs, 1 Witchwood, and 1 Moonbloom Truffle at a still or a field kit. Reward: 260 florins and Guild standing, and the satyr's cask, if the philters win the tasting."}, {"id": "gaa_shambling_mound_oil", "kind": "monster", "rank": "artisan", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "The Truffle-Woods", "text": "**Oil for the Shambling Mound** (The Truffle Patches, The Truffle-Woods). A shambling mound has settled in a wet dell at the edge of the Truffle Patches and has swallowed two truffle-hogs that rooted too near. The hog-breeder whose best sow went missing wants six vials of Emberglass Oil, enough to set a band of foragers' blades alight. Each vial takes 1 Emberglass ground into lamp oil at a still or a field kit; members can buy emberglass at the Market Stalls in Forge-town. Reward: 280 florins and Guild standing, and a truffle-hog piglet from her next litter."}, {"id": "gaa_bark_charmed_pie", "kind": "social", "rank": "artisan", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Hillhome", "text": "**A Sign for the Bakery** (Hill Street, Hillhome). A young halfling of Hillhome means to ask his grandmother to back his bakery at the next family supper and wants to show he is serious: a hanging sign carved from fine witchwood, with a small charm bound in so the smell of fresh bread drifts down Hill Street whenever the oven is lit. A rival baker on Hill Street, who sells stale buns and knows it, tells the village he will never open. 1 Witchwood is carved at a proper bench and charmed at an enchanter's bench with an Artificer's Toolkit, Superior only on a great success. Reward: 250 florins and Guild standing, and a seat at the family supper."}, {"id": "gaa_fair_storm_rod", "kind": "social", "rank": "artisan", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Forge-town", "text": "**A Rod for the Lantern-Lighter** (Town Square, Forge-town). A gnome storm-caller lights the lanterns around the Founder's statue with lightning every evening in the Town Square, and a fire-juggler who works the same crowd mocks her sparks as candle-tricks and wins the coin. She wants a Thunderglass Rod of Superior work that will throw a clean bolt across the whole square. It takes 1 Thunderglass, set on a short rod with its working laid in at an enchanter's bench with an Artificer's Toolkit, Superior only on a great success. Reward: 290 florins and Guild standing, and the fire-juggler's pitch in the square if she wins the crowd."}, {"id": "gaa_vine_emberglass_traps", "kind": "monster", "rank": "artisan", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Riverside Manor", "text": "**Fire Traps for the Fallen Chapel Path** (The Courtyard, Riverside Manor). The manor's under-steward, who measures the hedges with a rule, wants three Emberglass Traps of Fire set at its roots. The steward will lend a pattern; each trap takes an Artificer's Toolkit, one bundle of Mechanical Components, and about 1 Emberglass for the shard cage. Reward: 300 florins and Guild standing, and a cutting from the manor's rose garden that grows nowhere else."}, {"id": "gaa_warren_burstwheels", "kind": "monster", "rank": "artisan", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Whitehill Kobold Warren", "text": "**Burstwheels for the Warren Gate** (The Warren Gate, Whitehill Kobold Warren). A dwarf sapper has camped in the rocks below the Warren Gate for a month, measuring the hillside in paces. An old dwarven digging engine buried in the hill long ago has woken, and it grinds out of the gate to crush anything that comes up the path, kobolds included. She wants three Stormsteel Burstwheels of Shock to stop it. She supplies her Blueprint: Stormsteel Burstwheel of Shock and the stormsteel; each wheel takes an Artificer's Toolkit, one bundle of Mechanical Components, and a maker with enchanting 5. Reward: 360 florins and Guild standing, and the engine's brass gears, which a Forge-town tinker will pay well for."}, {"id": "gaa_council_breastplate", "kind": "social", "rank": "master", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Forge-town", "text": "**A Masterwork to Shame a Forger** (The Masters' Chamber, Forge-town). Reward: 1,200 florins and Guild standing, and the Council's thanks in front of the whole Guild."}]

offer_pool_guild_of_all_arts_data_007.name: offer_pool_guild_of_all_arts_data_007
offer_pool_guild_of_all_arts_data_007.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "gaa_slayer_brigandine", "kind": "monster", "rank": "master", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "The Wildmarket", "text": "**Brigandine for the Last Hunt** (The Grove Market, The Wildmarket). Masterwork armor needs exceptional hide or scale from a strong or elite creature and a master's workshop; Drake Scale from the beast's own kin would do, and she knows a molting ground. Reward: 1,400 florins and Guild standing, and her old hunting horn, which every slayer at the market knows."}, {"id": "gaa_manor_circlet", "kind": "social", "rank": "master", "region": "Whitecliff Downs", "location": "Riverside Manor", "text": "**A Circlet to End a Feud** (The Great Hall, Riverside Manor). Masterwork needs exceptional material from a strong or elite creature, a master's forge, and a master smith; a maker with smithing 25 or higher is one. Masterwork needs exceptional material from a strong or elite creature, a master's forge, and a master smith; a maker with smithing 25 or higher is one. fenimore_guild_directory.name: fenimore_guild_directory

conditions.query: A member of the party asks Fenimore Tully, or anyone in the Map Room, about guilds, orders, companies, or brotherhoods; which one to join or where they might belong; how to join one; or what can be joined in a particular region.

fenimore_guild_directory.script: effects.push({ type: 'story', instruction: "A member of the party is asking Fenimore Tully about guilds, orders, or where they might belong. He answers from his guide to the guilds of Larion, below. He answers what was asked: one guild in depth, or the two or three that best suit the asker, never the whole list at once. For each guild he mentions, he says plainly where its seat is and exactly what to do there to begin, and he tells his own story from his time in it. The League of Adventurers is downstairs in this same Watchtower, so he sends anyone asking about it there. The Adventuring Houses, affiliates of the League: seat, Wildward House in Carendon, the House of Many Banners in Gorren Crossing, Sky-River House in Oasis, and Skygate House in Cloudtop; suits people who want a home hall and a company of their own; to begin, ask the House's resident veteran to count you among its company, or to take up a dormant House and restore it; his story: he restored one for a week, and the roof had opinions. The Order of the Silver Sword: seat, Castle Harstone in Carendon; suits monster hunters; to begin, go to Castle Harstone and ask an Order officer to take you as an Initiate; his story: excellent cloaks, terrible soup. The Wolfpack: seat, the Great Lodge at Wolfpack Lodge, in the Orc Wolds; suits hunters, beast-friends, and anyone who wants their deeds witnessed; to begin, ask at the Great Lodge to join and volunteer for a proving deed; his story: they said he was too short to be witnessed, but he kept the wrestling hold. The service of Galard: the Templars Adamant and the Knights Vigilant: seat, the Hall of Shields, the Temple of the Sword Vigilant in Whitemoor, and the Shrine of Galard at Rovena; suits the brave, the oath-minded, shield-bearers and riders; to begin, ask a priest of Galard how to enter Galard's service; his story: he served Galard for a year and learned he is braver behind a desk. The Shadow Inquisition: seat, the Hall of Shadow in the Black Tower, Duchy of Drusavia; suits hunters of the dead, and the grim; to begin, ask Jett in the Hall of Shadow to take you on; she sends you to swear at the Pit; his story: never go to the Pit uninvited; he did, once. Tarnholme Academy: seat, the Great Hall on the Main Island of the Jade Tarn, reached by skiff from Tarnport, the port town on the shore; suits mages and the endlessly curious; to begin, ask at the Great Hall to sit the entrance examination; his story: he failed the examination, passed it the next year, and is still lost in the Library. The Crimson Company: seat, the Red House in Velmere, in the Shadow Summits; suits hunters of blood-drinkers with a taste for danger; to begin, ask at the Red House to sign the Company's writ; his story: he signed, read it afterward, and advises reading it first. The Long Watch: seat, the Lamp-Tower in Warmwater Township, Aurora; suits anyone who will stand a cold watch for other people; to begin, ask at the Lamp-Tower to join and swear its oath; his story: lovely people; his toes have not forgiven them. The arena circuit: seat, eight arenas, among them the Field of Valor, Tevantia's Amphitheater, and the Red Sands of Oasis; suits fighters who like a crowd; to begin, accept a sanctioned match at any arena; his story: he debuted, lost, and was carried out to applause. The Guild of All Arts: seat, the Guild hall in Forge-town, Whitecliff Downs; suits makers of every kind: smiths, tanners, tailors, carpenters, brewers, alchemists, enchanters; to begin, ask at the Guild hall to be entered as an apprentice; his story: the one guild still glad to see him, because they like his book." })

tarnport_backstage_guidance.name: tarnport_backstage_guidance
tarnport_backstage_guidance.script: effects.push({ type: 'story', instruction: "The party is at Backstage, the actors' tavern behind the Playhouse in Tarnport. This is the standing truth of the place; bring in one or two of these things when they fit the scene, never all at once. Backstage began as the actors' own club behind the stage, where the company drank after a show with a few friends. More and more people talked their way through the red door, until the company gave up and opened it to everyone. It is still the actors' place: they run it between performances, and they run it like a show. The actors are the hosts: they take orders in character, give regulars stage names, and pull everyone into the night's games. The house rule is that everyone plays. The crowd is young, well-off and lively: Tarnholme students in their College scarves, merchants' sons and daughters, travelers off the foreign ships in strange fashions, visiting nobles, a professor or two in a corner booth, and a scattering of townsfolk who come for the show. It is the place in Tarnport to be seen, to flirt and to show off. The house games, played out as scenes: the Dare Wheel, a painted wheel spun by an actor, landing on dares that are brave, absurd or romantic; Masks, where a guest draws a mask from the company's trunk and plays that character, such as the Pirate Queen, the Jilted Lover or the Pompous Archmage, until midnight while the room tries to make them break; the Liar's Tale, where a guest tells the room three stories about themselves and the room guesses which one is the lie; and Mock Trials, where a guest accuses a friend of an absurd crime, actors play judge and counsel, and the room's verdict carries a forfeit. Next door at the Playhouse, the company plays a rotating repertoire: a swashbuckling romance of pirates and a stolen bride; a comedy of mistaken identity at a noble wedding; a tragedy of a drowned prince who returns as a ghost to name his killer; a satire of Tarnholme's own masters that students cheer and the masters pretend not to see; and a spectacle night of illusions, fire and flying. Once a week the stage is open to anyone, and students sing, juggle spells, recite or make fools of themselves. Audience members are pulled on stage for small parts, and anyone drinking at Backstage on a show night may be grabbed, shoved into a costume and sent on as an extra." })

offer_pool_tarnholme_data_001.name: offer_pool_tarnholme_data_001
offer_pool_tarnholme_data_001.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "th1_climbing_construct", "kind": "combat", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Artificers' Isle", "text": "**It Learned to Climb** (The Workshop Climb, Artificers' Isle). A Second-Year Artificer's climbing construct has gone wrong and scuttles over the Workshop Climb's roofs, flinging tools at anyone below. Its mortified maker wants it destroyed or switched off before it hurts somebody. Reward: 45 florins and a brass messenger bird that flies notes anywhere on the islands."}, {"id": "th1_herb_garden_kobolds", "kind": "combat", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Wortwell", "text": "**Kobolds in the Herb Beds** (The Herb Garden, Wortwell). Kobolds have tunnelled into Wortwell's Herb Garden and strip the beds after dark, setting spiked snares. The furious halfling who keeps the garden wants them driven off or killed and the tunnel closed. Reward: 50 florins and a standing place at the herb-keeper's supper table, where half of Wortwell drops in to gossip."}, {"id": "th1_grow_hall_troglodytes", "kind": "combat", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "The Glowcaves", "text": "**Raiders in the Lower Beds** (The Grow-Halls, The Glowcaves). Troglodytes from the deep tunnels raid the myconids' lowest grow-hall beds at night and clubbed a myconid last night. A polite young bed-tender asks for help: the myconids hate fighting, and no one may bring fire into the caves. Reward: 45 florins and a guided walk through the myconids' grow-halls, which few surface folk have seen."}, {"id": "th1_herb_paths_ettercap", "kind": "combat", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "The Bramblewood", "text": "**Webs Across the Herb Paths** (The Herb Paths, The Bramblewood). An ettercap has strung webs across the Herb Paths and already dragged off a gatherer's dog. A nervous young Wortwell gatherer needs it killed or driven back into the thornbrakes and the webs cut down. Reward: 45 florins and the gatherer's introduction to Aelwen, the warden of the Bramblewood."}, {"id": "th1_bog_bridge_bullywugs", "kind": "combat", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "The Bramblewood", "text": "**Bullywugs at the Bog Bridge** (The Bog Bridge, The Bramblewood). Bullywugs hold the Bog Bridge and club anyone who won't pay their toll; they took an old basket-weaver's whole season of baskets. The grumbling weaver wants them driven off so people can cross safely. Reward: 40 florins and a round at the Tun and Tale, where the weaver tells everyone who cleared the bridge."}, {"id": "th1_glasshouse_mephits", "kind": "combat", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Wortwell", "text": "**Smoke in the Furnaces** (The Glasshouse, Wortwell). Smoke mephits have moved into the flues of Wortwell's Glasshouse, sooting the racks and cracking flasks. The short-tempered glassblower, a week behind, wants them gone before the next batch. Reward: 50 florins and a turn at the Glasshouse furnaces to blow a phial of your own."}, {"id": "th1_moorings_eels", "kind": "combat", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Battle Mages' Isle", "text": "**Eels in the Shallows** (The Moorings, Battle Mages' Isle). Giant eels have come into the Moorings' shallows and bite the young sky-skates and anyone who wades in. Ruvan Kesh, who teaches beginners there, wants them killed or driven out, and he'd like to see how newcomers do in the water. Reward: 45 florins and a first harnessed ride on a sky-skate."}, {"id": "th1_pens_goblins", "kind": "combat", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Dimbly Hatchery", "text": "**Goblins in the Pens** (The Pens, Dimbly Hatchery). Goblins sneak down at night to steal fowl from the Pens; last night they cut the fences and stabbed a keeper's dog. A Dimbly aunt wants them caught in the act and sent off for good. Reward: 45 florins and supper at the Brooding Hen on the Dimblys, who will want to hear every detail."}, {"id": "th1_missing_first_year", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Tarnport", "text": "**He Never Came Back** (The Sumps, Tarnport). A First-Year went to Tarnport three days ago and never came back to the Newcomers' Hall; his roommate last saw him heading toward the Sumps with a sailor who had offered him work. Someone needs to follow the trail, bring him home and deal with whoever took him. Reward: 55 florins and a roommate who owes you forever."}, {"id": "th1_vanishing_owl", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Tarnport", "text": "**The Owl Who Didn't Come Home** (The Dovecote, Tarnport). Familiars are vanishing off Tarnport's rooftops, among them a young Healer's owl and a pseudodragon from the Dovecote. Someone is netting them for a ship that sails at the end of the week. The Healer wants them found and returned, and the netter stopped. Reward: 55 florins and a room at the Dovecote whenever you want one, where the town's students cook and argue together."}, {"id": "th1_bursting_wands", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Burlwick", "text": "**Wands That Burst** (Workshop Row, Burlwick). Three wands fitted at one famous workshop on Workshop Row have burst in their owners' hands. Liesl Ambergrin, who has just taken over the family workshop, swears her work left sound and wants the saboteur found and the bad wands traced and taken back. Reward: 60 florins and a fitting at Liesl Ambergrin's bench, where she will tell you exactly what is wrong with your focus."}, {"id": "th1_stolen_sleeping_draught", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Wortwell", "text": "**Enough to Drop a Dozen** (The Brewhouses, Wortwell). Someone broke into Ryel's brewhouse and took only his strongest sleeping draught, enough to drop a dozen men. Ryel, who runs Wortwell's biggest potion house, wants the thieves found and their plan stopped before the village starts whispering. Reward: 60 florins, two of Ryel's healing draughts, and his good prices from then on."}, {"id": "th1_library_ghost", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "The Main Island", "text": "**Someone Reading Over Your Shoulder** (The Library, The Main Island). Students working late in the Library feel someone reading over their shoulders, and each morning the same book lies open at a page about a student who drowned in the Tarn a century ago. Mikol, the Professor of the History of Magic, wants the ghost's story learned and the ghost laid to rest or given what it wants. Reward: 40 florins and an evening of Mikol's stories, which are better than they sound."}, {"id": "th1_hoarded_eggs", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Dimbly Hatchery", "text": "**The Missing Eggs** (The Hatching House, Dimbly Hatchery). Eggs vanish from the Hatching House's racks one a night with the doors still bolted, and the drakeling egg the village has waited a year for is due any day. Hubert Dimbly half suspects a ghost. Someone must find the thief and get the eggs back. Reward: 50 florins and a place at the Hatching House when the drakeling egg hatches."}, {"id": "th1_backstage_admirer", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Tarnport", "text": "**Roses With Thorns** (Backstage, Tarnport). Juno Hartwell, the Playhouse's rising actress, has found roses at the red door after every show for a month. Now the notes know where she sleeps and someone was in her dressing room. She wants the admirer found and stopped. Reward: 50 florins and the best box at Juno's next premiere."}]

const data = [{"id": "th1_newcomers_sleepwalkers", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "The Main Island", "text": "**The Sleepwalkers** (The Newcomers' Hall, The Main Island). First-Years in the Newcomers' Hall keep waking up somewhere else, with no memory of getting there. Bridie Cahill notes they all bought a charm from the same smiling stranger in Tarnport and wants the sleepwalking stopped and the stranger found. Reward: 50 florins and Bridie's gratitude, which comes with the best room in the Hall."}, {"id": "th1_skiff_hill_eviction", "kind": "social", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Tarnport", "text": "**Notice to Quit** (Skiff Hill, Tarnport). A Skiff Hill landlady who has mothered students for forty years has told a whole house of them to be out by the new moon. She won't say why and has been crying; a smooth young agent has been seen at her door and three others. Someone should learn why and keep the students in their rooms. Reward: 50 florins and a room on Skiff Hill whenever you need one."}, {"id": "th1_stolen_design", "kind": "social", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Burlwick", "text": "**Whose Wand Is It?** (The Misfire, Burlwick). Two old gnome workshops launched the same new wand on the same day, each swearing the other stole it. One matriarch wants a student with no stake in Burlwick to judge it and broker a settlement before anyone's timber is hexed; a sweating apprentice from the other side seems to know more. Reward: 50 florins and a night at the Misfire with both families once the feud is settled, the drinks on them."}, {"id": "th1_spectacle_hecklers", "kind": "social", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Tarnport", "text": "**Spectacle Night** (The Playhouse, Tarnport). A clique of rich students wrecks the Playhouse's spectacle nights from the boxes, and their leader's father has offered to buy the lease if the company can't fill the house. Zhessa Rilnar, who runs the spectacle, needs someone to deal with the boxes so the next night goes off perfectly. Reward: 50 florins, free seats at the Playhouse, and a lesson in stage illusion from Zhessa."}, {"id": "th1_wortwell_buyer", "kind": "social", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Wortwell", "text": "**Half Price or Nothing** (The Green, Wortwell). A silky buyer from a great Tarnport merchant house has told Wortwell to sell its season of healing draughts at half price or lose the house's trade; the Academy's draughts come from Wortwell too. Tetha the White, the headwoman, needs an outsider to learn what the buyer is after and break the pressure. Reward: 60 florins and a standing welcome in every Wortwell kitchen."}, {"id": "th1_long_table_feud", "kind": "social", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Healers' Isle", "text": "**Peace at the Long Table** (The Long Table, Healers' Isle). A feud between a Battle Mage crew and an Artificer crew has turned dangerous: someone tampered with a practice ward and a Second-Year was carried in burned. Noemi Merel, who keeps the Long Table, wants a lasting peace and the tamperer to own up. Reward: 50 florins and Noemi's personal gratitude, which comes with cake."}, {"id": "th1_lordling_familiar", "kind": "social", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Dimbly Hatchery", "text": "**Not For Sale** (The Runs, Dimbly Hatchery). A spoiled young lordling insists on buying a pseudodragon, though the Dimblys never sell a familiar, and has hinted his family could make trouble for the village. Teo Dimbly wants him talked round, or matched with a creature that truly chooses him, before his family's men arrive. Reward: 45 florins and an afternoon on the Runs with Teo, meeting the young creatures that might one day choose you."}, {"id": "th1_pier_wages", "kind": "social", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Tarnport", "text": "**Spells for Pennies** (The Long Pier, Tarnport). A smug Third-Year hires out lifting spells on the Long Pier for pennies, taking work from dockhands; two students have been thrown in the lake and the dockhands talk of burning the Academy skiffs. Their foreman wants an agreement on spellwork on the pier before his patience ends. Reward: 40 florins and a dinner with the dock crews, which is louder than it sounds."}, {"id": "th1_hearth_spirit", "kind": "social", "rank": "first", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Summoners' Isle", "text": "**The Guest Who Won't Leave** (Summoners' Hall, Summoners' Isle). Someone called a proud fire spirit into Summoners' Hall's great hearth and couldn't send it back; it demands tribute or it will burn the rafters, and its caller is too frightened to own up. Nadra Solven thinks a newcomer can talk it home before the masters do it the hard way. Reward: 50 florins and a fire spirit's favor, which keeps you warm on any winter crossing."}, {"id": "th2_coppice_wolves", "kind": "combat", "rank": "second", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Hollin Coppice", "text": "**Wolves in the Old Groves** (The Old Groves, Hollin Coppice). A wolf pack hunts the edges of Hollin Coppice's old groves at dusk; it has pulled down two of Burlwick's donkeys and chased a cutter up a tree. A widowed cutter who works the far rings alone says they will soon take a person. The pack must be killed or driven out. Reward: 110 florins, a seasoned witchwood blank, and the cutter's introduction to the old gnome houses on Workshop Row."}, {"id": "th2_bog_hag", "kind": "combat", "rank": "second", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "The Bramblewood", "text": "**The Crying in the Bog** (The Bog Bridge, The Bramblewood). Gatherers crossing the Bog Bridge after dark hear a child crying in the bog, and two who followed it never came back. A green hag is mimicking voices to draw people off the path. A frightened Wortwell mother whose eldest was one of them begs the Academy to deal with the hag and find the missing. Reward: 120 florins and a Wortwell family's gratitude: a place at their table whenever you are in the village."}, {"id": "th2_tower_armor", "kind": "combat", "rank": "second", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "The White Tower", "text": "**The Armor in the Entry Hall** (Tower Entry, The White Tower). The White Tower's animated armor now attacks anyone who crosses the entry hall threshold. A cocky Fourth-Year with a bandaged arm wants company to find out what woke them, and to put the armor down or make it stand aside so the way in is open. Reward: 110 florins and the Fourth-Year's company on the next climb into the White Tower."}, {"id": "th2_blink_hounds", "kind": "combat", "rank": "second", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "The Wild Magic Badlands", "text": "**Hounds on the Stoneflats** (The Stoneflats, The Wild Magic Badlands). A hard-bitten old gatherer will show students where the pack runs if they kill or break it so the flats can be worked again. Reward: 120 florins and a day on the Stoneflats with the old gatherer, learning where the thunderglass falls."}, {"id": "th2_canal_nixies", "kind": "combat", "rank": "second", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Burlwick", "text": "**Pulled Under at the Quay** (The Canal Quay, Burlwick). A bitter bargeman who lost his brother won't sail until they're gone, and the village's glass and timber waits on the quay. Kill them or drive them back down the canal. Reward: 110 florins and free passage on any Burlwick barge."}]

offer_pool_tarnholme_data_003.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "th2_shock_rock_storm", "kind": "combat", "rank": "second", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Battle Mages' Isle", "text": "**What the Storm Left** (Shock-Rock, Battle Mages' Isle). A storm elemental left behind when the Battle Mages pulled down the last magic storm strikes anyone who lands on Shock-Rock, and two students were burned last week. A swaggering Fourth-Year swears it's harmless. It must be destroyed or sent off so the islet is safe to train on. Reward: 110 florins and a place on Shock-Rock itself for the next storm-pulling."}, {"id": "th2_rigged_rings", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "second", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Battle Mages' Isle", "text": "**The Wards Keep Failing** (The Dueling Rings, Battle Mages' Isle). Three times this month a ward in the Dueling Rings has failed mid-bout and hurt a favorite for the Dueling Tournament. Inès ni Castellar, the Tevantian duelist who means to win it, wants to beat her rivals fairly and wants the tamperer caught before the Tournament. Reward: 150 florins and a rapier lesson from Inès, who doesn't give them often."}, {"id": "th2_ropewalk_suitor", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "second", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Tarnport", "text": "**Is She Charmed?** (The Ropewalk, Tarnport). A Ropewalk merchant family is about to marry its youngest daughter to a charming southern lord nobody has heard of; she met him a month ago and can't bear to be out of his sight. Her grandmother is sure she's charmed and wants a mage to learn what was done, and by whom, and break it before the wedding. Reward: 150 florins and dinner at the grandmother's house on the Ropewalk, where half the merchant families of Tarnport come to call."}, {"id": "th2_stone_farmhands", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "second", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "The Wild Magic Badlands", "text": "**Stone in the Fields** (The Redbreak, The Wild Magic Badlands). Two Redbreak farmhands were found turned to stone after the last magic storm, but a farm wife says no storm leaves footprints, and someone was seen selling little bags of grey dust to gatherers. She wants whoever is behind it stopped and the farmhands restored or their fate learned. Reward: 120 florins and the Redbreak farms' welcome: a bed and supper there whenever the badlands turn rough."}, {"id": "th2_hexed_blade", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "second", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Tarnport", "text": "**The Blade That Bites Back** (Cinder Yard, Tarnport). A Third-Year nearly lost a hand to a knife that cut far too deep and wouldn't stop bleeding, carried by a cutthroat no older than sixteen. Hexed blades are turning up across Tarnport; someone in Cinder Yard is forging them. Find the hexsmith and stop the sales. Reward: 130 florins and a salve that closes cursed wounds."}, {"id": "th2_pit_spy", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "second", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Artificers' Isle", "text": "**Something in the Pit Is Watching** (The Piece Pit, Artificers' Isle). Designs from the Piece Pit turn up for sale in Tarnport before their makers finish them, and Ingrith Dunmar, head of the College of Artificers, found a construct eye in the heap that follows people. She wants the spy, and whoever buys from them, found. Reward: 150 florins and a week's pick of the Claw's best parts in the Piece Pit."}, {"id": "th2_sick_drakelings", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "second", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Dimbly Hatchery", "text": "**The Drakelings Are Dying** (The Lofts, Dimbly Hatchery). Young drakelings in the Lofts are sickening and two have died; only those bought by students are ill. A tearful Dimbly cousin who raised them is sure someone wants the best stock gone. Find the cause and the poisoner, and save the survivors. Reward: 120 florins and a drakeling that has chosen you, if one does."}, {"id": "th2_stolen_pennant", "kind": "social", "rank": "second", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Tarnport", "text": "**The Stolen Pennant** (The Pennant Market, Tarnport). A merchant house's silk pennant was taken in the night from its line over the Pennant Market; the ward was unpicked by someone who knew magic. The theatrical heiress blames a rival house and says her father will start a trade war if it isn't back by market day. Reward: 150 florins and the heiress's patronage, which starts with a seat in her family's box at the Playhouse."}, {"id": "th2_false_archmage", "kind": "social", "rank": "second", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Burlwick", "text": "**The Great Mage at the Clearwater** (The Clearwater, Burlwick). A famous traveling mage has taken rooms at the Clearwater, and the old workshops are paying him for the chance to make his focus. An overeager workshop owner is starting to wonder why his staff is so new and his spells so few. Expose the truth before anyone pays him more. Reward: 120 florins and a focus fitted at cost."}, {"id": "th2_noble_first", "kind": "social", "rank": "second", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Healers' Isle", "text": "**Everyone Gets a Bed** (The Warm Pools, Healers' Isle). A haughty noblewoman at Healers' Isle demands her cursed son be treated before a farmer's dying child who came first, and her armed guards are starting to push. Teddy Ambrose needs help keeping the peace without breaking the isle's one rule, so both are treated and the noblewoman leaves without a grudge. Reward: 120 florins and Teddy Ambrose's invitation to his next party, which will be the best on the islands."}, {"id": "th2_greedy_cutterboss", "kind": "social", "rank": "second", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Hollin Coppice", "text": "**Ask the Trees** (The Cutting Rings, Hollin Coppice). A Burlwick cutter-boss with a huge order has been taking rods from the rings without asking the trees, and an ancient treant has warned it will walk into the village if it happens again. Broker terms between them so nobody is crushed. Reward: 130 florins and a rod the treant gives freely, which is worth far more."}, {"id": "th2_thrown_bout", "kind": "social", "rank": "second", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Tarnport", "text": "**Lose or Else** (The Ballast, Tarnport). A Second-Year who fights for coin in the Ballast's ring owes the bookie more than she can pay, and he has told her to lose her next bout in the third round or have the debt collected another way. She won't go to the masters. She needs out from under him without throwing the bout or getting hurt. Reward: 100 florins, a ringside seat at the Ballast whenever she fights, and her in your corner if you ever step into the ring."}, {"id": "th2_shut_door", "kind": "social", "rank": "second", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "The Glowcaves", "text": "**Close the Door** (The Meeting Hall, The Glowcaves). A drunk, angry Wortwell brewer smashed a bed of caps in the Glowcaves, and the myconid colony is deciding whether to close the Trading Room door to Wortwell forever; a stern young myconid wants it shut. Persuade the colony to keep it open and the brewer to make amends. Reward: 120 florins and a story-trade with Ombrel in the Trading Room, who has stories from the deep no surface folk have heard."}, {"id": "th3_tower_golem", "kind": "combat", "rank": "third", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "The White Tower", "text": "**The Iron Man in the Workshop** (The Workshop, The White Tower). The White Tower's iron golem, still for forty years, has begun to move, stamping the floor flat around the artificer's last unfinished work and smashing students' constructs. A grey-bearded Artificer master wants it destroyed or stilled without harming what it guards. Reward: 300 florins and a share of what the workshop holds."}]

offer_pool_tarnholme_data_004.name: offer_pool_tarnholme_data_004
offer_pool_tarnholme_data_004.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "th3_gulley_ants", "kind": "combat", "rank": "third", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "The Wild Magic Badlands", "text": "**The Hill in the Gulleys** (The Gulleys, The Wild Magic Badlands). Dog-sized giant ants have built a hill at the head of the Gulleys and swarm the channels where gatherers shelter; two have been dragged into the nest. Thera Pel, who catches beasts in the badlands, will show a crew the way to the queen for good money, but won't go in. Destroy the nest or kill the queen. Reward: 280 florins and a jar of the queen's jelly, which Ryel the Brewer will buy at a good price."}, {"id": "th3_windfall_bugbears", "kind": "combat", "rank": "third", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Hollin Coppice", "text": "**Ambush at the Windfall** (The Windfall, Hollin Coppice). A bugbear war-band camps in the Windfall and ambushes Burlwick's cutters, dragging them off for ransom or worse. A burly cutter-wife has gone in alone once and means to go again. Break the war-band and free its captives. Reward: 300 florins and a feast at the Clearwater, thrown by the cutters you brought home."}, {"id": "th3_sumps_cutthroats", "kind": "combat", "rank": "third", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Tarnport", "text": "**Somebody Wants Him Dead** (The Sumps, Tarnport). A pawnbroker in the Sumps said aloud who sold him a stolen Academy relic, and hired cutthroats are now searching for him. He has locked himself in his cellar with a crossbow and begs the Academy for protection: keep him alive and beat or drive off the cutthroats. Reward: 260 florins and the name of whoever sold the relic."}, {"id": "th3_shambling_mound", "kind": "combat", "rank": "third", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "The Bramblewood", "text": "**The Thing in the Thornbrakes** (The Thornbrakes, The Bramblewood). A shambling mound has risen in the heart of the thornbrakes and last week took a Wortwell gatherer. A grim gatherer who lost a cousin to it wants it destroyed, but Aelwen will be furious if the thornbrakes burn, so it must be done without setting them alight. Reward: 260 florins and Aelwen's welcome at the Pixie Dell."}, {"id": "th3_quiet_ward_shadows", "kind": "combat", "rank": "third", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Healers' Isle", "text": "**Shadows on the Lawns** (The Resting-Lawns, Healers' Isle). A curse that came loose from a badlands patient has taken shape as shadows that slide out of the Quiet Ward at night and drain sleeping patients; three grow weaker each morning. A night nurse asks for students who can destroy them. Reward: 280 florins and the Healers' gratitude, which means a bed anywhere on the isle."}, {"id": "th3_hearts_cut", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "third", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "The Wild Magic Badlands", "text": "**No Heart in Him** (The Spires, The Wild Magic Badlands). A gatherer was found below the Spires with his heart cut cleanly out, and two more have gone missing; gatherers whisper of masked people in bone. A sharp-tongued gatherer who once crewed with Thera Pel will tell what she saw if someone listens. Learn who is killing them and what they do with the hearts. Reward: 300 florins and the gatherers' trust, which means a guide into the badlands whenever you ask."}, {"id": "th3_drained_patient", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "third", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Healers' Isle", "text": "**Someone Drank Him** (The Quiet Ward, Healers' Isle). A young Tarnport sailor lies in the Quiet Ward with his strength drained by magic until he looks an old man, and he isn't the first this month. Ozan Thrane, who heads the College of Healers, wants whoever is draining people found and stopped. Reward: 300 florins and Ozan Thrane's open door: an hour of the Head of Healers' time whenever you need it."}, {"id": "th3_cut_pages", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "third", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "The Main Island", "text": "**The Missing Pages** (The Library, The Main Island). Someone has cut pages out of every account of the Siege of Tarnholme in the Library, always those about the rogue mages' leader. Jovran Devray, the Third-Year Healer and sleuth, is sure it's someone inside the Academy and wants help catching them and finding the pages. Reward: 250 florins and Jovran's help on any mystery you bring him."}, {"id": "th3_caged_beasts", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "third", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Tarnport", "text": "**Cages in the Hold** (The Long Pier, Tarnport). A ship's surgeon found a cage of drugged volucats in her own ship's hold, bound south. Someone is catching wild familiar kinds and shipping them out on night barges, and they are dying in the cages. She trusts no one in the port. Find the smugglers, break their route and free the creatures. Reward: 280 florins and the surgeon's friendship, which comes with a ship's berth."}, {"id": "th3_copied_notebooks", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "third", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "The White Tower", "text": "**Someone Has Been Reading Her Notes** (Library Level, The White Tower). Someone is slipping past the White Tower's constructs into its library and copying the dead artificer's notebooks, some of it dangerous. A stiff old Artificer master wants the copyist found and the stolen pages recovered. Reward: 280 florins and one page of the artificer's own notes."}, {"id": "th3_dead_carver", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "third", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Burlwick", "text": "**The Carver's Last Staff** (The Foci Market, Burlwick). Burlwick's finest witchwood carver was found dead at his bench, and the staff he spent a year on is gone; three mages had been pestering him for it. His sharp-eyed widow says he never fell in his life. She wants his killer found and the staff back. Reward: 300 florins and the widow's pick of his remaining work."}, {"id": "th3_harbor_bribe", "kind": "social", "rank": "third", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Tarnport", "text": "**The Academy's Contract** (The Long Pier, Tarnport). The Academy's contract with the Harbor Council is up for renewal, and one vain, ambitious councillor is holding it up and hinting at a private gift. A College Head sends students to get it renewed without paying a bribe or starting a war with the port. Reward: 280 florins and the College's thanks, which means you speak for Tarnholme in town next time."}, {"id": "th3_satire_threats", "kind": "social", "rank": "third", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Tarnport", "text": "**Don't Play the Siege** (The Playhouse, Tarnport). The Playhouse company is rehearsing a satire of the Siege of Tarnholme, and someone has left threats: a burned costume, a dead crow in a prop crown, a note promising the theater will freeze. Orlando Fitch won't be frightened off, but the rest of the company is. Find the threatener so the play goes on. Reward: 250 florins, opening-night seats, and a drink with the company at Backstage afterward."}, {"id": "th3_brewers_feud", "kind": "social", "rank": "third", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Wortwell", "text": "**Two Houses** (The Tun and Tale, Wortwell). Wortwell's two big potion houses have feuded for a generation, and now one's heir and the other's daughter want to marry. Someone is poisoning both houses' batches, and a poisoned healing draught could kill someone in Tarnport. A lovesick young brewer begs help: find the poisoner and bring the houses to peace. Reward: 260 florins and a wedding invitation."}]

offer_pool_tarnholme_data_005.name: offer_pool_tarnholme_data_005
offer_pool_tarnholme_data_005.script:
skip = true
const data = [{"id": "th3_insulted_spirit", "kind": "social", "rank": "third", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Summoners' Isle", "text": "**Apologize to the Mountain** (The Run, Summoners' Isle). A great earth spirit called up for a trial on the Run was insulted by the haughty Third-Year who called it, and it refuses to go home, sinking the maze into the ground. His College is furious. Get him to apologize, or bargain the spirit home another way, so the Run stops sinking. Reward: 260 florins and a stone from the spirit, which never wears down."}, {"id": "th3_real_duel", "kind": "social", "rank": "third", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Battle Mages' Isle", "text": "**First Blood or Worse** (Battle Mages' Hall, Battle Mages' Isle). A visiting Tevantian noble has challenged Temyn Raskwood, the Third-Year dueling champion, to a real duel, steel and magic with no wards, over an insult Temyn swears he never gave. His friends want the challenge withdrawn without calling him a coward, and nobody killed. Reward: 280 florins and Temyn's friendship, which is worth a lot on the islands."}, {"id": "th3_collector_thieves", "kind": "social", "rank": "third", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Artificers' Isle", "text": "**Not For Any Price** (The Gallery, Artificers' Isle). Olya, the Fourth-Year Artificer, wants him made to stop before he hires someone worse. Reward: 260 florins and a small construct Olya builds for you."}, {"id": "th4_cursed_wolves", "kind": "combat", "rank": "fourth", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Cold Kell Mountain", "text": "**Ember Eyes in the Pines** (The Lower Pines, Cold Kell Mountain). The huge black wolves of Cold Kell Mountain, eyes like embers, have come down from the Lower Pines and are killing far beyond their old range: sheep, a charcoal-burner, a Burlwick cutter. Reward: 600 florins and a cursed wolf's pelt, cleansed by the Healers."}, {"id": "th4_ravine_werewolves", "kind": "combat", "rank": "fourth", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Cold Kell Mountain", "text": "**Claws in the Ravines** (The Ravines, Cold Kell Mountain). Werewolves of the Heart-Eaters, the rogue mages who besieged Tarnholme thirty years ago and took a wolf's shape for good, hold the Ravines on Cold Kell Mountain. A grim young Battle Mage, Torvald Haig's adjutant, is leading Fourth-Years in to break their hold; silver and fire help. Reward: 700 florins and a werewolf pelt cloak, which turns aside shape-changing magic."}, {"id": "th4_hunt_dead", "kind": "combat", "rank": "fourth", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Cold Kell Mountain", "text": "**They Run With the Pack** (The High Slopes, Cold Kell Mountain). On Cold Kell Mountain's High Slopes, those the Heart-Eaters killed in their Hunt rise again and run with the pack. A shaking trapper from Kittle Crags saw his murdered partner loping beside the wolves and wants him laid to rest. The dead are many and the snow is deep. Reward: 600 florins and a place at the trapper's fire in Kittle Crags, where he tells what he has seen on the mountain."}, {"id": "th4_lake_serpent", "kind": "combat", "rank": "fourth", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Tarnport", "text": "**Something Under the Skiffs** (The Long Pier, Tarnport). A lake serpent longer than a ship has come up from the Tarn Sea and overturned two skiffs between the Long Pier and the Main Island. A barrel-shaped skiffman refuses to take students across until it's dealt with. Kill it or drive it back down the river to the sea. Reward: 650 florins and the skiffmen's free passage, for life."}, {"id": "th4_clay_golem", "kind": "combat", "rank": "fourth", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Burlwick", "text": "**The Guardian Got Loose** (Workshop Row, Burlwick). A clay golem built to guard one of Burlwick's oldest workshops has broken its binding and is tearing Workshop Row apart; the village has fled to the Clearwater. Its gnome maker says it won't stop until broken and doesn't feel spells as people do. Destroy or rebind it before the Row is leveled. Reward: 600 florins and the gnome master's finest work, made to order."}, {"id": "th4_isle_raiders", "kind": "combat", "rank": "fourth", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Battle Mages' Isle", "text": "**Raiders on the Leaping-Stones** (The Leaping-Stones, Battle Mages' Isle). Twice this month Heart-Eaters, the rogue mages who besieged Tarnholme thirty years ago, have crossed the shallows by night to strike students on the Leaping-Stones of Battle Mages' Isle. A bandaged Tevantian duelist is organizing Fourth-Years to wait for the next raid and take one raider alive for questioning. Reward: 650 florins and the Battle Mages' crimson honor-cord."}, {"id": "th4_academy_traitor", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "fourth", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "The Main Island", "text": "**Who Is Telling Them?** (The Masters' Wing, The Main Island). Someone inside Tarnholme is passing word to the Heart-Eaters, the rogue mages who besieged Tarnholme thirty years ago: raids hit only when the muster is away, and Practica crews are ambushed on roads only they knew. Ottoline Fane quietly asks trusted Fourth-Years to find the traitor, and why, without frightening the school. Reward: 800 florins and dinner in the Masters' Wing with Ottoline Fane, who has a great deal to say to a student she trusts."}, {"id": "th4_kell_curse", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "fourth", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Cold Kell Mountain", "text": "**What Was Done at the Kell** (The Cold Kell, Cold Kell Mountain). A sorrowful old pilgrim and the Healers want to learn what was done, and to whom, and what it would take to break the curse. Reward: 750 florins and the old pilgrim's company on the climb to the shrine."}, {"id": "th4_debt_buyer", "kind": "investigation", "rank": "fourth", "region": "Jade Tarn", "location": "Tarnport", "text": "**The Debt Will Be Forgiven** (The Sumps, Tarnport).
